chapters.title: Chapter 351: Robot Army
paragraphs: “Why?”
“As long as you lend me an a-rank defense building, and as long as I can block this war building, I won’t lose!”
“Once the Divine Kingdom Core is seized, Your Lordship, your divine kingdom’s coordinates will also be at risk of exposure!”
“I am willing to return all the rewards of this Divine Kingdom War!”
“I am willing to sign a true Subordinate God Contract!”
“I am willing to become your servant!”
“I just want to live!”
His voice had already become extremely hoarse.
Watching the Cannibal Tribe army break through the final line of defense and frantically slaughter his believers, he could only issue a final prayer.
Hoping that his voice could reach Yang Fan’s ears.
Yang Fan could hear it, of course.
Not only could he hear it.
He could also take in every move of the other party at a glance.
Yet at this moment, Yang Fan, sitting high upon his divine throne, still wore a calm expression without the slightest ripple.
He merely watched all of this quietly, even feeling somewhat bored.
For those proxy demigods on The Frontline, the meaning of their existence was inherently to bear the war risks for the gods.
In the eyes of the vast majority of gods, they were never comrades, but tools.
Tools to help the gods disperse risks and acquire benefits.
And a wealth jointly controlled by the entire Human Race divine class.
If not for considering the interests of other gods and the federation’s existing rules, Yang Fan would have even wanted to take all these proxy demigods under his command.
In that case, how could he actively break the rules he formulated for just one of them.
The time flow speed inside the divine kingdom far exceeded reality.
In Yang Fan’s eyes, this war seemed to have been pressed with an acceleration button.
Scene after scene flashed by rapidly like slides.
Soon, the final line of defense completely collapsed.
Countless Cannibal Tribe believers let out excited roars, waving massive spiked clubs as they rushed into the Divine Kingdom Core area.
A large number of Human Race believers were slaughtered.
Fresh blood dyed the entire earth red.
The divine aura on that Human Race Demigod’s body also grew increasingly weak.
In the end, accompanied by the falling of the very last believer.
His figure slowly transformed into countless points of light, completely dissipating between heaven and earth.
A demigod had fallen just like that.
The war ended.
The entire Cannibal Tribe army erupted into deafening cheers.
They raised high that Human Race Divine Kingdom Core that was over a person’s height, their faces filled with wild joy.
As long as it was brought back to the divine kingdom.
This battle would be completely over.
However, at this very moment.
Boom——
The Void Realm suddenly tore apart.
A spatial rift spanning across the horizon suddenly appeared.
The next second, cold steel figures slowly walked out from the rift.
Step!
Step!
Step!
The neat and uniform footsteps seemed to be on the exact same beat.
Ten million, twenty million, fifty million.
One hundred million, two hundred million...
Dense Robot Soldiers, resembling a boundless steel torrent, continuously poured out from the spatial rift.
Their movements were neat, without the slightest noise.
Every single robot was covered in dark silver battle armor.
On the surface of the armor, streaks of purple energy lines constantly flowed, exuding a cold and dangerous light.
They held silver-white laser guns.
Their gun barrels lifted simultaneously, and hundreds of millions of barrels locked onto the entire battlefield almost at the exact same time.
However, this was not the most shocking part.
Behind the robot legion.
Towering steel giants standing as high as a thousand zhang slowly stepped out from the spatial rift.
Their entire bodies were forged from special alloys, and their eyes lit up with scarlet light.
Dense energy circuits covered their body surfaces.
Inside each steel giant, hundreds of robots controlled it simultaneously.
Boom!
The first steel giant landed, causing the entire divine kingdom to vibrate violently.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Following that, one steel giant after another continuously stepped out of the spatial rift.
With every step taken, the earth collapsed by hundreds of zhang.
Mountains shattered, and rivers rolled backward.
The steel torrent and the giant legion converged together, resembling a world-destroying legion.
Compared to them, those Cannibal Tribe believers who had just achieved victory were as tiny as a group of ants.
Just observing with the naked eye was enough to know that both sides were simply not existences of the same level.
The entire battlefield instantly fell into a dead silence.
All Cannibal Tribe believers subconsciously stopped in their tracks.
Staring blankly at this steel legion before them, their brains went completely blank.
They simply didn’t know what had happened.
Wasn’t the Divine Kingdom War already won?
The Divine Kingdom Core had already been captured in their hands.
Then where did these Mechanical armies in front of them come from?
Just as they were dazed.
A hurried and terrified Divine Decree suddenly exploded in the minds of all Cannibal Tribe believers.
“Run!”
“Bring back the Divine Kingdom Core!”
“As long as you return to the divine kingdom, everything is still in time!”
Within the Cannibal Demigod’s voice, there was even a trace of undisguisable panic.
Hearing the Divine Decree, all Cannibal Tribe believers finally reacted.
They didn’t even care to tidy up their formation.
Casting away their armor and weapons, hugging that Divine Kingdom Core, they fled wildly toward the edge of the divine kingdom.
The next moment.
The Robot Army simultaneously raised the Smart Weapon in their hands.
Hum——
The gun barrels lit up with a dazzling purple-white light.
Accompanied by the continuous convergence of energy, the entire battlefield seemed to quiet down for a split second.
Following closely, countless laser beams poured out like a rainstorm!
Swish! Swish! Swish!
Dense beams of light intertwined into a giant web of death covering the heavens and earth, sweeping toward the Cannibal Tribe army.
“Dodge quickly!”
A Cannibal Tribe member just let out an angry roar.
The next moment, a laser beam pierced straight through his chest.
However, this was merely the beginning.
Countless beams of light followed one after another.
Puff! Puff! Puff!
The Cannibal Tribe’s proud Physical Body was as fragile as paper in front of these Smart Weapons.
Body after body was instantly pierced through.
Some heads exploded.
Some chests were directly pierced through.
Even more, under the extremely dense firepower coverage, their entire bodies were beaten to pieces.
Even if their hearts had already been pierced and they were completely dead.
The subsequent pouring lasers continued to fall endlessly.
In just a few breaths, corpse after corpse was blasted into balls of minced meat, unable to leave even complete remains.
Across the entire battlefield, flesh and blood flew everywhere.
Only that a-rank war building, that huge meatball constantly writhing like a mountain of flesh, still stubbornly blocked the very front.
Countless lasers bombarded its surface.
Large patches of flesh writhed frantically, continuously repairing the injuries.
But as time passed, the surface of the meatball gradually glowed with a dazzling crimson red, and billows of white smoke continuously rose.
Clearly, this a-rank war building was also about to reach its bearing limit.
Just at this moment, all Robot Soldiers seemed to receive an order simultaneously, stopping their shooting in unison.
The battlefield instantly quieted down.
The Cannibal Tribe believers who survived by a fluke finally let out a long sigh of relief.
“Blocked!”
“Quick!”
“Continue retreating!”

chapters.title: Chapter 352: Killing Two Birds with One Stone
paragraphs: They hid behind the a-rank war building, clutching the Divine Kingdom Core, and fled frantically toward the spatial passage.
However, at this very moment.
Thousands of steel giants standing behind the robot army simultaneously raised their right arms.
Hum—
A low, rumbling sound resonated throughout the heavens and earth.
Visible air began to gather frantically and compress continuously.
The entire sky seemed to sprout patches of transparent, distorted areas.
In front of the arms of the thousands of steel giants, space vibrated violently.
Terrifying pressure continued to condense.
It was as if every steel giant was holding up an invisible mountain.
The next second.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!
Thousands of air cannons, compressed to the extreme, fired simultaneously!
There was no flash of fire, no meteor.
Their trajectories were almost impossible to track with the naked eye.
Yet the moment the air cannons flew out, the sky seemed to be torn apart by an invisible force.
The space along their path vibrated continuously, emitting piercing sonic booms.
The earth shook violently, and wild winds swept across the world.
The fleeing Cannibal Tribe believers looked up instinctively.
They saw nothing.
Yet it felt as if invisible giant mountains were crashing down from the Nine Heavens.
The terrifying sense of oppression made it difficult for them to even breathe.
“Help!”
“My God, save me!”
“Is this divine retribution?!”
Countless Cannibal Tribe members screamed in terror, frantically trying to hide beneath the a-rank war building.
The next instant, the air cannons descended with a roar.
Rumble—
The entire divine kingdom seemed to be facing the apocalypse.
Mountains collapsed, rivers broke, and the earth continuously caved in.
Massive cracks spread wildly.
In just a single breath.
Nearly one-third of the entire divine kingdom was reduced to ruins.
And at the location where the Cannibal Tribe was most concentrated, a massive ravine tens of thousands of miles long cut straight through the entire land.
It was as if divine retribution had split the entire divine kingdom in two.
Even the surface of that Human Race Divine Kingdom Core had developed a faint crack.
And that a-rank war building was blasted into scattered gore in the very first moment.
As the smoke and dust gradually dissipated.
In the entire battlefield, there was no longer a single living Cannibal Tribe member.
Except for a solitary Divine Kingdom Core floating in mid-air.
There was nothing else of value to be found in the entire divine kingdom.
Inside the divine temple.
Yang Fan watched this scene, a trace of surprise flashing in his eyes.
This was the first time he had truly witnessed the war power of his divine kingdom since his Breakthrough to become a god.
Moreover, what was before him were merely Smart Weapons.
The true Intelligent Life had not even participated in the battle personally.
If these Smart Weapons were all controlled by Intelligent Life.
Their combat power would rise by another level.
Just then, Yang Da walked forward with a slightly embarrassed expression.
“Master.”
“This time, it was my miscalculation.”
“The laws of heaven and earth in a demigod’s divine kingdom are too fragile; they simply cannot withstand this level of warfare.”
“Fortunately, only a portion of the intelligent mechs were sent out for testing this time.”
“If they had all been deployed to the battlefield...”
“That Divine Kingdom Core would likely have been destroyed along with them.”
Yang Fan nodded in satisfaction.
Although his believers had not entered the battlefield.
These Smart Weapons created by the Mechanical Civilization had already far exceeded the level that an ordinary demigod could withstand.
Especially with the blessing of the Hundred-fold Evolution Talent.
These expensive Smart Weapons could almost be mass-produced.
Even if they were only controlled by ordinary robots purchased from the Divine Shop.
The power they unleashed was by no means something an ordinary demigod could contend with.
“No matter.”
Yang Fan waved his hand lightly.
“Just be more careful next time.”
“Bring the Divine Kingdom Core back first.”
“Yes, Master.”
As the last Cannibal Tribe believer died within the divine kingdom.
The spatial passage connecting the two divine kingdoms had closed.
Those robot armies could no longer continue to pursue and enter the Cannibal Tribe’s divine kingdom.
Otherwise, Yang Fan wouldn’t have minded harvesting another Alien Demigod’s Divine Kingdom Core while he was at it.
Meanwhile.
On the other side, the Cannibal Demigod stood blankly at the location of his own Divine Kingdom Core.
His massive body was trembling slightly at this moment.
In his eyes, fear, confusion, lingering fear, and relief were constantly intertwined.
“This... what on earth is going on?”
“The god behind that Human Demigod absolutely cannot be just a low-ranking god!”
“Since he possesses such strength, why would he participate in an agent war of this level?”
“Why did he insist on waiting until his Subordinate God was dead before taking action?”
“What is the point of doing this?”
The more he thought about it, the more bizarre it seemed, and the growing unease in his heart became stronger.
After a moment of silence, he did not dare to hesitate in the slightest and immediately sent a communication request to his main god.
Shortly after the communication ended.
A vast divine consciousness descended into the Cannibal Demigod’s divine kingdom.
Divine Might permeated the area.
The believers of the entire divine kingdom knelt on the ground, not daring to lift their heads.
That Cannibal God looked down over the entire divine kingdom, sensing the changes within it, and his brows could not help but furrow slightly.
“What is going on?”
“Where is the Human Demigod’s Divine Kingdom Core?”
“And the a-rank war building I lent you—the Meat-Bomb Chariot—why is it gone too?”
In every agent war, he would give his Subordinate God as much support as possible.
And his Subordinate God would also report the situation on the The Frontline in real-time.

Just a short while ago, the other party had told him that the war was nearing its end and that he only needed to break through the last line of defense to completely seize the Human Demigod’s Divine Kingdom Core.
But now, when he personally descended into the divine kingdom, he found that the situation was completely different from what he had imagined.
A powerful Mental Energy swept across.
A large number of Cannibal Tribe believers in the divine kingdom had disappeared.
And most importantly.
That Divine Kingdom Core, which should have been brought back, and the a-rank war building he had lent out, were both completely absent from the divine kingdom.
“My Lord God.”
“This is the entire sequence of events.”
The Cannibal Demigod knelt respectfully on the ground.
Then, he activated the Cannibal Tribe’s unique neural resonance ability, transmitting the memories shared by all believers during the war, scene by scene, to his main god.
A moment later, the Cannibal God slowly opened his eyes, his expression having become extremely grim.
“You mean...”
“You had already killed that Human Demigod.”
“And only after the other party had completely fallen did the god behind him choose to make a move?”
“Yes.”
The Cannibal Demigod nodded hurriedly.
“I also cannot understand it.”

“Since the other party possessed such strength, even if they had only provided support with a few Smart Weapons, or lent out one a-rank war building, I would have had absolutely no chance of winning.”
“Yet the other party waited until I had won before taking action.”
“I truly cannot understand.”
Hearing this, the Cannibal God slowly fell into deep thought.
A moment later, a flash of insight suddenly appeared in his eyes.
“In order to avoid exposing his own divine kingdom coordinates, sending non-believer combat units to retrieve the Divine Kingdom Core is plausible.”
“However...”
“If that is the case, why not save him from the beginning?”
“Unless... that Human Demigod had already offended the god behind him.”
“The other party just happened to use your hand to eliminate him.”
“In this way, he leaves no handle for anyone to grasp, and he can still retrieve the Divine Kingdom Core at the end, ensuring his own coordinates are not leaked.”
“It really is killing two birds with one stone.”

chapters.title: Chapter 353: Alien God Coordinates Deduction Successful
paragraphs: The Cannibal Demigod listened and nodded repeatedly, finding it more and more reasonable the more he thought about it.
“Wise, Lord God!”
“The Human Race is famously known among all races for its complex rules and endless scheming.”
“What they are best at is infighting.”
“This is most likely the case.”
Listening to the flattery of his subordinate, that Cannibal God gently nodded, and then waved his hand.
“Forget it, your luck can be considered pretty good this time.”
“At least under the protection of the divine kingdom rules, you saved your own life.”
“For the next year, you don’t need to participate in the proxy war anymore.”
“Rest assured in recovering the Origin Qi of the divine kingdom, and let the believers multiply and thrive.”
“As for that a-rank war building...”
Speaking of this, a flash of heartache was clearly visible in the depths of the Cannibal God’s eyes.
After a few breaths of silence, he still slowly said: “You don’t need to compensate anymore.”
Hearing these words, the Cannibal Demigod was instantly relieved.
That was an a-rank war building, which was a considerable fortune even for a god.
In fact, when this Cannibal God was willing to lend the Meat Bullet Chariot to his Subordinate God back then, it was also after careful consideration.
Most of the proxy demigods of various races on The Frontline came from ordinary backgrounds, had no backing, and lacked much divine kingdom foundation.
An a-rank war building was enough to allow one of his Subordinate Gods to be invincible in the proxy war.
And as a god, he could continuously obtain stable returns through this.
This was originally a long-term investment that risked little for much, yet had an extremely high win rate.
Over so many years, the Meat Bullet Chariot had indeed won him proxy war after proxy war.
He had even long regarded it as a hen that could continuously lay golden eggs.
Who could have thought that this time, he would suffer such an unexpected defeat.
Wanting to earn back this loss,
he would probably have to win a dozen or so proxy wars in a row to do so.
Thinking of this, even as a god, he couldn’t help feeling a pang of heartache.
“Thank you, Lord God!”
The Cannibal Demigod solemnly saluted, his voice full of gratitude.
He knew very well in his heart that if he were really made to compensate for all the losses caused by this war,
let alone making a comeback, he would probably never have the chance to become a god in this lifetime.
Fortunately, his own god did not blame him for the responsibility.
This battle was not due to his poor command, but because his luck was too bad.
As time kept passing,
more and more demigods who signed the Subordinate God Contract with Yang Fan completed their own Divine Kingdom Wars.
After the war ended, the Otherworldly Collectors of the divine kingdom would enter the Alien Divine Kingdom at the first moment to clear wasteland.
After all high-value Resources were collected, the remaining lower-value Resources would be left to the other party according to the contract agreement.
Afterwards, under the witness of The Frontline Intelligent Life, both parties dissolved the Subordinate God Contract.
The entire process was very smooth.
The opponents of these demigods were originally selected by The Frontline Intelligent Life after massive data analysis.
Whether it was the opponent’s divine kingdom strength or war building configuration, evaluations would be conducted in advance.
Therefore, the win rate had always been maintained at an extremely high level.
About once every six or seven proxy wars would a failure occur.
Of course, for Yang Fan, the Divine Kingdom Core of Human Demigods had a higher value.
But Yang Fan was not anxious, he could just take it step by step.
As more and more demigods signed contracts with Yang Fan, his reputation gradually spread across The Frontline.
From no one believing it at the very beginning to now many demigods actively seeking connections.
In between, Li Tianheng also successively sent several batches of Subordinate God Contracts through robots.
Some people completed the war and dissolved the contract, and some new people joined.
Nowadays, the number of demigods who signed Subordinate God Contracts with Yang Fan had been maintained at a dynamic equilibrium.
There were a full sixty or so of them.
Besides this, the war in Li Tianheng’s divine kingdom was also very smooth.
With Yang Fan’s divine kingdom continuously providing corpse pill support, he would arrange for robots to send five or six Alien Demigod Divine Kingdom Cores almost every five days or so.
In just a few short months, the number of demigod Divine Kingdom Cores stored within Yang Fan’s divine kingdom had exceeded fifty.
He was not in a hurry to absorb these Divine Kingdom Cores.
After all, for the current Yang Fan,
the most important value of demigod Divine Kingdom Cores was the divine kingdom talent hidden within them.
As for Alien Divine Kingdom Cores, due to Origin Evolution requiring the consumption of a large amount of Origin power,
wanting to obtain Advanced talents was extremely difficult.
In most cases, what ultimately evolved were F-rank talents, and even D-rank talents rarely appeared.
Whenever a new Divine Kingdom Core entered the divine kingdom,
Yang Da would use the divine kingdom deduction card at the first moment to deduce the coordinates of the god behind it.
If it failed, it would be temporarily placed in the warehouse, waiting for Yang Fan to come to the divine kingdom and absorb them uniformly.
At this moment, in the Virtual World, Taichu City.
Yang Fan was holding Gu Le, lying quietly on the bed.
Just as Yang Fan closed his eyes to rest,
suddenly, Yang Da’s slightly excited voice rang out in his mind.
“Master!”
“Success!”
Yang Fan instantly opened his eyes.
Without any hesitation, his consciousness directly withdrew from the Virtual World and returned to the Real World.
Afterwards, he entered his own divine kingdom.
The next second, Yang Fan’s figure appeared in the Divine Kingdom Core area.
“Greetings, Master.”
Yang Da quickly hurried forward to greet him.
Only at this moment, this traditionally calm Intelligent Life’s voice rarely carried a hint of excitement.
“Congratulations, Master.”
“After several months of deducing over a hundred Alien Divine Kingdom Cores,”
“we have finally succeeded!”
Yang Fan’s eyes brightened slightly.
The next moment, as a god, a clear set of coordinates emerged in his mind.
That was a spatial positioning of a divine kingdom belonging to a powerful god.
However, aside from this, there was no other information at all.
This was also the limitation of the divine kingdom deduction card.
The god coordinates obtained through deduction would not come with any identity information or strength information.
Other than a set of coordinates, there were no other prompts whatsoever.
“Are there any other intelligence reports?” Yang Fan asked aloud.
“Reporting to Master,”
Yang Da immediately answered,
“the deduced Divine Kingdom Core belongs to the Angel Race.”
“Judging from the spatial fluctuations generated by the divine kingdom rules and the stability of the spatial channel, the opponent’s divine kingdom area can be roughly estimated.”
“After calculation, the opponent’s divine kingdom area should be between 15 billion square kilometers and 17 billion square kilometers.”
Yang Da continued to explain, “The number of gods in any race is extremely scarce.”
“And in order to avoid exposing their own strength, the vast majority of gods will hide their divine kingdom information.”
“Unless a war truly breaks out, it is difficult for the outside world to judge the opponent’s specific combat power.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan fell into deep thought. Unlike demigods, before a Divine Kingdom War between gods begins, it is basically impossible to know the specific information of the other party.
Of course, the divine kingdom rules also have a certain degree of judgment standards for the strength of a divine kingdom.
The most intuitive of these is the divine kingdom area.
The larger the divine kingdom area, the more stable the spatial rules.
The higher the difficulty to make a large number of believers enter a smaller divine kingdom through a spatial channel.
It is precisely because of this that proxy wars were born in the Real World.
And Intelligent Life can use the limitations of the spatial channel to roughly estimate the target divine kingdom area through spatial fluctuation changes.
However, the divine kingdom area does not completely represent a god’s true strength.
It can only serve as a reference.
After all, the factors that determine the outcome of a Divine Kingdom War also include believer quality, divine kingdom buildings, war Resources, civilization systems, and so on.
Although the divine kingdom area of this Angel Race god before him was fifty to seventy percent higher than Yang Fan’s current divine kingdom,
Yang Fan did not show the slightest fear.
On the contrary, at this moment, a trace of excitement even flashed in his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 354: A Massive Amount of Talents
paragraphs: From his Breakthrough to Godhood until now,
his Divine Kingdom had undergone another ten thousand years of Evolution.
The earliest batch of believers had long since reached the end of their natural lifespans.
Many of the new generation of believers who had grown up now possessed A-Rank talents like Spiritual Bodies or Battle Bodies.
The strengths of the four major factions—the Mechanical Civilization, the Zombie Kingdom, the Immortal Alliance, and the Wanxiang Martial Court—had undergone earth-shaking changes during this period.
“Just in time...”
“I can use this Angel Race God to test the true strength of my Divine Kingdom.”
A smile slowly curled on Yang Fan’s lips.
“Yang Da, there is no need to rush into invading them for now.”
“I will give you another 3,000 years. Begin full-scale preparations for war!”
Yang Fan’s gaze was calm as he spoke slowly.
“Mobilize one hundred million White Zombies and use them all to refine corpse pills.”
“Run the divine weapon world-forging platform at full capacity, prioritizing the crafting of A-Rank weapons.”
“Have the alchemist believers put all their efforts into refining war Medicinal Pills such as Blood-Coagulating Powder, Qi and Blood Pills, Spirit-Replenishing Pills, and Blood-Bursting Pills.”
“Especially the Mechanical Civilization; during these 3,000 years, they must put all their efforts into manufacturing Fourth-Tier Smart Weapons.”
“Not just the Intelligent Life.”
“Believers of the Cultivation system and the Martial Dao system, and even those in the Zombie Kingdom who have reached the level of Zombie King or above, must all be equipped with Smart Weapons.”
“In addition, the testing phase for those Intelligent Mechas must be concluded as soon as possible to begin mass production.”
“Although their individual combat power is somewhat lacking compared to s-class war structures like the Mechanical War Puppets or the Great Void Warships,”
“war is never just about individual strength. When their numbers reach a certain level, they can likewise form a terrifying combat force.”
Yang Fan laid out the arrangements one by one.
Hearing these commands, the corner of Yang Da’s mouth couldn’t help but twitch.
“Master...”
“According to the data in the Federation Database, those Alien Gods are actually not as strong as you think.”
Yang Da hesitated for a moment before speaking up to remind him.
“Among Tier 1 Alien Gods, those at the median level of Divine Kingdom combat power usually possess no more than five s-class war structures.”
“And most of them only have around one million high-level believers at the Core Formation Rank.”
As he spoke, his gaze secretly observed Yang Fan’s expression,
fearing that his words would displease his master.
After all, in Yang Da’s eyes, the current Foundation of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had already far surpassed that of ordinary gods.
Let alone a mere Tier 1 Alien God, they could even wage war against a Tier 3 God.
The most correct course of action right now should be to descend directly.
Crushing the opponent with absolute power, seizing their Divine Kingdom Core, and expanding the area of their own Divine Kingdom—this was the most efficient way to develop.
Hearing this, Yang Fan merely shook his head.
“Even a lion uses its full strength when hunting a rabbit.”
“How do you know the opponent doesn’t have hidden trump cards?”
“And this is The Frontline.”
“Other Angel Race Gods might not necessarily refrain from providing support.”
“A victorious army is bound to grow proud, and a proud army is bound to be defeated.”
“In a Divine Kingdom War between gods, one must be cautious, and then even more cautious.”
Yang Fan’s expression was incredibly serious.
Hearing this, Yang Da opened his mouth but ultimately did not argue.
But in his heart, he couldn’t help but complain wildly.
“Master... aren’t you being a bit too cautious?”
“Even if other Angel Race Gods really did support them, at most they would provide some war buildings, Divinity Points, or special Resources.”
“Who would be foolish enough to deploy their own believers on a large scale into someone else’s Divine Kingdom War? That is the very Foundation of their own Divine Kingdom.”
“Furthermore... Master, you already have so many trump cards.”
“What on earth is there to be afraid of?”
Thinking of this, Yang Da’s gaze couldn’t help but sweep toward the core area of the Divine Kingdom.
There, massive war buildings stood silently, with four to five hundred s-class war structures exuding a terrifying aura.
Even with the computing power of an Intelligent Life, looking at these war reserves, he still felt somewhat helpless and speechless.
After others broke through to Godhood, they might still be striving for a single a-rank war building.
His master, on the other hand, had only broken through not long ago, yet s-class war structures were already piled up in groups.
Even under these circumstances, he was still playing it safe!!!
“Your subordinate obeys.”
In the end, Yang Da still nodded respectfully.
Although he felt Yang Fan was being overly cautious, considering the safety of his own palace, he decided to do more and talk less.
After arranging the war preparations, Yang Fan did not immediately exit his Divine Kingdom.
Instead, he extended his right hand, and with a slight stir of his mind,
in the next moment,
the Divine Kingdom Cores stored in the warehouse began to float up slowly.
They then transformed into streaks of flowing light, flying toward Yang Fan.
Buzz— The first Divine Kingdom Core fused into his Divine Kingdom, causing the entire area of the Divine Kingdom to expand slightly.
Close behind came the second, the third, the fourth...
One Divine Kingdom Core after another was continuously absorbed.
Although the cores of these demigods provided very limited enhancement to the current area of the Divine Kingdom,
under the effect of the Origin Evolution talent, they were converted into brand-new Divine Kingdom Talents.
As the absorption concluded, both Yang Fan and Yang Da could clearly sense that
some subtle changes seemed to have occurred throughout the entire Divine Kingdom.
“F-Rank Talent: Soft Bones (enhances body flexibility, reduces the probability of injury),
F-Rank Talent: Strong Stomach (improves digestion, reduces food consumption),
F-Rank Talent: Night Vision (enhances Night Vision),
F-Rank Talent: Cold Resistance (improves Cold Resistance),
A large number of F-Rank talents surfaced on the information panel.
Although their Ranks were not high, they made up for it in sheer numbers.
As one Divine Kingdom Core after another was converted,
finally, a few talents of slightly higher quality appeared.
“[D-Rank Talent: Iron Armor]
Improves the Physical Body defense of all believers, making their physiques tougher.
[D-Rank Talent: Gale]
Improves the movement speed of all believers.
[C-Rank Talent: Fertile Soil]
Increases the yield of Planting Resources in the Divine Kingdom and accelerates the growth rate of Spirit Plants.”
Soon, the last Divine Kingdom Core was also completely absorbed by Yang Fan.
More than fifty Divine Kingdom Cores brought a total of over fifty brand-new Divine Kingdom Talents to his Divine Kingdom.
However, the vast majority of them were F-Rank.
Only two actually reached D-Rank.
The only C-Rank talent came from a Human Race Subordinate God who possessed a B-Rank Spiritual Field talent.
After absorbing so many Divine Kingdom Cores, Yang Fan gradually formed his own judgment regarding the laws of Origin Evolution.
If it was a Human Race Divine Kingdom Core, its Divine Kingdom Talent would mostly drop by one Rank and evolve into a similar type of talent suitable for his own Divine Kingdom.
For example, the B-Rank Spiritual Field ultimately evolved into the C-Rank talent, Fertile Soil.
On the other hand, if it was an Alien Divine Kingdom Core, due to the greater loss during the Origin conversion process, it would often drop by two or even three Ranks.
Because of this, the Divine Kingdom Talents provided by Alien Divine Kingdom Cores were mostly only F-Rank.
Some talents even had effects so useless that they could almost be ignored due to insufficient Origin energy.
Yang Fan, however, did not care about this.
In his eyes, as long as it was a talent, it was enough.
Because they would ultimately become nourishment for the growth of his Divine Kingdom.

chapters.title: Chapter 355: Enjoy Yourself Thoroughly
paragraphs: Thinking of this, Yang Fan looked toward the divine kingdom panel.
At the very end of the talent column, a familiar option was quietly floating.
[Fusion Available]
Yang Fan did not hesitate in the slightest and directly chose to fuse all of them.
Hum—
In an instant.
More than fifty newly added talents simultaneously transformed into streams of Origin light, converging toward the original talents.
Those massive amounts of F-rank and D-rank talents quickly dissipated.
Meanwhile, the A-rank and S-rank Talents originally possessed within the divine kingdom began to undergo extremely subtle changes.
“Talent: SSS-Rank Talent: Evolution [First Divine Power: Time Evolution (one hundred times); Second Divine Power: Origin Evolution]”
“[S-rank Talent Growth of All Things]”
“[A-rank Talent Spirit Body]”
“[A-rank Talent Divine Craftsman]”
“[B-rank Talent Breeding]”
“[A-rank Talent Battle Body]”
“[C-rank Talent Pill Heart]”
“[C-rank Talent Formation Dao]”
Although the number of newly added talents this time was not small, the vast majority were merely F-rank.
Even if all of them were fused into those Advanced talents, it would not be enough to allow the A-rank or even S-rank Talents to complete a qualitative transformation.
However, this did not mean that the Fusion was meaningless.
In fact, even for the exact same talent, there was a distinction in strength between them.
After Yang Fan continuously fused these low-tier talents into their corresponding Advanced talents, the effects of those Advanced talents all improved to a certain degree.
Only, from a true qualitative change and promotion to a higher level, there was still quite a significant distance.
In addition to this, Yang Fan’s divine kingdom also had two newly added occupation-class talents.
[C-rank Talent: Pill Heart], capable of increasing the pill-forming rate of Alchemists, while also increasing the probability of producing Alchemy geniuses.

[C-rank Talent: Formation Dao], increasing the probability of producing Formation geniuses within the divine kingdom and enhancing the believers’ Comprehension Ability regarding the Dao of Formations.
Nowadays, the Formation systems within Yang Fan’s divine kingdom were mostly purchased from the Federal Mall.
If Formation geniuses could continue to be born within the divine kingdom in the future,
perhaps one day, his believers would also be able to independently deduce Formations, improve the Formation system, and even create a grand Formation uniquely belonging to their own divine kingdom.
However, for Yang Fan today, the Dao of Formations was long no longer the core determining the strength of the divine kingdom.
It could only be considered adding the icing on the cake.
After finishing all this, Yang Fan slowly withdrew from the divine kingdom, and his consciousness returned to reality.
Meanwhile, following the order issued by Yang Da,
the entire divine kingdom also began to enter a state of comprehensive war preparation.
Inside the Eternal Corpse Mine, hundreds of millions of White Zombies acted simultaneously, and one corpse pill after another was continuously condensed and refined out.
Then, they were neatly sealed into the Tianshu Spirit Sealing Box and transported to the warehouse for unified preservation as important strategic materials for future Divine Kingdom Wars.
On the other side,
Alchemists, Artifact Refiners, and other occupational believers likewise entered a state of full-out production.
Various wartime Medicinal Pills and A-rank weapons were continuously manufactured like flowing water.
And the busiest was naturally the Mechanical Civilization.
The fourth-tier Smart Weapons had just been successfully researched and developed not long ago.
To meet the war preparation requirements put forward by Yang Fan, Yang Da directly gave the order to newly build and simultaneously open more than two hundred Smart Weapon production lines.
The entire Mechanical Civilization completely entered an overloaded operating state.
Especially thinking of Yang Fan’s words— “Even believers above the Zombie King are all equipped with fourth-tier Smart Weapons.”
Even Yang Da could not help feeling his scalp go numb for a moment.
He even suddenly gave birth to a strange feeling.
The Intelligent Life directly managed by him... seemed a bit too much like beasts of burden.
Fortunately, Intelligent Life was different from ordinary believers.
They would not get tired, nor would they complain.
Any command from Yang Da would be executed with the highest efficiency.
Of course, being able to support such massive war preparations, when it all came down to it, was still because Yang Fan possessed an almost inexhaustible amount of Divinity Points.
In the Real World, a large number of robots were continuously materialized out.
Then, under Yang Da’s unified dispatch, they continuously headed to The Frontline trading area to purchase Resources.
Batch after batch of rare metals, Spirit Medicine, Ore, smart chips...
were continuously transported back.
In the end, they were all collected into the divine kingdom, transforming into the most solid foundation for this Divine Kingdom War.
“I truly have a life of toil!”
Yang Da’s consciousness appeared ten thousand meters above the divine kingdom.
Looking at the entire divine kingdom below, which had gradually entered a state of stable operation, he nodded in satisfaction.
Now, all major production lines had been fully opened.
Alchemy, Artifact Refining, Mechanical manufacturing, resource collection...
All areas were operating at high speed according to the established plan.
After confirming that there were no problems whatsoever, Yang Da spoke softly,
“Where is Yang Yi?”
As his voice fell,
a Mechanical figure instantly appeared before him.
It was precisely the Intelligent Life Yang Yi, who was now responsible for the daily dispatch of the divine kingdom.
“Greetings, Lord.”
Yang Yi bowed respectfully.
“Calculated according to the current production efficiency, three thousand years of time is enough to complete all of the Master’s requirements.”
Yang Da nodded.
“Next, the production dispatch of the divine kingdom will be handed over to you to be responsible for.”
“Yes.”
Yang Yi nodded in response.
Subsequently, as if Yang Da had thought of something, he spoke once more,
“There is one more matter.”
“In the future, those female Martial Kings should no longer be sent to my palace.”
“Their muscles are too hard, I do not like this type.”
Yang Da said with a straight face.
“In my name, reward the Elf Race with ten thousand drops of Earth Heart Milk.”
“Have them arrange twenty female Elven Warriors to come to my palace and take charge of daily affairs.”
“Yes, Lord.”
Yang Yi hurriedly nodded.
Regarding the special hobbies of this highest Intelligent Life of their divine kingdom, the upper echelons of the divine kingdom basically already knew about it.
However, Yang Da’s personality was quite good. Whether treating believers or other Intelligent Life, he was extremely generous.
Therefore, aside from the Zombie Kingdom,
within the Immortal Alliance, Wanxiang Martial Court, and Elf Kingdom, many females considered being able to enter Yang Da’s palace to work as an honor.
After all, being able to receive the care of this highest Intelligent Life of the divine kingdom was in itself a form of glory.
“Additionally,”
“go to the warehouse to collect ten Mechanical Hearts.”
“This is your reward.”
Yang Da waved his hand casually.
“Many thanks, Lord!”
Yang Yi immediately revealed an expression of excitement and then departed.
Watching Yang Yi’s departing back, Yang Da stretched lazily.
“After toiling hard for half a year, the production system has finally been completely stabilized.”
“For the next three thousand years... I should also enjoy myself thoroughly.”
“With Yang Yi and these believers responsible for execution, I, the highest Intelligent Life of the divine kingdom, only need to grasp the general direction.”
Finished speaking, Yang Da’s figure gradually turned illusory.
The next second,
his consciousness returned into his own palace.
At this moment, inside Yang Da’s palace,
there were already many female believers waiting for a long time.
These high-tier believers whose strength had reached the Core Formation Realm were now each wearing various bizarre attire, displaying meticulously prepared dance postures before Yang Da.
Their movements were light, and their expressions were charming.
They completely did not look like those powerhouses on the battlefield who could shatter mountains with a single punch.

chapters.title: Chapter 356: Will Not Underestimate the Enemy
paragraphs: “Not bad.”
Yang Da watched attentively and nodded with satisfaction.
“Each of you will be rewarded with one drop of Earth Heart Milk.”
“Thank you, my Lord!” The many female believers immediately beamed with joy.
Subsequently, some brought over Monkey Wine, while others fed Yang Da spirit fruits.
Others voluntarily stood behind him to knead his shoulders and hammer his back.
The entire palace was filled with a harmonious atmosphere.
If Yang Fan were to see this scene, he would probably be rendered speechless.
An Intelligent Life form that had created a purely Mechanical body for itself.
It didn’t even have flesh and blood, yet it was here enjoying a massage?
It really knew how to play the emotional value game!
In the real world, another four or five days had passed.
On this day.
While Yang Fan was checking the progress of various production tasks in his divine kingdom, Niu Tou and Ma Mian simultaneously sent him a message.
Their meaning was simple.
They had already purchased enough Divine Kingdom defensive buildings in the Divine Shop, as per Yang Fan’s requirements.
Now, they could enter the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone at any time to begin the Divine Kingdom War.
Upon seeing the message, Yang Fan did not hesitate at all.
His consciousness entered the Virtual World, and he directly logged into the official databases of Primordial Academy and Xingqiong Academy.
The Alien Divine Kingdom Zone of the two great academies was top secret for ordinary students.
After all, it involved a large number of core buildings.
However, for Yang Fan, these restrictions naturally did not exist.
Today, he was not only a Peerless Prodigy of Primordial Academy, but also a future powerhouse being heavily cultivated by the Gu Family.
With his authority, querying this information was completely problem-free.
After selecting the targets, he only needed to let Niu Tou and Ma Mian enter the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone and obtain the corresponding divine kingdom coordinates.
Although it was less than a month until the Divine Kingdom War with the Angel Race deity.
Yang Fan’s plan to obtain the Divine Kingdom Cores of Alien Demigods showed no signs of stopping.
In fact, even while waging war against the Angel Race deity, he could still continue to support Niu Tou, Ma Mian, and Li Tianheng.
His divine kingdom’s production capacity was already beyond what ordinary deities could imagine.
A massive amount of corpse pills and war resources could be supplied continuously.
As for those Alien Demigods?
No matter how strong they were, they were ultimately just Alien Demigods.
No matter how large their divine kingdom area was, it would not exceed 100 million square kilometers.
As long as he chose Alien Demigods with a life-based system, Yang Fan was not worried about any accidents.
Moreover, these Alien Demigods imprisoned by the academies didn’t even have a way to purchase detoxifying potions.
In Yang Fan’s view, there would be no surprises regarding the outcome.
Yang Fan’s Mental Energy was currently extremely powerful.
Facing the massive amount of information on the official websites of the two great academies, he quickly filtered out a large number of targets.
“Race: Dark Elf.”
“Divine Kingdom Talent: S-rank Talent — Myriad Manifestations.”
“Known Divine Kingdom Buildings: Great Void Warship × 10, Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest × 30...”
“Evaluation: Top-tier Alien Demigod in the Level 2 Alien Divine Kingdom Zone.”
“Race: Sky-Sea Yao Race.”
“Divine Kingdom Talent: S-rank Talent — Water Yao Body.”
“Known Divine Kingdom Buildings: S-Rank Deep Sea Warship...”
Yang Fan’s criteria for filtering targets were simple.
First, choose Alien Demigods with a life-based system.
Second, the divine kingdom talent must reach S-Rank.
Third, check the S-Rank Buildings the opponent possessed to ensure they were suitable for his own divine kingdom.
As for the outcome of the war?
Yang Fan hadn’t even considered it.
Or rather, he never felt that these Alien Demigods were qualified to withstand his ‘corpse pill’ offensive.
Soon, Yang Fan sent the two targets to Niu Tou and Ma Mian.
At this moment, inside Primordial Academy and Xingqiong Academy.
The two, having received the message, fell silent almost simultaneously.
“S-Rank Divine Kingdom Talent?”
Niu Tou looked at the information before him, his eye twitching slightly.
“And it’s a top-tier Alien Demigod who has lived for four or five thousand years?”
“Isn’t this pressure a bit too much?”
He had originally thought that although the targets Yang Fan chose were strong, they shouldn’t be too exaggerated.
After all, the two of them were only Grade A Geniuses.
Even if they had a chance to become deities in the future, they were currently still just ordinary Alien Demigods.
However, what Yang Fan had arranged for them was actually the top-tier existence in the Level 2 Alien Divine Kingdom Zone.
This made them instantly feel the pressure multiply.
Although Yang Fan had already paid the Divinity Points in advance.
And the agreement clearly stated that their believers did not need to participate in the entire Divine Kingdom War.
They only needed to protect their own divine kingdom and prevent it from being counter-invaded.
To be safe, the two had already spent nearly a million Divinity Points to purchase a large number of A-Rank defensive buildings.
But looking at the targets Yang Fan had chosen at this moment.
They suddenly felt... was their preparation far from enough?
“Brother Ma, this is my target.”
Niu Tou forwarded the information to Ma Mian.
“Take a look at your opponent, is it also this exaggerated?”
A moment later, Ma Mian replied, “Same here.”
Niu Tou: “...”
“Then what do we do now?”
Ma Mian was silent for a moment, then said seriously:
“What else can we do?”
“Before we start, continue purchasing defensive buildings.”
“I plan to invest another five million Divinity Points.”
“Five million?”
Niu Tou immediately widened his eyes.
“That much? Isn’t that too wasteful?”
Ma Mian shook his head.
“After the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone war ends, we can sell some of the buildings and recover at least some of the costs.”
“But the most important thing right now is to fulfill the agreement with Chairman Yang.”
Niu Tou was silent for a while, then said with some hesitation:
“Our believers are not participating in the war at all; can Chairman Yang really handle it?”
Hearing this, Ma Mian glanced at him.
“Brother Niu, Chairman Yang is a powerful deity, and he has the Gu Family standing behind him.”
“If he says he can do it, he definitely can.”
“We just need to execute according to the agreement.”
“Don’t overthink it.”
Hearing this, Niu Tou could only nod.
Although he was still a bit uneasy in his heart, thinking of Yang Fan’s terrifying status and background.
He ultimately chose to believe.
After all, that was a Peerless Prodigy who had achieved a Breakthrough to deity status in his junior year.
Perhaps things that were incomprehensible in their eyes.
Were merely normal operations for Yang Fan.
Yang Fan did not urge Niu Tou and Ma Mian.
For him, time was never an issue.

Once the two had completely finished setting up their divine kingdom’s defenses, Ma Yu would naturally follow his instructions and hand over those Tianshu Spirit Sealing Boxes filled with corpse pills to them.
At that time, the monitoring equipment prepared in advance by both sides would complete real-time docking with his Intelligent Life.
Every move of the entire Divine Kingdom War would be under Yang Fan’s surveillance.
For Yang Fan, these were all just minor matters.
Merely Alien Demigods; with the terrifying monthly resource output of his divine kingdom, even if he just relied on brute-forcing with Divinity Points, it would be enough to crush them to death.
The only thing worth his attention right now was the upcoming first Divine War.
Those who could achieve a Breakthrough to deity status and hold the The Frontline for a long time had almost all lived for tens of thousands of years.
Such figures were none of them simple characters.
Yang Fan would absolutely not underestimate the enemy because of this.

chapters.title: Chapter 357: Task Will Definitely Be Completed
paragraphs: Time passed slowly in peace.
In the Real World, only ten days had passed.
Yang Fan simultaneously received messages from Niu Tou and Ma Mian.
The two had successfully obtained the target Alien Divine Kingdom coordinates, and everything was ready.
Without delay, Yang Fan immediately notified Ma Yu.
Through the Virtual World, he delivered the pre-prepared Tianshu Spirit Sealing Boxes to the two of them.
At the same time, Yang Fan’s consciousness entered his own Divine Kingdom.
Inside the grand palace hall, Yang Fan sat solemnly on the main seat.
Yang Da and Yang Yi stood on his left and right sides, respectively.
In front of the three of them, millions of thumb-sized holographic projections floated densely in midair.
Every frame corresponded to real-time footage transmitted back by a miniature monitoring device.
Countless robots carrying Tianshu Spirit Sealing Boxes continuously crossed through spatial passages into the two Alien Divine Kingdoms.
As corpse pills were dropped one after another,
drastic changes quickly occurred in both Divine Kingdoms.
Meanwhile, the demigods imprisoned in the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone almost instantly noticed the anomaly.
However, they were different from the Alien Demigods on The Frontline.
The Human Federation had completely cut off these demigods in the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone from all outside contact.
They could neither ask for help nor purchase any detoxification Resources from the Divine Shop.
Facing the near-endless stream of corpse pills being dropped, the only thing they could rely on was their Divine Kingdom’s self-purification ability.
But facing such a terrifying quantity of corpse poison, the purification speed of their Divine Kingdoms was insignificant.
Their only option was to launch a counteroffensive.
As long as they shattered the defensive line of the Human Demigods and stopped the robots from entering their kingdoms to drop poison, the crisis would naturally end.
The Divine Kingdoms of Niu Tou and Ma Mian came under fierce counterattacks almost simultaneously.
In the left projection, hundreds of millions of Dark Elves swarmed out from the depths of the forest.
They had grayish-black skin, long pointed ears, and eyes glowing with an eerie green light.
Clad in light armor and carrying pitch-black longbows, they moved as swiftly as ghosts.
Every shift and leap seemed to blend seamlessly into the shadows.
On the other side, the Sky-Sea Demon Race charged out from towering, colossal waves.
Their upper bodies resembled humans, covered entirely in deep blue scales, with their arms transformed into sharp bone blades.
Thick fish tails trailed behind them, and single horns grew from their foreheads.
Countless sea demons rode giant sea beasts, treading the waves with immense momentum.
Combined, the believers of both races numbered several billion.
Blinding the sky and covering the earth, they charged frantically toward the spatial passages.
At the same time, Niu Tou and Ma Mian personally presided over their respective Divine Kingdoms to command the defense.
“Activate all defensive structures!”
Following the order,
around the outer perimeter of the Divine Kingdoms, row after row of war structures lit up simultaneously.
Laser weapons spewed out blinding beams of light.
City-Annihilating Cannons roared continuously.
f3500 fighter jets pierced the sky.
Large numbers of small tactical nuclear missiles launched into the air, turning into blinding flashes of destructive fire.
The defensive system the two had spent millions of Divinity Points to build...
...finally revealed its true power at this moment.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The alien believers who had just rushed out of the spatial passages suffered a devastating strike.
Swaths of Dark Elves were torn apart by lasers, and countless Sky-Sea Demon Race warriors were swallowed by explosions.
Bodies continuously fell, and blood dyed almost the entire battlefield red.
With just the first volley of fire,
the alien charge was forcefully suppressed and driven back.
Large numbers of surviving alien believers fled back to their own Divine Kingdoms in panic, no longer daring to approach the spatial passages easily.
Seeing this, both Niu Tou and Ma Mian let out a long sigh of relief.
Spending nearly five million Divinity Points hadn’t been in vain after all.
A defensive system of this scale...
...was sturdy enough to stand firm as a mountain even against the top demigods of the Tier-2 Alien Divine Kingdom Zone.
Inside the Divine Kingdom hall,
Yang Fan merely glanced at the scene calmly and gave a light wave of his hand.
Millions of projections rapidly gathered back together, turning into streams of data that sank into the Void Realm.
“The victory is decided.”
Yang Fan had a calm expression.
“In a little over a month, we will be able to reap the harvest.”
Speaking up to this point, a faint smile slowly curled at the corners of his lips.
“I hope these two Alien Divine Kingdoms store plenty of Divine Kingdom Cores left behind by Human Race Prodigies.”
The original purpose of the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone in the Two Major Academies was to temper the top young Geniuses of the entire Human Race.
Every single person capable of entering to challenge it was a Genius of the Human Federation.
These living Alien Demigods often possessed a massive number of Divine Kingdom Cores left behind by past generations of humans.
For Yang Fan, this was the true Treasure Trove.
A Human Race Prodigy possessing an S-rank Divine Kingdom Talent, once their Divine Kingdom Core underwent Origin Evolution, would be enough to grant him an A-rank Divine Kingdom Talent.
If his luck was good enough and there were Divine Kingdom Cores left by Peerless Prodigies,
he might even be able to gain a brand-new S-rank Talent through it.
Considering the harvest of Divine Kingdom Talents alone,
a top demigod from the academy’s Alien Divine Kingdom Zone was worth as much as he could reap from slaying over a thousand ordinary demigods through proxy wars.
“Yang Da, how are the pre-war preparations coming along?”
Yang Fan looked at Yang Da beside him and asked.
“Reporting to Master, according to Master’s original arrangements, with 1,500 years of time in the Divine Kingdom, we will definitely complete all goals!”
Yang Da patted his chest and guaranteed.
Hearing this, Yang Fan nodded in satisfaction. It seemed Yang Da’s capability was quite good, having actually shortened the completion time.
Afterwards, his consciousness slowly exited the Divine Kingdom and returned to the Real World.
However, right after Yang Fan left,
Yang Da’s expression instantly turned serious.
“Yang Yi.”
“You heard Master’s words just now.”
“Currently, the largest flaw of the Divine Kingdom is our reserves of various Medicinal Pill Resources.”
“Going forward, you need to focus heavily on this area.”
“Make those Core Formation and Foundation Establishment believers who are responsible for Alchemy work a bit harder.”
“Within 1,300 years, the goals set by Master must be completed.”
“Everything is for the Divine Kingdom!”
Yang Da spoke in an extremely solemn tone.
“Yes, my Lord!” Yang Yi immediately responded.
After handing down the instructions, Yang Da’s figure vanished in an instant.
The next moment, he was back in his own palace.
Yang Yi, on the other hand, did not linger.
With a thought, his figure appeared directly in the sky above the Heavenly Court.
“Where is the Lord of the Heavenly Court?”
Yang Yi’s voice echoed across heaven and earth.
A second later, a beam of teal-wood light cut through the sky.
A Cultivation believer wearing a teal robe rushed over quickly.
It was the current Lord of the Heavenly Court of the Immortal Alliance, a powerful expert at the Core Formation Perfection Realm.
Coming before Yang Yi, he knelt on both knees without hesitation. “Greetings, Divine Emissary!”
Yang Yi looked down at him.
“The God commands.”
“Within 1,000 years, the reserves of various Medicinal Pills in the Divine Kingdom must meet the requirements.”
“Otherwise...”
“...you should know the consequences.”
Hearing this, the body of the Lord of the Heavenly Court shuddered slightly.
“Yes!”
“This subordinate will definitely complete the task!”
Soon, the Lord of the Heavenly Court returned to the main hall.
He summoned all high-ranking believers in charge of Resource production.
“The Divine Emissary commands.”
“800 years!”
“We have only 800 years!”
“Department of Alchemy, your task is the most important!”
The Lord of the Heavenly Court sat high on his throne, his voice cold.
“If we fail to complete the task entrusted by the God...”
“...that would be a betrayal against the God.”
At this point, a flash of chilliness flickered in his eyes.
Below, the Core Formation believers responsible for Medicinal Pill production immediately prostrated on the ground.
“Rest assured, Your Majesty!”
“We subordinates will definitely complete the task!”

chapters.title: Chapter 358: Birthday Gift
paragraphs: Real World.
Virtual World.
Yang Fan was sitting on the sofa in the villa, holding the one-year-old Gu Chengye in his arms.
On the table in front of them, various exquisite models were laid out.
There were small airships that could simulate flight trajectories, skyscraper models built to the scale of real cities, and aircraft carrier models that spanned across the starry sky.
There were even various cosmic warships, planetary models, and Mechanical life models.
These were all birthday gifts that Yang Fan had specially prepared for Gu Chengye.
“Ye’er.”
“What do you like?”
Yang Fan asked softly.
Although Gu Chengye was still young, he was, after all, his own child.
For his first birthday, he naturally hoped to leave behind something memorable.
In the next moment, Gu Chengye reached out with his small hand.
He did not choose those massive warship models.
Instead, he grabbed an inconspicuous little blue ball at the corner of the table.
Seeing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help but burst into laughter.
“Wife Le’er.”
“Come and take a look.”
“This little guy is going to achieve great things.”
“For his very first birthday, he actually wants me, his father, to give him a living planet!”
Hearing his voice, Gu Le walked out of the kitchen, holding a plate of Spirit Fruits.
Looking at her son, a gentle smile appeared on her face.
“Husband, you’re actually taking it seriously.”
“Chengye is only one year old. How could he understand any of this?”
“He just thinks this ball is fun.”
Yang Fan shook his head.
“Since he chose it, as his father, I must naturally fulfill his wish.”
With that, Yang Fan opened Feixun and sent a message to Ma Yu.
“Ma Yu, help me purchase a living planet close to Xiling Planet in the near future.”
“The requirements are a stable planetary environment and good resource conditions.”
“Once the purchase is complete, transfer the ownership of this living planet to Gu Chengye.”
“The procedures and subsequent management arrangements will be handled by the Yang Corporation.”
“Get this done as quickly as possible.”
During this period, with the continuous expansion of the Yang Corporation,
Ma Yu had already begun laying out a large-scale plan in this Star Domain.
To expand its business empire, the Yang Corporation constantly acquired various living planets and established new commercial strongholds.
And the price of an ordinary living planet was only ten to twenty trillion Divinity Points.
To ordinary deities, this might be an astronomical figure.
But the current Yang Fan didn’t care at all.
After all, the Divinity Points in his Divine Kingdom were accumulating more and more, to the point where he didn’t even know how to spend them.
Giving Gu Chengye a living planet was not pure spoiling.
To the current Yang Fan, this was merely an ordinary birthday gift.
Gu Le looked at the message Yang Fan had sent, and the corners of her mouth curled up slightly.
There was sweetness as well as a hint of curiosity in her eyes.
A living planet.
Even with her status as a direct descendant of the Gu Family, she would not purchase one lightly.
It wasn’t that she couldn’t afford it, but rather that it wasn’t worth it.

Right now, her own Divine Kingdom still had massive room for improvement. Every resource should be invested into her Divine Kingdom to lay a deeper Foundation for her future Breakthrough into a deity.
As for development in the Real World...
At least for now, it was far from the right time.
Yet Yang Fan had bought a living planet without the slightest hesitation as a first birthday gift for his son.
She was naturally somewhat surprised.
Back when Yang Fan transferred ten percent of the Yang Corporation’s shares to Gu Chengye, Gu Le had set out to investigate the Yang Corporation.

She not only found all the information regarding the Yang Corporation’s predecessor, Elephant Loan, but she also knew that Yang Fan had injected one hundred trillion Divinity Points into the company all at once.
Such a massive source of wealth was enough to make countless people curious.
But Gu Le had never actively asked about it.
Because she knew very well that every deity had their own opportunities and secrets.

Some awakened Heaven-Defying talents; some obtained priceless buildings in Divine Kingdom Wars; some had believers who explored the Divine Kingdom world and discovered Heaven-Grade Secret Realms; and some unexpectedly found a large number of resource planets, soaring to the sky from then on.
These secrets were both the Foundation of one’s standing and the key to survival.
Even the closest people did not necessarily need to know everything.
A true husband and wife never calculated against each other, nor did they try to control one another.
Instead, they respected each other like guests, helped each other achieve their goals, supported one another, offered assistance when needed, and preserved appropriate personal space when not.
Gu Le had been born into a top-tier prestigious family like the Gu Family since childhood.
Many truths did not require her elders to deliberately teach her; she understood them naturally.
The higher one stood, the more one understood that the most precious thing between people was trust, not prying.
Only those ordinary Divine Beings who ran around all day for basic necessities would harbor suspicions and pressure each other over gains and losses.
Those who truly stood at the Peak understood that marriage was a contract and a responsibility—walking side by side, supporting each other, and maintaining just the right amount of distance.

“Husband, there are still over ten years before Ye’er awakens his Divine Kingdom. If you spoil him like this, I’m afraid his nose will be pointed to the sky by the time he starts compulsory education,” Gu Le said coquettishly, snuggling into Yang Fan’s arms.
“He won’t. I have to give him a birthday gift every year anyway. In the future, this kid will study at a noble school in Taichu City.”

“As far as I know, many descendants of the Gu Family’s younger generation are already shareholders of listed companies as soon as they are born, or their elders have purchased a large amount of baby funds for them!” Yang Fan said nonchalantly.
“But none of them gifted a living planet!” Gu Le rolled her eyes at him.
“Who let him be my flesh and blood?”
Yang Fan continued, “When the certificate of ownership is delivered, please help me hand it over to Father.”
“Ye’er is still too small. Let Father hand it over to him when he turns eighteen and his Divine Kingdom awakens.”
“I understand, Husband,” Gu Le nodded with a smile.
Afterward, Yang Fan played with Gu Chengye for a good while longer.
Lifting him high up one moment and gently rocking him the next, the little guy giggled constantly, waving his two chubby little hands as if trying to grab his father.
Only when Gu Chengye grew tired and yawned in Gu Le’s arms did Yang Fan finally log out of the Virtual World.
Taichu City.
Gu Le lifted Gu Chengye high above her head and smiled with gentle affection. “Ye’er, why do you think your father has so many little tricks up his sleeve?”
“If he wanted anything, he could have just told his wife directly. Would I really not help with such a small matter?”
“He just had to take such a long detour.”
“Instead, it benefited you, little guy. You haven’t even grown your feathers yet, and you’re already the lord of a planet.”
“When you grow up, if you dare to learn from the likes of Gu Shaoqing and get some title like ‘Amorous Young Master’, I’ll spank your butt raw.”
As she spoke, Gu Le reached out and gently patted Gu Chengye’s little bottom.
“Wah—”
Gu Chengye’s eyes instantly widened into round circles.
He had absolutely no idea what had happened, only feeling his bottom suddenly get slapped.
Pouting his little mouth, tears welled up in his eyes instantly, and he immediately burst into loud crying.

chapters.title: Chapter 359: Nascent Soul
paragraphs: “Oh!”
Gu Le panicked instantly, hurriedly holding him in her arms, gently patting his back and coaxing him softly: “Little darling, don’t cry, don’t cry, Mother accidentally hurt you just now.”
“It’s all Mother’s fault.”
While gently rocking him, Gu Le lowered her head and kissed Gu Chengye’s tender, pink little face.
Not long after, the little guy’s cries gradually subsided, leaving only grievance as he sniffled, tightly grabbing Gu Le’s lapel, refusing to let go.
After returning to the Real World, Yang Fan didn’t delay at all, immediately sending a message to Ma Yu.
“The news can be released to the outside world.”
“Yang Corporation has a deep relationship with the Third Elder of the Gu Family, Gu Xuanting. This life planet transaction was mediated by the Gu Family.”

“In addition, by the way, tell those planet holdouts who are still watching and waiting that Yang Corporation has always been willing to trade fairly at market prices, but for those who intentionally sit on the ground and raise prices, there will be no need for cooperation in the future.”
Just seconds after the message was sent.
Ma Yu replied immediately.
“Boss is awesome!”
“Within a hundred years, I am confident I can make Yang Corporation rank among the top 500 enterprises in this Star Domain!”
Seeing the message, Yang Fan just smiled and closed the communication.
In the following days, Yang Fan poured his consciousness into the Divine Kingdom most of the time.
However, he wasn’t checking how the Divine Kingdom War supplies were being prepared.
After all, he was not in a hurry; even if they weren’t properly prepared, waiting another few hundred years wouldn’t matter.
Anyway, the Divine Kingdom coordinates of the Angel Race deity had already been deduced; it was impossible for the other party to suddenly die.
What he truly cared about was the Divine Kingdom War of Ma Mian and Niu Tou.
Ever since the first invasion by the Dark Elves and the Sky-Sea Demon Race, the two races had successively organized several counterattacks.
Yet every offensive was weaker than the last.
Until now, a long time had passed, and the two Divine Kingdoms had not suffered any new invasions.
Seeing this scene, Yang Fan nodded with satisfaction.
The reason was not hard to guess.
As more and more corpse pills were delivered into the two races’ Divine Kingdoms, their outer peripheries were probably already completely covered by thick corpse poison.
Those corpse poisons had long integrated into the Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi, mountains, and rivers, forming a natural forbidden zone of death.
Now, if they wanted to lead a large army across the corpse poison area, they would likely lose more than half their troops before even reaching the battlefield.

For the two Alien Demigods, the safest method now was only to turtle up in the Divine Kingdom Core area, struggle to hold on, and pray that the number of corpse pills would eventually run out one day.
Unfortunately, they were destined to be disappointed.
A mere demigod Divine Kingdom was, to the current Yang Fan, simply an existence that could be wiped out with a wave of his hand.
As long as he was willing, casually supporting some corpse pills over would be enough to completely turn the entire Divine Kingdom into a dead zone.
Of course, the other party was, after all, a demigod cultivated by the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone of Primordial Academy.
Regardless of the Divine Kingdom’s foundation or area, they were far from comparable to those ordinary demigods on The Frontline.
Wanting to rely on the zombie virus to poison all the believers in such a massive Divine Kingdom, the Real World would likely still need one or two months.
However, Yang Fan was not in a hurry at all.
To a deity, one or two months was merely the snap of a finger.
On this day.
Yang Fan was in the Virtual World at Tianxiang Renjian, cultivating his sentiments with a few demigod-level workers.
Suddenly, his expression shifted slightly.
A violent fluctuation suddenly came from the Physical Body Dantian in the Real World.
Yang Fan didn’t hesitate at all, casually dropping a drop of Water of Life as a tip, and his consciousness instantly returned to reality.
Inside the villa courtyard.
Yang Fan was still sitting cross-legged in his original spot.
The moment his consciousness returned, a vast and pure five-color Spiritual Qi surged out from the Divine Kingdom, continuously pouring into his body.
The Five Elements Spiritual Qi of gold, wood, water, fire, and earth intertwined and circulated, like a surging river, constantly scouring his meridians and bones.
If it were an ordinary Cultivator, facing such violent Spiritual Qi infusion, they would probably have already been in agonizing pain.
But Yang Fan was different.

His Divine Kingdom simultaneously developed three systems: Cultivation, Martial Arts, and Mechanical. His Physical Body was already comparable to a top Martial Artist, and his Mental Energy far surpassed Cultivators of the same rank.
This level of Spiritual Qi scouring only made him feel a slight tingling sensation.
Not long after, the Spiritual Qi gradually subsided.
A subtle cracking sound suddenly came from the Dantian location.
The original Dantian slowly shattered like it had completed its mission.
Following that, a crystal-clear mini infant, identical in appearance to Yang Fan, quietly sat cross-legged in the center of the Dantian.
The Nascent Soul was formed.
The entire process had no obstacles whatsoever, as if everything fell naturally into place.
The Divine Kingdom’s nourishment to the Physical Body in the Real World also ended accordingly.
Yang Fan slowly raised his right hand.
Next moment.
Five-color Spiritual Qi slowly emerged from his palm.
Scorching flames burned fiercely, cyan vines wound and grew, clear water flowed slowly, sharp golden lights continuously condensed, and heavy rocks suspended within them.
The five distinctly different powers blended with each other yet did not interfere with one another.
At this moment, Yang Fan’s aura grew increasingly profound and natural, as if his entire person had merged into one with heaven and earth.
Curious, Yang Fan beckoned toward a household robot in the distance that was trimming tree branches.
The robot immediately put down the garden shears in its hand and hurried to his front.
“Master.”
Yang Fan didn’t speak, just flicked his finger gently.
A wisp of nearly transparent Spiritual Qi thread instantly swept across the robot’s body.
Next moment.
Clatter——
The entire robot scattered all over the ground in an instant.
Every joint, every screw, every part on its body, and even the internal control core, were precisely cut and separated without the slightest deviation.
Looking at the robot turned into scrap metal before him, a hint of a smile appeared on Yang Fan’s face.
After reaching the Nascent Soul Realm, his control over Spiritual Qi had completely ascended to another level.
If before it was just Spiritual Qi turning into swords, sabers, and hammers to crush enemies with absolute force.
Then now, it was true Spiritual Qi turning into threads.
A single wisp of Spiritual Qi could be meticulous and precisely control every single detail.
Yang Fan walked slowly to that pile of parts and slowly extended his right hand.
Vast Mental Energy instantly covered the entire pile of Mechanical parts.
Next moment.
An formless power slowly lifted all the parts.
They began to automatically arrange, splice, and reorganize.
The entire process was like time flowing backward.
The connection points originally cut by the Spiritual Qi quickly recovered, the broken circuits reclosed, and the damaged structures restored bit by bit.
In just a few breaths.
The household robot that had originally turned into scrap metal stood completely intact before Yang Fan once again.
This was an extension of the creation ability in the Real World after the Divine Kingdom gave birth to Intelligent Life of the fourth rank.
Although the current Yang Fan still couldn’t create a complete household robot out of thin air.
As long as he had existing Materials and structure, completely repairing it was already effortless.
