chapters.title: Chapter 360: Monument of Great Achievements
paragraphs: The robot lowered its head to look at its body, a trace of confusion flashing in its electronic eyes as if it did not quite understand what had just happened.
“Go back to work.”
Yang Fan waved his hand.
“Yes, Master.”
“Qin Technology Alliance is dedicated to serving you. Please feel free to give orders if you have any needs.”

Accompanied by the familiar Mechanical prompt sound, the robot picked up the gardening shears again and returned to its original position to trim the branches, as if everything that just happened had never occurred.
After returning to his room, Yang Fan did not stay long.
He sat cross-legged, and his consciousness instantly entered the Divine Kingdom.
As a deity, the entire Divine Kingdom was within his perception range.
His gaze seemed to pierce through endless space, instantly landing upon the main hall of the Heavenly Court.
At the highest point, a figure was sitting cross-legged.
Surrounded by the Five Elements Spiritual Qi, a Nascent Soul phantom flickered faintly above its head.
That was precisely the first Nascent Soul Cultivator born in his Divine Kingdom.
Seeing this scene, a trace of satisfaction appeared in Yang Fan’s eyes.
Finally... the Cultivation civilization of the Divine Kingdom had also taken a crucial step forward.
The birth of the first Nascent Soul Cultivator meant that the rules of the Divine Kingdom were gradually becoming complete.
Next, more and more talented believers would inevitably achieve a Breakthrough into the Nascent Soul Realm.
By then, the top combat power of the entire Cultivation civilization would experience a huge boost.
“Should I... lie low for a bit longer?”
Looking at the changes in the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan could not help but feel a trace of hesitation in his heart.
After all, his Divine Kingdom’s foundation was still continuously growing.
If he continued to wait, waiting for more Nascent Soul Cultivators to be born and the power of the God-Slaying Tower to further increase, his chances of winning would undoubtedly be even higher.
Just at this moment, a familiar voice suddenly sounded in front of Yang Fan.
“Reporting to Master!”
Yang Da walked over briskly, his face filled with excitement.
“Under the subordinate’s day-and-night unceasing supervision, the Divine Kingdom War supplies have now all exceeded their reserve targets!”
“Medicinal Pills, weapons, Talismans, corpse pills, and production lines for all kinds of war structures have all met the predetermined requirements!”
“Now the Divine Kingdom has made thorough preparations and can fight for Master at any time!”
Speaking to the end, Yang Da even clenched his fists in excitement.
Yang Fan nodded in satisfaction.
It had to be said that although Yang Da was usually a bit flighty, his capability in handling matters was truly unquestionable.
However... Yang Fan suddenly noticed a detail.
When Yang Da was speaking, his left hand had been kept behind his back.
It seemed he was trying hard to hide something.
With a sweep of Yang Fan’s Divine Thought, the corners of his mouth twitched slightly.
He saw that behind Yang Da’s back, a small red dudou was being tightly clenched in his hand.
Seeing this scene, Yang Fan was somewhat speechless for a moment.
Clearly, his own appearance had been too sudden.
Just now, Yang Da was resting in the Divine Kingdom and was even preparing to undress, but then he felt his arrival.
Not daring to delay, he rushed over to report at the very first moment.
He just hadn’t expected... to forget to put down this “small item”.
Sensing Yang Fan’s gaze, Yang Da’s old face instantly flushed red.
“Master...”
“Your subordinate just now...”
Yang Fan waved his hand.
“Alright.”
“There’s no need to explain such minor matters.”
Yang Da instantly breathed a sigh of relief.
“Very good, well done.”
Yang Fan then said:
“I reward you with a free-use quota of one million Divinity Points.”
Hearing this number, Yang Da’s eyes instantly lit up, “Thank you, Master!”
“Next, reorganize the troops and prepare for war.”
Yang Fan’s expression gradually turned serious.
“Pass down my order: all high-tier war-type Intelligent Life are to mobilize their troops and gather at the outer periphery of the Divine Kingdom.”
“Five hundred years from now, wait for me to personally command the invasion.”
“Your subordinate obeys!”
Yang Da immediately saluted.
After arranging everything, Yang Fan’s consciousness withdrew from the Divine Kingdom.
Five days in reality would allow the Divine Kingdom to continue its Evolution for five hundred years.
This period of time was just right to allow more Cultivation believers to achieve a Breakthrough into the Nascent Soul Realm.
By then, the power of the s-class war structures God-Slaying Tower would also inevitably rise to another level.
The reason why Yang Fan did not immediately start the war, but chose to wait five hundred years,
was not because he was afraid, but because once the Divine Kingdom War was initiated, a continuous supply of follow-up troops had to be guaranteed.
He needed to ensure that the believers entering the enemy’s Divine Kingdom would not be completely wiped out.
In any case, he must not let the enemy discover the coordinates of his Divine Kingdom.
The real battlefield had to be within the opponent’s Divine Kingdom.
Therefore, the more thoroughly this war was prepared, the greater the chances of winning.
After Yang Fan left the Divine Kingdom, Yang Da summoned Yang Yi to his presence.
“Things were handled well.” Yang Da nodded with satisfaction.
“Here is a free-use quota of ten thousand Divinity Points, which is a reward from the Master for you.”
“With these Resources, I imagine you are not far from a Breakthrough either.”
Hearing this, Yang Yi’s face immediately showed an expression of excitement, “Thank you, Lord!”
“Go ahead.”
Yang Da waved his hand.
“Those believers have also worked hard during this period of time; the rewards that should be given cannot be less.”
“Yes, your subordinate understands.”
Yang Yi bowed respectfully and then slowly left.
Soon, he arrived above the Heavenly Court.
“Where is the Lord of the Heavenly Court?”
As his voice fell,
the next moment, a figure appeared before Yang Yi as if teleporting and knelt respectfully.
“Greetings, Lord Divine Envoy!”
Yang Yi looked at the Lord of the Heavenly Court before him and nodded in satisfaction.
“This mission was completed quite well.”
“Here is a Cultivate Resources quota of one thousand Divinity Points.”
“Whatever Resources you need, just tell me directly.”
Hearing this, the Lord of the Heavenly Court was completely stunned.
One thousand Divinity Points!
That was currency rumored to be usable only by deities!
For believers like them, Spirit Stones were mostly used for transactions in daily life.
“Thank you, Lord Divine Envoy!”
The Lord of the Heavenly Court said excitedly.
Yang Yi nodded.
“Keep up the hard work.”
“The Nascent Soul Realm grants a long lifespan, and there are infinite possibilities in the future.”
“With these Resources, perhaps you too will have the chance to strive for Soul Transformation.”
“Yes! Your subordinate will definitely not fail the Divine Envoy’s expectations!” said the Lord of the Heavenly Court.
Yang Yi continued:
“In addition, those Alchemists have also worked hard over the past nearly thousand years.”
“They have made huge contributions to the Divine Kingdom.”
“Remember to properly appease them.”
“Your subordinate accepts the order.”
After Yang Yi left,
the Lord of the Heavenly Court immediately summoned the head of the Medicinal Pill Department.
After a moment,
an Alchemist at the Core Formation Perfection Realm arrived within the main hall, “Your Majesty.”
The Lord of the Heavenly Court looked at the other party and slowly spoke:
“This time, the Medicinal Pill Department has made huge contributions.”
“These are the rewards you deserve.”
Having said that, he directly took out a Resources quota of one hundred Divinity Points.
“These are Divinity Points.”
“You should understand its value.”
“This is the reward for this work.”
“With this batch of Resources, I believe it won’t be long before you can also achieve a Breakthrough into the Nascent Soul Realm.”
That Core Formation Perfection Alchemist’s eyes instantly turned red.
“Thank you, Your Majesty, for your Cultivation!”
“This subordinate will never forget it for all eternity!”
The Lord of the Heavenly Court nodded.
“Those Alchemists have also worked hard.”
“You must properly appease them.”
“Your subordinate understands.”
“You may withdraw.”
After leaving the main hall of the Heavenly Court, the head of the Medicinal Pill Department did not delay at all.
Soon, he summoned the managers of this war’s Medicinal Pill reserves.
“Everyone has worked hard on the work of refining the war reserve Medicinal Pills this time.”
“To commend you, Lord Divine Envoy has specially erected a Monument of Great Achievements, and the names of all Alchemists can be inscribed upon the Monument of Great Achievements!”
“This is the glory of our Heavenly Court, and it is the glory of everyone!”
The voice of the head of the Medicinal Pill Department gradually grew higher.
“Everything for the Divine Kingdom!”
“Everything for the deity!”
“In the future, we must strive even harder to enhance our own abilities and create more value for the Divine Kingdom!”
“We absolutely cannot lose to the Mechanical Civilization, and even less can we lose to that group of brute fighters from the Wanxiang Martial Court!”
As soon as these words were spoken, the managers below revealed expressions of immediate understanding.
“Your orders, my lord!”
“Your subordinate will immediately arrange for the construction of the Monument of Great Achievements!”
“All Alchemists will definitely remember this glory!”

chapters.title: Chapter 361: Eve of War
paragraphs: Time flowed slowly.
Five days in the real world passed in a flash.
During the day before, Yang Fan did not Cultivate.
Instead, he entered the Virtual World, Xiling Planet, and spent the entire day with his family.
When night fell.
He spent the first half of the night with Gu Le.
The second half, he spent relaxing at Tianxiang Renjian.
Yang Fan was now a Black Gold member of Tianxiang Renjian.
For Yang Fan, who had already achieved a Breakthrough to the Realm of a God, rest was no longer necessary.
His powerful level of life kept his spirit in a constant state of Peak performance.
Thus, he had arranged his day to be incredibly fulfilling.
He accompanied his family, enjoyed life, and at the same time, adjusted his state of mind for the coming war.
The next morning.
Yang Fan sat in his villa room and took a slow, deep breath.
The next moment.
His consciousness instantly entered his Divine Kingdom.
The outskirts of the Divine Kingdom.
At this moment, it had already turned into a boundless war camp.
Looking out, the dense army of believers was arranged neatly, stretching endlessly.
Cultivation civilizations, Martial Arts civilizations, the Elf Race, and even the Zombie legions.
All were equipped with Smart Weapons, forming massive war phalanxes.
Each phalanx was composed of hundreds of millions of believers.
Their auras were connected, and the power of their military formations converged to form a heart-palpitating force.
At the very front, Yang Da and Yang Yi stood side by side.
Behind them stood Yang Four all the way to Yang Eleven.
This was the core war command system under Yang Fan’s command.
Besides this, the changes in the Zombie Kingdom were equally significant.
After a long period of development, those powerful White Zombies had successfully taken human form.
Although they still exuded a cold aura, they could now perfectly control their own zombie toxins and would no longer affect the friendly troops around them.
At this moment, they also formed military formations, standing at the very edge of the army.
Their bodies were straight, and their heads were held high.
However... when believers from other camps looked at them, there was some disdain in their eyes.
After all, compared to normal life forms, the aura of the Zombie race was truly too peculiar.
As for those truly powerful Zombie Kings and Zombie Generals, they were all hidden within the flesh disaster hive.
The interior space of this s-class war structures was extremely vast.
It could even be said that it was a natural war transport base.
Countless Zombie legions were hidden within it during ordinary times.
Once the war began, they could be instantly deployed to the battlefield.
In addition to the army of believers, various war weapons were also fully prepared.

Ten units each of s-class war structures like the Great Void Warship, Mechanical War Puppet, and God-Slaying Tower were mobilized and hovered in front of their corresponding battle formations, exuding terrifying pressure.
The ones occupying the largest area were the Intelligent Gundam legions created by the Mechanical Civilization.
Tens of millions of Intelligent Gundams were neatly arranged at the very back of the army.
At a glance, it looked like a forest of steel.
Each Intelligent Gundam was equipped with a hundred Intelligent Life units responsible for control.
These war weapons could only truly unleash their full power when paired with Intelligent Life.
At this moment, the war power of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had reached an unprecedented Peak.
The next moment.
Yang Fan’s consciousness instantly descended.
His figure appeared at the very front of the army.
Almost the instant he appeared, Yang Da and Yang Yi knelt on the ground first.
“Greetings, Master!”
Immediately after, Yang Four through Yang Eleven knelt down simultaneously.
“Greetings, Master!”
Subsequently, countless believers knelt in unison.
Cultivation believers, Martial Arts believers, the Elf Race, and the Zombie legions.
Every life form lowered their heads at this moment.
Even those massive Intelligent Gundams, under the control of Intelligent Life, slowly knelt on one knee.
The next moment, a heaven-shaking, earth-shattering sound resonated throughout the entire outskirts of the Divine Kingdom.
“Greetings to our God!”
“Greetings to our God!”
“Greetings to our God!”
The voices converged into a wave, one higher than the next.
The gaze of every believer looking at Yang Fan was filled with fanaticism and awe.
They had waited for this moment for too long.
Yang Fan waved his hand, signaling everyone to rise.
As Yang Fan signaled, the army of over ten billion stood straight, their faces full of excitement!
The Divine Kingdom had developed for so long, and finally, they could fight for their God, fight for the Divine Kingdom, and expand their territory again!
Yang Fan did not immediately order an attack on the Angel Race Divine Kingdom, but instead turned his gaze to the Divine Kingdom’s information.

Assets: Spirit Plant Star x 100, Ore Star x 60, Level 4 Smart Weapon x 5.4 billion, Level 3 Smart Weapon x 28.5 billion...
Today, the total population of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had already exceeded 300 billion.
However, it was naturally impossible to commit all 300 billion lives to the war.
This included a large number of the elderly, weak, sick, and disabled, as well as young believers who were still growing.
The ten billion-strong army truly standing on the The Frontline of the Divine Kingdom’s war was the most elite core force of the entire Divine Kingdom.
Yang Fan’s goal was also very simple: after entering the opponent’s Divine Kingdom, establish a stable The Frontline immediately.
No matter what, the battlefield must not be allowed to retreat back into his own Divine Kingdom.
Otherwise, once the Alien God followed the spatial channel and discovered the coordinates of his Divine Kingdom, it would leave a huge hidden danger for the future.
Therefore, in this battle, the vanguard must be strong enough.
Strong enough to gain a foothold within the enemy’s Divine Kingdom.
Strong enough to leave the enemy with absolutely no chance to counterattack.
Yang Fan slowly looked up, watching the boundless army of believers before him, and took a deep breath.
The next moment, his voice resonated throughout the entire Divine Kingdom.
“My believers.”
“You should know what we are about to face today.”
“That is an Alien God.”
“A powerful existence who controls a Divine Kingdom and possesses countless believers.”
“But I want to tell you...”
“In a war between Gods, there is never any retreat.”
“Today, we step into his Divine Kingdom, not for destruction, but to allow our civilization to continue moving forward!”
“The land beneath our feet is our home.”
“Our loved ones, our friends, our descendants, all live within this Divine Kingdom.”
“And if we want to make this home more vast, let more life be born in the future, and let all believers have a better environment to Cultivate...”
“Then we must keep moving forward!”

chapters.title: Chapter 362: Angel Race Divine Kingdom
paragraphs: Yang Fan’s voice grew louder and louder.
“Resources, we need to fight for them!”
“The future, we need to create it!”
“Today, if we defeat the Alien God, we will obtain countless resources and countless Opportunities!”
“We will possess a wider world.”
“We will possess more Cultivation resources.”
“Our civilization will continue to undergo Evolution during the war!”
“Therefore...”
Yang Fan paused for a moment, then his voice resounded across the world like thunder.
“Fight for the divine kingdom!”
“Fight for our civilization!”
“Fight for the future that belongs to us!”
“Let those Alien Gods know!”
“My, Yang Fan’s, divine kingdom cannot be violated!”
“My, Yang Fan’s, believers will never retreat!”
Boom!
As Yang Fan’s voice fell, the ten billion believers below instantly burst into earth-shaking cheers.
“Fight for the divine kingdom!”
“Fight for the god!”
“Fight for the future!”
Countless voices merged together, forming a terrifying wave of sound.
The entire divine kingdom trembled at this moment.
Seeing this, Yang Fan nodded with satisfaction.
Now, this army of ten billion was ready for war.
Yang Fan slowly turned around.
The next moment, his figure appeared high above the divine kingdom, his majestic body appearing as the center of the world.
He slowly opened his arms, a thought moving through his mind.
A passage connecting to an unknown space instantly opened in the Void Realm.
“Fight!”
“My believers!”
“Let the Alien God feel the fury from our divine kingdom!”
As Yang Fan’s voice fell, he waved his hand.
In an instant.
Countless spatial rifts appeared simultaneously.
“Warriors!”
“Charge for me!”
Yang Da’s voice followed immediately after.
The next moment, countless believers, like a tide, frantically poured into the spatial passage.
Looking from a distance, the dense figures, like an endless swarm of ants, advanced toward another world.
The Cultivation civilization, Martial Arts civilization, Elf Race, and Mechanical Civilization.
The four major systems formed battle formations and, following pre-planned routes, entered the enemy’s divine kingdom in batches.
On the other side, the White Zombie believers of the Zombie Kingdom entered from another spatial passage.
Behind them followed the massive flesh disaster hive.
Before reaching the White Zombie Realm, believers of the corpse-Cultivation system could not control their own corpse poison.
They were like mobile pathogens.
Even their own allies could not get close for long periods.
Therefore, only after entering the enemy’s divine kingdom would they be released from the flesh disaster hive.
This not only avoided affecting their own army but also maximized the advantages of the zombie legion.
Meanwhile, Yang Four, Yang Eleven, and other war-type high-level Intelligent Life also led their troops into the enemy’s divine kingdom.
As for Yang Yi, he remained at the rear to coordinate war resources.
A large number of f3500 fighter jets began to mobilize.
Countless robots and ordinary believers also began to transport supplies from the Divine Kingdom Core area.
Medicinal Pills, weapons, Talismans, and energy were all prepared to support the The Frontline at any time.
The war officially began at this moment.
Yang Fan waved his hand and then took Yang Da back to the core palace of the divine kingdom.
Now that the believers had entered the enemy’s divine kingdom.
He and Yang Da only needed to observe everything on the battlefield through the perspective of the believers.
Yang Fan sat on the divine throne, his consciousness connecting to the believers on the The Frontline.
The next moment.
A strange divine kingdom scene appeared before his eyes.
This was the divine kingdom of the Angel Race god.
Mountains rose and fell, rivers surged.
Birds flew across the sky, and various creatures ran on the ground.
Everything looked not much different from the Human Race divine kingdom.
But the only difference was... the entire divine kingdom was planted with a type of plant that emitted a pure white light.
These plants covered the land.
A breeze blew by, emitting a faint, refreshing fragrance.
Yang Fan could even perceive the sense of tranquility brought by this fragrance through the believers’ perception.
Smelling this scent for a long time seemed to soothe even the spirit.
“Yang Da.”
Yang Fan frowned slightly.
“Immediately scan these plants.”
“Yes, Master.”
Just a moment later, Yang Da’s voice came.
“Master, I have found it.”
“This is a C-Rank Spirit Plant, the Holy Spirit Flower.”
“It contains rich, holy power.”

“The Angel Race is naturally inclined toward light and spirit attributes, so they usually plant a large number of Holy Spirit Flowers in their divine kingdom to increase the Cultivation speed of their believers and enhance their spiritual talent.”
Yang Fan was thoughtful, “In other words, these plants are not dangerous?”
“That’s correct.”
Yang Da replied.
“However, it is only a C-Rank Spirit Plant, and its value is not high.”
“With the current income of Master’s divine kingdom, there is no need to waste time harvesting them.”
After hearing this, Yang Fan leaned back on the divine throne and couldn’t help but shake his head.
“Why plant so many harmless Spirit Plants on the periphery of the divine kingdom?”
“Shouldn’t they be setting up defensive buildings?”
“At the very least, they should set up a large number of traps like the Thousand Poison Swamp.”
“This Angel Race god...”
“What on earth are they thinking?”
Hearing Yang Fan’s words, Yang Da’s face couldn’t help but twitch.
However, he did not refute it.
Because he knew very well why his master’s cognition was so different from other gods.
I am afraid that only his own god would set up such an exaggerated number of defensive buildings on the periphery of the divine kingdom.
Under normal circumstances, the true core combat power of a divine kingdom is always the believers themselves.
The more powerful a god is, the more they hope to utilize their divine kingdom space to the extreme.
Of course, they would also set up defensive buildings on the periphery of the divine kingdom.
But the role of those buildings is more to delay the enemy’s attack speed and consume the enemy’s war resources.
What truly determines the victory or defeat is still the slaughter between the believers of both sides.
As for Planting a large number of low-rank Spirit Plants in the divine kingdom, that is the most normal thing.
On one hand, Spirit Plants can improve the divine kingdom’s environment and increase the Cultivation speed of believers.
On the other hand, after the Spirit Plants mature, they can be harvested and sold, converted into Divinity Points.
This is the normal way most gods manage their divine kingdoms.
It’s just... Yang Fan is different.
Possessing the SSS-Rank Evolution Talent, he simply does not need to consider the resource gains that ordinary gods care about most.
Today, his divine kingdom’s peripheral area is almost entirely occupied by defensive buildings.
Not to mention Spirit Plants, even the Spiritual Veins that greatly improve the environment have not been set up.
Because for Yang Fan, time and resources have already lost their meaning.
At the end of the day, it is because the SSS-Rank Evolution Talent is too Heaven-Defying.
It is so powerful that when Yang Fan sees the management methods of ordinary gods, he finds them somewhat incomprehensible.
It is just like how gods cannot understand why demigods would haggle over resources.
Similarly, those gods who possess vast resources cannot understand why ordinary gods need to be frugal.
However, Yang Da only dared to think about these words in his heart.
To ask him to correct his master... he no longer has the guts to do that now.

chapters.title: Chapter 363: Without Rules, Nothing Can Be Accomplished
paragraphs: “Master, you are wise,” Yang Da said quickly.
“The way this Angel Race deity has set things up has actually given us an opportunity.”
“With this, the difficulty of our army advancing on the periphery of the enemy divine kingdom will be greatly reduced.”
Yang Fan nodded.
“Tell Yang Four and the others to advance at full speed.”
“Establish a defensive line every one hundred kilometers.”
“If you encounter strong resistance, retreat to the defensive line and wait for follow-up support.”
“This is the first Divine Kingdom War in the true sense.”
“Just advance steadily and surely.”
“I do not ask for great achievements, but I demand that there be no mistakes.”
“Yes, Master.”
Yang Da nodded immediately.
Afterward, he transmitted the order to the war-type Intelligent Life on the The Frontline.
Upon receiving the instructions, Yang Four and the other war-type Intelligent Life did not hesitate.
“All troops, listen to my command!”
“Accelerate the advance!”
“Follow the plan and occupy the peripheral areas of the enemy divine kingdom!”
Following the issuance of the order, the vast army began to push forward.

Meanwhile, in the core area of the Angel Race divine kingdom, inside a pristine white palace, a humanoid creature with snowy white wings was watching the illusory light screen in front of him with a grave expression.
It was a patch of white mist, and within the mist, the scene of the divine kingdom’s periphery was being reflected.
Countless Human Race believers were advancing rapidly.
Various war weapons were emitting heart-palpitating auras.
“Great Angel God.”
“The divine kingdom has not experienced war for tens of thousands of years.”
“This time, the invaders are powerful.”
“We beseech our God for guidance; how should we resist?”
Below, a large number of Angel Race believers knelt on the ground.
Each of them possessed strength not inferior to a Human Race Core Formation Cultivator.
There were both men and women, and their appearance was almost indistinguishable from the Human Race.
The only difference was that they each had a pair of white wings on their backs.
Watching the enemies on the light screen, the Angel God frowned deeply.
“Human Race deity...”
“Cultivation system, Martial Arts system, Mechanical system, and even Elf Race dependents.”
His gaze fell on another part of the battlefield scene.
There, a group of corpse-Cultivator believers was emitting a cold, gloomy aura.
“Corpse-Cultivation system...”
“To think there is a Human Race deity who follows this path.”
A trace of gravity flashed in the Angel God’s eyes.
After a moment of silence, the Angel God finally made a decision.
A majestic voice resonated throughout the entire divine kingdom.
“My believers.”
“The enemy has invaded, do not panic.”
“Follow the defensive tactics practiced over the last thousand years to guard the borders of the divine kingdom.”
“Rely on the Holy Spirit Flower area to construct defensive lines and wear down the enemy army through defense.”
“Do not rush into a decisive battle.”
“Delay them and wait for my return.”
“I will bring support within a year.”
“At that time, I will personally descend onto the battlefield.”
“Let the invaders know that the glory of the Angel Race cannot be violated.”
“We obey our God’s decree!”
Below, all the Angel Race believers responded in unison, their voices echoing throughout the divine kingdom.
The next moment, the Angel God’s consciousness instantly returned to reality.
He opened his eyes.
At this moment, he was in a massive, pristine white palace.
Around the palace, powerful auras of deities flickered in and out of existence.
This was the gathering place for Angel Race deities.
The Angel God did not linger for a second.
He immediately stood up and rushed toward the Angel Race’s The Frontline military affairs area.
Now that his divine kingdom was being invaded, he had to apply for support from the tribe immediately.
In the Angel Race’s The Frontline military affairs office, an Angel Race deity wearing white battle armor walked in quickly.
“My Lord.”
“I am Lufa, Battalion Commander of the 24th Military District.”
“My divine kingdom is being invaded by a coalition of Human Race deities.”
“I am now applying for support from the tribe!”
After speaking, Lufa bowed respectfully.
He then extended his right hand, and a mass of pure white mist slowly drifted out.
This was a unique way of transmitting information for the Angel Race.
Through this special ability, they could transmit everything that happened in their divine kingdom to other clansmen in a manner similar to video recording.
As long as the other party received it, they could clearly see the entire process of the Divine Kingdom War.
And at this moment, this mass of white mist was recording everything about Yang Fan’s army invading the Angel divine kingdom.
The Angel Race deity in charge of processing just glanced casually at the images in the white mist and quickly made a judgment.
“Application approved.”
“They have Elf Race dependents, and in addition to that, there are three major civilization systems: Mechanical, Cultivation, and Martial Arts.”
“Judging from the intelligence currently available, it is highly likely that three Human Race deities are invading together, and at the very least, there are no fewer than two.”
Speaking of this, his gaze fell onto another army emitting a gloomy aura.
“As for the corpse-Cultivation system...”
“This type of civilization is extremely rare; it should be a Human Race deity who follows a special path.”
After pondering for a moment, that Tier 3 Angel God spoke slowly.
“According to the The Frontline military regulations, I will arrange for four entry-level deities to support you.”
“During the war, they will provide you with weapons, Medicinal Pill, and war supplies, as well as arrange corresponding tactical guidance.”
“All supplies will be traded at a price slightly higher than the cost price.”
“If the war situation worsens and the enemy successfully breaches your Divine Kingdom Core area, you can also voluntarily open your divine kingdom coordinates.”
“At that time, they will dispatch some of their believers into your divine kingdom to assist in resisting the foreign enemy.”
“Thank you, My Lord!” Lufa immediately bowed.
In fact, it was not just the Angel Race.
Throughout the entire The Frontline battlefield, almost all races had established similar mutual aid systems.
After all, when fighting on the The Frontline, no one could guarantee that they would not be the next person to be invaded.
If someone helped you today, you would help others in the future.
The entire race was, in reality, a community of interests.
Of course, this help was not without cost.
Divine Kingdom Wars were extremely expensive.
Every weapon, every Medicinal Pill, and every war building represented a massive amount of wealth behind it.
No deity would be willing to unconditionally exhaust their own foundation for someone else’s war.
Therefore, all races had formulated nearly identical rules.
Members of the same race could support each other.
But all war resources had to be traded at a price slightly higher than the cost.
This ensured that support could continue to operate without causing the party providing the help to bear excessive losses.
As the saying goes, “Without rules, nothing can be accomplished.”
If one were to blindly demand selfless dedication from deities, then in the long run, even the most perfect system would eventually exist in name only.
After all, those who had reached the level of a deity were all old monsters who had lived for tens of thousands of years or even longer.
It was simply unrealistic to expect all deities to willingly bring out their own foundations based solely on the grand cause of the race.
Only when interests were aligned and rules were clear could the entire The Frontline system operate truly and sustainably.
For all deities, what they were upholding was not just a rule, but an order that could also protect themselves in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 364: Strength is Nothing More Than This
paragraphs: After receiving the reply, Lufa also secretly breathed a sigh of relief in his heart.
Once a war breaks out, the thing most lacking is time.
If he were to purchase a large amount of war resources now, even if he had enough Divinity Points, it would be too late to produce them.
Now, being able to directly allocate supplies from nearby divine kingdoms of the same race, and at prices close to cost, was already a huge help to him.
As for opening his divine kingdom coordinates... Lufa had never considered it from the very beginning.
That was his final trump card.
It was also a helpless choice to be made only when the divine kingdom was on the verge of destruction.
After all, divine kingdom coordinates were the greatest secret of every deity.
Even when facing those of the same race, no one was willing to reveal them easily.
No one could guarantee that there wouldn’t be someone with ulterior motives among their own race.
If someone were to secretly sell their divine kingdom coordinates to an outside race...
One might not have the intention to harm others.
But one must absolutely have the intention to guard against others.
Therefore, until the final moment when the divine kingdom was about to be destroyed, no deity was willing to let another deity’s believers enter their own divine kingdom.
The area of a deity’s divine kingdom was far beyond that of a demigod.
The ten billion troops Yang Fan initially deployed were merely the vanguard.
Their mission was simple: to gain a foothold on the periphery of the enemy’s divine kingdom and construct a stable defensive line for the war.
As the spatial channels continued to open, army after army of believers constantly entered the Angel Race’s divine kingdom.
Within the divine kingdom, it had only been a short year.
The total number of believers deployed to the battlefield had already exceeded thirty billion.
Divine Kingdom Core.
Inside the magnificent palace.
Yang Fan sat high upon his divine throne, his expression calm.
Yang Da and Ling Xuzi stood on his left and right sides respectively.
And in front of the three of them, dozens of huge virtual light screens were floating.
Each light screen corresponded to a battlefield.
Plains, mountains, rivers, forests...
Real-time images from countless battlefields were constantly being transmitted back from the The Frontline.
The war between deities’ divine kingdoms had a front line that was simply too long.
The number of believers easily reached tens of billions or even hundreds of billions.
If one were to rely entirely on divine authority to connect to the believers’ perspectives, even with Yang Fan’s current Mental Energy, he would feel a significant burden.
Therefore, the Mechanical Civilization had long since developed specialized battlefield monitoring devices.
Monitoring equipment spread across the The Frontline transmitted the real-time battle situation from various places back to the Divine Kingdom Core.
Yang Fan only needed to adjust the strategic deployment of the entire battlefield based on these images.
His gaze swept across the various battlefields, and he suddenly spoke indifferently.
“The strength of this Angel Race is nothing more than this.”
“Is it time to speed up the pace of the invasion?”
In one year within the divine kingdom, the Angel Race had organized several large-scale blocking battles one after another.
On the plains, among the forests, and on both banks of the riverbeds.
Billions of Angel Race believers relied on the terrain advantages to desperately block the advance of Yang Fan’s army.
However, in the face of absolute strength, these resistances appeared somewhat pale and feeble.
Among the entire Angel Race army, the strongest was only at the Core Formation Realm.
Furthermore, most of these Core Formation angels were stationed at the core of the military formations.
Once they sensed that the battle situation was unfavorable, they would immediately retreat; they would never fight to the death.
Whether it was weapon equipment, military formation systems, or overall cultivation, they were far from being comparable to Yang Fan’s believers.
“This subordinate agrees with Master’s judgment.”
Yang Da bowed slightly.

“Based on the analysis of the engagements over this past year, the divine kingdom talent awakened by this Angel Race deity should be biased towards cultivation assistance rather than war enhancement.”
“Although the growth rate of his believers is decent, their true frontal combat power is not outstanding.”
“If we continue at the current rate of advancement, I fear it will take several hundred years to reach the core area of the opponent’s divine kingdom.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan nodded slightly.
Several hundred years in the opponent’s divine kingdom, when converted to the real world, was several hundred days.
For ordinary deities, such a war tempo was perfectly normal.
But Yang Fan was unwilling to waste so much time.
In one hundred days in the real world, ten thousand years had already passed in his divine kingdom.
Now, his divine kingdom’s population growth had gradually stabilized.
He needed to devour new Divine Kingdom Cores, expand the area of his divine kingdom, and further improve his overall strength.
Naturally, he would not waste time on a war of attrition that was destined to be won.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan turned his gaze to the side.
“Ling Xuzi.”
“How is your reconnaissance going?”
Hearing the inquiry, Ling Xuzi immediately knelt on one knee, a look of guilt appearing on his face.
“Master, this subordinate is incompetent.”
“This Angel Race is born with holy and light attributes, which have a natural restraint against my Void Spirit Race.”
“My clansmen are currently at most at the Qi Refining Realm.”
“As soon as they get slightly close to the Angel Race army, it is extremely easy to expose their tracks.”
“As of now, we have already lost over fifty thousand clansmen.”
Speaking of this, a flash of heartbreak appeared in Ling Xuzi’s eyes.
Those Void Spirit Race believers were all clansmen he had cultivated bit by bit.
Now that they were being lost one after another, it would be a lie to say he didn’t feel bad.
At the same time, a sense of unease also arose in his heart.
In the end, his own strength was still too weak.
What he was facing now was no longer a demigod’s divine kingdom with incomplete rules.
But a true deity’s divine kingdom.
Here, the laws of heaven and earth were complete, and space was incomparably solid.
The spatial talent that the Void Spirit Race was most proud of had also been greatly suppressed.
They could no longer freely traverse space and come and go without a trace as they did before.
Their reconnaissance capabilities were naturally greatly reduced.
Yang Fan, upon hearing this, did not blame him.
Instead, after a moment of contemplation, he spoke slowly.
“Continue to dispatch the Void Spirit Race to enter the enemy’s divine kingdom for reconnaissance.”
“However, from now on, every reconnaissance squad must be equipped with alarm devices produced by my divine kingdom’s Mechanical Civilization.”
“In addition, the reconnaissance range must not exceed one hundred li from our main force.”
“Once danger is discovered, immediately retreat towards the direction of the main army.”
“In this way, we should be able to minimize losses.”
“Yes!” A look of gratitude immediately appeared in Ling Xuzi’s eyes. “Thank you for your understanding, Master!”
Such an arrangement, although it would significantly reduce the Void Spirit Race’s reconnaissance range and consequently lower reconnaissance efficiency quite a bit.
But correspondingly, the survival rate of the clansmen would be greatly improved.
Ling Xuzi couldn’t help but feel moved in his heart.
If it were his previous masters, how would they care about the life or death of his believers?
In the eyes of those deities, they were just consumables that could be sacrificed at any time.
But his current master was willing to actively adjust the entire war deployment just to reduce their casualties.
Such a deity was truly worth following for a lifetime.
Yang Fan pondered for a moment, then turned to look at Yang Da.
“Purchase a large amount of resources suitable for the Void Spirit Race to Cultivate.”
“The Qi Refining Realm is still too weak; help Ling Xuzi Cultivate a batch of Foundation Establishment Realm believers as soon as possible.”
“Yes, this subordinate will arrange it immediately.” Yang Da did not hesitate in the slightest and immediately nodded in agreement.
Yang Fan continued:
“In addition, from those Divine Kingdom Cores sent by Li Tianheng, pick some of the smallest ones and give them to Ling Xuzi.”
“I want him to reach the deity Realm as soon as possible.”
“This subordinate understands.”

chapters.title: Chapter 365: War, Resources, and Supply
paragraphs: Only by truly experiencing a war between gods can one discover that they still have many shortcomings.
During the demigod stage, the Void Spirit Race had provided him with immense help.
Whether it was scouting the enemy situation in advance, warning of danger, or reconnoitering the enemy’s divine kingdom, the Void Spirit Race had made significant contributions.
It was just that... Yang Fan was growing too fast.
Possessing the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, his divine kingdom’s strength would welcome a leap forward almost every period of time.
Now, facing a real Divine Kingdom Battlefield, the Void Spirit Race believers at the Qi Refining Realm were gradually failing to keep up with the pace of war.
But these problems were nothing to Yang Fan.
Resources?
Nowadays, the thing his divine kingdom lacked the least was resources.
It only required taking out a tiny portion to allow the entire Void Spirit Race to complete a comprehensive transformation.
As for the Divine Kingdom Core needed for a Breakthrough to godhood.
Yang Fan was not lacking in that either.
By using the corpse pill to launch proxy wars, the Divine Kingdom Cores of ordinary demigods were now almost within his reach.
And the talents that could be obtained from these ordinary Divine Kingdom Cores were mostly only F-grade.
In the short term, it was better to use them to cultivate Ling Xuzi.
Only when the Void Spirit Race truly grew up could they continue to exert their irreplaceable role on the Divine Kingdom Battlefield in the future.
Hearing Yang Fan’s words, Ling Xuzi’s delicate body trembled slightly, and she immediately knelt on the ground without hesitation.
“Thank you, Master, for your cultivation!”
“Everything you have bestowed upon me today, Master, I will remember for all eternity!”
“From now on, through mountains of blades and seas of fire, as long as you give the word, Master, even if my Divine Soul is utterly destroyed, I will never take a step back!”
“You have given me a new life and given the Void Spirit Race a future, Master.”
“In this life, I am yours in life, and yours in death!”
“I am willing to lead the Void Spirit Race to serve by your side for generations to come, and will never betray you!”
Yang Fan’s lips curled up slightly as he listened.
However, he quickly restrained his smile.
“Alright, stop with the flattery.”
“What I want to see is results.”
“I will help you become stronger, and I will help you achieve a Breakthrough to godhood.”
“But on the Divine Kingdom Battlefield, I must see corresponding returns.”
“Do you understand?”
“I understand, Master!” Ling Xuzi nodded heavily.
In this world, there is never help without reason, nor is there favoritism without cause.
If others are willing to support you, it is not out of charity, but because you possess value worth investing in.
But if you are never able to create value, then one day, all help will leave you.
Although Ling Xuzi was very good at flattery, and Yang Fan quite enjoyed it.
What he truly valued, however, remained the unique reconnaissance ability of the Void Spirit Race.
“I will never betray your trust, Master!” Ling Xuzi said with a firm expression.
Yang Fan slowly stood up, his gaze falling back onto the battlefield light screen in front of him.
“Continue mobilizing troops.”
“Send more believers into the enemy’s divine kingdom.”
“Order Yang Eleven to lead the zombie army to continue penetrating deep into enemy territory and infect as many Angel Race believers as possible.”
“For all other units, double the speed of advancement.”
“Let the Mechanical War Puppets and Intelligent Gundams take the lead to pave the way for the army.”
“Additionally, continue to expand the scale of war material production within the divine kingdom.”
“Especially the Intelligent Gundams; prioritize their production.”
“This type of war weapon can minimize casualties among our believers.”
“Yes, Master!” Yang Da immediately replied.
After observing the battle, Yang Fan had witnessed the huge advantages of Mechanical Civilization in the Divine Kingdom War.
Those Intelligent Gundams, under the control of Intelligent Life, were like steel giants.
Charging into battle, they were invincible.
They could completely take the lead, blocking the vast majority of attacks for the believers behind them.
The only disadvantage was their overly large size.
Standing on the battlefield, they were like huge targets.
Moreover, their overall strength was far inferior to the Mechanical War Puppets.
Faced with the powerful attacks condensed by the Angel Race using Formations, the Intelligent Gundams would still be destroyed.
“Rest assured, Master.”
Yang Da grinned.
“I have already arranged for Intelligent Life to add two new production lines.”
“The current output is not only enough to make up for the losses on the The Frontline but can also continuously increase inventory.”
Speaking of this, Yang Da’s face was full of pride.
The terror of the Hundredfold Evolution Talent was also fully reflected at this moment.
For the vast majority of gods.
A Divine Kingdom War is a crazy consumption of resources and heritage.
But for Yang Fan, it was the exact opposite.
Weapons, the more they fought, the more there were.
War buildings, the faster they were built.
The source of troops also became more and more abundant as the divine kingdom continued to develop.
Nowadays, the war materials consumed by the The Frontline war were not even a small fraction of the divine kingdom’s daily total production.
Of course, the Angel Race god could not possibly know all this.
In his eyes, he would only think that Yang Fan was just well-prepared for war.
He might even be excited about how many Intelligent Gundams he had successfully consumed.
Yang Fan’s consciousness soon returned to the real world.
For gods, the divine kingdom is vast and boundless.
A Divine Kingdom War could never be like a battle between demigods, where the winner is decided in a short time.
Currently, Yang Fan’s army had only just broken through the outer defensive area of the Angel Race’s divine kingdom, and what was mainly happening were small-scale skirmishes.
In this situation, there was naturally no need for Yang Fan to keep staring at the battlefield.
In terms of war command, having Yang Da and those high-level Intelligent Life handle it was sufficient.
If an emergency occurred, or if a massive battle of believers on the scale of over ten billion took place.
Yang Da would naturally remind him immediately.
After all, war is not just about combat power.
It is also about population, logistics, equipment, and a continuous supply of war resources.
And in these aspects, Yang Fan believed he held an absolute advantage.
Of course, he would not underestimate his opponent because of this.
After all, this was the first god he had truly crusaded against.
Any existence capable of becoming a god would never be simple.
Time passed slowly.
In the real world, another five days had passed.
On this day, while in the Virtual World, Yang Fan suddenly heard Yang Da’s voice.
Yang Fan did not hesitate, his consciousness instantly entering the divine kingdom.
The next moment, his figure appeared in the Divine Kingdom Core palace.
“Has there been a change on the battlefield?”
As soon as he appeared, Yang Fan asked directly.
“Reporting to Master.”
Yang Da immediately saluted.
“There have indeed been some changes on the The Frontline recently.”
“The Angel Race’s resistance intensity has significantly increased, and they have invested a large amount of war resources.”
“The zombie contamination plan executed by Yang Eleven has also been somewhat affected.”
“A large number of antidotes targeting the zombie virus have suddenly appeared within the enemy’s divine kingdom, which have temporarily curbed the infection rate.”
“Besides that, the Angel Race believers’ interception is more intensive, and tens of thousands of Intelligent Gundams are lost every year.”
“However, the divine kingdom’s production speed far exceeds the consumption, and Yang Yi has established a dedicated transport route based on the The Frontline losses.”
“Once there is a gap on the The Frontline, war weapons and supplies will be delivered immediately.”
“Currently, the overall progress of the war is stable, and no special circumstances have occurred.”

chapters.title: Chapter 366: Alchemy Spirit World
paragraphs: After listening to the report, Yang Fan breathed a sigh of relief.
Immediately after, his Mental Energy covered the entire battlefield in an instant.
Through the perspective of his believers, he could clearly sense the situation at The Frontline.
Right now, his army had advanced to about one-fifth of the Angel Race’s Divine Kingdom territory.
This speed was much faster than he had anticipated.
“Not bad.”
Yang Fan nodded with satisfaction.
“Very well done.”
Then, he asked in confusion:
“Since there are no issues on the battlefield, why did you contact me so suddenly?”
Hearing this, Yang Da’s face showed a trace of excitement.
“Reporting to Master.”
“In this Dark Web auction, top-tier S-Rank Buildings extremely suitable for the development of the Divine Kingdom have appeared!”
“And... there are two of them!”
“Since the Dark Web uses a single-bid format, your subordinate did not dare to make a decision without authorization.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s eyes instantly lit up.
After such a long time, the Dark Web finally had something big up for bid.
“Project the detailed information.”
“Yes, Master.”
Yang Da nodded.
The next moment, a massive amount of data flashed in his eyes.
A huge virtual light screen instantly emerged in front of Yang Fan.
[S-Rank Building: Alchemy Spirit World]
[Description: Special resource-type building, forming its own Small World.]
[The area of the Alchemy Spirit World is one percent of the total area of the Divine Kingdom. It contains dense Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi and possesses top-grade Heaven and Earth Furnace Fire.]
[Performing Alchemy inside the Alchemy Spirit World can greatly enhance Alchemy efficiency.]
[Effect: Alchemy success rate increased by 500%.]

[Residing in the Alchemy Spirit World long-term can subtly improve the Alchemist’s Comprehension Ability, with a chance to refine existing Pill Formulas and increase the success rate of creating new Medicinal Pills.]

[Evaluation: Top-tier resource-type building. With the Alchemy Spirit World, the efficiency of the Divine Kingdom’s Medicinal Pill industry will receive a massive boost, and Medicinal Pill-related revenues can be increased by up to 4 to 5 times.]
[S-Rank Building: Heavenly Court]
[Description:...]
[Evaluation:...]
Looking at the information in front of him, a look of satisfaction appeared in Yang Fan’s eyes.
“It wasn’t easy for two top-tier S-Rank Buildings to appear at once.”
“No matter what, I must secure both of them.”
For Yang Fan, the importance of Medicinal Pills went without saying.
Excluding the Intelligent Life of the Mechanical Civilization,
the Cultivation system, Martial Dao system, Elf Race, and even those believers taking the Corpse Cultivator path...
...all required Medicinal Pills to assist in their Cultivate process.
And this was just for daily consumption.
If they truly entered a state of war, the consumption of Medicinal Pills would surge a hundredfold in an instant.
Although the Alchemy Spirit World was only one percent of the Divine Kingdom’s area,
the area of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had now reached ten billion square kilometers.
One percent meant one hundred million square kilometers.
Such a vast space, if used solely to train Alchemists, was more than enough.
Of course, Yang Fan hadn’t considered making money by selling Medicinal Pills for the time being.
After all, under the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, the believers’ consumption was extremely terrifying.
Sometimes, even Yang Da needed to purchase Medicinal Pills from the outside world to meet the development needs of the Divine Kingdom.
In the long run, the Alchemy Spirit World held great significance for him.
With the existence of the Virtual World, buying Resources from the Real World was indeed very convenient now.
But a truly powerful Divine Kingdom could never rely entirely on external supply.
In the Real World, a large-scale racial war hadn’t broken out in tens of thousands of years.
But according to historical records Yang Fan had read in Taichu City,
every time a large-scale war broke out,
Resources like Medicinal Pills, weapons, and war buildings would skyrocket in price,
even reaching a state where they were priceless and unavailable.
This was just like grain.
A nation could buy grain, but it could never rely entirely on imports.
Otherwise, once the external environment changed, the entire system would fall into a passive position.
The same applied to a Divine Kingdom.
Resource self-sufficiency would always be an important standard for measuring a Divine Kingdom’s foundation.
Of course, these principles were all things Yang Fan had read from books.
Perhaps they didn’t apply to his own Divine Kingdom.
After all... his believers had long been spoiled picky by him.
Especially those believers at or above the Core Formation Realm.
What they consumed daily were spiritual liquids and spiritual milk.
On special anniversary days of the Divine Kingdom, they even had the chance to taste high-tier Resources like Earth Heart Milk.
Looking across The Frontline, one probably couldn’t find a second Divine Kingdom so extravagant.
But a principle remained a principle.
Being prepared for any contingency was definitely right.
The Alchemy Spirit World was something he must acquire.
As for the Heavenly Court, he needed it just as much.
As Yang Fan had a Breakthrough to become a deity,
after the area of the Heavenly Court expanded to one billion square kilometers, it completely stopped growing.
Currently, the entire Heavenly Court only occupied about one-tenth of the Divine Kingdom’s sky area.
Because the Cultivation environment inside the Heavenly Court was superb,
most of those currently able to enter it to Cultivate were Cultivation believers with deep backgrounds or powerful strength.
As for those Cultivation believers with insufficient strength, more of them now chose to live in the City of Technology on the ground.
Therefore, as for these two top-tier S-Rank Buildings,
Yang Fan did not want to give up on either of them.
“Master, how should we place our bids?”
Yang Fan pondered for a moment, then asked:
“Are there historical transaction prices for these two buildings on the Dark Web?”
“Reporting to Master.”
“According to database retrieval, the average historical transaction price for the Alchemy Spirit World is around seven trillion Divinity Points.”
“And the average historical transaction price for the Heavenly Court is around nine trillion Divinity Points.”
Yang Da reported truthfully.
“So low?”
Hearing this, a trace of surprise appeared on Yang Fan’s face.
Only a few trillion Divinity Points?
To him now, this was nothing at all.
Seeing Yang Fan’s slightly surprised expression,
Yang Da’s face twitched violently.
“Master...”
“You might have some misunderstanding regarding the value of a trillion Divinity Points.”
Yang Da hesitated for a moment before speaking cautiously.
“Among the publicly listed companies in various Star Domains, many have a market capitalization of less than one trillion Divinity Points.”
“And according to available data, no deity would deploy Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests and enlightenment ancient trees in large quantities within their Divine Kingdom like you do, Master.”
“The current revenue of the Divine Kingdom is built upon the foundation of the SSS-Rank Evolution Talent and the S-rank Talent Growth of All Things.”
“Without these special talents...”
“...the estimated monthly revenue of Master’s Divine Kingdom would only be around a hundred billion Divinity Points.”
“Even so, this revenue already exceeds the annual profits of the vast majority of listed companies.”
Yang Da’s voice was very soft.
He even observed Yang Fan’s expression secretly while explaining,
afraid that his words might make his master feel he was questioning his judgment.
In Yang Da’s view,
the biggest problem with his master was that making money was simply too easy for him.
So easy that he had developed a skewed perception of prices.
After listening, Yang Fan couldn’t help but cough awkwardly.
“In that case...”
“...what bid do you think is appropriate?”
Yang Da replied immediately:
“According to historical data analysis...”
“...if Master bids ten trillion Divinity Points for each...”
“...the probability of successfully winning one item is about 97.2%.”
“The probability of securing both buildings simultaneously reaches 82%.”
Yang Fan nodded.
“What if I bid fifteen trillion?”

chapters.title: Chapter 367: Auction Success
paragraphs: Yang Da was silent for a moment, then said:
“The price will be significantly high.”
“In historical records, the highest bid for the Alchemy Spirit World was 10.2 trillion Divinity Points.”
“The highest bid for the Heavenly Court was 11.5 trillion Divinity Points.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan did not hesitate at all.
“Then bid 15 trillion for both.”
“I want to secure them 100%.”
For S-Rank Building levels like the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest and the enlightenment ancient tree,
Yang Fan would never compete so crazily.
Because although these buildings are precious, they appear on the Dark Web every month.
One only needs to offer a reasonable price.
But the Alchemy Spirit World and the Heavenly Court are different.
These types of top-tier S-Rank Buildings are simply too rare.
No one knows when they will appear next.
For Yang Fan, who possesses the SSS-Rank Evolution Talent,
The earlier he possesses these top-tier buildings, the faster his Divine Kingdom will develop.
Time, in itself, is the greatest resource.
As for spending a few trillion more Divinity Points?
Yang Fan didn’t care at all.
It was just Divinity Points, after all.
Nowadays, the wealth created by his Divine Kingdom every day far exceeds what ordinary gods can imagine.
In Yang Fan’s view, this is a guaranteed profitable investment.
“Yes, Master.” Yang Da nodded.
Then, in front of Yang Fan, he directly connected to the Dark Web and submitted the bidding information.
From the perspective of an Intelligent Life’s calculations, Yang Fan’s bid was undoubtedly on the high side.
If following the optimal strategy, the price could definitely be lowered.
But... Yang Da did not raise any objections.
The reason was simple: his master was not short of money.
Moreover, arguing with the master over the loss of a few trillion Divinity Points was meaningless.
If he accidentally annoyed his master, causing his own palace to be sealed, the loss would be huge.
After submitting the bid, Yang Fan did not leave the Divine Kingdom.
Instead, he stayed directly in Yang Da’s palace, sat in the main seat, and quietly waited for the Dark Web auction results.
“Master.”
Yang Da glanced at the Dark Web auction countdown.
“There is still quite some time before the auction ends.”
“Does Master need some entertainment?”
“Entertainment?” Yang Fan was slightly taken aback.
Clearly, he had not expected Yang Da to suddenly make this suggestion.
Seeing Yang Fan’s puzzled expression, Yang Da immediately revealed a flattering smile.
Then, he gently clapped his hands, “Come in.”
The next moment.
The palace gates slowly opened.
A large number of female believers walked in slowly.
Among them, the most numerous were the Core Formation female cultivators from the Cultivation system.
Besides them, there were also many Elf Race women.
They all had different temperaments.
Some wore gorgeous long dresses, some wore specially designed outfits, and some Elf Race women carried a unique natural aura.
Clearly, these were all carefully selected by Yang Da.
Just at this moment, when they saw Yang Fan sitting on the main seat of the palace, everyone’s expressions instantly became nervous.
They hurriedly knelt on the ground.
“Greetings, My God!”
The voices were neat and loud.
Yang Fan looked at the scene before him, his brows slightly raised.
It had to be said that Yang Da’s taste was indeed quite good.
These believers and Elf Race women were all carefully selected from tens of billions, or even hundreds of billions, of believers.
Although in terms of temperament, they could not compare to noble ladies from top families like Gu Le.
But in terms of appearance alone, they were definitely each outstanding in their own way.
They were even much better than the professional staff at Tianxiang Renjian.
In fact, Yang Fan had always known the true purpose of this palace that Yang Da was in charge of, he just hadn’t seen it with his own eyes before.
Now that he truly saw it, he realized that this kid’s daily life was actually so comfortable.
Yang Fan’s mouth twitched slightly, not knowing why.
At this moment, he actually felt a trace of inexplicable envy in his heart.
This was his Divine Kingdom, after all.
In the real world, he needed to follow various rules.
But within the Divine Kingdom, when he was away, Yang Da almost held the highest authority.
He could do whatever he wanted.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan even felt a bit suspicious.
Was he, the god, actually living less comfortably than Yang Da?
“Master.”
Yang Da said respectfully.
“I am an extension of your will.”
“In terms of aesthetics, it is naturally close to Master’s.”
“These were all carefully selected by your subordinate.”
“In addition, I also specially choreographed some dance music suitable for Master to enjoy.”
“I wonder if Master would like to watch?”
Yang Fan glanced at him, then nodded faintly, “Very well.”
Having received permission, Yang Da immediately smiled.
Then he turned and waved, “Begin.”
The next moment.
Throughout the palace, music slowly began to play.
The surrounding smart devices started simultaneously.
Light and shadow, music, and environmental layout were completed in an instant.
Those female cultivators and Elf Race women, who were still a bit nervous just a moment ago, also quickly adjusted their state.
Accompanied by the music, they began to display their dance moves.
Every movement had been carefully trained.
Every turn, every rhythm, was just right.
With the god personally present, these believers naturally dared not be the least bit negligent.
They exerted everything they could show to the extreme.
At the same time, the attendant believers nearby also began to prepare spiritual wine and spiritual fruits for Yang Fan.
The entire palace was filled with an atmosphere of luxury.
Yang Fan sat on the main seat.
Looking at everything before him, he had to admit,
It was no wonder some gods would become addicted to enjoyment after possessing long lives.
After all, having the entire Divine Kingdom as a backing, controlling countless lives.
This feeling was indeed easy to get lost in.
As one song ended, Yang Da hurriedly asked: “Master, how does it feel?”
“Very good.” Yang Fan nodded with satisfaction, “Play another one.”
“Yes, Master.” Yang Da immediately arranged it.
After several dance songs, Yang Fan suddenly thought of something.
It was a pity that this was only the Divine Kingdom after all, and his body in the real world could not enter directly.
Gods could only descend with their consciousness, or re-condense a divine body in the Divine Kingdom.
Otherwise, Yang Fan wouldn’t mind occasionally treating this place as another Tianxiang Renjian.
Just as a song ended, Yang Da’s expression suddenly changed.
“Master.”
“News from the Dark Web.”
Yang Da immediately signaled everyone to withdraw.
Soon, the entire palace returned to silence.
Yang Fan picked up the spiritual wine and drank it in one gulp, “How is it?”
A smile appeared on Yang Da’s face.
“Congratulations, Master.”
“There were no accidents at all.”
“Both the Alchemy Spirit World and the Heavenly Court were successfully auctioned.”
“The auction party has already completed delivery.”
“Now, both S-Rank Buildings can be loaded into the Divine Kingdom at any time.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan slowly stood up.
The next moment, he moved his thoughts.
The rules of the entire Divine Kingdom began to operate.
First to be loaded was the Heavenly Court.
Boom!
Above the sky of the Divine Kingdom.
The space next to the originally existing Heavenly Court began to fluctuate violently.
A huge heavenly palace, equally magnificent, slowly emerged.

“In historical records, the highest bid for the Alchemy Spirit World was 10.2 trillion Divinity Points.”
“The highest bid for the Heavenly Court was 11.5 trillion Divinity Points.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan did not hesitate at all.
“Then bid 15 trillion for both.”
“I want to secure them 100%.”

Yang Fan would never compete so crazily.

chapters.title: Chapter 368: The War Value of Mechanical Civilization
paragraphs: Countless palaces, immortal mountains, and spiritual pools appeared simultaneously.
Subsequently, the new Heavenly Court perfectly fused with the original Heavenly Court, like a giant puzzle piece.
There was not the slightest conflict between the two areas.
The area of the new Heavenly Court continued to expand.
One billion square kilometers!
This was the maximum area that the S-Rank Building, the Heavenly Court, could reach.
Along with the expansion of the Heavenly Court, a massive amount of Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi began to pour in frantically.
Clouds and mist churned as Spiritual Qi gathered.
Then, under the influence of the Heavenly Court’s unique rules, this Spiritual Qi gradually began to transform, ultimately forming higher-Rank Immortal Qi.
At this moment, the entire Divine Kingdom’s Cultivation environment welcomed a massive upgrade once again.
And those Cultivation believers who originally lived in the City of Technology also felt the change immediately.
They looked up at the magnificent Heavenly Palace in the sky, each one of them incredibly excited.
Then, all the Cultivation believers knelt down together.
“Gratitude to our God!”
“Thank you for the great God’s grace!”
“May our God live forever!”
As the Heavenly Court finished loading,
Yang Fan slowly raised his right hand and pressed down gently.
The next moment,
above the sky of the Divine Kingdom, space began to fluctuate violently.
A massive transparent sphere with a diameter of over a hundred kilometers slowly emerged.
Like a miniature star, it quietly floated high in the air.
Its surface emitted a faint crimson glow, and through the transparent outer wall, faint starlight could be seen inside.
It was as if an independent planet had appeared in the sky of the Divine Kingdom.
This was the S-Rank Building—the Alchemy Spirit World.
Unlike the Eternal Corpse Mine, the Alchemy Spirit World did not take up any land area in the Divine Kingdom; it was an independent Small World in its own right.
Yang Fan did not have the believers move on their own; instead, he directly mobilized his divine authority.
Under the watchful eyes of all the Divine Kingdom’s believers,
within the Heavenly Court, Alchemy Towers suddenly turned into streams of light and flew toward the Alchemy Spirit World in the sky.
Then, they silently merged into it.
Many Alchemists who were currently performing Alchemy were also transferred by Yang Fan.
As the first batch of Alchemists entered the Alchemy Spirit World,
Yang Fan finally saw the true appearance of the interior of this S-Rank Building.
This was an independent Small World.
However, unlike ordinary worlds, the environment of this heaven and earth was extremely unique.
The entire world was filled with rich fire-attribute Spiritual Qi.
There were continuous mountain ranges in the distance, but the plants on the mountains were not ordinary green, but patches of flame-like crimson.
Rivers ran through the land, but the river water was not cold; instead, it continuously emitted billowing heat.
The entire world was like a naturally formed Holy Land for Alchemy.
The Alchemists who had just entered immediately felt the change.
They didn’t feel the slightest discomfort; instead, they felt completely refreshed.
The fire-attribute Spiritual Qi in the air actively merged into their bodies, and the rotation speed of the spiritual power within their Meridians was several times faster than before.
Even their thinking became much clearer.
Many Alchemy problems that had troubled them for years actually seemed to have new solutions at this moment.
For Alchemists with fire-attribute talents,
this place was simply a natural Holy Land.
After a moment, Yang Fan slowly withdrew his gaze.
Then, a majestic voice echoed throughout the entire Alchemy Spirit World.
“My believers.”
“For a thousand years, you have concentrated on Alchemy, dedicating yourselves to the development of the Divine Kingdom.”
“I have always seen the efforts you have made.”
“Today, I bestow upon you the Alchemy Spirit World.”
“From now on, all Alchemists may enter it to Cultivate and refine Medicinal Pills.”
“This world possesses the Heaven and Earth Furnace Fire, which can help you improve your Alchemy skills.”
“I hope you will not forget your original intention and continue to study the Dao of Alchemy.”
“Contributing your strength to the prosperity of the Divine Kingdom.”
“I look forward to the day in the future when you can create more Alchemy miracles belonging to the Divine Kingdom.”
“Let the name of the Divine Kingdom spread across the myriad worlds.”
As the last sentence fell, the entire Alchemy Spirit World fell into silence.
Then, countless Alchemists knelt on the ground one after another, their eyes moist.
“Gratitude to our God!”
“The God indeed felt our prayers!”
“We Alchemists finally have our own Holy Land for Cultivation!”
“In the future, we will no longer have to depend on the Heavenly Court and be restricted by other forces!”
“Praying in front of the Monument of Merits is useful!”
“Our efforts, the God sees them all!”
“Contribute power to the Divine Kingdom!”
“Offer our lives to the Divine Kingdom!”
Countless Alchemists were incredibly excited.
For them, this was not just a building.
It also represented the God’s recognition of their group.
Yang Fan looked at this scene with a calm expression, then turned to Yang Da and said,
“Through the channels of the Gu Clan’s resource star trading area, purchase Spirit Plant Stars in large quantities.”
“Increase the quantity to at least five times the original amount.”
“With the Alchemy Spirit World, the efficiency of the Alchemists will be greatly improved.”
“Now that manpower efficiency has increased, the supply of raw Materials cannot lag behind.”
“Yes, Master.”
Yang Da nodded and immediately began calculating.
“According to the analysis of the Alchemy Spirit World’s rules,”
“when Alchemists refine Medicinal Pills within it, their efficiency will be comprehensively improved.”
“Not only will it improve the efficiency of medicinal herb extraction,”
“but at the same time, the Pill Toxin generated during the Alchemy process will also be greatly reduced due to environmental factors.”
“The physical burden on the Alchemists will be reduced, and the time they can work continuously will also increase.”
With the loading of the Alchemy Spirit World, as the highest Intelligent Life of the Divine Kingdom, Yang Da had fully acquired all of its effects.
Compared to the simple description in the Dark Web’s introduction, the actual effects were much more powerful.
The so-called four-to-five-fold increase in Medicinal Pill production was probably still a conservative estimate.
“Ensure the transportation of Resources is well managed,”
Yang Fan continued.
“We are currently in the midst of the Divine Kingdom War.”
“These Alchemist believers will probably have to work hard for a while longer.”
“Allocate some extra Earth Core Condensate to them as a reward.”
“Yes, Master,” Yang Da immediately responded.
Yang Fan nodded, and then his gaze turned toward the direction of The Frontline once more.
“Although we are currently fighting the gods of the Angel Race,”
“the development of the Divine Kingdom cannot stop, especially the Mechanical Civilization.”
“Currently, our only war building is the Intelligent Mecha, which is still too singular.”
“Aside from continuing to expand the production lines, R&D investment cannot be reduced either.”
“Your subordinate understands,”
After this Divine Kingdom War, Yang Fan had truly realized the war value of the Mechanical Civilization.
The flesh is weak, Mechanical Ascension!
Under the control of Intelligent Life, those war buildings on The Frontline displayed extremely terrifying combat power.
Especially the Intelligent Mecha; a single blast from its air cannon could easily wipe out hundreds or thousands of foreign believers.
The only problem was that the cost was too high.
The massive Mechanical structures required a large amount of rare metals, and the manufacturing cycle was long.
Moreover, once damaged, they practically had to be entirely melted down and rebuilt.
This was an extremely money-consuming path of war.
But the thing is...
As for time, Yang Fan had the Hundredfold Evolution Talent.
And Resources happened to be the thing he lacked the least right now.
In that case, why not develop it vigorously?
