chapters.title: Chapter 369: Lufa: I Don't Understand
paragraphs: Yang Fan gazed at the battlefield footage on the The Frontlines, his eyes gradually firming.
Of course, Yang Fan naturally would not give up on other civilization routes because of this.
As a god, all the power he possessed in the real world stemmed from his believers.
The Mechanical Route could enhance his Mental Energy.
The Cultivation Route allowed him to harness Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi and unleash various miraculous methods.
The Martial Arts route tempered his Physical Body until it was indestructible, making his close-quarters combat far superior to those of the same rank.
Even the corpse Cultivation Route allowed Yang Fan to unleash some of the Divine Abilities of a White Zombie in the real world.
It was just that most of those methods involved corpse poison and Yin Qi, which were too insidious, so Yang Fan had never truly tried them.
For Yang Fan, every civilization route in his Divine Kingdom held value.
Regardless, he possessed the Hundredfold Evolution Talent and did not lack the time for development or the corresponding resources.
The only thing that needed consideration was which route could generate the maximum profit for the Divine Kingdom at the current stage.
At least judging from this Divine Kingdom War.
The Mechanical Civilization was undoubtedly the development direction most suitable for large-scale warfare at the moment.
“Master, rest assured. A mere Angel Race Divine Kingdom is not worth our kingdom exhausting all its energy.”
“I have already pushed the resource allocation for the development of each civilization route in the Divine Kingdom to the limit for the current stage.”
“With sufficient resources, the development speed of the Mechanical Civilization will inevitably lead the other systems,” Yang Da guaranteed, patting his chest.
Yang Fan nodded in satisfaction, then changed the subject, “Your aesthetic sense is not bad.”
After saying this, his consciousness directly exited the Divine Kingdom.
Leaving only Yang Da standing in place, stunned for a long time.
“Master... what did that mean just now?”
“Was he praising me?”
“Or was he hinting at something?”
“Could it be that Master likes this style?”
Yang Da stroked his chin.
“It seems that next time Master enters the Divine Kingdom, I must prepare a few new programs in advance.”
“The dance needs to be updated, and the costumes need to be changed too.”
“Hmm... it would be best to add some new lighting effects.”
Thinking of this, Yang Da’s eyes suddenly lit up, as if he had discovered a new direction for his work.
Although Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom was currently embroiled in a Divine Kingdom War with an Alien God.
Yang Fan himself, as the god, remained as usual.
During the day, he went to the Virtual World of Xiling Planet to accompany his family, and when he had time, he returned to Taichu City to spend time with Gu Le and Gu Chengye.
If he felt bored, he would even go to Tianxiang Renjian to cultivate his character.
Of course, he now had a new pastime.
Every time he entered the Divine Kingdom to inspect, Yang Da could always come up with some new tricks for him.
Various costumes of distinct styles, carefully choreographed dances.
Coupled with lighting and music, the visual impact was extremely strong.
The only pity was that every time Yang Fan descended into the Divine Kingdom, it was only his consciousness.
He could watch to his heart’s content, but in the end, it was just feasting his eyes.
It could truly be called—a “fowl”-less talk.
If other gods knew of Yang Fan’s current state, their eyeballs would likely drop in shock.
For most gods on the The Frontlines, let alone erupting into a Divine Kingdom War with an Alien God.
Even for a proxy war between Subordinate Gods, they would pay close attention at all times.
After all, once a Subordinate God was defeated, there was a risk that their own Divine Kingdom’s coordinates would be exposed.
Not to mention a true war between gods.
That was a major event where a moment of carelessness could lead to the destruction of the Divine Kingdom.
The vast majority of gods would stay in their Divine Kingdoms twenty-four hours a day, personally directing troops and deploying generals.
They would be happy for a long time if they could destroy even one more enemy war building.
How could they dare to leave such an important war completely to an Intelligent Life?
At least, looking at Yang Fan’s current state.
No matter who saw it, they wouldn’t think his Divine Kingdom was engaged in a life-or-death battle with an Alien God.
Meanwhile, at the core of the Angel Race Divine Kingdom.
Lufa’s expression grew increasingly ugly.
He was staring at the rolling white mist in front of him.
In the footage, the Human Race army had already pushed into the central area of his Divine Kingdom.
At this moment, he only felt a chill running down his back.
“Why does he possess so many war buildings?”
“How long has he been preparing for this?”
Lufa’s voice was trembling slightly.
Yang Fan’s method of advancement was simple and brutal.
The entire battle line stretched for thousands of kilometers.
At the very center, Mechanical War Puppets sat in command.
Then there were dense swarms of Intelligent Mecha, like a torrent of steel, constantly pushing forward.
Every certain distance, there were Great Void Warships suspended high in the sky, providing long-range fire support for the entire army formation.
Only behind these war buildings was the true army of Human Race believers.
On the other side of the battlefield was the corpse Cultivation legion led by Yang Eleven.
Countless White Zombies were forming a corpse tide, dancing in battle formations, engaging in close-quarters combat with the Angel Race.
From time to time, they would throw out a large number of corpse pills, attempting to contaminate the entire battlefield.
However, the advance of the corpse Cultivation Route was clearly hindered.
The Angel Race naturally possessed holy attributes and had extremely high resistance to corpse poison.
Coupled with the fact that Lufa had purchased a large number of antidotes specifically for corpse poison from within his race.
Both sides were now completely deadlocked.
The corpse Cultivation legion could not continue to penetrate deeper and could only be said to be dragging down a small portion of the opponent’s effective strength!
Therefore, Lufa was not worried about this front.
Their Angel Race was inherently the greatest nemesis of such dark systems.
But what truly made him feel despair was the frontal battlefield.
Until now, he still didn’t understand what the opponent was thinking.
“Over these years, I have destroyed nearly a million of his war buildings.”
“But why...”
“Why have his war buildings not decreased at all?”
“Just how much has his Divine Kingdom stockpiled?”
“Could it be that... he has been preparing his Divine Kingdom for this battle for tens of thousands of years?”
The more Lufa thought about it, the colder his heart became.

If this consumption continued, the military merits he had accumulated on the The Frontlines over these years, as well as the Divinity Points accumulated from many years of investment in the Divine Kingdom.
Would likely be completely wiped out by this one war.
“What exactly is the situation with this Human Race god who follows the Mechanical Route?”
Lufa couldn’t help but curse out loud.
“To pay such a huge price for this battle, could it be just to act as a stepping stone for the other few Human Race gods?”
In his view, this Divine Kingdom War had reached this point.
Over ninety percent of his troops had been committed to the confrontation with these war buildings.
The remaining ten percent were all used to resist those insidious corpse Cultivation armies.
Conversely, those following the Cultivation, Martial Arts, and the Elf Race.
From beginning to end, they were just following behind these war machines, advancing steadily.
Lufa simply could not understand this tactic.
How precious were war buildings?
They were only deployed when breaking through enemy defense lines, guarding strategic locations, or breaking a stalemate on the battlefield.
But this Human Race god before him was different.
He actually placed these war buildings directly at the very front, using them like bulldozers to push across everything.
Every one destroyed would make a god feel heartache for a long time, yet the opponent seemed completely indifferent.
In Lufa’s eyes, those war buildings were far more precious than the lives of ordinary believers.
How could there be any logic in using war buildings to block damage for believers?
Lufa simply couldn’t understand the tactics of these Human Race gods anymore.

sentences.text: Yang Fan gazed at the battlefield footage on the The Frontlines, his eyes gradually firming.
Of course, Yang Fan naturally would not give up on other civilization routes because of this.
As a god, all the power he possessed in the real world stemmed from his believers.
The Mechanical Route could enhance his Mental Energy.
The Cultivation Route allowed him to harness Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi and unleash various miraculous methods.
The Martial Arts route tempered his Physical Body until it was indestructible, making his close-quarters combat far superior to those of the same rank.
Even the corpse Cultivation Route allowed Yang Fan to unleash some of the Divine Abilities of a White Zombie in the real world.
It was just that most of those methods involved corpse poison and Yin Qi, which were too insidious, so Yang Fan had never truly tried them.
For Yang Fan, every civilization route in his Divine Kingdom held value.
Regardless, he possessed the Hundredfold Evolution Talent and did not lack the time for development or the corresponding resources.
The only thing that needed consideration was which route could generate the maximum profit for the Divine Kingdom at the current stage.
At least judging from this Divine Kingdom War.
The Mechanical Civilization was undoubtedly the development direction most suitable for large-scale warfare at the moment.
“Master, rest assured.
A mere Angel Race Divine Kingdom is not worth our kingdom exhausting all its energy.”
“I have already pushed the resource allocation for the development of each civilization route in the Divine Kingdom to the limit for the current stage.”
“With sufficient resources, the development speed of the Mechanical Civilization will inevitably lead the other systems,” Yang Da guaranteed, patting his chest.
Yang Fan nodded in satisfaction, then changed the subject, “Your aesthetic sense is not bad.”
After saying this, his consciousness directly exited the Divine Kingdom.
Leaving only Yang Da standing in place, stunned for a long time.
“Master... what did that mean just now?”
“Was he praising me?”
“Or was he hinting at something?”
“Could it be that Master likes this style?”
Yang Da stroked his chin.
“It seems that next time Master enters the Divine Kingdom, I must prepare a few new programs in advance.”
“The dance needs to be updated, and the costumes need to be changed too.”
“Hmm... it would be best to add some new lighting effects.”
Thinking of this, Yang Da’s eyes suddenly lit up, as if he had discovered a new direction for his work.
Although Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom was currently embroiled in a Divine Kingdom War with an Alien God.
Yang Fan himself, as the god, remained as usual.
During the day, he went to the Virtual World of Xiling Planet to accompany his family, and when he had time, he returned to Taichu City to spend time with Gu Le and Gu Chengye.
If he felt bored, he would even go to Tianxiang Renjian to cultivate his character.

Every time he entered the Divine Kingdom to inspect, Yang Da could always come up with some new tricks for him.

The only pity was that every time Yang Fan descended into the Divine Kingdom, it was only his consciousness.

chapters.title: Chapter 370: It's Him, It Is Him
paragraphs: Watching the Human Race’s army continuing to advance steadily, Lufa remained silent for a long time.
In the end, with a thought, he withdrew his consciousness from the divine kingdom
and returned to the Real World.
After leaving his palace, Lufa walked straight toward the military district building.
Following the signs, he quickly arrived at a room and pushed the door open to enter.
This place was the Mutual Aid Discussion Hall specially established by the Angel Race at The Frontline.

Any gods belonging to the same mutual aid group who encountered difficulties during a Divine Kingdom War, or needed to discuss tactics and exchange intelligence, could come here to convene the other members.
Without hesitation, Lufa directly took out his identity token and placed it onto the pure white altar in the center of the hall.
Buzz—
A pure white divine light slowly rose up.
The next moment, four figures with pure white wings on their backs descended into the hall simultaneously.
“Haha, Lufa.”
One burly Angel Race god laughed heartily.
“What’s up? Is there new progress on the Divine Kingdom Battlefield?”
“You bought so many Angel Light Swords from us, those Human Race believers must have been thoroughly defeated by now, right?”
Another Angel Race god also spoke with a smile.
“You were really willing to spend money this time.”
“My divine kingdom inventory was almost emptied out by you.”
“When the war ends, you must patronize my business more.”
Although the other two Angel Race gods didn’t speak, the way they looked at Lufa was equally amiable.
Although according to The Frontline regulations, they sold war supplies almost at cost price,
there was still a small profit to be made.
More importantly, having stockpiled inventory in a divine kingdom was a headache.
Lufa’s large-scale purchasing this time had helped them clear out most of their inventory.
Who wouldn’t like a customer like this?
They had also supported many gods of their own race before,
but seeing someone as generous and spendthrift as Lufa was truly a first.
Facing them, Lufa couldn’t squeeze out a smile no matter how hard he tried.
He didn’t want to spend so many Divinity Points either.
However, facing those overwhelming numbers of Intelligent Mecha, he had no choice but to frantically throw Resources at them.
Over the years, it wasn’t as if he hadn’t fought against other Alien Gods—he had even won.
But there had never been a war like today’s that made him feel so powerless.
Now, the savings he had accumulated over all these years were almost completely spent, yet the battle situation had barely changed at all.
If there was any single consolation, it was that through clan intelligence, he had found out the approximate manufacturing cost of those Intelligent Mecha.
For every one destroyed, the cost paid by the opponent was nearly several times his own.
Therefore, when personally commanding the battle over these years,
every time an Intelligent Mecha was destroyed, he felt a bit of secret pleasure inside.
He had even thought that when the war ended,
if he could recycle all those rare metals on the battlefield, he might even be able to make up for a lot of his losses.
However, as the war continued, Lufa gradually realized something was wrong.
Those Intelligent Mecha... were simply endless!
Until now, he finally began to panic.
If the advance continued like this,
it wouldn’t be long before the opponent would be at the gates of his Divine Kingdom Core.
Thinking of this, Lufa took a deep breath and said in a heavy voice:
“Everyone, the divine kingdom foundation of that Human Race god on the Mechanical Route far exceeds my expectations.”
“Right now, I can’t think of a better way to handle this.”
“So, I need to borrow your wisdom.”
After speaking, Lufa waved his hand gently.
A real-time broadcast of the divine kingdom frontline immediately projected into the center of the hall.
When the four Angel Race gods saw the sight in the projection,
their previously relaxed expressions vanished instantly.
What met their eyes was an endless, overwhelming swarm of Intelligent Mecha.
A torrent of steel stretched to the very end of their vision.
Behind them was a legion of high-tier believers numbering in the tens or even hundreds of billions.
Advancing in neat ranks, blotting out the sky and sun.
For a moment, the entire hall fell into a brief silence.
“Angel Lufa, you purchased so many war supplies from our divine kingdoms, fight!”
One of the Angel Race gods couldn’t help speaking up.
“The opponent’s strength is indeed not weak, but since you smashed so many war Resources into this, you should at least be able to destroy half of those war buildings, right?”
In his view, although Yang Fan’s army scale was astonishing, as battle-hardened gods, they had seen far too many grand spectacles.
Several gods launching a joint Divine Kingdom War, or even more than a dozen gods besieging a single divine kingdom together, were things they had witnessed with their own eyes.
Although the battle before them was shocking, it was still far from reaching the point of driving them into panic.
Hearing this, Lufa sighed with a bitter smile.
Then, with a gentle wave of his right hand, the white mist roiled once more.
This time, what was projected was no longer a single battlefield,
but the complete battle footage of Yang Fan’s believer army advancing all the way from the outer perimeter of the divine kingdom to its current position.
The footage began playing rapidly.
The four Angel Race gods immediately stowed their smiles and watched seriously.
As the scenes flashed by, their expressions grew increasingly grave.
From initial calm, to surprise, to shock.
In the end, they were left virtually speechless.
After a long silence, one of the Angel Race gods slowly let out a long breath.
“Those Human Race gods who walk the Mechanical Route are famously dripping with wealth.”
“Today, I’ve truly witnessed it firsthand.”
Another Angel Race god couldn’t help his lips twitching.
“Absurd! Judging by the losses along this advance, the Divinity Points lost by the opponent in this war probably exceed five hundred billion.”
“To be so reckless with cost...”
“Could it be that this Human Race god on the Mechanical Route has a mortal grudge against you?”
To a god,
five hundred billion Divinity Points was already enough to purchase a vast number of S-Rank Buildings.
Such immense wealth was actually dumped entirely into war attrition.
This way of fighting was practically throwing Divinity Points onto the battlefield like rocks.
Even if he ultimately conquered a divine kingdom, would it really be worth it?
Hearing this, Lufa hurriedly shook his head.
“Impossible.”
“I only arrived at The Frontline to take up my post three hundred years ago.”
“Over all these years, I’ve never fought against any Human Race gods, let alone formed a grudge with them.”
“Moreover, the coordinates of my divine kingdom are very well protected.”
“Only a while ago, one of my Subordinate Gods fought a proxy war against a demigod of the Human Race...”
Speaking up to this point, Lufa’s voice suddenly trailed off, and he froze in place.
“What’s wrong?”
Another Angel Race god hurriedly pressed for an answer.
Lufa’s eyes grew brighter and brighter, as if he had finally grasped the key point.
“I remember now!”
“During that proxy war, my Subordinate God sent me a request for help.”
“At that time, my consciousness descended into his divine kingdom.”
“However, the entire divine kingdom had already been completely enveloped in corpse poison.”
“Almost all the believers were wiped out, and that divine kingdom no longer had any value to save, so I abandoned it directly.”
Speaking up to this point, Lufa jerked his head up, his eyes filled with rage.
“It’s that Human Race god who walks the path of a Corpse Cultivator!”
“It’s him!”
“First, he used corpse poison to destroy my Subordinate God’s divine kingdom, and then through the Subordinate God’s Divine Kingdom Core, he deduced my divine kingdom’s coordinates.”
“Afterward, he allied with three Human Race gods of Mechanical, Cultivation, and Martial Arts to jointly invade my divine kingdom!”

chapters.title: Chapter 371: I Want to Live
paragraphs: At this moment, Lufa finally figured out the ins and outs of the whole situation.
The rage in his heart ignited instantly.
He even wanted to return to his Divine Kingdom immediately, mobilize his troops first, and slaughter all those corpse-cultivator believers to vent the hatred in his heart.
“Enough.”
One of the Angel Race gods waved his hand.
“Since the cause has already been found, there is no point in dwelling on it further.”
“The Divine Kingdom War has already begun; regretting it now won’t solve any problems.”
“Compared to that Human Race god who follows the corpse-cultivation path.”
“The one we truly need to pay attention to is this god on the Mechanical Route.”
“No one knows exactly how many war structures he still has in reserve within his Divine Kingdom.”
Another god nodded with a grave expression.
“Indeed.”
“Not only does he have such a large number of Intelligent Mecha units.”
“But he also has so many Mechanical War Puppets and Great Void Warships.”
“This Human Race god on the Mechanical Route... his background is likely not simple.”
“Could it be... that he comes from the Five Great Giants of the Human Race?”
As the words fell, the four Angel Race gods responsible for supporting Lufa exchanged glances.
All of them saw a hint of apprehension and hesitation in each other’s eyes.
In fact, although the rules of the Divine Kingdom divide gods into first to ninth orders based on the size of their Divine Kingdom.
The real world is far from being that simple.
Especially on the The Frontline.
It is not uncommon for a Tier 3 God to have their Divine Kingdom Core plundered by a First-Order God.
The size of a Divine Kingdom can only represent a portion of one’s strength.
What truly determines a god’s combat power is the foundation of their Divine Kingdom.
Some gods are clearly only First-Order.
Yet the accumulation in their Divine Kingdom is enough to rival that of Fourth-Order or Fifth-Order God.
The reason is simple: from the moment they are born, they stand at a finishing line that countless gods cannot reach even after exhausting their entire lives.
While the war structures in other gods’ kingdoms are still stuck at C-rank or B-rank.
They have long since begun equipping A-rank, or even s-class war structures on a large scale.
The Divine Kingdom War may look like a war between believers.
But in the final analysis, it is more a contest of resources and foundation.
Even if one possesses believers at the Nascent Soul, Soul Transformation, or even higher Realm, so what?
Without the support of battle formations, they are helpless when facing s-class war structures.
Hearing the analysis of the four, Lufa’s expression became even uglier.
He understood that the others were not alarmist.
This time, he was afraid he had truly encountered a god cultivated by those major powers!
If it were a god of ordinary background like him, it would be absolutely impossible to possess such terrifying resource reserves, let alone employ this kind of near-insane attrition tactic.
That is not war at all; it is simply smashing out a path using Divinity Points!
“Everyone, I still want to purchase more war supplies. Is that possible?” Lufa took a deep breath and pleaded in a low voice.
“Lufa, as long as you purchase at ‘cost price’, I naturally have no reason to refuse.”
One of the Angel Race gods nodded.
“Moreover, we also hope you can win. After all, if the invaders are repelled, we can also receive a substantial military merit reward.”
“Many thanks!”
Lufa nodded solemnly.
Afterwards, he did not linger, turned around, and walked outside.
Watching Lufa’s departing back, the other four Angel Race gods couldn’t help but sigh.
“What a pity.”
“His Divine Kingdom coordinates have already been exposed, and to a god on the Mechanical Route who is highly likely to be from the Human Race’s Five Great Giants, no less.”
“Even if he can hold off the attack this time, I’m afraid he won’t be able to develop his Divine Kingdom in peace for a long time to come.”
The group was silent for a moment.
Suddenly, the Angel Race god with the bold voice asked:
“If this Human Race god on the Mechanical Route truly reaches Lufa’s Divine Kingdom Core, should we intervene?”
The other three frowned upon hearing this.

“According to the rules of the The Frontline, if a god of the same race reaches a moment of life-or-death crisis and voluntarily opens their Divine Kingdom coordinates, we should indeed provide support.”
“But this rule is not absolute.”
Another Angel Race god shook his head.
“After all, once our believers enter his Divine Kingdom, a connection will be formed between our respective Divine Kingdoms.”
“Just like those proxy wars, there is a possibility that the enemy could deduce our coordinates through our believers and the traces of our Divine Kingdoms.”
“Furthermore, we are all gods; the probability of being deduced is far higher than for demigods!”
“I am not willing to drag my own Divine Kingdom into danger just to save someone else.”
Hearing this, everyone fell into silence again.
“Let’s see how the battle develops.”
The first Angel Race god who spoke said slowly.
“After Lufa goes out, he will likely have to resort to financing methods.”
“If even then he gets pushed to his Divine Kingdom Core by the opponent...”
He paused for a moment.
“Do you dare to go?”
As the words fell, the several Angel Race gods all fell silent.
Indeed, did they dare to go?
Facing an enemy who could bring out countless war structures and push forward with terrifying resources.
Who could guarantee that their own Divine Kingdom wouldn’t become the next target?
“I hope Lufa has good fortune.”
“What does it matter if one becomes a god?”
“Apart from a longer lifespan, essentially, there are still tiers and classes.”
One of the Angel Race gods gave a bitter smile.
“Sometimes, it’s really better to start over and be born into a better life.”
After speaking, his figure turned into a ray of white light and slowly dissipated.
On the other side, Lufa, having left the mutual aid group’s projection area, had a face that was gloomy to the extreme.
His fists were clenched tightly, and his eyes were bloodshot.
“Damn it!”
“How could I be so stupid!”
“Why did I show them the battlefield situation!”
The more Lufa thought, the angrier he became, and he couldn’t help but roar in a low voice.
He had originally wanted to use the wisdom of these gods of his own race to find a way to break the deadlock.
But now, he suddenly realized that he seemed to have exposed too much of his situation.
Those people knew the terror of his enemy.
They also knew that his Divine Kingdom was in jeopardy.
“No!”
“I must save myself!”
Lufa’s eyes gradually became crazed.
“I want to raise funds!”
“I want to take out loans!”
“I want to mortgage everything!”
“I want to sell everything I can sell!”
“Companies, resources, industries, women, children...”
“As long as I can survive, everything can be sacrificed!”
His breathing became increasingly rapid.
“I cannot die!”
“I absolutely cannot die here!”
“I have gone through countless years, finally becoming a god, finally possessing everything I have today!”
“I cannot just fall inexplicably because of one bit of bad luck!”
“I must survive!”
“No matter what price I have to pay, I must survive!”
Lufa made his way back to his residence.
At this moment, his eyes were cold and gloomy, and his whole body was exuding an aura of madness.
He didn’t even notice it himself.
On those originally flawless white wings.
At some unknown point, a wisp of pitch-black color had quietly appeared at the base of the feathers.

The rage in his heart ignited instantly.
He even wanted to return to his Divine Kingdom immediately, mobilize his troops first, and slaughter all those corpse-cultivator believers to vent the hatred in his heart.
“Enough.”

“But he also has so many Mechanical War Puppets and Great Void Warships.”
“This Human Race god on the Mechanical Route... his background is likely not simple.”
“Could it be... that he comes from the Five Great Giants of the Human Race?”
As the words fell, the four Angel Race gods responsible for supporting Lufa exchanged glances.
All of them saw a hint of apprehension and hesitation in each other’s eyes.
In fact, although the rules of the Divine Kingdom divide gods into first to ninth orders based on the size of their Divine Kingdom.
The real world is far from being that simple.
Especially on the The Frontline.
It is not uncommon for a Tier 3 God to have their Divine Kingdom Core plundered by a First-Order God.
The size of a Divine Kingdom can only represent a portion of one’s strength.
What truly determines a god’s combat power is the foundation of their Divine Kingdom.
Some gods are clearly only First-Order.
Yet the accumulation in their Divine Kingdom is enough to rival that of Fourth-Order or Fifth-Order God.
The reason is simple: from the moment they are born, they stand at a finishing line that countless gods cannot reach even after exhausting their entire lives.
While the war structures in other gods’ kingdoms are still stuck at C-rank or B-rank.
They have long since begun equipping A-rank, or even s-class war structures on a large scale.
The Divine Kingdom War may look like a war between believers.
But in the final analysis, it is more a contest of resources and foundation.
Even if one possesses believers at the Nascent Soul, Soul Transformation, or even higher Realm, so what?
Without the support of battle formations, they are helpless when facing s-class war structures.
Hearing the analysis of the four, Lufa’s expression became even uglier.
He understood that the others were not alarmist.
This time, he was afraid he had truly encountered a god cultivated by those major powers!
If it were a god of ordinary background like him, it would be absolutely impossible to possess such terrifying resource reserves, let alone employ this kind of near-insane attrition tactic.
That is not war at all; it is simply smashing out a path using Divinity Points!

Is that possible?” Lufa took a deep breath and pleaded in a low voice.

One of the Angel Race gods nodded.
“Moreover, we also hope you can win.
After all, if the invaders are repelled, we can also receive a substantial military merit reward.”
“Many thanks!”
Lufa nodded solemnly.

The other three frowned upon hearing this.

chapters.title: Chapter 372: As Long As the Money Is Right
paragraphs: Although his Divine Kingdom was currently embroiled in a fierce war with an Angel Race deity.
Yet as a deity, Yang Fan felt increasingly relaxed as his army of believers continued to advance.
Watching the opponent’s defensive lines being destroyed by his army and seeing those Angel Race believers retreating steadily, a faint smile appeared on Yang Fan’s face.
“The Angel Race deity is nothing special.”
“It seems Yang Da was right. Given the current foundation of my Divine Kingdom, these ordinary deities have absolutely no qualifications to be my opponents.”
Yang Fan said in a relaxed tone.
This was his first time waging war against a deity. Even though he had absolute confidence in his own strength, he had still made thorough preparations in advance.
War materials, logistical supplies, and troop reserves.
He had planned for every aspect based on the worst-case scenario.
However, after the war actually began, he realized that he seemed to have overestimated the consumption of this war.
Under the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, the development speed of his Divine Kingdom had long exceeded the understanding of normal deities.
The resources consumed by the war buildings on the The Frontline every year were not even as much as the resources produced within his Divine Kingdom.
In fact, as the war continued, the overall strength of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom was actually still constantly improving.
New believers achieved a Breakthrough, and new war buildings were produced.
The Divine Kingdom of today, compared to before the war started, was not weakened at all; on the contrary, it had become even stronger.
The rate of consumption on the The Frontline could not keep up with his rate of growth.
In Yang Fan’s view, taking down this Angel Race deity’s Divine Kingdom Core was already just a matter of time.
Yang Fan didn’t even have any tactical requirements for this Divine Kingdom War anymore.
No need for clever strategies, ambushes, or luring the enemy deep.
None of that was needed.
Just have the war buildings produced by the Mechanical Civilization push forward all the way.

The Mechanical War Puppets were responsible for breaking through defenses, the Intelligent Mecha was responsible for clearing the path, and the Great Void Warship was responsible for long-range suppression.
Blocking the way? Just destroy them.
Damaged? Just reproduce them.
In the end, it was nothing more than Divinity Points.
And this consumption was not even one percent of the wealth created by Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom every day.
Thinking back to the past.
When Yang Fan was still a Divine Being, or even during the demigod stage.
To make the Divine Kingdom develop, he needed loans, needed to calculate carefully, and needed to compress every bit of resource input.

To save costs, and even because Intelligent Life could not understand the existence of the Evolution Talent, he adopted a zombie cultivation route, converting some believers into zombies to obtain maximum combat power at the lowest cost.
At that time, every single Divinity Point had to be spent where it mattered most.
Every choice concerned the future of the Divine Kingdom.
But now... everything was already different.
The current Yang Fan already possessed the qualifications to crush enemies with massive amounts of resources.
Perhaps in the eyes of other deities, this way of waging war was completely a loss.
Spending trillions of Divinity Points just to compete for one Divine Kingdom Core.
The cost far exceeded the gains.
But in Yang Fan’s view, that was only because the scale of wealth was different.
When resources reach a certain level, many problems are no longer problems themselves.

“When poor, a grain of gold is worth more than ten thousand schemes; when rich, a thousand mountains of jade are but chess pieces in one’s palm. In the past, seeking survival, every inch of land had to be cherished; today, ruling the Divine Kingdom, all things can be obtained. Money can forge divine weapons, wealth can open the path to heaven; if resources are endless, why fear the enemies of ten thousand races.”
For the current Yang Fan.
The Divine Kingdom War had essentially changed from a contest of wisdom and strategy into a collision of resources and foundation.
And on this point, possessing the SSS-Rank Evolution Talent, he naturally stood in a position that other deities could not understand.
Of course, this world is just like this.
Sometimes, it is truly ironic.
Giving one’s all, yet receiving no reward.
Muddling along often leads to big advantages.
But money is different; as long as the money is right, there’s basically nothing you can’t get.
At this moment, in the Virtual World, at Tianxiang Renjian.
Yang Fan was sitting in the highest-spec black gold private room.
Melodious music slowly began to play.
Dozens of female Human Race demigods, following Yang Fan’s request, danced gracefully in the center of the hall.
Their figures were elegant, their movements uniform, and every detail had been carefully trained.
Some were responsible for playing music, others for pouring wine.
Some peeled spiritual fruits for Yang Fan and handed them to him.
Various precious fine wines emitted a rich Spiritual Qi, causing the entire private room to be filled with a faint fragrance.
It must be said that Tianxiang Renjian being able to become a top-tier entertainment venue naturally had its reasons.
These staff members at the demigod Realm were top-notch in both appearance and temperament.
“Not bad.”
Yang Fan nodded with satisfaction.
“One drop of Water of Life for each of you.”
Hearing this, the eyes of the women present instantly lit up.
“Thank you for the reward, my lord!”
Everyone hurriedly bowed, their faces full of gratitude and fawning.
For them.
Besides their fixed salary, tips given by customers were also an extremely important income.
And an existence like Yang Fan, who gave out Water of Life as a tip, was extremely rare.
Naturally, he was worth their full effort in service.
Just then, Yang Yi’s voice suddenly rang out in Yang Fan’s mind.
“Master, your father-in-law, Gu Xuanting, requests that you visit the Gu Family Territory.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan did not hesitate.
He snapped his fingers lightly.
The next moment, a ripple of Divine Power spread out.
Every staff member present received a tip of 2 million Faith Points.
“Thank you, my lord!”
The women bowed respectfully again.
Yang Fan did not linger; his consciousness followed the coordinates left by Gu Xuanting and descended instantly.
The Gu Family Territory.
In a quiet courtyard.
Yang Fan pushed open the door.
He saw Gu Xuanting sitting at a stone table in the courtyard, leisurely brewing tea.
Yang Fan immediately stepped forward and bowed respectfully, “I have seen Father.”
Gu Xuanting looked up at him, then smiled faintly.
“You’re here.”
“Come in and have some tea.”
In the courtyard.
The water on the tea stove was slowly boiling, steam rising, and amidst the swirling white mist, a faint aroma of tea permeated the air.
Wisps of Spiritual Qi spread with the tea aroma, making the entire courtyard appear exceptionally tranquil.
Yang Fan sat opposite Gu Xuanting and did not speak first, instead waiting quietly for what the other had to say.
He knew very well in his heart.
Gu Xuanting had specifically called him over; it could not possibly be just to drink tea and chat, there must be something important to say.
“Drink some tea first, taste how it is?”
Gu Xuanting picked up his teacup and said softly.
Yang Fan nodded, picked up his teacup, and took a slow sip.
“How is it?”
“Reporting to Father, it is very fragrant.”
Yang Fan carefully savored it, then said somewhat awkwardly:
“However, I have no research into tea, so I cannot taste the specific quality.”
Hearing this, Gu Xuanting smiled indifferently.
“Tea is something that cannot be rushed.”
“Many people drink tea and only look at the taste when it finally enters their mouth, but they don’t know that what is truly important is the process.”
“Water temperature, time, tea-to-water ratio, and even the state of mind of the person brewing the tea will all affect the final taste.”
“Just like the development of a Divine Kingdom, if you are anxious to pursue results, you are prone to neglecting the accumulation along the way.”
“Savor it slowly, comprehend it slowly.”
“Truly good tea requires time to settle.”

chapters.title: Chapter 373: Master? New home?
paragraphs: Gu Xuanting gently put down his teacup, his tone calm.
Yang Fan looked up at him, a trace of thought flashing in his eyes.
But before he could say anything, Gu Xuanting continued.
“You are my son-in-law.”
“When you reach a place like The Frontline, naturally I will pay more attention.”
“Instead of directly heading to the border of The Frontline to take risks, you chose to stay in the villa of the Gu Family. For this, I am very gratified.”
“But you are still too young.”
“For some things, do not take strides too fast.”
Gu Xuanting’s voice gradually grew serious.
“Recently, you have been widely recruiting proxies at The Frontline.”
“The number of divine kingdoms of the Alien Demigods destroyed every month exceeds forty.”
“Do you know that doing this is very dangerous?”
At this moment, the smile on Gu Xuanting’s face had already vanished.
His gaze locked tightly onto Yang Fan, as if he wanted to see something from the young man’s expression.
Yang Fan was slightly stunned.
“Father, is there a problem with this?”
“Could it be because the number of Subordinate Gods I signed is too large, causing dissatisfaction among other gods?”
Hearing this, Gu Xuanting was so angry he laughed.
“You brat.”
“Usually you look cautious and clever, why this time can you not even grasp the main point?”
“How vast is the territory of the Human Race?”
“The battlefield of The Frontline is even more incomparably long, and the number of demigods is too numerous to count.”
“Not to mention signing dozens of Subordinate Gods.”
“Even if you sign hundreds at the same time, no one will look for trouble with you over such a matter.”
“What I am worried about is the coordinate security of your divine kingdom!”
Gu Xuanting’s voice was low.
“Do not use this method to farm battle merits.”

“Not only will it consume a massive amount of Divinity Points, but more importantly, once those Subordinate Gods are defeated and their Divine Kingdom Core falls into the hands of the alien race, there is a risk that your coordinates will be deduced!”
“Do you understand the danger in this?”
Listening to these words, the corners of Yang Fan’s mouth twitched slightly.
He naturally understood that Gu Xuanting was caring about him.
It’s just that... Gu Xuanting did not know the existence of the Origin Evolution Talent.
In his view, Yang Fan’s crazy recruitment of proxies had the sole purpose of quickly acquiring battle merits.
After all, many precious buildings and Resources cannot be purchased simply by having Divinity Points.
But what Gu Xuanting did not know was...
For Yang Fan, the deaths of those Subordinate Gods were instead another kind of profit.
Of course, such a matter, he could not possibly explain.
He couldn’t possibly tell Gu Xuanting:
that he wished those Alien Gods would kill a few more Subordinate Gods so that he could obtain more Divine Kingdom Cores, right?
“Thank you for the reminder, Father.” Yang Fan could only nod earnestly.
Looking at Yang Fan’s expression, Gu Xuanting slightly frowned.
For some unknown reason, he always felt that this son-in-law of his did not seem to truly realize the severity of the matter.
However, the words that should be said had already been spoken by him.
If Yang Fan still did not restrain himself and an accident really happened by then, he would only be able to choose to announce the divine kingdom coordinates to the Gu Family.
He would let the gods of the Gu Family make a move together to assist in defense.
“I heard you recently established the Yang Corporation, and have already injected 200 trillion Divinity Points?”
Gu Xuanting suddenly changed the subject.
“Yes.”
Yang Fan nodded.
“I must also thank Father for being willing to let me borrow your reputation.”
“The Yang Corporation is currently developing very smoothly.”
Gu Xuanting picked up his teacup and took another gentle sip.
“It seems you are prepared to go into business in the future?”
“This...”
Yang Fan hesitated slightly.
“I indeed have thoughts in this regard.”
“Recently, you also purchased 500 Spirit Plant Stars from the Gu Clan.”
Gu Xuanting glanced at him.
“Your actions are indeed getting bolder.”
Yang Fan opened his mouth, not knowing how to explain for a moment.
“Alright.”
Gu Xuanting waved his hand.
“Everyone has their own secrets.”
“Although you are my son-in-law, as an elder, I will not forcibly probe your trump cards.”
“I am the Third Elder of the Gu Family, in charge of the Gu Family’s Medicinal Pill and spiritual material channels.”
“If your divine kingdom wants to develop industries related to Medicinal Pills in the future, you can go through my channels.”
“Increasing the profit by one or two tenths will not be a big problem.”
Yang Fan hurriedly nodded, “Thank you, Father.”
Gu Xuanting nodded.
But the next moment, as if thinking of something, his expression suddenly turned somewhat complex.
After a long silence, he ultimately sighed.
“There is one more matter.”
“Although I do not approve...”
“But Qinglan and that girl Gu Le have both agreed, so it is not good for me to say anything more.”
As he spoke, Gu Xuanting took out a slip of paper and handed it to Yang Fan.
“This is an address in the Real World.”
“Once you go, you will naturally understand.”
Having said that, he waved his hand.
“Alright, go ahead.”
Looking at his appearance, he seemed somewhat unwilling to continue the conversation.
Although Yang Fan was full of doubts, he still politely stood up.
“Then this child takes his leave.”
Yang Fan’s consciousness withdrew from the Virtual World.
The next moment, the slip of paper Gu Xuanting gave him was also materialized into his hand accordingly.
Yang Fan lowered his head and glanced at it.
It was indeed an address in the Real World on it.
And it was right in the area of The Frontline.
However, it was not a dangerous zone, but a safe zone specially designated by The Frontline.
It was only more than two hundred kilometers away from the Gu Family villa where he currently lived.
“What does Father-in-law mean by this?”
Yang Fan frowned slightly.
“Who is he asking me to come here to see?”
To be safe, Yang Fan took out his communication device, took a photo of the address on the slip of paper, and then sent it to Gu Le via Feixun.
Not long after, Gu Le replied.
There was only a single word, “Go.”
Seeing this reply, the corners of Yang Fan’s mouth twitched.
“What is the situation?”
“Everyone is speaking in riddles, huh?”
One told him to go over, but didn’t explain the reason.
One knew the situation, but only replied with a single word.
However, taking a glance at the address, Yang Fan was not overly worried.
After all, this was a safe zone of The Frontline.
Thinking of this,
Yang Fan did not hesitate any longer.
He directly boarded the small fighter aircraft equipped by the Gu Family villa and rushed towards the address given by Gu Xuanting.
Not long after,
the fighter aircraft landed.
Yang Fan looked at the building before him, slightly stunned.
This was also a villa area, and the overall layout was almost identical to the place where he lived at The Frontline.
“Strange.”
Yang Fan felt even more puzzled in his heart.
He then walked up to the front door of the villa and pressed the doorbell.
Soon, the door opened automatically.
A humanoid robot slowly walked out.
A light blue scanning beam swept across Yang Fan’s body.
“Identity confirmation completed.”
“Welcome, Master, to your new home for the first time.”
The robot bowed slightly, then made a standard gentleman’s salute.
“Master?”
Yang Fan was stunned for a moment.
“New home?”
He tilted his head to glance at the interior of the villa, feeling utterly baffled.
He already had a residence at The Frontline.
What did it mean for Gu Xuanting to suddenly arrange a new villa for him?

sentences.text: Gu Xuanting gently put down his teacup, his tone calm.
Yang Fan looked up at him, a trace of thought flashing in his eyes.
But before he could say anything, Gu Xuanting continued.
“You are my son-in-law.”
“When you reach a place like The Frontline, naturally I will pay more attention.”
“Instead of directly heading to the border of The Frontline to take risks, you chose to stay in the villa of the Gu Family.
For this, I am very gratified.”
“But you are still too young.”
“For some things, do not take strides too fast.”
Gu Xuanting’s voice gradually grew serious.
“Recently, you have been widely recruiting proxies at The Frontline.”
“The number of divine kingdoms of the Alien Demigods destroyed every month exceeds forty.”
“Do you know that doing this is very dangerous?”
At this moment, the smile on Gu Xuanting’s face had already vanished.
His gaze locked tightly onto Yang Fan, as if he wanted to see something from the young man’s expression.
Yang Fan was slightly stunned.
“Father, is there a problem with this?”
“Could it be because the number of Subordinate Gods I signed is too large, causing dissatisfaction among other gods?”
Hearing this, Gu Xuanting was so angry he laughed.
“You brat.”
“Usually you look cautious and clever, why this time can you not even grasp the main point?”
“How vast is the territory of the Human Race?”
“The battlefield of The Frontline is even more incomparably long, and the number of demigods is too numerous to count.”
“Not to mention signing dozens of Subordinate Gods.”
“Even if you sign hundreds at the same time, no one will look for trouble with you over such a matter.”
“What I am worried about is the coordinate security of your divine kingdom!”
Gu Xuanting’s voice was low.
“Do not use this method to farm battle merits.”

“Not only will it consume a massive amount of Divinity Points, but more importantly, once those Subordinate Gods are defeated and their Divine Kingdom Core falls into the hands of the alien race, there is a risk that your coordinates will be deduced!”
“Do you understand the danger in this?”
Listening to these words, the corners of Yang Fan’s mouth twitched slightly.
He naturally understood that Gu Xuanting was caring about him.
It’s just that...
Gu Xuanting did not know the existence of the Origin Evolution Talent.
In his view, Yang Fan’s crazy recruitment of proxies had the sole purpose of quickly acquiring battle merits.
After all, many precious buildings and Resources cannot be purchased simply by having Divinity Points.
But what Gu Xuanting did not know was...
For Yang Fan, the deaths of those Subordinate Gods were instead another kind of profit.
Of course, such a matter, he could not possibly explain.
He couldn’t possibly tell Gu Xuanting:
that he wished those Alien Gods would kill a few more Subordinate Gods so that he could obtain more Divine Kingdom Cores, right?
“Thank you for the reminder, Father.” Yang Fan could only nod earnestly.
Looking at Yang Fan’s expression, Gu Xuanting slightly frowned.
For some unknown reason, he always felt that this son-in-law of his did not seem to truly realize the severity of the matter.
However, the words that should be said had already been spoken by him.
If Yang Fan still did not restrain himself and an accident really happened by then, he would only be able to choose to announce the divine kingdom coordinates to the Gu Family.
He would let the gods of the Gu Family make a move together to assist in defense.
“I heard you recently established the Yang Corporation, and have already injected 200 trillion Divinity Points?”
Gu Xuanting suddenly changed the subject.
“Yes.”
Yang Fan nodded.
“I must also thank Father for being willing to let me borrow your reputation.”
“The Yang Corporation is currently developing very smoothly.”
Gu Xuanting picked up his teacup and took another gentle sip.
“It seems you are prepared to go into business in the future?”
“This...”
Yang Fan hesitated slightly.
“I indeed have thoughts in this regard.”
“Recently, you also purchased 500 Spirit Plant Stars from the Gu Clan.”
Gu Xuanting glanced at him.
“Your actions are indeed getting bolder.”
Yang Fan opened his mouth, not knowing how to explain for a moment.
“Alright.”
Gu Xuanting waved his hand.
“Everyone has their own secrets.”
“Although you are my son-in-law, as an elder, I will not forcibly probe your trump cards.”
“I am the Third Elder of the Gu Family, in charge of the Gu Family’s Medicinal Pill and spiritual material channels.”
“If your divine kingdom wants to develop industries related to Medicinal Pills in the future, you can go through my channels.”
“Increasing the profit by one or two tenths will not be a big problem.”
Yang Fan hurriedly nodded, “Thank you, Father.”
Gu Xuanting nodded.
But the next moment, as if thinking of something, his expression suddenly turned somewhat complex.
After a long silence, he ultimately sighed.
“There is one more matter.”
“Although I do not approve...”
“But Qinglan and that girl Gu Le have both agreed, so it is not good for me to say anything more.”
As he spoke, Gu Xuanting took out a slip of paper and handed it to Yang Fan.
“This is an address in the Real World.”
“Once you go, you will naturally understand.”
Having said that, he waved his hand.
“Alright, go ahead.”
Looking at his appearance, he seemed somewhat unwilling to continue the conversation.
Although Yang Fan was full of doubts, he still politely stood up.
“Then this child takes his leave.”
Yang Fan’s consciousness withdrew from the Virtual World.
The next moment, the slip of paper Gu Xuanting gave him was also materialized into his hand accordingly.
Yang Fan lowered his head and glanced at it.
It was indeed an address in the Real World on it.
And it was right in the area of The Frontline.
However, it was not a dangerous zone, but a safe zone specially designated by The Frontline.
It was only more than two hundred kilometers away from the Gu Family villa where he currently lived.
“What does Father-in-law mean by this?”
Yang Fan frowned slightly.
“Who is he asking me to come here to see?”
To be safe, Yang Fan took out his communication device, took a photo of the address on the slip of paper, and then sent it to Gu Le via Feixun.
Not long after, Gu Le replied.
There was only a single word, “Go.”

chapters.title: Chapter 374: Acquaintance!
paragraphs: “Master, please enter,” the robot said again.
“The Mistress is already waiting inside.”
Upon hearing this, Yang Fan’s eyes lit up instantly.
“Could it be...”
“Did Gu Le graduate early?”
“Is she planning to give me a surprise?”
Thinking of this, Yang Fan did not hesitate any longer.
He pushed the door open and walked toward the main hall.
Just as he pushed open the doors to the main hall, Yang Fan’s footsteps came to a halt.
In the center of the hall, a familiar figure came into view.
The woman seemed to have just finished bathing.
Her long, black hair was still slightly damp, with a few strands clinging gently to her fair cheeks.
She wore an exquisitely tailored haute couture evening gown that outlined her perfect figure.
Soft light spilled over her, making her appear as if she had stepped out of a painting.
But what truly caught Yang Fan’s attention was not her stunning appearance, but the aura of a deity that she could not hide.
After seeing her face clearly, Yang Fan froze.
He certainly knew this person.
But he had never imagined that they would meet under such circumstances.
The person was not Gu Le, but Gu Le’s cousin—Lu Wan.
Back when they were in the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone at Primordial Academy, Lu Wan was already a fourth-year student.
Now that she had graduated and entered the The Frontline, and achieved a Breakthrough to the Realm of a deity, it was entirely consistent with her status and talent.
After all, as the pride of the Lu Family, this rate of growth was not exaggerated.
However...
Yang Fan could not imagine why he would see her here.
And to be arranged by Gu Xuanting, no less.
This felt wrong no matter how he looked at it.
“Ahem.”
Yang Fan coughed lightly and subconsciously took a half-step back.
“Lu Wan.”
“Is there some kind of mistake?”
His impression of Lu Wan was not shallow.
Back at Primordial Academy, she had even seduced him right in front of Gu Le.
Moreover, Lu Wan’s status was not inferior to Gu Le’s in the slightest.
Yang Fan truly did not want to provoke a woman like this.
His life was going well right now.
He did not want to suddenly trigger some cliché drama involving infidelity and a love triangle.
However, Lu Wan did not retreat at all.
“Young Lord Yang.”
The corners of her mouth curled up slightly.
“It seems this form of address is no longer appropriate.”
“Now, I should call you...”
“Husband.”
As her voice faded, Lu Wan moved.
In less than half a breath, she was already in front of Yang Fan.
She reached out with both hands, seemingly preparing to wrap them naturally around Yang Fan’s neck.
Yang Fan subconsciously reached out to block her, his palm making contact with her arm, and he applied a light force.
The next moment, Lu Wan’s face instantly turned pale.
“Ouch!”
“Be gentler!”
Yang Fan was startled and quickly let go.
“My apologies.”
Lu Wan rubbed her arm, but there was no anger in her eyes; instead, she revealed a hint of surprise.
“Husband is indeed a Peerless Prodigy-level Genius.”
“We both only achieved our Breakthrough to deity not long ago.”
“And I specialize in the Martial Route, yet I didn’t expect... your Physical Body to actually surpass mine.”
Yang Fan rubbed his nose awkwardly.
“I just want to know, what is going on here?”
“Also, Lu Wan.”
“We don’t have a marriage relationship, do we?”
Lu Wan blinked.
“Isn’t marriage essentially just a contract?”
“If we sign one, don’t we have a relationship?”
Her tone was natural.
“Besides, Aunt Qinglan and cousin Gu Le have already agreed.”
“You don’t need to worry.”
“How about... we go inside and have dinner first?”
As she spoke, Lu Wan turned slightly to the side.
She lifted her right hand lightly, placed her left hand naturally at her waist, and leaned forward slightly, her skirt draping gently with the movement.
This was a standard welcoming etiquette of an upper-class Family.
The movement was elegant and restrained.
It expressed an invitation while maintaining sufficient respect.
“Young Lord Yang, please.”
“Tonight’s dinner is already prepared.”
Yang Fan swept his Mental Energy across the area.
He discovered that there was no one else in the entire villa besides Lu Wan.
Only then did he completely lower his guard and walk inside with a calm expression.
In the center of the hall, the long dining table was already filled with all sorts of exquisite delicacies.

Crystal-clear spirit fruits and delicacies of immortal poultry exuded a rich aroma, and in the center were even several jars of immortal brew—a top-tier vintage—the fragrance of which alone was enough to invigorate the spirit.
Now, with the birth of the fourth-tier Intelligent Life, Yang Fan’s Mental Energy was no longer what it used to be.

A single sweep of his Mental Energy could even analyze the material structure; with just one glance, he confirmed that all the wine and food before him had no issues, and only then did he sit down with peace of mind.
At this moment, Lu Wan gently placed a document in front of Yang Fan.
“Husband, take a look at this first.”
Yang Fan opened the document and scanned it quickly.
However, the further he read, the more intense the surprise in his eyes became.
This was actually a complete strategic plan for the future development of the Yang Corporation!

Starting from the Star Domain on the front lines where Xiling Planet was located, to gradually covering the entire Human Federation, the development routes for each stage, networking channels, capital operations, resource integration, IPO planning... almost every step was arranged in extreme detail.

The Lu Corporation’s industries spanned the entire Human Federation, and in the Star Domain on the front lines, it held shares in almost all large listed companies, controlling the resource channels of over a thousand life planets.
And this plan was prepared to utilize these networks to push the Yang Corporation toward the entire Human Federation, step by step.
Yang Fan slowly looked up at Lu Wan, his eyes full of surprise.
“What is this?”
Lu Wan smiled slightly.
“This is my sincerity.”

“According to our investigation, you have already injected two hundred trillion Divinity Points into the Yang Corporation. Now that the company has ample funds, it has already begun to acquire assets and life planets in the Star Domain on the front lines in large quantities.”
“However, this can only be counted as capital accumulation.”
“To truly become a super consortium capable of influencing the entire Human Federation, funds alone are far from enough.”
“Government relations, networking channels, industrial layout, business models, resource integration... the Yang Corporation is still very weak in these areas.”
“And these are precisely what the Lu Corporation excels at.”
Speaking of this, she slowly stood up and came to Yang Fan’s side.
“The Lu Corporation holds shares in over eighty percent of the large enterprises in the Federation.”
“In the future, whether it is mergers and acquisitions, financing, IPOs, or sales channels for the Yang Corporation, I can help you pave the way.”
Having said that, she leaned down and blew gently into Yang Fan’s ear.
“Besides that...”
“You must be very short on funds right now, right?”
“My mother has prepared one hundred trillion Divinity Points and fifty million military merits for me as my dowry.”
“How about it?”
Hearing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help but chuckle.
“Since the dowry is so generous, shouldn’t I also prepare a decent bride price?”
As he spoke, he reached out and gently wrapped his arm around Lu Wan’s slender waist.
With a tap of his toes, his chair slid backward slowly.
The next moment, he took the opportunity to gently pull Lu Wan into his embrace.
Facing Yang Fan’s sudden movement, Lu Wan stiffened for a moment.
Her originally fair cheeks flushed with a layer of red that was visible to the naked eye, spreading all the way to her earlobes.
“I... I am surnamed Lu.”
“The Lu Family lacks nothing.”
She lowered her head and said softly.
“What I set my eyes on was you in the first place.”
“However... let’s get this straight.”
“In the future, if we have children, you cannot play favorites.”
“The children... must have at least ten percent of the Yang Corporation’s shares.”
Her voice grew quieter and quieter, until at the end, it was almost inaudible.

chapters.title: Chapter 375: One Must Have Vision
paragraphs: Yang Fan looked at the woman in his arms and smiled gently.
“I... don’t seem to have any reason to refuse.”
Since the Gu Family had already agreed, Yang Fan had absolutely no reason to refuse!
This was simply a relationship, benefits, and a girl delivered right to his doorstep!
If he didn’t take advantage of such a bargain, wouldn’t he just be a complete bastard?
In the adult world, the more you eat of the’soft rice’, the tastier it gets!
Yang Fan looked down at the delicacies on the table and suddenly lost interest.
He gently picked up Lu Wan and walked straight upstairs.
Along the way, the smart robots had already opened the doors in advance.
In the bedroom, the lighting was soft.
The large bed was covered with light red petals, and the air was filled with a faint floral fragrance.
Clearly, all of this had been prepared well in advance.
Lu Wan gently gripped Yang Fan’s sleeve, her expression finally showing a hint of nervousness.
“Um... you... be gentle.”
“It’s my first time.”
Yang Fan was slightly stunned.
“First time?”
“Aren’t you the famous socialite of the Primordial Academy?”
When at the Primordial Academy, Lu Wan had an extremely wide social circle, with connections across all departments, and even many close male friends; these things were no secret.
Hearing this, Lu Wan immediately became anxious.
“That’s managing connections!”
“Those who can enter the Primordial Academy, thousands of years from now, which one of them won’t be a big shot in the Federation’s political and business circles?”
“Making connections early never hurts.”
As she said this, she gave a soft huff.
“As for it being my first time... that has to be sold for a good price!”
“After all, don’t some men in this world have a special obsession?”
Yang Fan couldn’t help but smile upon hearing this.
“I’ve discovered that you women from big families all have one thing in common.”
“What?”
“You’re too direct.”
Lu Wan blinked and suddenly said seriously:
“So, Husband likes a different style.”
“I can act, you know.”
“For example... I have a sick mother, a gambling-addicted father, and a younger brother in school.”
“Now the hope of the whole Family rests on me.”
After finishing, she couldn’t help but laugh herself.
Yang Fan laughed, “You really have a way with words.”
“Of course.”
Lu Wan lifted her chin, looking somewhat proud.
“Although I have always kept myself pure, I am not like that homebody Gu Le.”
“I know much more than her.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan finally couldn’t hold back anymore and pulled her into his arms.
Outside the window, the moonlight was like water, and the night breeze brushed gently.
Amidst the flickering lights, only tenderness remained in the room.
“Mortal feelings first pledged to Wan, Wan’s heart returns entirely to Fan. A night of spring breeze warms, from now on never to part.”
Meanwhile.
In the Virtual World.
Gu Le’s consciousness was sitting in the courtyard, chatting with her mother, Lu Qinglan.
Lu Qinglan was all smiles, teasing Gu Chengye in her arms.
“Didn’t you always dislike that girl, Lu Wan? How could you agree to this?” Lu Qinglan asked with a smile.
Gu Le’s expression remained calm upon hearing this.
“Disliking her is just because our personalities don’t match.”
“But I won’t reject something beneficial to me just because I dislike someone.”
Speaking of this, she raised her head and looked at her mother.
“Mother, didn’t you tell me this since I was a child?”
“In the eyes of a merchant, everything is negotiable; as long as the benefits are sufficient, there is nothing in this world that cannot be traded.”
Gu Le’s tone was flat, as if she were simply stating a very ordinary fact.
“Now that you have married into the Gu Family, although you still have connections in the Lu Family, you ultimately cannot compare to Lu Wan’s mother.”
“If the Yang Corporation only relies on the Gu Family, it will probably take at least a thousand years to step out of the Zhanbian Star Domain.”
“As for growing into a top consortium that can influence the entire Human Federation, who knows how many tens of thousands of years that would take.”
Lu Qinglan nodded slightly, then asked with a smile:
“But that girl, Lu Wan, is not someone to be trifled with.”
“Before, my son-in-law only had the Gu Family connection, so naturally, he would consider your feelings in everything.”
“Now that there is the added connection of the Lu Family, aren’t you worried at all that your interests will be affected?”
Gu Le shook her head slightly.
“Your daughter still has some ability to judge people.”
“Husband certainly has many little schemes, and perhaps his utilization of me outweighs his love.”
“But he is not an ungrateful person.”
“As long as I don’t touch his bottom line, I will always be his wife.”
Speaking of this, the corners of Gu Le’s mouth lifted slightly.
“Just like those two girls from the Luo Family.”
“Regardless of status, strength, or background, they are far inferior to me.”
“But Husband only favors me more, yet he has never deliberately belittled them to please me, nor has he harmed those who once accompanied him.”
“I can trust a person like this.”
Gu Le looked down at Gu Chengye in her arms, her eyes softening significantly.
“Besides, Mother, didn’t you also tell me?”
“One must have vision; instead of fighting for a small piece of cake, it is better to make the cake bigger.”
“Yang Fan is my husband.”
“The resources behind Lu Wan can allow the Yang Corporation to soar.”
“The stronger the Yang Corporation, the more I will receive.”
“To take, one must first give.”
“Sometimes, giving away a portion of the benefits can actually be exchanged for greater power.”
As she spoke, she leaned down and gently pinched Gu Chengye’s little nose.
“Little guy.”
“When you grow up, the shares in your hand will likely become an astronomical figure.”
“You really are a lucky little guy.”
Gu Le’s eyes were full of doting affection.
Lu Qinglan couldn’t help but laugh.
“You girl, you really are calculating.”
“But this is good, I can rest easy.”
“At least you won’t be at a disadvantage.”
As she said this, she waved her hand, and a share transfer agreement appeared in front of Gu Le.
“Lu Wan’s mother has already transferred the shares of Wanling Biopharmaceuticals to me for free.”
“Now my shareholding has reached 61 percent.”
“I will transfer all of these shares to you.”
“I cannot compete with her mother in terms of Lu Corporation connections.”
“Consider these shares as compensation from me; manage them well.”
Gu Le’s eyes lit up immediately.
“Thank you, Mom!”
Lu Qinglan laughed helplessly:
“You girl, you are not polite at all when receiving things from your parents.”
Gu Le picked up Gu Chengye with a smile.
“Who told me I have a good life?”
“Isn’t that right, Ye’er?”
She gently supported Gu Chengye’s little arms and lifted him up.
The little guy immediately giggled non-stop, not knowing whether he understood or just felt ticklish.
Time passed quietly.
In the blink of an eye, a night had passed.
Early morning.
Outside the villa, the first ray of sunlight slowly fell.
The smart shading glass automatically adjusted its light transmittance, softening the harsh morning light, and the room maintained a comfortable light level.
In the bedroom, Lu Wan nestled quietly in Yang Fan’s arms, breathing evenly.
Yang Fan looked down at the woman in his arms, and recalling her stubborn yet constantly begging appearance from last night, he couldn’t help but raise a smile at the corner of his mouth.

sentences.text: Yang Fan looked at the woman in his arms and smiled gently.
“I... don’t seem to have any reason to refuse.”
Since the Gu Family had already agreed, Yang Fan had absolutely no reason to refuse!
This was simply a relationship, benefits, and a girl delivered right to his doorstep!
If he didn’t take advantage of such a bargain, wouldn’t he just be a complete bastard?
In the adult world, the more you eat of the’soft rice’, the tastier it gets!
Yang Fan looked down at the delicacies on the table and suddenly lost interest.
He gently picked up Lu Wan and walked straight upstairs.
Along the way, the smart robots had already opened the doors in advance.
In the bedroom, the lighting was soft.
The large bed was covered with light red petals, and the air was filled with a faint floral fragrance.
Clearly, all of this had been prepared well in advance.
Lu Wan gently gripped Yang Fan’s sleeve, her expression finally showing a hint of nervousness.
“Um... you... be gentle.”
“It’s my first time.”
Yang Fan was slightly stunned.
“First time?”
“Aren’t you the famous socialite of the Primordial Academy?”
When at the Primordial Academy, Lu Wan had an extremely wide social circle, with connections across all departments, and even many close male friends; these things were no secret.
Hearing this, Lu Wan immediately became anxious.
“That’s managing connections!”
“Those who can enter the Primordial Academy, thousands of years from now, which one of them won’t be a big shot in the Federation’s political and business circles?”
“Making connections early never hurts.”
As she said this, she gave a soft huff.
“As for it being my first time... that has to be sold for a good price!”
“After all, don’t some men in this world have a special obsession?”
Yang Fan couldn’t help but smile upon hearing this.
“I’ve discovered that you women from big families all have one thing in common.”
“What?”
“You’re too direct.”
Lu Wan blinked and suddenly said seriously:
“So, Husband likes a different style.”
“I can act, you know.”
“For example...
I have a sick mother, a gambling-addicted father, and a younger brother in school.”
“Now the hope of the whole Family rests on me.”
After finishing, she couldn’t help but laugh herself.
Yang Fan laughed, “You really have a way with words.”
“Of course.”
Lu Wan lifted her chin, looking somewhat proud.
“Although I have always kept myself pure, I am not like that homebody Gu Le.”
“I know much more than her.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan finally couldn’t hold back anymore and pulled her into his arms.
Outside the window, the moonlight was like water, and the night breeze brushed gently.
Amidst the flickering lights, only tenderness remained in the room.
“Mortal feelings first pledged to Wan, Wan’s heart returns entirely to Fan.
A night of spring breeze warms, from now on never to part.”
Meanwhile.
In the Virtual World.
Gu Le’s consciousness was sitting in the courtyard, chatting with her mother, Lu Qinglan.
Lu Qinglan was all smiles, teasing Gu Chengye in her arms.
“Didn’t you always dislike that girl, Lu Wan?
How could you agree to this?” Lu Qinglan asked with a smile.
Gu Le’s expression remained calm upon hearing this.
“Disliking her is just because our personalities don’t match.”
“But I won’t reject something beneficial to me just because I dislike someone.”
Speaking of this, she raised her head and looked at her mother.
“Mother, didn’t you tell me this since I was a child?”
“In the eyes of a merchant, everything is negotiable; as long as the benefits are sufficient, there is nothing in this world that cannot be traded.”
Gu Le’s tone was flat, as if she were simply stating a very ordinary fact.
“Now that you have married into the Gu Family, although you still have connections in the Lu Family, you ultimately cannot compare to Lu Wan’s mother.”
“If the Yang Corporation only relies on the Gu Family, it will probably take at least a thousand years to step out of the Zhanbian Star Domain.”
“As for growing into a top consortium that can influence the entire Human Federation, who knows how many tens of thousands of years that would take.”
Lu Qinglan nodded slightly, then asked with a smile:
“But that girl, Lu Wan, is not someone to be trifled with.”
“Before, my son-in-law only had the Gu Family connection, so naturally, he would consider your feelings in everything.”
“Now that there is the added connection of the Lu Family, aren’t you worried at all that your interests will be affected?”
Gu Le shook her head slightly.
“Your daughter still has some ability to judge people.”
“Husband certainly has many little schemes, and perhaps his utilization of me outweighs his love.”
“But he is not an ungrateful person.”
“As long as I don’t touch his bottom line, I will always be his wife.”
Speaking of this, the corners of Gu Le’s mouth lifted slightly.
“Just like those two girls from the Luo Family.”
“Regardless of status, strength, or background, they are far inferior to me.”
“But Husband only favors me more, yet he has never deliberately belittled them to please me, nor has he harmed those who once accompanied him.”
“I can trust a person like this.”
Gu Le looked down at Gu Chengye in her arms, her eyes softening significantly.
“Besides, Mother, didn’t you also tell me?”
“One must have vision; instead of fighting for a small piece of cake, it is better to make the cake bigger.”
“Yang Fan is my husband.”
“The resources behind Lu Wan can allow the Yang Corporation to soar.”
“The stronger the Yang Corporation, the more I will receive.”
“To take, one must first give.”
“Sometimes, giving away a portion of the benefits can actually be exchanged for greater power.”
As she spoke, she leaned down and gently pinched Gu Chengye’s little nose.
“Little guy.”
“When you grow up, the shares in your hand will likely become an astronomical figure.”
“You really are a lucky little guy.”
Gu Le’s eyes were full of doting affection.
Lu Qinglan couldn’t help but laugh.
“You girl, you really are calculating.”
“But this is good, I can rest easy.”
