chapters.title: Chapter 376: Giving Gifts
paragraphs: As a deity, Lu Wan’s perception was incredibly sharp.
Even the slightest twitch at the corner of Yang Fan’s mouth was immediately noticed by Lu Wan.
She slowly opened her eyes.
Just in time to meet Yang Fan’s smiling gaze.
Her pretty face instantly flushed red all the way to her ears.
“Husband...”
“You really don’t know how to be gentle with women.”
She gave Yang Fan a shy, annoyed glare.
Yang Fan spread his hands with an innocent look.
“You can’t blame me for this.”
“Who was the one talking tough last night, saying she had great physical fitness?”
Lu Wan was so embarrassed she wished she could find a hole in the ground to crawl into.
“Get lost!”
She reached out and gave Yang Fan a gentle push, but she had no strength at all, making it seem more like she was acting coquettishly.
Yang Fan laughed and didn’t tease her further.
The two of them quickly washed up, changed their clothes, and went to the living room together.
By this time, the intelligent robot had already prepared a sumptuous breakfast.
Seeing them come out, the robot immediately bowed gracefully.
“Master, Mistress.”
“Good morning.”
“Wishing you both a happy marriage.”
Yang Fan swept his Mental Energy over it, his gaze landing on the intelligent robot.
He was surprised to find that, except for the brain portion, the rest of the robot’s structure was almost indistinguishable from a real human.

The skeleton was made of a special titanium alloy, and the muscles, skin, and blood vessels were extremely realistic, with even a red liquid flowing slowly through the vessels to simulate human blood circulation.
If not for his powerful Mental Energy, it would be almost impossible to tell the real from the fake with the naked eye.
“This kind of robot is quite rare on the market!” Yang Fan said with some curiosity.
Lu Wan smiled slightly.
“It’s a beta-test product from Cyber Company, a subsidiary of the Qin Technology Alliance.”
“Although it’s just a startup, it has immense potential.”
“I currently hold 10% of their shares, so I got a batch of testing slots in advance.”
She looked at Yang Fan and said softly:
“If you like them, Husband, I can have a batch transferred over.”
“These robots are equipped with the most advanced medical, health, dietary, and combat assistance chips.”
“We can arrange a few for my parents-in-law to take care of their daily lives, which will save a lot of trouble.”
Yang Fan didn’t stand on ceremony and nodded directly.
“Sure.”
“My parents should like them a lot.”
Pausing, he continued:
“Let’s go to the Virtual World to see them in a bit.”
“I can also introduce you to the current general manager of the Yang Corporation.”
“Alright.”
Lu Wan smiled and nodded.
After breakfast.
The two of them put on the virtual helmets that the intelligent robot had already prepared.
Their consciousnesses blurred for a moment, and they descended onto Xiling Planet.
This time, Yang Fan did not teleport to the Yang Corporation headquarters, but instead went straight to the villa where his parents lived.
Since he had given them a heads-up, there weren’t many people in the villa at this time.
Aside from his parents, Yang Tiexin and Sun Rong, there were only the sisters Luo Rou and Luo Bing, as well as Ma Yu, the general manager of the Yang Corporation.
Yang Fan led Lu Wan into the hall and introduced her with a smile:
“This is my wife, Lu Wan.”
Then, he looked at Lu Wan again.
“These are my parents.”
“These two are my wives who have been with me since our time in Yang County, Luo Rou and Luo Bing.”
“And this is Ma Yu, the current general manager of the Yang Corporation.”
After the introductions.
Lu Wan naturally took a step forward, folded her hands in front of her, bowed slightly, and saluted Yang Tiexin and his wife.
The entire movement was elegant and standard, leaving no room for criticism.
“Father, Mother.”
“My name is Lu Wan. It is a pleasure to meet you both.”
“Before coming, I learned a bit about everyone’s situation beforehand. I hope I am not being too forward.”
As she spoke, she gave a gentle wave of her hand.
Several electronic shareholding agreements floated in front of everyone.
“Father, I heard that you have always liked running companies.”
“Coincidentally, I hold original shares of a science and technology innovation board listed company in the Zhanbian Star Domain, and they have now all been transferred under your name.”
Then, she looked at Sun Rong.
“Mother, I understand that you usually like shopping and enjoy researching culinary arts.”
“The largest department store in the Zhanbian Star Domain is located on Pluto, and I have already transferred the ownership of the entire mall to your name.”
“In addition, I also hold a 5% stake in the large catering group Hailaolao, and the transfer of ownership has already been completed.”
“I hope you like these gifts.”
Hearing this, Yang Tiexin and Sun Rong couldn’t help but swallow hard.
They had long known that Lu Wan came from the Lu Corporation.
But only after meeting her in person did they truly experience how incredibly wealthy and generous this new daughter-in-law was.
Lu Wan turned around and took the initiative to hold Luo Rou’s hands.
“This must be Sister Luo Rou, right?”
“I heard that your Divine Kingdom was once severely damaged by an Alien Demigod.”
“Has it fully recovered now?”
Luo Rou was clearly a bit constrained.
“It has... it has already recovered.”
“Greetings, Sister... Sister Lu.”
Lu Wan smiled and nodded.
“That won’t do.”
“I’ve already had the Intelligent Life handle the procedures to gift you a 4.9% stake in Xinhai Pharmaceuticals.”
“You will be a shareholder from now on, and you can directly use the group’s highest medical channel.”
“As for your health, you still need to have regular checkups.”
Speaking of this, she suddenly remembered something.
“Oh, right.”
“Is Cheng Rou not here?”
“I specially prepared 100% equity of a large toy chain enterprise for her.”
“The child is still young, so she must have her own toy company.”
Luo Rou was completely stunned.
“Th-Thank you, Sister Lu.”
Her voice trembled slightly.
Lu Wan smiled and nodded, then turned her gaze to Luo Bing. “And this must be Sister Luo Bing, right?”
Luo Bing managed to squeeze out a smile.
“Hello, Sister Lu.”
At this moment, however, stormy waves were already crashing in her heart.
This newly arrived sister was simply too formidable.
From the moment she entered the door, she had been gentle and polite, her words and actions absolutely flawless.
Yet, it was precisely this politeness that, without anyone realizing it, put the rhythm of the entire hall completely into her hands.
There was no sharp display of dominance.
Yet, it made everyone’s eyes involuntarily follow her.
Until this moment, Luo Bing finally understood a little why Luo Rou, even after having Cheng Rou, never tried to fight or vie for anything.
This gap was not a matter of high or low status.
It was a total crushing defeat in terms of vision, connections, and capability.
They were all equally Yang Fan’s wives.
But between them, there was ultimately an insurmountable distance.
“Although Sister Luo Bing transferred to the Star Dome Heavenly Favor Academy, she used to study at Tianshui University.”
Lu Wan smiled slightly.
“Coincidentally, I became a member of the board of directors of Tianshui University some time ago.”
“So, I donated a library to the school in your name, Sister.”
“I hope it will be of some help to you.”
Luo Bing was instantly dazed, not knowing where to put her hands.
She was so nervous that she kept stealing glances at Yang Fan, her eyes filled with a plea for help.
Seeing this, Yang Fan finally stepped forward with a smile and gently patted Lu Wan’s shoulder.
“Alright, that’s enough.”
“As long as the thought is there, that’s fine.”
“The Yang Corporation has always been managed by Ma Yu.”
“Why don’t you two go upstairs and talk about company matters?”
“Leave the development of the corporation to Ma Yu; you don’t need to worry too much about it in the future.”
“You should still prioritize the development of your own Divine Kingdom.”

chapters.title: Chapter 377: Matriarch
paragraphs: Lu Wan nodded obediently, “Understood, Husband.”
After Lu Wan and Ma Yu headed to the second-floor conference room, everyone in the living room collectively breathed a sigh of relief.

Clearly, the other party always wore a smile and spoke gently and politely, yet that invisible coercion originating from a god still made these Divine Beings feel somewhat constrained in their breathing.
What’s more, for a first meeting, she gave such a heavy welcoming gift.
That feeling was no longer being flattered, but rather somewhat at a loss.
“Xiaofan, with you suddenly marrying another wife like this, won’t Le’er have any objections?” Sun Rong couldn’t help asking with worry.
In her view, one was the Gu Family, and the other was the Lu Family.
Both families were among the Five Great Giants of the Human Federation, and they had no idea what the private relationship between the two sides was like.
If any conflicts arose because of this, the one suffering while caught in the middle in the end would still be her own son.
“It’s fine, Le’er agreed to this.” Yang Fan smiled and explained.
Hearing this, Yang Tiexin immediately gave a thumbs up.
“You brat are truly awesome! Eating this soft rice, I think it can even make the headlines of the Human Federation!”
Just as the words fell.
Slap!
Sun Rong raised her hand and gave him a smack on the head.
“Can you even speak? What do you mean by eating soft rice?”
“That’s because my son is likable!”
“He’s eating hard rice!”
“Right, right, right!”
Yang Tiexin nodded hurriedly, “Eating soft rice hard! No... eating hard rice!”
However, the more he spoke, the more chaotic it became, even becoming somewhat incoherent.
Sun Rong wore a look of disgust and directly pinched his ear.
“Stop spouting nonsense here, hurry up and get into the kitchen to taste-test the dishes for me!”
“Hey hey hey... lighter, lighter!”
Yang Tiexin was dragged all the way into the kitchen, continuously begging for mercy.
Afterwards, Sun Rong walked in front of Yang Fan, her expression turning a bit more serious.
“Xiaofan, Mom knows you are capable now.”
“But no matter when, a person must never forget their roots.”
“Girl Rou and Girl Bing have accompanied you all the way to today; no matter what happens in the future, you must not let them suffer too great of a grievance.”
“Understood, Mom.”
Yang Fan nodded seriously.
“I won’t.”
Hearing this, Luo Rou standing nearby hurriedly tugged gently on Sun Rong’s sleeve.
“Mom, actually... I don’t feel aggrieved at all.”
Lowering her head to look at the information on her smart wrist watch, her voice was even trembling slightly.
“I just checked, the shares of the pharmaceutical company that Sister Lu Wan gave me are worth 2.8 billion Divinity Points.”
“And the toy company Cheng Rou received, although it’s only a listed enterprise on a life planet, its market value is also 200 million Divinity Points.”
Luo Rou couldn’t help swallowing a mouthful of saliva.
These big families... are their gifts always this exaggerated?
What grievances could she possibly still have?
At this moment, she even had an urge, wishing she could immediately go upstairs and call Lu Wan her own dear sister a few times.
On the other side, Luo Bing’s intelligent wrist watch also vibrated continuously.
She clicked on the email with doubt.
The next second, her entire person froze on the spot.
[Tianshui University Board of Trustees]
[Thank you, Honorary Alumna Ms. Luo Bing, for donating a modern comprehensive library to our school.]
Luo Bing blinked.
“I’ve just become an honorary alumna like this?”
The corners of her mouth couldn’t help twitching.
Tianshui University, which she once attended, was also a prestigious key university in the Luotian Star Domain.
As a result, now... why does it feel like some bogus university?
At this moment, the last bit of small pride in Luo Bing’s heart also completely vanished into thin air.
There’s no comparing.
Truly cannot compare at all.
Father was right.
Some people’s starting point is the destination others can’t reach even after struggling for a lifetime.
In the future, she should still watch her words and actions, and peacefully stay by her husband’s side; that would be enough.
Meanwhile.
Inside the second-floor conference room.
Ma Yu sat upright, constantly wiping the cold sweat from his forehead.
“M-Madam.”
“Those issues you raised just now, I will rectify them immediately!”
“Those low-yield equities sorted out by the Intelligent Life, I will immediately stop acquiring and readjust the investment direction!”
Ma Yu spoke a bit faster than usual.
Others might not understand what Lu Corporation implies.
But as a businessman, Ma Yu knew it all too well.
Back when he joined several shareholders to found Elephant Loan, he had also fantasized about receiving investment from Lu Corporation.
Unfortunately, because it was a financial company, it couldn’t even reach the minimum threshold to enter Lu Corporation’s investment list.
Little did he expect that now.
He would actually communicate face-to-face with a true direct-line Prodigy of the Lu Family in this identity.
Although Lu Wan was currently only a First-Order God.
Yet the status gap between the two sides was like the difference between clouds and mud.
Compared to the boss Yang Fan, this Madam was clearly even harder to deal with.
Every single requirement she raised was precise to the point of being harsh.
In just over ten minutes, she pointed out dozens of problems in Yang Corporation’s resource allocation, equity allocation, and capital utilization.
Every single one left Ma Yu with no room to refute.
“As expected of a Prodigy nurtured by the Lu Family...”
Ma Yu sighed inwardly.
“The Intelligent Life carried by the Madam is probably also of the highest tier.”
“To actually be able to filter out all the hidden problems of Yang Corporation in such a short time.”
The more he listened, the more admirable he found her.
He even had a feeling.
If from the very beginning, Lu Wan had been coordinating the development of Yang Corporation.
Supported by Yang Fan’s massive amount of Divinity Points, the expansion speed of the entire Yang Corporation could have been at least fifty percent faster.
“That’s all for now.”
Lu Wan closed the materials in her hand, saying in a calm tone.
“If you have any questions, you can contact my Intelligent Life directly.”
“If you encounter insoluble problems during the acquisition process, I will step forward personally.”
“After all, in this Zhanbian Star Domain, my Lu Family has also invested in quite a few life planets.”
The sound of her speaking was not heavy, but landing in Ma Yu’s ears, it carried an invisible pressure.
“Yes... Madam.”
Ma Yu swallowed his saliva and nodded hurriedly.
“There is one more matter.”
Lu Wan tapped her fingers lightly on the desktop, her gaze falling upon Ma Yu.
“I have already investigated your identity profile.”
“Although you are a Fifth-Order God, the Elephant Loan you founded back then had a peak market value of no more than ten billion Divinity Points.”
“With your resume and status, you actually don’t qualify to firmly sit in the position of general manager of Yang Corporation.”
“If it weren’t for my Husband, I would have even wanted to directly deploy a latest ninth-grade Intelligent Life from the Lu Family to serve as a professional manager.”
Every single tap felt as though it landed on Ma Yu’s heart.
Ma Yu lowered his head, completely not daring to refute.
Even he himself hadn’t noticed that at this moment, his real-life body’s back was already completely soaked in cold sweat.
The aura of a direct-line Prodigy of the Lu Family was simply too strong.
“However, since you were able to win the recognition of my Husband, it is not easy for me to say much more.”
Lu Wan’s tone softened slightly.
“However, I must still remind you to remember your status.”
“Nominally you are the general manager of Yang Corporation, but the relationship between you and my Husband is not that of an ordinary boss and employee.”
“Rather, it is the relationship of master and servant.”
“In the future, your form of address must also be changed.”
Hearing these words, Ma Yu immediately breathed a sigh of relief in his heart.
“Yes, Matriarch!”

sentences.text: Lu Wan nodded obediently, “Understood, Husband.”
After Lu Wan and Ma Yu headed to the second-floor conference room, everyone in the living room collectively breathed a sigh of relief.

Clearly, the other party always wore a smile and spoke gently and politely, yet that invisible coercion originating from a god still made these Divine Beings feel somewhat constrained in their breathing.
What’s more, for a first meeting, she gave such a heavy welcoming gift.
That feeling was no longer being flattered, but rather somewhat at a loss.
“Xiaofan, with you suddenly marrying another wife like this, won’t Le’er have any objections?” Sun Rong couldn’t help asking with worry.
In her view, one was the Gu Family, and the other was the Lu Family.
Both families were among the Five Great Giants of the Human Federation, and they had no idea what the private relationship between the two sides was like.
If any conflicts arose because of this, the one suffering while caught in the middle in the end would still be her own son.
“It’s fine, Le’er agreed to this.” Yang Fan smiled and explained.
Hearing this, Yang Tiexin immediately gave a thumbs up.
“You brat are truly awesome!
Eating this soft rice, I think it can even make the headlines of the Human Federation!”
Just as the words fell.
Slap!
Sun Rong raised her hand and gave him a smack on the head.
“Can you even speak?
What do you mean by eating soft rice?”
“That’s because my son is likable!”
“He’s eating hard rice!”
“Right, right, right!”
Yang Tiexin nodded hurriedly, “Eating soft rice hard!
No... eating hard rice!”
However, the more he spoke, the more chaotic it became, even becoming somewhat incoherent.
Sun Rong wore a look of disgust and directly pinched his ear.
“Stop spouting nonsense here, hurry up and get into the kitchen to taste-test the dishes for me!”
“Hey hey hey... lighter, lighter!”
Yang Tiexin was dragged all the way into the kitchen, continuously begging for mercy.
Afterwards, Sun Rong walked in front of Yang Fan, her expression turning a bit more serious.
“Xiaofan, Mom knows you are capable now.”
“But no matter when, a person must never forget their roots.”
“Girl Rou and Girl Bing have accompanied you all the way to today; no matter what happens in the future, you must not let them suffer too great of a grievance.”
“Understood, Mom.”
Yang Fan nodded seriously.
“I won’t.”
Hearing this, Luo Rou standing nearby hurriedly tugged gently on Sun Rong’s sleeve.
“Mom, actually...
I don’t feel aggrieved at all.”
Lowering her head to look at the information on her smart wrist watch, her voice was even trembling slightly.
“I just checked, the shares of the pharmaceutical company that Sister Lu Wan gave me are worth 2.8 billion Divinity Points.”
“And the toy company Cheng Rou received, although it’s only a listed enterprise on a life planet, its market value is also 200 million Divinity Points.”
Luo Rou couldn’t help swallowing a mouthful of saliva.
These big families... are their gifts always this exaggerated?
What grievances could she possibly still have?
At this moment, she even had an urge, wishing she could immediately go upstairs and call Lu Wan her own dear sister a few times.
On the other side, Luo Bing’s intelligent wrist watch also vibrated continuously.
She clicked on the email with doubt.
The next second, her entire person froze on the spot.
[Tianshui University Board of Trustees]
[Thank you, Honorary Alumna Ms.
Luo Bing, for donating a modern comprehensive library to our school.]
Luo Bing blinked.
“I’ve just become an honorary alumna like this?”
The corners of her mouth couldn’t help twitching.
Tianshui University, which she once attended, was also a prestigious key university in the Luotian Star Domain.
As a result, now... why does it feel like some bogus university?
At this moment, the last bit of small pride in Luo Bing’s heart also completely vanished into thin air.
There’s no comparing.
Truly cannot compare at all.
Father was right.
Some people’s starting point is the destination others can’t reach even after struggling for a lifetime.
In the future, she should still watch her words and actions, and peacefully stay by her husband’s side; that would be enough.
Meanwhile.
Inside the second-floor conference room.
Ma Yu sat upright, constantly wiping the cold sweat from his forehead.
“M-Madam.”
“Those issues you raised just now, I will rectify them immediately!”
“Those low-yield equities sorted out by the Intelligent Life, I will immediately stop acquiring and readjust the investment direction!”
Ma Yu spoke a bit faster than usual.
Others might not understand what Lu Corporation implies.
But as a businessman, Ma Yu knew it all too well.
Back when he joined several shareholders to found Elephant Loan, he had also fantasized about receiving investment from Lu Corporation.
Unfortunately, because it was a financial company, it couldn’t even reach the minimum threshold to enter Lu Corporation’s investment list.
Little did he expect that now.
He would actually communicate face-to-face with a true direct-line Prodigy of the Lu Family in this identity.
Although Lu Wan was currently only a First-Order God.
Yet the status gap between the two sides was like the difference between clouds and mud.
Compared to the boss Yang Fan, this Madam was clearly even harder to deal with.
Every single requirement she raised was precise to the point of being harsh.
In just over ten minutes, she pointed out dozens of problems in Yang Corporation’s resource allocation, equity allocation, and capital utilization.
Every single one left Ma Yu with no room to refute.
“As expected of a Prodigy nurtured by the Lu Family...”
Ma Yu sighed inwardly.
“The Intelligent Life carried by the Madam is probably also of the highest tier.”
“To actually be able to filter out all the hidden problems of Yang Corporation in such a short time.”
The more he listened, the more admirable he found her.
He even had a feeling.
If from the very beginning, Lu Wan had been coordinating the development of Yang Corporation.
Supported by Yang Fan’s massive amount of Divinity Points, the expansion speed of the entire Yang Corporation could have been at least fifty percent faster.

“If you have any questions, you can contact my Intelligent Life directly.”

chapters.title: Chapter 378: I Am Not Someone Who Lives Off A Woman
paragraphs: Ma Yu uttered this form of address with absolute naturalness.
There was even a hint of relief in his voice.
Ever since Yang Fan had consecutively injected two hundred trillion Divinity Points, Ma Yu had always felt somewhat uneasy sitting in the position of General Manager.
The reason was simple—his virtue did not match his position.
Initially, his Elephant Loan, while considered successful, could not be counted as a large enterprise when looking at the entire Human Federation.
But the current Yang Corporation possessed capital sufficient to influence an entire Star Domain.
He had long wanted to address Yang Fan as Master.
It was just that Yang Fan himself requested to be called Boss, so he had no choice but to comply.
Now, Lu Wan had instead helped him formally establish the relationship.
What was wrong with addressing him as Master?
What was wrong with being someone’s dog?
Being able to follow an existence destined to stand at the Peak of the Human Race in the future was an opportunity countless people prayed for but could not get.
What did a few barks matter?
During this period, because of his status as the General Manager of the Yang Corporation, those so-called friends of the past were all eager to kneel down and be dogs for him.
Ma Yu was very clear about his position.
“That will be all for now.”
Lu Wan stood up and walked out of the conference room.
At this moment, in the hall downstairs.
Yang Fan was sitting leisurely on the sofa.
Luo Rou was sitting on his left, and Luo Bing was on his right.
Sun Rong was on the side, cutting spiritual fruits for him.
As for Yang Tiexin... he was currently still locked in the kitchen.
Seeing this scene, Lu Wan, who had just walked downstairs, couldn’t help but reveal a hint of a smile.
It had to be said, this husband of hers was truly interesting.
Two hundred trillion Divinity Points was not a small number.
Even she would not underestimate such a massive sum of capital.
Yet Yang Fan was something else; he was so trusting that he let her go up alone to negotiate with Ma Yu.
He stayed below, looking completely unconcerned, with women in his arms, enjoying family time.
“Is he truly trusting enough of me...”
“Or does he simply not care about the Yang Corporation at all?”
A hint of curiosity arose in Lu Wan’s heart.
This man seemed completely different from those Geniuses she had met before.
“Wan’er, you’re down?”
Seeing Lu Wan walk over, Yang Fan spoke with a smile.
Lu Wan nodded, “Mm, the matter has been discussed.”
Seeing this scene.
Luo Bing instinctively stood up, giving up her original seat.
Lu Wan did not stand on ceremony and sat directly beside Yang Fan.
The family stayed in the Virtual World just like that, chatting about some daily topics.
After a while, Yang Fan and Lu Wan exited the Virtual World, their consciousness returning to reality.
“How do you feel?”
After taking off the virtual helmet, Yang Fan looked at Lu Wan.
Lu Wan pondered for a moment.
“The predecessor of the Yang Corporation, Elephant Loan, while having a relatively weak foundation, has no issues with its company structure, and the personnel configuration is quite complete.”
“Now with the two hundred trillion Divinity Points injected by my husband, there is absolutely no need to worry about capital issues for the next few decades.”
“Therefore, there is no need to interfere too much; Manager Ma should be able to handle it well.”
Yang Fan: “...”
He remained silent for a few seconds.
“I mean...”
“After meeting my family, how do you feel?”
Yang Fan couldn’t help but cough.
Only now did he suddenly realize.
This newlywed wife of his seemed to have a bit too strong a sense of career ambition.
From the moment they met, her mouth was either about the company or shares.
If not that, it was business layouts or personnel structures.
Even when meeting his parents for the first time, she could quickly enter a group management state.
Yang Fan looked at Lu Wan, and for a moment, he actually didn’t know what to say.
Did he marry a wife... or did he marry a business consultant?
“Ah? The... the people are all very good.”
Lu Wan was stunned for a moment, then hurriedly nodded.
“That... husband, my mother has already transferred 100 trillion Divinity Points and 50 million Military Merit to me.”

“You have only recently achieved a Breakthrough to deityhood, and you have invested a large amount of resources into developing the Yang Corporation, so presumably, your Divine Kingdom is currently in need of resources.”
“I will transfer this dowry to you first.”
Lu Wan’s tone was calm, as if she were just talking about the most ordinary matter.
Last night, the two had officially signed a marriage contract and completed the Human Federation’s legal certification.
Now, they were a husband-and-wife relationship recognized by the Human Federation.
Although the marriage contract did not explicitly state the dowry matter, Lu Wan had always valued her promises.
Since she had agreed to it initially, she would definitely do it.
Moreover, she truly wanted to help Yang Fan.

Having just achieved a Breakthrough to the deity stage, the development of the Divine Kingdom was in a period of rapid expansion, and the consumption of various resources by believers would show exponential growth.
And Yang Fan was simultaneously walking the three paths of Cultivation, Martial Arts, and Mechanical, so the Divine Kingdom was definitely a bottomless pit devouring resources.
She believed that the 100 trillion Divinity Points provided by her mother would definitely be able to solve Yang Fan’s current urgent needs.
“No need.”
Yang Fan shook his head.
“I will accept the Military Merit, but Wan’er, you should keep these 100 trillion Divinity Points for yourself.”
“You also just achieved a Breakthrough to deityhood not long ago, and you need them just as much.”
“As for the company in reality, there is no need to invest too much energy; many things can be left to the Intelligent Life to handle.”
As he spoke, Yang Fan gently held Lu Wan’s hands, his tone sincere and gentle.
“Hus... husband.”
Lu Wan was completely stunned.
“This is 100 trillion Divinity Points!”
“Although Military Merit is precious, by comparison, it is merely a bonus.”
“My mother considered that you might be lacking funds recently, so she specifically mobilized the company’s circulating capital as my dowry.”
“You... you really don’t want it?”
At this moment, Lu Wan’s eyes were filled with disbelief.
100 trillion Divinity Points.
What kind of concept was this?
Many large listed companies did not necessarily reach this figure in total market capitalization.
She had never thought that Yang Fan would refuse.
In the education Lu Wan had received since childhood, this kind of thing was almost impossible to happen.
Coming from the Lu Corporation, she had seen too many commercial marriages.
Husbands and wives united because of interests, and also turned against each other because of interests.
There were even quite a few deity couples who, after their relationship broke down, ended up in federal court over issues of Divine Kingdom assets and company share distribution.
Therefore, in her view, marriage was essentially a form of cooperation.
Since two people were united, they naturally had to maximize the utilization of both parties’ resources.
But now... Yang Fan had actually taken the initiative to refuse a fortune that would drive countless deities mad.
Watching Lu Wan’s shocked expression, Yang Fan stood up and gently pulled her into his embrace.
“Wan’er.”
“How much the dowry is, is actually not important.”
“What I value is your attitude.”
“I already feel that the 50 million Military Merit is very good.”
“As for these 100 trillion Divinity Points...”
Yang Fan shook his head gently.
“The amount is too large.”
“If I accept it, wouldn’t that prove that I am only together with you because of these resources?”
Lu Wan’s body trembled slightly upon hearing this.
“I, Yang Fan, may not be an upright gentleman, but I am definitely not someone who lives off a woman!”
“To say that I didn’t consider your status at all when I got together with you would definitely be a lie!”
“But I also truly like you.”
Yang Fan looked into Lu Wan’s eyes, his voice gentle.
“Wan’er, I love you.”

chapters.title: Chapter 379: Fallen Angels
paragraphs: At this moment, Lu Wan was completely stunned.
She stared blankly at the man before her, as if she were truly seeing Yang Fan for the first time.
She had always believed that Yang Fan was an extremely rational person.
One who could even calmly calculate every step for the sake of profit.
But at this moment, she suddenly realized that this man did not seem to be the person she had imagined.
“You... you...”
Lu Wan opened her mouth, but she couldn’t say a complete sentence.
The next second, her face flushed instantly.
She stood up abruptly and pushed Yang Fan out of the room.
“Bang!”
The door slammed shut.
“Wan’er?”
Yang Fan stood outside the door, somewhat puzzled.
“What’s wrong?”
There was silence in the room for a moment.
Then, Lu Wan’s slightly flustered voice came from within.
“I... I have things to think about.”
“You should go back first.”
“I’ll come find you after I’ve thought it through.”
Yang Fan was taken aback for a moment, but he still nodded.
“Alright.”
“Then take care and get some rest.”
After saying that, he turned and left the villa.
At this moment, Lu Wan was huddled on the floor.
She gently pressed one hand against her chest, and she could clearly feel her heart beating violently.
“How is that possible?”
“The reason I chose to marry him wasn’t it because of his Divine Kingdom talent and that terrifying potential?”
“Besides, according to my investigation, he shouldn’t be the type of person who is deeply infatuated...”
“We were clearly in a relationship of mutual utilization!”
Lu Wan muttered softly.
“Could it be... that he really loves me?”
“Otherwise, why would he give up a full 100 trillion Divinity Points?”
Thinking of this, Lu Wan felt a bit dazed.
“Love...”
“Mother, I feel... like I’ve met the male protagonist from a storybook.”
“You used to say that there is no such thing as pure love in this world, perhaps... you were really wrong.”
Her voice was very soft.
Born into the Lu Family, what Lu Wan had been exposed to most was not romance, but interests.
Corporate structure, asset distribution, equity ratios, business negotiations...
These things had long been ingrained in her bones.
She had also seen too many so-called prodigies.

When those young elites interacted with her, they often discussed prenuptial assets, post-marital shares, future corporate control, and even planned asset division schemes in case their relationship fell apart.
In Lu Wan’s view, there was nothing wrong with this.
Marriage is inherently a contract.
It’s just like running a company together.
When the company develops smoothly, everyone is naturally happy.
But if the company goes bankrupt, it naturally needs to be liquidated according to the rules.
This was the philosophy she had been raised with.
But today, Yang Fan’s choice broke her long-standing perception for the first time.
A man who was willing to give up 100 trillion Divinity Points for her.
“He really loves me...”
Lu Wan hugged her knees, her eyes somewhat lost.
“Then what on earth should I do?”
She was skilled at company valuation, wealth investment, drafting contracts, and legal provisions.
But for the thing called “love,” she was completely clueless.
Yang Fan’s sudden confession caught her off guard.
That feeling was like someone suddenly handing a warm flame to her, who had always lived in a cold business world.
She wanted to get close, but she was also a bit afraid.
“Was I wrong?”
“At the beginning, should I not have used this method of exchanging interests to obtain him?”
“Should I have really had a romance with him, just like in the storybooks?”
The more Lu Wan thought about it, the more confused she felt.
For the first time, she discovered that the matter she was facing was actually more difficult than managing a large conglomerate.
On the other side.
Yang Fan was sitting in the aircraft returning to the Gu Family villa, and he was clearly in a good mood.
He couldn’t even help humming a little tune.
“It’s still Big Sister Ruyan who taught me well.”
“Wan’er is actually quite interesting; she couldn’t hold her ground at all after just a little teasing.”
“And she’s supposed to be a social butterfly?”
“All name and no substance; no wonder it was her first time yesterday.”
Thinking of Lu Wan’s shy and annoyed appearance, Yang Fan couldn’t help but laugh.
“Earned another 50 million military merits.”
“This time, I can exchange for a top-tier S-Rank Building.”
“Comfortable!”
As for those 100 trillion Divinity Points, Yang Fan’s refusal was naturally not because of any love.
It was because the current him was truly not lacking in Divinity Points.
The income generated by his Divine Kingdom grew every day, and a large amount of Divinity Points flowed in continuously.
Even if he accepted those 100 trillion Divinity Points, it would just be left to gather dust in the Divine Kingdom.
If it were back when he had just entered the Primordial Academy...
At that time, if Lu Wan had been willing to gift him 100 trillion Divinity Points.
Let alone marrying him, even if she asked him to acknowledge her as his mother on the spot, he probably would have seriously considered it.
But now, it was different.
His Divine Kingdom had long since grown to another level.
After returning to the Gu Family villa.
Yang Fan closed his eyes, and his consciousness instantly entered the Divine Kingdom.
Within the magnificent temple, his figure slowly appeared.
The moment he appeared, Yang Fan cast his gaze toward the The Frontline battlefield.
At this moment, the war was still ongoing.
Countless Angel Race believers, as if they didn’t care about their lives, were frantically launching charges toward the Intelligent Mecha.
Tens of thousands of angels formed small battle formations, erupting with terrifying power, and slammed directly into the core position of the Intelligent Mecha.
Seeing this scene, a flash of surprise crossed Yang Fan’s eyes.
However, what surprised him was not the Angel Race’s fearless fighting style.
But rather... the appearance of these Angel Race members seemed to have undergone some kind of change.
Their originally pure white wings had now all turned jet black.
On those holy faces, eerie black patterns had also emerged.
As if they had been eroded by some kind of power, or as if they had been poisoned.
“This is...”
Yang Fan furrowed his brows slightly.
“Angel Race, how did they become like this?”
“Reporting to Master, these are Fallen Angels,” Yang Da replied with a bow.
“Fallen Angels?”
Yang Fan raised an eyebrow slightly.
Yang Da nodded and then explained: “It is a type of mutation phenomenon.”
“For example, among the Demon Monkey race, the vast majority are ordinary demon monkeys, but among them, there are also variants like the Vajra King Monkey, which are born with powerful Bloodline.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s eyes flickered, and he subconsciously thought of Qi Tian, whose Divine Kingdom Core he had once seized.
“Others are different from birth, so what is the situation with this Angel Race?”
“The Angel Race excels in powers related to the spirit and Soul, so their mutation is not reflected in the Physical Body, but rather on the level of the mind.”
Yang Da continued to explain.

“According to the Human Race war database, in many historical wars against the Angel Race, after entering the Late Stage, there would be situations where some Angel Race believers transformed into Fallen Angels.”
“This probability is as high as 67.2%.”
“How is the increase in strength?”
Yang Fan waved his hand, not paying too much attention.
In the Divine Kingdom Era, the Human Race was merely one of thousands of races.
Races waged wars against each other for resources, territory, and development opportunities; essentially, there was no such thing as good or evil.
The winner gains everything, and the loser loses everything.
And every race possessed its own area of expertise (Domain), and would also have some special trump cards.
Whether they were ordinary angels or Fallen Angels, it made no difference to Yang Fan.
What he truly cared about was only whether the battlefield situation had changed.

She stared blankly at the man before her, as if she were truly seeing Yang Fan for the first time.
She had always believed that Yang Fan was an extremely rational person.
One who could even calmly calculate every step for the sake of profit.
But at this moment, she suddenly realized that this man did not seem to be the person she had imagined.
“You... you...”
Lu Wan opened her mouth, but she couldn’t say a complete sentence.
The next second, her face flushed instantly.
She stood up abruptly and pushed Yang Fan out of the room.
“Bang!”
The door slammed shut.
“Wan’er?”
Yang Fan stood outside the door, somewhat puzzled.
“What’s wrong?”
There was silence in the room for a moment.
Then, Lu Wan’s slightly flustered voice came from within.
I have things to think about.”
“You should go back first.”
“I’ll come find you after I’ve thought it through.”
Yang Fan was taken aback for a moment, but he still nodded.
“Alright.”
“Then take care and get some rest.”
After saying that, he turned and left the villa.
At this moment, Lu Wan was huddled on the floor.
She gently pressed one hand against her chest, and she could clearly feel her heart beating violently.
“How is that possible?”
“The reason I chose to marry him wasn’t it because of his Divine Kingdom talent and that terrifying potential?”
“Besides, according to my investigation, he shouldn’t be the type of person who is deeply infatuated...”
“We were clearly in a relationship of mutual utilization!”
Lu Wan muttered softly.
“Could it be... that he really loves me?”
“Otherwise, why would he give up a full 100 trillion Divinity Points?”
Thinking of this, Lu Wan felt a bit dazed.
“Love...”
“Mother, I feel... like I’ve met the male protagonist from a storybook.”
“You used to say that there is no such thing as pure love in this world, perhaps... you were really wrong.”
Her voice was very soft.
Born into the Lu Family, what Lu Wan had been exposed to most was not romance, but interests.
Corporate structure, asset distribution, equity ratios, business negotiations...
These things had long been ingrained in her bones.
She had also seen too many so-called prodigies.

When those young elites interacted with her, they often discussed prenuptial assets, post-marital shares, future corporate control, and even planned asset division schemes in case their relationship fell apart.
In Lu Wan’s view, there was nothing wrong with this.
Marriage is inherently a contract.
It’s just like running a company together.
When the company develops smoothly, everyone is naturally happy.
But if the company goes bankrupt, it naturally needs to be liquidated according to the rules.
This was the philosophy she had been raised with.
But today, Yang Fan’s choice broke her long-standing perception for the first time.
A man who was willing to give up 100 trillion Divinity Points for her.
“He really loves me...”
Lu Wan hugged her knees, her eyes somewhat lost.
“Then what on earth should I do?”
She was skilled at company valuation, wealth investment, drafting contracts, and legal provisions.
But for the thing called “love,” she was completely clueless.
Yang Fan’s sudden confession caught her off guard.
That feeling was like someone suddenly handing a warm flame to her, who had always lived in a cold business world.
She wanted to get close, but she was also a bit afraid.
“Was I wrong?”
“At the beginning, should I not have used this method of exchanging interests to obtain him?”
“Should I have really had a romance with him, just like in the storybooks?”
The more Lu Wan thought about it, the more confused she felt.
For the first time, she discovered that the matter she was facing was actually more difficult than managing a large conglomerate.
On the other side.
Yang Fan was sitting in the aircraft returning to the Gu Family villa, and he was clearly in a good mood.
He couldn’t even help humming a little tune.
“It’s still Big Sister Ruyan who taught me well.”
“Wan’er is actually quite interesting; she couldn’t hold her ground at all after just a little teasing.”
“And she’s supposed to be a social butterfly?”
“All name and no substance; no wonder it was her first time yesterday.”
Thinking of Lu Wan’s shy and annoyed appearance, Yang Fan couldn’t help but laugh.
“Earned another 50 million military merits.”
“This time, I can exchange for a top-tier S-Rank Building.”
“Comfortable!”
As for those 100 trillion Divinity Points, Yang Fan’s refusal was naturally not because of any love.
It was because the current him was truly not lacking in Divinity Points.
The income generated by his Divine Kingdom grew every day, and a large amount of Divinity Points flowed in continuously.
Even if he accepted those 100 trillion Divinity Points, it would just be left to gather dust in the Divine Kingdom.
If it were back when he had just entered the Primordial Academy...
At that time, if Lu Wan had been willing to gift him 100 trillion Divinity Points.
Let alone marrying him, even if she asked him to acknowledge her as his mother on the spot, he probably would have seriously considered it.
But now, it was different.
His Divine Kingdom had long since grown to another level.
After returning to the Gu Family villa.
Yang Fan closed his eyes, and his consciousness instantly entered the Divine Kingdom.
Within the magnificent temple, his figure slowly appeared.
The moment he appeared, Yang Fan cast his gaze toward the The Frontline battlefield.
At this moment, the war was still ongoing.
Countless Angel Race believers, as if they didn’t care about their lives, were frantically launching charges toward the Intelligent Mecha.
Tens of thousands of angels formed small battle formations, erupting with terrifying power, and slammed directly into the core position of the Intelligent Mecha.
Seeing this scene, a flash of surprise crossed Yang Fan’s eyes.
However, what surprised him was not the Angel Race’s fearless fighting style.
But rather... the appearance of these Angel Race members seemed to have undergone some kind of change.
Their originally pure white wings had now all turned jet black.
On those holy faces, eerie black patterns had also emerged.
As if they had been eroded by some kind of power, or as if they had been poisoned.
“This is...”

chapters.title: Chapter 380: Two Faces
paragraphs: “Master, rest assured.”
“Although the Fallen Angel’s overall strength has increased somewhat, the margin of improvement is limited, only about 30%.”
“It will not affect the current battle situation.”

“Now our army is close to the opponent’s Divine Kingdom Core, and this subordinate guarantees that within at most twenty years of the Divine Kingdom, this Angel Race Divine Kingdom can be completely captured.”
Yang Da’s tone was calm, without the slightest bit of pressure.
Hearing this, Yang Fan nodded.
If the strengths of both sides were comparable, the sudden appearance of a second-stage change like the Fallen Angel would indeed have the possibility of altering the entire battle situation.
But obviously, from the very beginning, this war was never a fair match.
Until now, the ones truly bearing over ninety percent of the offensive and defensive tasks were still the Intelligent Mecha produced by the Mechanical Civilization.
Under Yang Da’s arrangements, it had even been a long time since any new high-tier believers entered the enemy’s Divine Kingdom Battlefield.
However many Intelligent Mecha were consumed on The Frontline, the rear transport team would continuously replenish them.
This was a pure suppression of Resources.
Let alone the Angel Race’s overall strength increasing by 30%.
Even if it increased by 300%, it would still be difficult to change the final outcome.
Ordinary Alien Gods were no longer even qualified to let Yang Fan truly test his own divine kingdom combat power.
“Very good.”
“Continue to steadily advance, and acquire this Angel Race Divine Kingdom Core as soon as possible.”
“Your subordinate obeys.” Yang Da bowed respectfully.
After arranging the matters of the Divine Kingdom War, Yang Fan returned to his daily life once again.
Every day, he still stayed in the Gu Family’s villa, occasionally handling matters of the Yang Corporation, and spending the rest of his time accompanying his family in the Virtual World.
During this period, he made a special trip to see Gu Le.
Originally, Yang Fan had thought that given Gu Le’s personality, she would have a bit of petty emotion.
After all, the relationship between Lu Wan and her had never been considered harmonious.
But to Yang Fan’s surprise, Gu Le did not complain at all, instead asking him to spend more time with Lu Wan recently.
However, strangely enough, ever since that day, he hadn’t seen Lu Wan for several days.
“What is going on with this newly wedded wife?”
“Could it be... that night I really exerted too much force?”
Sitting alone in the courtyard, Yang Fan couldn’t help rubbing his nose, his mind involuntarily bringing up the softness of Lu Wan that night.
Although the Virtual World could highly simulate reality, it was ultimately just virtual.
Now his own wife was clearly on The Frontline, shouldn’t he eat a bit better?
And just as Yang Fan was enjoying this rare period of leisure, the Divine Kingdom War was still steadily progressing.
The destruction of the Angel Race Divine Kingdom was only a matter of time.
As for Li Tianheng and those newly accepted Subordinate Gods acquiring the demigod Divine Kingdom Cores, there were similarly no accidents.
Every few days, a few demigod Divine Kingdom Cores would appear in Yang Fan’s divine kingdom warehouse, waiting for him to absorb them.
Everything was proceeding according to plan.
The Divine Kingdom Wars of Ma Mian and Niu Tou had still not ended.
Within the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone of the Two Major Academies, the Alien Demigods possessing the S-rank Talent indeed had a foundation far surpassing ordinary demigods.
Relying on the method of corpse pill infection and poisoning believers, the efficiency was quite a bit lower than Yang Fan had anticipated.
However, for the current Yang Fan, the production of the corpse pill was not a problem at all; supporting the two of them was more than enough.
Now, he similarly only needed to wait for the final result.
Just at this moment.
“Dong, dong, dong.”
A burst of knocking suddenly sounded.
Yang Fan was slightly startled, his Mental Energy sweeping across in an instant.
The next moment, a trace of a smile appeared at the corners of his mouth.
Standing outside the door was none other than Lu Wan.
Without the slightest hesitation, Yang Fan immediately got up and opened the door.
However, when he saw Lu Wan clearly outside the door, he froze for a moment.
Today, Lu Wan was unexpectedly not wearing her usual professional attire, nor was she wearing those exquisite and luxurious evening gowns.
Instead, she wore a simple casual outfit.
Her smooth long hair was casually draped over her shoulders, and the clothing style was not luxurious, but it completely displayed the youthful vitality on her body.
It lacked a bit of the majesty of a legitimate daughter of the Lu Family, and gained a touch of the ease and naturalness of a next-door girl.
“Husband, have you missed me these past few days?”
Lu Wan walked up with a smile, very naturally hooking her arm into Yang Fan’s.
She raised her head slightly, staring at Yang Fan with wide eyes, carrying a bit of anticipation in her gaze.
Yang Fan, however, was stunned for a moment.
Because the Lu Wan in front of him was far too different from the woman in his impression.
The Lu Wan of the past always gave people the feeling of being shrewd, capable, and full of a sense of control.
Whether talking about the Yang Corporation or discussing the company’s development with Ma Yu, she was always like a true business woman.
But now... where was there even a shred of that aura?
She was completely like a young girl looking forward to a date with her husband.
“I think about you every day.” Yang Fan came to his senses and immediately nodded.
This wasn’t a lie.
Lu Wan was truly a social butterfly; based purely on technique, even when she first experienced things, her tricks were only slightly inferior to those professional personnel at Tianxiang Renjian.
But compared to Gu Le, Luo Rou, and Luo Bing, she was much more proactive.
Furthermore, with the days on The Frontline being so ‘arduous’, and his own wife just happening to be around, how could Yang Fan not want to?
“Husband, let’s go shopping today!”
Lu Wan said excitedly.
“I’ve already made plans!”
“Although this is The Frontline and can’t compare to those tourism planets, there are still quite a few commercial areas.”
“In the past, I would directly buy shares of those companies, but today I want to go take a look in person!”
“Ah?”
Yang Fan was instantly dumbfounded.
No... is there something wrong with the plot?
He had originally thought that the plan for a day starts in the morning, and since his wife suddenly came to see him, shouldn’t they hurry back to the room to rest.
As a result... shopping?
If she needed to buy things, wouldn’t it be fine to buy them directly in the Virtual World?
Even having intelligent robots buy them on her behalf would work.
However, looking into Lu Wan’s eyes full of anticipation, Yang Fan opened his mouth, but ultimately couldn’t bear to refuse.
“Alright.”
Yang Fan nodded helplessly.
“Yay!”
“We’re going on a date!”
Lu Wan immediately became happy.
Looking at her cheering appearance, Yang Fan felt even more puzzled in his heart.
“What on earth is going on here?”
“Could it be... Wan’er really has two faces?”
Soon, the two arrived at the commercial area of The Frontline.
However, when Yang Fan truly saw the commercial street here, his expression instantly became somewhat strange.
The so-called commercial street of The Frontline was completely different from what he had imagined.
There were indeed various shops here, and they did indeed sell clothing.
But these clothes were not ordinary clothing in the usual sense.
They were all crafted using special Materials.
Some came from the Mechanical Route divine kingdoms, manufactured using nanoscale defense Materials, capable of automatic repair and even resisting attacks from gods.
Some came from the Cultivation Route divine kingdoms, carved with a large number of defense Formations, making them Magical Artifacts in their own right.
To call them clothes, they were actually more like close-fitting defensive equipment.
The price of a single ordinary piece of clothing reached tens of millions of Faith Points.
Some of the Advanced goods among them were worth several Divinity Points.

chapters.title: Chapter 381: Lu Family Estate
paragraphs: Lu Wan didn’t mind at all.
Anything she touched, she bought directly.
Even if some clothes did not look very good in her opinion, she would directly store them in her Divine Kingdom.
Those demigod shopping assistants were all smiling from ear to ear.
After all, big clients like Lu Wan were very rare throughout The Frontline.
Every item they sold was of extremely high value.
Usually, very few people would buy things so unhesitatingly.
“This one is not bad.”
“This one is also okay.”
“And this one.”
Lu Wan shopped all the way, her smile growing wider.
She even occasionally pulled Yang Fan along to ask for his opinion.
On the surface, Yang Fan maintained a smile, but inwardly he was gradually becoming numb.
His body had long reached the divine level, and strolling the streets for a day would not make him feel tired.
But mental fatigue... was completely another matter.
“Why on earth do women like shopping so much?”
Yang Fan felt somewhat helpless.
In his view, staying at home and lying down was clearly much more comfortable.
Although he was also very bored, wasn’t lying down and doing nothing wonderful?
In the end, Yang Fan did not return to the villa prepared for him by the Gu Family.
Instead, he was dragged directly to the Lu Family’s villa by Lu Wan.
“The styles of things here in The Frontline are still too few.”
Looking at the clothes she had just bought, Lu Wan felt some regret.
“Husband, take a look at how this one is?”
As she spoke, she picked up a piece of clothing and gestured with it in front of Yang Fan.
Then she smiled and went to change into another set.
Looking at Lu Wan before him, who was completely different from usual, Yang Fan was momentarily dazed.
This woman... where was there even a shred of a career woman’s appearance?
The next second, Yang Fan’s figure flashed, and he directly arrived beside Lu Wan, gently holding her in his arms.
Inside the room, the atmosphere gradually grew tender.
For the next period of time, Yang Fan simply stayed directly at Lu Wan’s place.
And after this period of getting along, he finally confirmed one thing.
Lu Wan indeed had two faces.
On usual days, as long as it involved company matters, Lu Wan would instantly become the Incarnation of that resolute and swift direct daughter of the Lu Family.
Yang Fan could often hear her handling work through Feixun.
“Who approved this proposal?”
“Why continue investing in this kind of low-yield project?”
“Commercial expansion does not rely on blindly piling up Resources!”
“Re-plan, and give me a new proposal within three days!”
Lu Wan on the phone had an incomparably strong tone.
All kinds of professional terms rolled off her tongue easily, and sometimes when she reached an emotional point, she would directly scold the person in charge on the other end to a pulp.
At that moment, she was completely a female CEO controlling a large consortium.
But the magical thing was that every time she hung up the communication, as long as she turned her head to look at Yang Fan, she would instantly transform into another person.
“Husband, did you think I was too fierce just now?”
“Did I speak too harshly?”
“What do you want to eat tonight?”
That gentle little woman appearance was completely like a different person from just now.
This feeling of freely switching states right in front of him made Yang Fan only able to sigh: “It feels fucking amazing!”
Evening.
Wearing loose pajamas, Yang Fan sat comfortably on an antique armchair.
Beside him, five smart robots were respectively responsible for massaging his shoulders, arms, legs, and head.
Various precision instruments constantly adjusted their strength, plunging Yang Fan’s entire being into a state of ultimate relaxation.
“This is what you call life!”
Yang Fan couldn’t help sighing.
“As expected of the Lu Family, the wealthiest among the Five Great Families.”
“This living standard is simply too corrupt.”
Looking at the scenery outside the window, a trace of a smile appeared at the corners of his mouth.
“Tonight...”
“Should I have Wan’er hold a Feixun meeting while simultaneously...”
Thinking of certain scenes, a trace of a wicked smile couldn’t help but emerge at the corner of Yang Fan’s mouth.
Ever since he was reminded by Yang Da back then, Yang Fan had actually changed quite a bit.
When he first entered Primordial Academy, he had also seriously Cultivated, studied hard, hoping to improve himself.
After all, back then he had no background and no Resources.
He could only rely on himself to climb up bit by bit.
But now... he only just discovered.
His past self perhaps hadn’t changed; he just hadn’t seen truly top-tier life.
As a direct descendant of the Lu Family, the living experience Lu Wan brought completely exceeded his imagination.
The food eaten every day consisted of specially allocated special-supply Resources by the Lu Family’s transport team from various living planets.
There were Spirit Fruit capable of nourishing Mental Energy, special ingredients capable of strengthening the Physical Body, and even some rare delicacies specially developed for gods.
In terms of entertainment, it was even completely different.
In the Virtual World, there were immersive starry sky theaters built by top companies.
There were true experiences capable of simulating ancient civilization ruin explorations.
There were even competitive entertainment projects specially designed for gods.
Ordinary gods simply could not enjoy this kind of treatment.
Consequently... Yang Fan felt that he was starting to degenerate again.
“Female beauty ruins me!”
He couldn’t help sighing, but soon, he found an excuse for himself again.
“Forget it, let’s enjoy it for a period of time first.”
“I’ll work hard later.”
“After all, without resting well, where would the energy to study come from?”
“If you don’t eat your fill, how can you lose weight?”
Yang Fan earnestly nodded.
Perfect!
This reason was extremely reasonable.
Just as Yang Fan was thinking about how to further enhance his relationship with Lu Wan tonight.
The room door was suddenly pushed open.
Lu Wan walked in.
“Husband.”
A gentle smile was on her face.
“My mother wants to see you.”
“In the Virtual World.”
Hearing these words, Yang Fan’s originally lazy state instantly disappeared, and his entire body sat up straight directly.
“Wan’er, it is my problem.”
“We have been married for so long, but I still haven’t formally met your Family.”
“This is indeed somewhat impolite.”
“Do I need to prepare anything?”
Yang Fan asked seriously.
After all, Lu Wan’s identity was different; she was a direct descendant of the Lu Corporation.
Now that he was meeting his mother-in-law for the first time, naturally he couldn’t be as casual as meeting ordinary elders.
Lu Wan shook her head and said with a smile:
“Just like cousin Gu Le, my mother only had me after being over a hundred thousand years old, so she doted on me very much since I was little.”
“Husband doesn’t need to be nervous, no need to specially prepare anything.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan slightly frowned instead.
“Meeting the mother-in-law for the first time, I certainly can’t go over empty-handed.”
“It’s too rushed, too late to prepare, but I do have some local specialties in my Divine Kingdom that can be used as a greeting gift.”
Lu Wan chuckled lightly, “Husband, no need to be too precious, my mother lacks nothing.”
“Understood.”
Yang Fan nodded and didn’t say anything more.
Subsequently, the two of them put on their virtual helmets simultaneously.
Looking at the coordinates sent by Lu Wan, Yang Fan lightly clicked to confirm.
The next moment.
His consciousness was slightly dazed.
When he regained clarity once more, the scene before his eyes had completely changed.
“This is the Lu Family Estate?”
Looking at everything before him, a trace of surprise flashed through Yang Fan’s eyes.

sentences.text: Lu Wan didn’t mind at all.
Anything she touched, she bought directly.
Even if some clothes did not look very good in her opinion, she would directly store them in her Divine Kingdom.
Those demigod shopping assistants were all smiling from ear to ear.
After all, big clients like Lu Wan were very rare throughout The Frontline.
Every item they sold was of extremely high value.
Usually, very few people would buy things so unhesitatingly.
“This one is not bad.”
“This one is also okay.”
“And this one.”
Lu Wan shopped all the way, her smile growing wider.
She even occasionally pulled Yang Fan along to ask for his opinion.
On the surface, Yang Fan maintained a smile, but inwardly he was gradually becoming numb.
His body had long reached the divine level, and strolling the streets for a day would not make him feel tired.
But mental fatigue... was completely another matter.
“Why on earth do women like shopping so much?”
Yang Fan felt somewhat helpless.
In his view, staying at home and lying down was clearly much more comfortable.
Although he was also very bored, wasn’t lying down and doing nothing wonderful?
In the end, Yang Fan did not return to the villa prepared for him by the Gu Family.
Instead, he was dragged directly to the Lu Family’s villa by Lu Wan.
“The styles of things here in The Frontline are still too few.”
Looking at the clothes she had just bought, Lu Wan felt some regret.
“Husband, take a look at how this one is?”
As she spoke, she picked up a piece of clothing and gestured with it in front of Yang Fan.
Then she smiled and went to change into another set.
Looking at Lu Wan before him, who was completely different from usual, Yang Fan was momentarily dazed.
This woman... where was there even a shred of a career woman’s appearance?
The next second, Yang Fan’s figure flashed, and he directly arrived beside Lu Wan, gently holding her in his arms.
Inside the room, the atmosphere gradually grew tender.
For the next period of time, Yang Fan simply stayed directly at Lu Wan’s place.
And after this period of getting along, he finally confirmed one thing.
Lu Wan indeed had two faces.
On usual days, as long as it involved company matters, Lu Wan would instantly become the Incarnation of that resolute and swift direct daughter of the Lu Family.
Yang Fan could often hear her handling work through Feixun.
“Who approved this proposal?”
“Why continue investing in this kind of low-yield project?”
“Commercial expansion does not rely on blindly piling up Resources!”
“Re-plan, and give me a new proposal within three days!”
Lu Wan on the phone had an incomparably strong tone.
All kinds of professional terms rolled off her tongue easily, and sometimes when she reached an emotional point, she would directly scold the person in charge on the other end to a pulp.
At that moment, she was completely a female CEO controlling a large consortium.
But the magical thing was that every time she hung up the communication, as long as she turned her head to look at Yang Fan, she would instantly transform into another person.
“Husband, did you think I was too fierce just now?”
“Did I speak too harshly?”
“What do you want to eat tonight?”
That gentle little woman appearance was completely like a different person from just now.
This feeling of freely switching states right in front of him made Yang Fan only able to sigh: “It feels fucking amazing!”
Evening.
Wearing loose pajamas, Yang Fan sat comfortably on an antique armchair.
Beside him, five smart robots were respectively responsible for massaging his shoulders, arms, legs, and head.
Various precision instruments constantly adjusted their strength, plunging Yang Fan’s entire being into a state of ultimate relaxation.
“This is what you call life!”
Yang Fan couldn’t help sighing.
“As expected of the Lu Family, the wealthiest among the Five Great Families.”
“This living standard is simply too corrupt.”
Looking at the scenery outside the window, a trace of a smile appeared at the corners of his mouth.
“Tonight...”
“Should I have Wan’er hold a Feixun meeting while simultaneously...”
Thinking of certain scenes, a trace of a wicked smile couldn’t help but emerge at the corner of Yang Fan’s mouth.
Ever since he was reminded by Yang Da back then, Yang Fan had actually changed quite a bit.
When he first entered Primordial Academy, he had also seriously Cultivated, studied hard, hoping to improve himself.
After all, back then he had no background and no Resources.
He could only rely on himself to climb up bit by bit.
But now... he only just discovered.
His past self perhaps hadn’t changed; he just hadn’t seen truly top-tier life.
As a direct descendant of the Lu Family, the living experience Lu Wan brought completely exceeded his imagination.
The food eaten every day consisted of specially allocated special-supply Resources by the Lu Family’s transport team from various living planets.
There were Spirit Fruit capable of nourishing Mental Energy, special ingredients capable of strengthening the Physical Body, and even some rare delicacies specially developed for gods.
In terms of entertainment, it was even completely different.
In the Virtual World, there were immersive starry sky theaters built by top companies.
There were true experiences capable of simulating ancient civilization ruin explorations.
There were even competitive entertainment projects specially designed for gods.
Ordinary gods simply could not enjoy this kind of treatment.
Consequently...
Yang Fan felt that he was starting to degenerate again.
“Female beauty ruins me!”
He couldn’t help sighing, but soon, he found an excuse for himself again.
“Forget it, let’s enjoy it for a period of time first.”
“I’ll work hard later.”
“After all, without resting well, where would the energy to study come from?”
“If you don’t eat your fill, how can you lose weight?”
Yang Fan earnestly nodded.
Perfect!
This reason was extremely reasonable.
Just as Yang Fan was thinking about how to further enhance his relationship with Lu Wan tonight.
The room door was suddenly pushed open.
Lu Wan walked in.
“Husband.”
A gentle smile was on her face.
“My mother wants to see you.”
“In the Virtual World.”
Hearing these words, Yang Fan’s originally lazy state instantly disappeared, and his entire body sat up straight directly.
“Wan’er, it is my problem.”
“We have been married for so long, but I still haven’t formally met your Family.”
“This is indeed somewhat impolite.”
“Do I need to prepare anything?”
Yang Fan asked seriously.
After all, Lu Wan’s identity was different; she was a direct descendant of the Lu Corporation.
Now that he was meeting his mother-in-law for the first time, naturally he couldn’t be as casual as meeting ordinary elders.
Lu Wan shook her head and said with a smile:
“Just like cousin Gu Le, my mother only had me after being over a hundred thousand years old, so she doted on me very much since I was little.”
“Husband doesn’t need to be nervous, no need to specially prepare anything.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan slightly frowned instead.
“Meeting the mother-in-law for the first time, I certainly can’t go over empty-handed.”
“It’s too rushed, too late to prepare, but I do have some local specialties in my Divine Kingdom that can be used as a greeting gift.”
Lu Wan chuckled lightly, “Husband, no need to be too precious, my mother lacks nothing.”
“Understood.”
Yang Fan nodded and didn’t say anything more.
Subsequently, the two of them put on their virtual helmets simultaneously.
Looking at the coordinates sent by Lu Wan, Yang Fan lightly clicked to confirm.
The next moment.
His consciousness was slightly dazed.
When he regained clarity once more, the scene before his eyes had completely changed.
“This is the Lu Family Estate?”
Looking at everything before him, a trace of surprise flashed through Yang Fan’s eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 382: Lu Yanran
paragraphs: Unlike the classical solemnity of the Gu Family...
As one of the Five Great Families, the Lu Family showcased another kind of extreme.
Technology! The future!
A cold yet brilliant aura of technological civilization virtually filled the entire space.
Where Yang Fan stood at this moment was a massive sky island floating in the starry sky.
Looking out, countless massive metal city clusters floated above the sea of clouds.
Skyscrapers towering tens of thousands of meters high pierced into the clouds, their outer walls crafted from an unknown alloy with complex data streams constantly flowing across their surfaces.
Countless intelligent aircraft shuttled between the cities, while a vast number of intelligent robots worked in perfect order.

Some were responsible for maintaining the urban environment, some managed commercial areas, and there were also some Advanced Intelligent Life forms, looking almost identical to Immortal Masters, who were handling various affairs.
Even some of the buildings themselves were autonomously maintained and repaired by intelligent machinery.
The entire sky island was like a super metropolis that truly belonged to a future era.
There were no noisy human voices, no chaotic disorder—everything was precise to the extreme.
Yang Fan swept his Mental Energy across the area, unable to help but feel deeply impressed.
“As expected of the Lu Family...”
Just then, Lu Wan’s figure suddenly appeared beside Yang Fan.
She naturally took Yang Fan’s hand and said with a smile:
“Husband, this is my mother’s private island in the Real World.”
“Aside from intelligent robots, no other carbon-based life forms live here.”
“Come with me.”
With that, Lu Wan led Yang Fan toward the center of the sky island.
Soon, the two arrived in front of a massive villa.
The villa was not as luxurious as traditional buildings; instead, it was full of technological aesthetic appeal, as if the entire structure merged seamlessly with its surroundings.
Lu Wan pushed open the front door, where a large number of intelligent robots were also at work inside.
In the center of the courtyard, a woman sat quietly.
At his first glance of her, Yang Fan was slightly stunned.
She was an extremely young-looking woman.
She wore a simple gown that nonetheless failed to conceal her nobility, with her pitch-black long hair draped casually behind her.
Her facial features were exquisite to the extreme, and there was an indescribable indifference and elegance between her brows.
Though she was merely sitting there quietly, she seemed to merge as one with heaven and earth.
That aura of hers even made people subconsciously shrink from looking directly at her.
This person was none other than Lu Wan’s mother—Lu Yanran.
Lu Yanran immediately cast her gaze upon Yang Fan.
The next moment.
Boom!
Yang Fan only felt an incredibly terrifying pressure instantly descend into the depths of his consciousness.
Even though they were only in the Virtual World at this moment, his mind felt as if it were being crushed by an invisible divine mountain.
Even his Divine Kingdom faintly experienced a sense of stagnation.
Yang Fan’s expression changed slightly, and his brows furrowed deeply.
But just a moment later, that terrifying pressure vanished without a trace, as if it had never existed.
“Not bad.” Lu Yanran nodded with satisfaction.
Yang Fan let out a soft breath.
In that instant just now, he had understood.
This mother-in-law of his was absolutely a High-Order God of terrifying strength.
She was not even weaker than an existence like Gu Xuanting.
“Greetings, Mother-in-law.” Yang Fan bowed respectfully.
After reaching the Realm of gods, one’s appearance could no longer be used to judge their true age.
Although Lu Yanran was Lu Wan’s mother, she looked barely older than Lu Wan.
If one didn’t know their relationship, anyone would probably think they looked more like sisters.
“Sit down.”
Lu Yanran said indifferently.
She then glanced at Lu Wan, a meaningful smile appearing at the corner of her mouth.
“If I hadn’t brought it up myself, Wan’er would probably have been reluctant to bring you to see me.”
Hearing this, Lu Wan suddenly felt a bit embarrassed.
“Mom, we’ve only been together for a short while.”
“I prepared some gifts that you like, which is why I finally dared to bring my husband over.”
Lu Yanran rolled her eyes at her.
“I think you’ve just been having too much fun.”
“You used to take the initiative to contact me every week. How is it that now you have a husband, you’ve forgotten your mother?”
Hearing this, a trace of embarrassment appeared on Lu Wan’s face.
“That’s not true...”
Lu Yanran did not continue teasing her and instead held out her right hand.
“Where is the gift?”
“In the past, you never came to the Virtual World empty-handed.”
Lu Wan cleared her throat slightly, then took out a card and handed it over.
“Mom, these are clothes I carefully selected from the commercial street on The Frontline.”
“The brands and styles you usually like are too fixed. Why not try these new ones?”
“I think they suit you very well.”
Lu Yanran took the card and cast a brief glance, her expression instantly becoming peculiar.
“For me?”
“And... isn’t this size a bit off?”
The corner of Lu Yanran’s mouth twitched slightly.
Seeing this, Yang Fan also released his Mental Energy to check the items inside the card.
The next second, his expression instantly became highly entertaining.
“Damn...”
“Wan’er, you really are ‘filial’.”
Yang Fan was speechless in his heart.
How was this ‘carefully selected’?
These were clearly the few ‘ugliest’ styles that Yang Fan had picked out at home according to his own taste after Lu Wan dragged him shopping yesterday.
She didn’t want to wear them herself.
And now... she was giving them to her mother?
For a moment, Yang Fan didn’t even know what to say.
After all, the clothes sold on The Frontline’s commercial street were called clothes, but they were actually more like a type of special defensive equipment.
Although the quality was decent, judging by Lu Yanran’s attire, these things probably wouldn’t catch her eye at all.
Yang Fan even suspected...
...whether his wife was deliberately setting up her own mother.
Yang Fan cleared his throat and stepped forward.
“Mother-in-law, this is the gift that Wan’er and I actually prepared.”
With that, he handed over another card.
Lu Yanran took the card and merely glanced at it casually, but a flash of surprise crossed her eyes.
However, she didn’t say much and instead waved her hand gently.
“Alright, don’t just stand there.”
“Taste the new flavor of Immortal Brew I recently blended.”
As her voice fell,
an intelligent robot walked over slowly, carrying three incredibly exquisite luminous cups.
The liquid in the cups swirled, emitting a faint ripple of Spiritual Qi.
“Xiao Fan, I can call you that, right?”
Lu Yanran picked up her glass and asked softly.
“Of course.”
Yang Fan nodded hastily.
The person before him was no ordinary god.
She was highly likely an existence on the same level as Gu Xuanting.
Looking across the entire Human Federation, she was a major figure with immense authority.
Against a powerhouse of this caliber, even he had to maintain sufficient respect.
“Xiao Fan.”
Lu Yanran took a light sip of the Immortal Brew and then said slowly:
“My Lu Family controls over eighty percent of the commercial Resources in the entire Human Federation.”
“Although the Yang Corporation you founded has good development momentum now, its foundation is ultimately still too shallow.”
“I will arrange the connections, Resources, and channels you will need in the future.”
“You can also use my name when conducting affairs outside.”
