chapters.title: Chapter 383: It really was hard on him
paragraphs: Yang Fan’s gaze shifted slightly.
He naturally understood what those words represented.
With Lu Yanran, a core figure of the Lu Family, standing behind him, the future development speed of the Yang Corporation would likely rise to a new level.
But the next moment, Lu Yanran changed the subject.
“However, I have only one requirement for you.”
“Treat Wan’er well.”
She put down her wine glass and looked at Yang Fan earnestly.
“I don’t know what’s wrong with this girl; she was usually so arrogant, but after meeting you, she changed completely.”
“Now, she’s even so infatuated with you that she’s out of her mind.”
“However...”
Lu Yanran’s tone sank slightly.
“In matters of affection, no one can guarantee that it will never change.”
“If there truly comes a day in the future when problems arise between you two, I also hope you won’t hurt her too deeply.”
“Otherwise...”
Her gaze narrowed slightly.
“This old lady won’t let you off easily.”
Although her tone was calm,
the Aura released in that instant made Yang Fan clearly sense that this mother-in-law was not joking.
“I understand.”
Yang Fan’s expression was earnest.
“I truly love Wan’er, and I will never let her down.”
“People’s hearts change.”
Lu Yanran did not continue to push him, instead gently shaking her head.
“I believe that you are sincere toward Wan’er right now.”
“However, both of you are still young, and perhaps you haven’t even completely figured out the difference between liking and loving right now.”
“But matters of affection are ultimately your own choice.”
“As an elder, I won’t forcefully interfere.”
“As long as Wan’er is happy, that’s enough.”
“Life is long, but what one can truly grasp is only the present.”
Hearing this, Lu Wan at the side couldn’t help but pout.
“Mom, you need to learn to trust others.”
Looking at her daughter’s appearance, which clearly favored Yang Fan, Lu Yanran shook her head helplessly.
“Alright, alright.”
“Handle your own affairs between the two of you.”
Then she looked toward Yang Fan.
“Xiaofan, you should go back first.”
“Wan’er and I still have some things to talk about alone.”
“Yes.”
Yang Fan nodded, and then his consciousness withdrew from the Virtual World.
Virtual World.
Lu Family territory.
After Yang Fan left,
Lu Wan immediately couldn’t help speaking up.
“Mom!”
“I finally managed to find someone who truly loves me; can you please stop always looking at people through colored glasses?”
Lu Yanran picked up her wine glass, took a light sip, and then glanced at her daughter.
“Is this the reason you sent your mother a bunch of’street stall junk’?”
“Who told you to scare him the moment you met?”
Lu Wan directly retorted, her eyes filled with dissatisfaction toward her own mother.

“My husband is only in his early twenties, and you, an old lady who has lived for over one hundred thousand years, released your Aura to suppress him the very first time you met. Is that appropriate?”
Hearing her daughter’s words, the corners of Lu Yanran’s mouth twitched slightly.
Especially upon hearing that phrase “old lady who has lived for over one hundred thousand years,” her face darkened instantly.
“Stinky girl!”
“It’s only been a few days, and you’re already starting to lean toward outsiders?”
“What kind of soul-melting soup did this husband of yours feed you?”
Yet Lu Wan didn’t care at all.
She looked at her mother and directly made a face.
“Bleh, bleh, bleh!”
Looking at her daughter’s appearance, Lu Yanran let out a helpless sigh.
“Forget it.”
“You girl were spoiled rotten by me since childhood anyway.”
“However, don’t worry, this husband of yours is truly not simple.”
“He has already condensed a Nascent Soul within his body, and his Physical Body and Mental Energy are both not weaker than an ordinary Tier 3 God.”
“In the Virtual World, even if I released my Aura at full strength, it would be impossible to make him make a fool of himself.”
Hearing this, Lu Wan’s eyes widened slightly. “My husband is this amazing?”
Lu Yanran nodded.
“As far as I know, among the young Genius born in the Human Federation in the past century, his potential is enough to rank in the top five.”
“At least... when I was his age, I was far inferior to him.”
Speaking of this, a trace of satisfaction also flickered in Lu Yanran’s eyes.
Although she kept reprimanding Yang Fan verbally, in reality, the result of the probing just now had already made her highly approving.
Her own daughter truly had good judgment.
Although Lu Wan only had an S-rank Talent, placed across the entire Human Federation, she only belonged to the Prodigy tier.
But she was Lu Yanran’s daughter and a direct descendant of the Lu Family.
For Gods, talent was certainly important.
But what truly determined future height, besides talent, were Resources, background, and Opportunity.
Relying on the Lu Family’s foundation, Lu Wan’s future development was destined not to be weaker than those beings rated as Peerless Prodigy.
Therefore, her daughter naturally deserved the most outstanding young God in the Human Federation.
In Lu Yanran’s view,
someone who cherished Lu Wan and was wholeheartedly willing to accompany her was certainly rare.
But the matching of identity and value was even more important.
If not for personally probing him today and finding Lu Yanran deeply satisfied with Yang Fan, she might really have had to properly correct her daughter’s state of sudden infatuation.
Hearing her mother approve of Yang Fan, a trace of pride instantly appeared on Lu Wan’s face.
“Mother, your daughter’s judgment isn’t bad, right?”
“Although having to share my husband with Cousin Gu Le makes me somewhat unwilling,”
“but among the people I know, my husband truly is the most outstanding.”
“Not a single one of those so-called Peerless Prodigy can compare to him.”
Lu Yanran looked at her daughter’s confident appearance and couldn’t help smiling.
“Your judgment is indeed not bad.”
“And what you said about him truly loving you—I believe that a bit more now.”
Speaking of this, Lu Yanran’s gaze fell upon the card on the table.
Following her mother’s gaze, Lu Wan was also somewhat curious.
“Mom, what on earth did my husband give you?”
“You didn’t know?”
Lu Wan shook her head.
“You suddenly notified me that we were going to meet, so I didn’t have time to prepare at all.”
“My husband said this is a specialty from his Divine Kingdom.”
“Specialty?”
Hearing this, Lu Yanran couldn’t help letting out a chuckle.
“It seems this kid really does hold you in his heart.”
“Inside this are massive amounts of Earth Heart Milk and enlightenment tea leaves.”
“Calculated by market value, it is worth about one trillion Divinity Points.”
“One trillion Divinity Points...”
Lu Wan was also slightly stunned.
Although she came from the Lu Family and was long accustomed to wealth,
she also knew that this was not a small sum.
Lu Yanran gently swirled her wine glass.
“Although this child has immense potential, he is after all only in his early twenties.”
“From Awakening his Divine Kingdom until now, only four or five years have passed in the Real World.”
“Moreover, he has just achieved a breakthrough as a God, which is precisely the stage where his Divine Kingdom’s consumption of Resources is greatest.”
“Upon meeting me for the first time, he took out a gift worth one trillion Divinity Points.”
“It really was hard on him.”
She was clear in her heart that for a God of her level, one trillion Divinity Points was nothing much.
It might even just be the amount for a single business investment.
But the key was that Yang Fan was not an old-school God who had lived for hundreds of thousands of years.
He was merely a young man who had just risen to prominence.
Being able to pull out such a gift at this stage already represented a kind of attitude in itself.
Thinking back to what Lu Wan had told her earlier,
Yang Fan, when faced with a dowry of 100 trillion Divinity Points, actually chose to accept only 50 million military merits.
Combined with today’s welcoming gift,
the last trace of doubt in Lu Yanran’s heart gradually dissipated.
A gentleman is judged by his actions rather than his intentions.
A person’s inner thoughts might be hard to judge,
but his actions cannot deceive people.
Even direct descendants of the Five Great Families with heaven-reaching backgrounds might not be willing to pull out such Resources for a single meeting at Yang Fan’s age.

“However, I have only one requirement for you.”
“Treat Wan’er well.”
She put down her wine glass and looked at Yang Fan earnestly.
“I don’t know what’s wrong with this girl; she was usually so arrogant, but after meeting you, she changed completely.”
“Now, she’s even so infatuated with you that she’s out of her mind.”
“However...”
Lu Yanran’s tone sank slightly.
“In matters of affection, no one can guarantee that it will never change.”
“If there truly comes a day in the future when problems arise between you two, I also hope you won’t hurt her too deeply.”
“Otherwise...”
Her gaze narrowed slightly.
“This old lady won’t let you off easily.”
Although her tone was calm,
the Aura released in that instant made Yang Fan clearly sense that this mother-in-law was not joking.
“I understand.”
Yang Fan’s expression was earnest.
“I truly love Wan’er, and I will never let her down.”
“People’s hearts change.”
Lu Yanran did not continue to push him, instead gently shaking her head.
“I believe that you are sincere toward Wan’er right now.”
“However, both of you are still young, and perhaps you haven’t even completely figured out the difference between liking and loving right now.”
“But matters of affection are ultimately your own choice.”
“As an elder, I won’t forcefully interfere.”
“As long as Wan’er is happy, that’s enough.”
“Life is long, but what one can truly grasp is only the present.”
Hearing this, Lu Wan at the side couldn’t help but pout.
“Mom, you need to learn to trust others.”
Looking at her daughter’s appearance, which clearly favored Yang Fan, Lu Yanran shook her head helplessly.
“Alright, alright.”
“Handle your own affairs between the two of you.”
Then she looked toward Yang Fan.
“Xiaofan, you should go back first.”
“Wan’er and I still have some things to talk about alone.”
“Yes.”
Yang Fan nodded, and then his consciousness withdrew from the Virtual World.
Virtual World.
Lu Family territory.
After Yang Fan left,
Lu Wan immediately couldn’t help speaking up.
“Mom!”
“I finally managed to find someone who truly loves me; can you please stop always looking at people through colored glasses?”
Lu Yanran picked up her wine glass, took a light sip, and then glanced at her daughter.
“Is this the reason you sent your mother a bunch of’street stall junk’?”
“Who told you to scare him the moment you met?”
Lu Wan directly retorted, her eyes filled with dissatisfaction toward her own mother.
“My husband is only in his early twenties, and you, an old lady who has lived for over one hundred thousand years, released your Aura to suppress him the very first time you met.
Is that appropriate?”
Hearing her daughter’s words, the corners of Lu Yanran’s mouth twitched slightly.
Especially upon hearing that phrase “old lady who has lived for over one hundred thousand years,” her face darkened instantly.
“Stinky girl!”
“It’s only been a few days, and you’re already starting to lean toward outsiders?”
“What kind of soul-melting soup did this husband of yours feed you?”
Yet Lu Wan didn’t care at all.
She looked at her mother and directly made a face.
“Bleh, bleh, bleh!”
Looking at her daughter’s appearance, Lu Yanran let out a helpless sigh.
“Forget it.”
“You girl were spoiled rotten by me since childhood anyway.”
“However, don’t worry, this husband of yours is truly not simple.”
“He has already condensed a Nascent Soul within his body, and his Physical Body and Mental Energy are both not weaker than an ordinary Tier 3 God.”
“In the Virtual World, even if I released my Aura at full strength, it would be impossible to make him make a fool of himself.”
Hearing this, Lu Wan’s eyes widened slightly.
“My husband is this amazing?”
Lu Yanran nodded.
“As far as I know, among the young Genius born in the Human Federation in the past century, his potential is enough to rank in the top five.”
“At least... when I was his age, I was far inferior to him.”
Speaking of this, a trace of satisfaction also flickered in Lu Yanran’s eyes.
Although she kept reprimanding Yang Fan verbally, in reality, the result of the probing just now had already made her highly approving.
Her own daughter truly had good judgment.
Although Lu Wan only had an S-rank Talent, placed across the entire Human Federation, she only belonged to the Prodigy tier.
But she was Lu Yanran’s daughter and a direct descendant of the Lu Family.
For Gods, talent was certainly important.
But what truly determined future height, besides talent, were Resources, background, and Opportunity.
Relying on the Lu Family’s foundation, Lu Wan’s future development was destined not to be weaker than those beings rated as Peerless Prodigy.
Therefore, her daughter naturally deserved the most outstanding young God in the Human Federation.
In Lu Yanran’s view,
someone who cherished Lu Wan and was wholeheartedly willing to accompany her was certainly rare.
But the matching of identity and value was even more important.
If not for personally probing him today and finding Lu Yanran deeply satisfied with Yang Fan, she might really have had to properly correct her daughter’s state of sudden infatuation.
Hearing her mother approve of Yang Fan, a trace of pride instantly appeared on Lu Wan’s face.
“Mother, your daughter’s judgment isn’t bad, right?”
“Although having to share my husband with Cousin Gu Le makes me somewhat unwilling,”
“but among the people I know, my husband truly is the most outstanding.”
“Not a single one of those so-called Peerless Prodigy can compare to him.”
Lu Yanran looked at her daughter’s confident appearance and couldn’t help smiling.
“Your judgment is indeed not bad.”
“And what you said about him truly loving you—I believe that a bit more now.”
Speaking of this, Lu Yanran’s gaze fell upon the card on the table.
Following her mother’s gaze, Lu Wan was also somewhat curious.
“Mom, what on earth did my husband give you?”
“You didn’t know?”
Lu Wan shook her head.
“You suddenly notified me that we were going to meet, so I didn’t have time to prepare at all.”
“My husband said this is a specialty from his Divine Kingdom.”
“Specialty?”
Hearing this, Lu Yanran couldn’t help letting out a chuckle.
“It seems this kid really does hold you in his heart.”
“Inside this are massive amounts of Earth Heart Milk and enlightenment tea leaves.”
“Calculated by market value, it is worth about one trillion Divinity Points.”
“One trillion Divinity Points...”
Lu Wan was also slightly stunned.
Although she came from the Lu Family and was long accustomed to wealth,
she also knew that this was not a small sum.
Lu Yanran gently swirled her wine glass.
“Although this child has immense potential, he is after all only in his early twenties.”
“From Awakening his Divine Kingdom until now, only four or five years have passed in the Real World.”
“Moreover, he has just achieved a breakthrough as a God, which is precisely the stage where his Divine Kingdom’s consumption of Resources is greatest.”
“Upon meeting me for the first time, he took out a gift worth one trillion Divinity Points.”
“It really was hard on him.”
She was clear in her heart that for a God of her level, one trillion Divinity Points was nothing much.
It might even just be the amount for a single business investment.
But the key was that Yang Fan was not an old-school God who had lived for hundreds of thousands of years.
He was merely a young man who had just risen to prominence.
Being able to pull out such a gift at this stage already represented a kind of attitude in itself.
Thinking back to what Lu Wan had told her earlier,
Yang Fan, when faced with a dowry of 100 trillion Divinity Points, actually chose to accept only 50 million military merits.
Combined with today’s welcoming gift,
the last trace of doubt in Lu Yanran’s heart gradually dissipated.
A gentleman is judged by his actions rather than his intentions.
A person’s inner thoughts might be hard to judge,
but his actions cannot deceive people.
Even direct descendants of the Five Great Families with heaven-reaching backgrounds might not be willing to pull out such Resources for a single meeting at Yang Fan’s age.

chapters.title: Chapter 384: What Can I Do? I Love You So Much
paragraphs: “It seems...”
“he truly has some sincerity toward Wan’er.”
Lu Yanran’s eyes flickered slightly.
“In the future, I can help him out a bit more.”
Hearing that Yang Fan had actually given away Resources worth one trillion Divinity Points, Lu Wan immediately grew anxious.
“Mother, you don’t lack these things anyway. Why don’t we return them?”
Saying this, Lu Wan directly reached out, wanting to take back the card.
However, in the next second, Lu Yanran merely snapped her fingers softly, and the card vanished instantly.
“Take your paws off.”
Lu Yanran glanced at her calmly, a slight smile appearing at the corners of her lips.
“This Earth Heart Milk actually tastes pretty good when used to make tea.”
Lu Wan’s eyes widened in anxiety.
These were Resources worth one trillion Divinity Points!
“Alright, alright.”
Lu Yanran shook her head helplessly.
“Returning the gift now would only make people overthink.”
“Since you are already legally husband and wife, I naturally won’t let him suffer a loss.”
At this point, Lu Yanran’s expression turned a bit more serious.
“Take these hundred thousand Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests and give them to him.”
“His Divine Kingdom Talent is Hundredfold Chronology, which requires consuming a massive amount of Spiritual Qi to sustain the rapid growth of his believers.”
“With these buildings, the pressure on his Divine Kingdom will be lightened considerably.”
“In addition, give him this Heavenly Pool as well.”
“Having just achieved a breakthrough to deityhood, yet able to give birth to believers in the Nascent Soul Realm in such a short time, he must have used some special method to accelerate growth.”
“Although this method can quickly raise strength, it will inevitably lead to an unstable Foundation.”
“This Heavenly Pool happens to be able to make up for that.”
Lu Yanran said slowly.
Hearing the return gift her mother had prepared, Lu Wan’s eyes instantly lit up.
“Thank you, Mom!”
Seeing her daughter’s overjoyed expression, Lu Yanran couldn’t help but roll her eyes.
“Although Xiao Fan might really love you right now, human hearts can never withstand testing.”
“I’m not trying to tear you apart, nor am I disapproving of him.”
“It’s just that as your mother, there are certain things I must tell you in advance.”
Lu Wan’s expression turned serious as well. “Please speak, Mother.”
Lu Yanran raised one finger.
“First, that SS-Rank Building I gave you when you achieved a breakthrough to deityhood must not be known to Xiao Fan.”
“Not because I don’t trust him, but because you shouldn’t actively test human nature.”
“Husband and wife can support each other, but they must also maintain a certain distance.”
“Deities have long lifespans; everyone should have their own secrets.”
“Second, you must never reveal the coordinates of your Divine Kingdom.”
Speaking up to here, Lu Yanran’s tone turned extremely solemn.
“This is the bottom line for all deities.”
“In the Real World, you can help each other and grow together.”
“But never touch upon the taboos between deities.”
“No matter how much you trust someone, you can never place your life and death completely in another’s hands.”
As her words fell, the atmosphere in the entire room turned heavy.
Lu Wan nodded solemnly.
She understood that her mother was saying this not out of distrust for Yang Fan.
Rather, as a High-Order God who had lived for over a hundred thousand years, this was her greatest protection for her.
Seeing her daughter’s serious expression, Lu Yanran nodded in satisfaction.
Then, she raised a third finger.
“As for the third point...”
“Within a thousand years, you and Yang Fan must have a child.”
“Ah?”
Lu Wan was instantly stunned.
Lu Yanran, however, remained calm.
“The conception rate for deities is extremely low, but as you are currently only Low-tier Gods, with the help of certain special medicines, the probability isn’t particularly low.”
“Without the Lu Family’s Bloodline as a bond, it wouldn’t be convenient for me to directly mobilize the Lu Family’s power to help the Yang Corporation develop.”
Lu Wan was silent for a moment before nodding seriously. “I understand.”
This was the tacit rule among prominent Families.
Large Families could intermarry with Geniuses from outside clans to absorb outstanding talent, but they had to leave behind a true bond.
Emotion was far too fleeting; for a Family with a Legacy spanning tens of thousands of years, a more stable connection of interests was required.
Back then, Yang Fan was able to receive further investment from the Gu Family precisely because he had Gu Chengye as a bond.
According to the laws of the Human Federation, children naturally enjoyed partial inheritance rights.
Once Lu Wan and Yang Fan had a child, the Yang Corporation would truly establish a connection with the Lu Family.
Only then would the Lu Family supporting the Yang Corporation be truly justified and proper.
In the Real World, Lu Wan’s consciousness returned.
Almost as soon as she opened her eyes, she threw herself into Yang Fan’s arms, holding him tightly.
“Husband, you’re so foolish!”
“How could you give away Resources worth one trillion Divinity Points?”
“Are you crazy?”
“How are we going to live our lives in the future?”
Lu Wan pouted, looking angry.
But in reality, her eyes were filled with sweetness.
She naturally knew why Yang Fan had given such a precious gift.
Meeting his mother-in-law for the first time, he simply didn’t want her to lose Face.
Thinking of this, Lu Wan felt an even greater warmth in her heart.
Yang Fan looked at the beauty in his arms and couldn’t help but chuckle.
“Silly girl, isn’t this the first time meeting your mother?”
“I couldn’t exactly go empty-handed.”
“Besides...”
Yang Fan looked down at her.
“What can I do? I love you so much.”
Hearing these words, Lu Wan only felt her heart fluttering like butterflies.
Even though she was already a deity who managed numerous companies, at this moment she was still like an ordinary young girl, her cheeks blushing slightly.
She lowered her head and muttered in a low voice.
Then suddenly remembering something, she hastily manifested a card.
“Oh right! Luckily my mom is the God of Wealth.”
“She asked me to pass this to you. It should be of great help to your Divine Kingdom.”
Lu Wan handed the card into Yang Fan’s hand.
Sweeping his Mental Energy over it, Yang Fan instantly saw the buildings inside.
A large quantity of Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests, as well as a special S-Rank Building.
Seeing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help but sigh in admiration.
Worthy of a big shot, she truly wouldn’t take advantage of him at all.
He had sent over Resources worth one trillion Divinity Points, and the buildings she returned, though not ridiculously exaggerated, were definitely worth more than the Resources he had given.
“So much?” Yang Fan feigned a hint of hesitation.
Seeing this, Lu Wan hastily said:
“Husband, just accept it.”
“These things are nothing to my mother.”
“Besides, she genuinely hopes you can grow and develop.”
Seeing Lu Wan’s earnest expression, Yang Fan ultimately didn’t refuse further. “Alright.”
In the next moment, he deposited all these items into his Divine Kingdom.
And right at that moment, Lu Wan suddenly drew close and whispered softly into Yang Fan’s ear:
“Husband...”
“I want it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 385: Military Parade
paragraphs: That night.
Yang Fan was resting in bed when suddenly, a voice rang out in his mind.
“Master.”
Hearing Yang Da’s voice, Yang Fan instantly opened his eyes.
With a thought, his consciousness descended directly into the divine kingdom.
The next second, the scene before him changed rapidly.
“Master, the army on The Frontline has now advanced to the core area of the Angel Race divine kingdom.”
“According to reconnaissance, the opponent’s final defense line is about to unfold, and the final decisive battle will soon erupt between both sides.”
Yang Da reported respectfully.
Hearing this, Yang Fan nodded slightly.
Afterwards, he raised his head to look at the real-time battlefield image transmitted from ahead.
In the boundless sky, two armies were already facing each other from afar.
On the Angel Race side,
countless angels waved their pitch-black wings, holding holy spears, neatly arranged in the Void Realm.
Looking out, it was dense and endless.
These angels emitted a rich radiance, except that within that pure white light now, madness and murderous intent were mixed in.
They had been driven to a desperate situation.
In the center of the endless angel army, a huge divine seat hovered in the Void Realm.
Lufa, the deity of the Angel Race, sat upright upon it.
At this moment, he had long lost his past majesty.
His eyes were bloodshot, filled with rage as he stared fixedly at the enemy ahead.
Over the years, he had watched helplessly as his divine kingdom was nibbled away bit by bit.
Watching countless believers die.
Watching his Foundation continuously destroyed.
Now, only one thought remained in his heart — Kill!
Even if it cost everything, he would make the enemy pay a heavy price for this.
On the other side, Yang Fan’s army still maintained its initial formation.
At the very front were massive numbers of Intelligent Mecha.
One huge Mechanical body after another stood tall in the Void Realm, their cold metal armor reflecting a chilly light, resembling an uncrossable Great Wall of Steel.
Behind the Intelligent Mecha was a massive legion composed of Cultivation system believers, Martial Arts believers, Intelligent Life, and Elven Warriors.
Compared to the nearly frantic state of the Angel Race, the army under Yang Fan’s command appeared incomparably calm.
Over the years, attacks that could truly break through the Intelligent Mecha defense line and threaten them were few and far between.
Most of the time, they didn’t even truly participate in battle.
Therefore, fighting until now, these believers suffered almost no damage aside from slight dirt on the corners of their clothes.
The two armies formed an extremely stark contrast.
One side had already fallen into madness.
While the other side still maintained an absolute advantage.
In another direction, the zombie army led by Yang Eleven was engaged in a frenzied slaughter with the Angel Race.
Even though Yang Eleven had set up the Zombie Tide Dance Formation in advance, facing these Angel Race warriors whose eyes were red from killing, it was still difficult to gain an advantage.
A large number of Zombie Generals rushed onto the battlefield.
But the next moment,
brilliant beams of Holy Light flashed past.
The heads of countless Zombie Generals were directly lopped off.
These Angel Races seemed to have completely lost their sanity.
They didn’t even place their main attention on Yang Fan’s main legion.
Instead, they seemed to have locked onto the zombie army, acting with a stance of vowing not to stop until every single Corpse Cultivator system believer was completely annihilated.
Inside the flesh disaster hive, Yang Eleven’s expression was ugly to the extreme.
In the current Zombie Kingdom, the least lacking thing was the number of soldiers.
Even if a large number of Zombie Generals died, for Yang Eleven who possessed a massive divine kingdom Foundation, it didn’t amount to much at all.
But the problem was... these Angel Races possessed an extremely strong restraint capability against the Corpse Cultivation System.
Their Holy Light power had a natural suppression against undead and Corpse Cultivator type life forms.
Causing the army under Yang Eleven’s command to be completely unable to unleash their full strength.
To reduce losses, Yang Eleven even directly withdrew a large number of White Zombie-level believers into the flesh disaster hive.
Relying on the defensive capabilities of the s-class war structures, he continuously maneuvered against the Angel Race.
Even under his request, another twenty flesh disaster hives were mobilized from the Eternal Corpse Mine, continuously transporting troops to The Frontline.
Yet even so, fighting this battle up to now,
believers at the Zombie General level had already suffered over twenty billion deaths!
Looking at the losses on the battlefield, Yang Eleven’s expression was incomparably gloomy.
“Is there something wrong with this Angel Race deity’s brain?”
“Ignoring the biggest threat, why are they staring dead at me and refusing to let go?”
“Can’t they tell who the real enemy is?”
Yang Eleven mentally complained frantically.
Now that he governed the entire Zombie Kingdom, his perspective naturally dictated his thoughts.
Standing from the perspective of the Corpse Cultivation System, no matter how he looked at it, he felt he was the most wronged one.
Clearly his threat was the lowest, yet over these past dozen years, he had endured the greatest fury of the Angel Race.
At this moment, Yang Eleven even somewhat missed the time when he was originally Yang San.
At that time, he was responsible for leading the entire divine kingdom army, able to mobilize the power of all systems for battle.
Unlike now, where he could only control believers of the Corpse Cultivator path.
Facing a natural nemesis like the Angel Race, his combat capability dropped by a huge margin directly.
Watching the believers under his command continuously die, Yang Eleven’s teeth itched with hatred.
In the end, he couldn’t help but send a message to Yang Four.
“Yang Four, quickly dispatch troops to invade.”
“My losses on this side are too heavy.”
After the message was sent out, a reply came back very quickly.
“Lord has an order.”
“Presently, Master is watching the battle in the divine kingdom.”
“Mere Angel Race deities are completely nothing to worry about.”
“Lord’s meaning is to treat this battle as a military parade.”
“Allowing Master to more clearly see the current comprehensive combat strength of the divine kingdom.”
“Convenient for making more accurate judgments when conducting Divine Kingdom Wars in the future.”
Hearing this, Yang Eleven fell silent for a moment, then nodded slowly.
“Understood.”
The next moment,
Yang Eleven took a deep breath and looked towards the battlefield once more.
“All zombie armies, redeploy the formation!”
“Continue meeting the enemy!”
Yang Fan sat high upon the main seat of the divine kingdom, gazing calmly at the battlefield images transmitted from ahead.
“I have already witnessed firsthand the terrifying destructive power of war structures manufactured by Mechanical Civilization.”
“Since this Angel Race deity is now at the end of their tether...”
The corners of Yang Fan’s mouth curved up slightly.
“Then, let me see to what extent the believers’ own combat power has reached nowadays.”
“This subordinate understands.”
Yang Da bowed respectfully.
The next moment, with a thought, he transmitted Yang Fan’s order to The Frontline.
On the battlefield,
Yang Four, who was directing the army’s advance, instantly received the message.
“Master has an order to begin the second phase of operations.”
A flash of sharp light crossed Yang Four’s eyes.
“Execute!”
Following the issuance of the order,
the Intelligent Mecha and Mechanical War Puppets that were originally blocking the very front began to rapidly move to both sides.
The massive Mechanical bodies slowly parted, revealing the true main force hidden in the rear.
The next moment,
the boundless army of believers began to push forward.
Cultivation, Martial Arts, Intelligent Life, and Elven Warriors.
Believers of the four paths, under the leadership of Yang Five through Yang Ten, rapidly arranged themselves according to the formation of the Four Symbols Heaven Evolution Array.
In an instant, an Aura completely different from the Mechanical legion swept across the entire battlefield.
Seeing this scene,
a trace of hope suddenly flashed within the originally despairing eyes of Lufa, the deity of the Angel Race.
“What happened?”
“Could it be... the quantities of these Mechanical monsters in the opponent’s divine kingdom have already been completely exhausted?”

In the center of the endless angel army, a huge divine seat hovered in the Void Realm.
Lufa, the deity of the Angel Race, sat upright upon it.
At this moment, he had long lost his past majesty.
His eyes were bloodshot, filled with rage as he stared fixedly at the enemy ahead.
Over the years, he had watched helplessly as his divine kingdom was nibbled away bit by bit.
Watching countless believers die.
Watching his Foundation continuously destroyed.
Now, only one thought remained in his heart — Kill!
Even if it cost everything, he would make the enemy pay a heavy price for this.
On the other side, Yang Fan’s army still maintained its initial formation.
At the very front were massive numbers of Intelligent Mecha.
One huge Mechanical body after another stood tall in the Void Realm, their cold metal armor reflecting a chilly light, resembling an uncrossable Great Wall of Steel.
Behind the Intelligent Mecha was a massive legion composed of Cultivation system believers, Martial Arts believers, Intelligent Life, and Elven Warriors.
Compared to the nearly frantic state of the Angel Race, the army under Yang Fan’s command appeared incomparably calm.
Over the years, attacks that could truly break through the Intelligent Mecha defense line and threaten them were few and far between.
Most of the time, they didn’t even truly participate in battle.
Therefore, fighting until now, these believers suffered almost no damage aside from slight dirt on the corners of their clothes.
The two armies formed an extremely stark contrast.
One side had already fallen into madness.
While the other side still maintained an absolute advantage.
In another direction, the zombie army led by Yang Eleven was engaged in a frenzied slaughter with the Angel Race.
Even though Yang Eleven had set up the Zombie Tide Dance Formation in advance, facing these Angel Race warriors whose eyes were red from killing, it was still difficult to gain an advantage.
A large number of Zombie Generals rushed onto the battlefield.
But the next moment,
brilliant beams of Holy Light flashed past.
The heads of countless Zombie Generals were directly lopped off.
These Angel Races seemed to have completely lost their sanity.
They didn’t even place their main attention on Yang Fan’s main legion.
Instead, they seemed to have locked onto the zombie army, acting with a stance of vowing not to stop until every single Corpse Cultivator system believer was completely annihilated.
Inside the flesh disaster hive, Yang Eleven’s expression was ugly to the extreme.
In the current Zombie Kingdom, the least lacking thing was the number of soldiers.
Even if a large number of Zombie Generals died, for Yang Eleven who possessed a massive divine kingdom Foundation, it didn’t amount to much at all.
But the problem was... these Angel Races possessed an extremely strong restraint capability against the Corpse Cultivation System.
Their Holy Light power had a natural suppression against undead and Corpse Cultivator type life forms.
Causing the army under Yang Eleven’s command to be completely unable to unleash their full strength.
To reduce losses, Yang Eleven even directly withdrew a large number of White Zombie-level believers into the flesh disaster hive.
Relying on the defensive capabilities of the s-class war structures, he continuously maneuvered against the Angel Race.
Even under his request, another twenty flesh disaster hives were mobilized from the Eternal Corpse Mine, continuously transporting troops to The Frontline.
Yet even so, fighting this battle up to now,
believers at the Zombie General level had already suffered over twenty billion deaths!
Looking at the losses on the battlefield, Yang Eleven’s expression was incomparably gloomy.
“Is there something wrong with this Angel Race deity’s brain?”
“Ignoring the biggest threat, why are they staring dead at me and refusing to let go?”
“Can’t they tell who the real enemy is?”
Yang Eleven mentally complained frantically.
Now that he governed the entire Zombie Kingdom, his perspective naturally dictated his thoughts.
Standing from the perspective of the Corpse Cultivation System, no matter how he looked at it, he felt he was the most wronged one.
Clearly his threat was the lowest, yet over these past dozen years, he had endured the greatest fury of the Angel Race.
At this moment, Yang Eleven even somewhat missed the time when he was originally Yang San.
At that time, he was responsible for leading the entire divine kingdom army, able to mobilize the power of all systems for battle.
Unlike now, where he could only control believers of the Corpse Cultivator path.
Facing a natural nemesis like the Angel Race, his combat capability dropped by a huge margin directly.
Watching the believers under his command continuously die, Yang Eleven’s teeth itched with hatred.
In the end, he couldn’t help but send a message to Yang Four.
“Yang Four, quickly dispatch troops to invade.”
“My losses on this side are too heavy.”
After the message was sent out, a reply came back very quickly.
“Lord has an order.”
“Presently, Master is watching the battle in the divine kingdom.”
“Mere Angel Race deities are completely nothing to worry about.”
“Lord’s meaning is to treat this battle as a military parade.”
“Allowing Master to more clearly see the current comprehensive combat strength of the divine kingdom.”
“Convenient for making more accurate judgments when conducting Divine Kingdom Wars in the future.”
Hearing this, Yang Eleven fell silent for a moment, then nodded slowly.
“Understood.”
The next moment,
Yang Eleven took a deep breath and looked towards the battlefield once more.
“All zombie armies, redeploy the formation!”
“Continue meeting the enemy!”
Yang Fan sat high upon the main seat of the divine kingdom, gazing calmly at the battlefield images transmitted from ahead.
“I have already witnessed firsthand the terrifying destructive power of war structures manufactured by Mechanical Civilization.”
“Since this Angel Race deity is now at the end of their tether...”
The corners of Yang Fan’s mouth curved up slightly.
“Then, let me see to what extent the believers’ own combat power has reached nowadays.”
“This subordinate understands.”
Yang Da bowed respectfully.
The next moment, with a thought, he transmitted Yang Fan’s order to The Frontline.
On the battlefield,
Yang Four, who was directing the army’s advance, instantly received the message.
“Master has an order to begin the second phase of operations.”
A flash of sharp light crossed Yang Four’s eyes.
“Execute!”
Following the issuance of the order,
the Intelligent Mecha and Mechanical War Puppets that were originally blocking the very front began to rapidly move to both sides.
The massive Mechanical bodies slowly parted, revealing the true main force hidden in the rear.
The next moment,
the boundless army of believers began to push forward.
Cultivation, Martial Arts, Intelligent Life, and Elven Warriors.
Believers of the four paths, under the leadership of Yang Five through Yang Ten, rapidly arranged themselves according to the formation of the Four Symbols Heaven Evolution Array.
In an instant, an Aura completely different from the Mechanical legion swept across the entire battlefield.
Seeing this scene,
a trace of hope suddenly flashed within the originally despairing eyes of Lufa, the deity of the Angel Race.
“What happened?”
“Could it be... the quantities of these Mechanical monsters in the opponent’s divine kingdom have already been completely exhausted?”

chapters.title: Chapter 386: Battle Body
paragraphs: Lufa stared fixedly ahead.
The sky full of Intelligent Mecha had once brought him endless despair.
These Mechanical lifeforms possessed terrifying defensive and destructive power, such that even his army of Fallen Angels found it difficult to contend with them head-on.
To counter these Mechanical monsters,
he had even specially had his believers research small-scale assault Formations, attempting to use the power of Formations to destroy the cores of the Intelligent Mecha.
However... even so, it still could not change the tide of battle.
The number of Intelligent Mecha was simply too overwhelming.
Even though they constantly looked for opportunities to break through the defensive line, they would pay a heavy price every time.
In the end, they could only continuously shrink their defensive line.
But now... these Mechanical monsters had actually stepped aside on their own initiative?
Whatever the reason, for Lufa, who was already in a desperate situation, this was a rare opportunity.
His gaze fell upon the army of Human race believers behind them.
Cultivation, Martial Arts, Intelligent Life, Elven Warriors.
And... he could also sense the aura of several believers in the Nascent Soul Realm.
“This is definitely the elite force of these Human race divine kingdoms.”
Lufa’s expression was grave, but soon, a cold glint flashed in his eyes again.
“But so what?”
“You come from different systems, and even from different divine kingdoms.”
“Even if you are powerful, put together on short notice like this, how much combat power can you actually display?”
“This is my divine kingdom!”
“My believers hold an absolute advantage in numbers!”
Lufa quickly made his judgment.
Especially after seeing those Intelligent Life, his gaze became even more resolute.
“As long as we slaughter these Intelligent Life first...”
“Without the control of Intelligent Life, those Mechanical monsters are nothing more than a pile of scrap metal!”
Thinking of this, Lufa instantly stood up, his terrifying Divine Might sweeping through the entire divine kingdom.
“My believers, heed my summon!”
“The Fallen Angel race has reached the moment of life and death!”
“Today, foreign enemies invade my divine kingdom and trample upon my glory!”
“For the survival of the divine kingdom!”
“For the glory of my Lord!”
“Slay all the invaders!”
“Let them witness the true power of the Fallen Angel race!”
As the Divine Decree descended,
Boom!
the madness in the eyes of countless Fallen Angels instantly erupted.
They held black holy spears and flapped their pitch-black wings.
In the next second,
the army of Fallen Angels that blotted out the sky charged like a black torrent toward Yang Fan’s army of believers.
On the other side, Yang Four stood in the center of the battlefield, overseeing the overall situation.
“Yang Five, Yang Liu, Yang Seven, Yang Eight, Yang Nine, Yang Ten!”
“Prepare to face the enemy according to the plan!”
“Understood!”
The six of them responded in unison.
Faced with the overwhelming army of Fallen Angels, Yang Fan’s side did not choose to attack proactively.
Instead, under the command of Yang Four, they steadily awaited the enemy’s impact.
At the very front, a large number of Martial Arts system believers stood there.
They were primarily composed of experts in the Martial Master and Martial King Realms.
Watching the approaching Fallen Angels, their expressions showed not the slightest hint of panic.
One Martial Master lightly patted his waist.
In the next moment, a flash of Mechanical light gleamed.
A giant shield, fully ten Zhang tall, instantly appeared in his hand.
This was no ordinary shield, but a Tier 4 Smart Weapon manufactured by the Mechanical Civilization, possessing a high degree of intelligence.
It could freely change its form according to the user’s needs.
Not only could it defend against attacks, but it could also perfectly harmonize with the user’s strength to the greatest extent.
Boom!
In the next moment, the first wave of Fallen Angels had already rushed near.
Holding their holy spears, they erupted with maximum speed.
The terrifying impact force caused space itself to tremble faintly.
However... the moment their holy spears struck the shields, the expressions of all the Fallen Angels changed.
Because they felt as if the holy spears in their hands had slammed into an unshakeable giant mountain.
Not only did they fail to pierce the shields, but under the influence of the terrifying inertia, the weapons in their hands flew straight out of their grip.
In the next second,
their own bodies crashed violently against the giant shields.
Bang!
Bang!
Bang!
A series of dull crashing sounds rang out.
It was as if a rain of blood was pouring from the sky.
The high-speed flying Fallen Angels were now like out-of-control giant flying insects, constantly crashing against the steel defensive line formed by the Martial Arts believers.
Even though they possessed powerful strength,
facing this kind of physical collision, they could not gain any advantage whatsoever.
“Hahaha!”
One Martial Master felt the force transmitted from his shield and couldn’t help but laugh out loud.
“Brothers, these birdmen aren’t all that!”
“Was the Marshal and the others being too cautious?”
“With an attack of this level, even without these defensive weapons, they might not even be able to break through our Physical Bodies!”
Saying that, this Martial Master clenched his fist tightly.
Terrifying vital energy and blood instantly erupted.
The clothes on his body were directly torn apart by his expanding muscles, and his entire being seemed to transform into a mini giant.
“Do not underestimate the enemy!”
“Maintain Formation!”
A Martial King at the absolute front shouted in a deep voice.
Although a hint of strangeness also lingered on his face.
Until they actually clashed,
they had never imagined... that these so-called Fallen Angels would actually be weak to this extent.
After all, along the way, they had barely participated in any real combat.
Now, facing the enemy head-on for the first time, this massive disparity actually felt somewhat surreal to them.
However, as a military commander,
he knew very well that war was no time to show off.
Even if the enemy was weak, they had to maintain Formation and await subsequent orders.
Directly above the army,
Yang Eight floated in the Void Realm, casting his gaze toward Yang Four.
He did not issue orders immediately, but was waiting for the final instruction.
Yang Four naturally understood his meaning.
After a brief moment, he nodded slightly, “You may.”
Having received permission, a flash of Battle Intent instantly surged in Yang Eight’s eyes.
In the next instant,
he took a sudden step forward, his voice resounded across the entire battlefield like thunder.
“Soldiers of the Wanxiang Martial Court!”
“The great deity is watching you!”
“Unleash your Battle Bodies!”
“Today, let the enemy witness the power of our Martial Route!”
“Even if we are just shields standing at the very front to absorb damage, we still possess the power to tear the enemy apart!”
“We, too, can expand the territory for our deity!”
“Slaughter all of these Angel Race believers!”
Following Yang Eight’s command,
the eyes of all the Martial Masters and Martial Kings walking the Martial Route instantly blazed with fanatical Battle Intent.
They had waited for this moment for far too long.
Over these years, the Mechanical legion had always stood at the very front.
Now, it was finally their turn to prove themselves.
Boom!
In the next moment,
surges of terrifying vital energy and blood erupted from within their bodies.
Their originally two-meter-tall Human race bodies began to expand wildly.
Their bones thickened, and their muscles swelled.
Their vital energy and blood burned like fire.
Two meters! Four meters! Eight meters! Ten meters!
Only when they reached a height of ten meters did their bodies temporarily stop growing.
However... this was not the end.
Right at this moment, Yang Eight waved his large hand.
“Descend!”
Boom!
Dozens of giant Immortal Army Soul Steles instantly descended upon the battlefield.

chapters.title: Chapter 387: How Do We Fight This?
paragraphs: In an instant, an incredibly dense blood Qi began to spread.
A terrifying will belonging to an army enveloped the entire battlefield.
Under the buff of the Immortal Army Soul Stele, the bodies of these Martial Arts believers, who were already ten meters tall, began to expand once again.
Fifteen meters! Twenty meters! Thirty meters!
Ultimately, each of the Martial Arts believers transformed into a true little giant.
Standing there, they resembled moving mountains.
And the tier-four Smart Weapon shields in their hands adjusted simultaneously with the physical changes of their users.
The shields, which were originally only dozens of zhang in size, were also giant-sized at this moment.
Held in the hands of these thirty-meter-tall giants, they fit perfectly.
Seeing this scene, Yang Fan, who was watching the battlefield from his Divine Kingdom, couldn’t help but widen his eyes.
“This...”
Seeing this, Yang Da quickly explained:
“Reporting to Master, this is the A-grade combat talent—the Battle Body.”

“After tens of thousands of years of development in the Divine Kingdom, Yang Yi immediately sends any of the newborn descendants who awaken the Battle Body talent to the Wanxiang Martial Court for Cultivation.”
“Possessing this Physique not only greatly increases the speed of martial Cultivation.”
“More importantly, once the Battle Body is activated, the body undergoes a massive transformation.”
“Strength, defense, and blood Qi will all be multiplied several times over.”
Yang Fan did not speak, but stared intently at the real-time image coming from the front.
In the next moment.
The battlefield fell completely into madness.
Those Martial Arts believers with the Battle Body, like unshakable fortresses, charged directly into the army of Fallen Angels.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The holy spears in the hands of the Fallen Angels stabbed at them, but could only spark, unable to even pierce their skin.
And the massive shields in their hands were no longer defensive weapons at this moment.
Instead, they became the most terrifying offensive weapons.
A thirty-meter-tall Martial King believer swung his shield, sending a large swath of Fallen Angels flying.
These agile Angel Race warriors seemed to have truly turned into mere mosquitoes in front of these giants.
In the sky, a rain of blood began to fall continuously.
It was not ordinary rain, but the flesh and blood of countless Angel Race believers who had been blasted to pieces.
Meanwhile, behind Yang Fan’s army.
Those Cultivation Believers and the Elf Race responsible for long-range combat looked at the battle ahead, and they couldn’t help but frown.
“The people of the Wanxiang Martial Court are indeed as crude as ever.”
A Core Formation Realm Cultivator couldn’t help but transmit his voice.
“A bunch of reckless fools who only know how to rely on their Physical Bodies.”
“Their way of fighting has absolutely no aesthetic value.”
Another Cultivation Believer beside him nodded.
“Indeed.”
“The great deity is watching.”
“Yet they actually fight in such a crude manner.”
“Nothing but clumsy brutes.”
“Back in the day, when I was young, I snatched a Spirit Stone from a Martial Master.”
“Later, I had already returned to my Heavenly Court Immortal Cave to Cultivate in seclusion.”
“But that Martial Master had only just chased his way out of the city.”
A group of Core Formation Cultivators transmitted their voices to each other.
Their eyes, as they looked at the giants ahead, were filled with disdain.
However, disdain aside, they had to admit in their hearts.
These fellows with powerful Physical Bodies were indeed somewhat terrifying.
On the other side.
The Angel Race deity Lufa was completely stunned at this moment.
He stared blankly at the battlefield, his eyes full of disbelief.
“How is this possible...”
“How could these Human race believers on the Martial Route possess such terrifying combat talents?”
His gaze fell upon those massive stone steles.
“That is actually an S-grade war buff building?”
Lufa felt his head spinning in confusion.
“How do we fight this?”
Lufa swallowed his saliva, then forced himself to calm down and quickly analyze the battle situation.
“No.”
“These Martial Arts believers have too strong a defense.”
“If we continue to clash head-on, it will only result in massive casualties for my believers.”
“We must avoid them.”
With this in mind, Lufa looked at the other phalanxes in the distance that still maintained their formations, instantly changing his combat strategy.
“My believers!”
“Do not continue to crash into these mountains of flesh!”
“You possess the wings of freedom, utilize your advantage!”
“Bypass them! Attack those foreign races in the rear!”
“First, destroy those Intelligent Lives!”
“As long as they lose the control of Intelligent Life, those Mechanical monsters will become scrap metal!”
“In this battle, the final victory will still belong to us!”
As the Divine Decree was handed down.
Countless Fallen Angels immediately changed direction.
They spread their pitch-black wings and flew directly into the high sky.
Bypassing the Martial Arts legion in front, they charged toward the Intelligent Life and other believers in the rear.
Seeing this scene, the Martial Masters and Martial Kings below suddenly grew anxious.
“Running?”
“These birdmen only know how to run?”
A Martial Master cursed angrily.
“Do they think we can’t do anything just because they’ve taken flight?”
Saying that, he directly pressed the button on the left side of the shield.
In the next moment, the massive shield instantly deformed.
The metal structure recombined, and in the blink of an eye, it transformed into a giant gun barrel.
He was just about to hoist it onto his shoulder.
However, in the next second, a hand pressed down on his shoulder.
It was none other than the Martial King leading this legion.
“My Lord?”
That Martial Master turned back in confusion.
The Martial King shook his head.
“General Eight has given orders.”
“This battle is a military parade.”
“What the great deity wants to see is the strength of our Wanxiang Martial Court itself.”
“Not reliance on the weapons of the Mechanical Civilization.”
“As for the rest, someone else will naturally handle it.”
The Martial Master was stunned for a moment, then put away his weapon. “This subordinate understands.”
Watching the massive host of Fallen Angels change direction and fly toward their side.
Instead of being nervous, those Cultivation Believers showed expressions of excitement one after another.
Finally... it was their Heavenly Court’s turn to show its power!
In the sky above the battlefield, Yang Four, serving as the commander-in-chief of the entire war, swept his gaze over the incoming Fallen Angels and spoke calmly.
“These Angel Race believers have limited strength.”
“Group yourselves into tens of thousands and form the F-grade Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array to face the enemy.”
“Let Master see the fruits of the Heavenly Court’s development over these years.”
“Display all the advantages of the Spirit Body.”
“If you encounter danger, you can enter the God-Slaying Tower at any time to avoid battle.”
As Yang Four’s voice fell.
Boom!
Massive towers suddenly rose from the Void Realm.
Twelve God-Slaying Towers floated above the battlefield, exuding an incomparably sharp aura.
These war buildings were the ultimate guarantee for the Cultivation Believers, allowing them to fight without any worries.
Seeing this scene, the Battle Intent in the eyes of those Cultivation Believers grew even more intense.
They had waited for this moment for far too long.
For all these years, they had been immersed in Cultivation.
Constantly perfecting their Cultivation Techniques, raising their Realms, and researching spells.
Now, they finally had the opportunity to prove their strength before the deity.
“Heavenly Court Disciples, face the enemy!”
As the order was passed down.
The Cultivation Believers also grouped themselves into tens of thousands to form combat phalanxes.

Boom!
Boom!
The holy spears in the hands of the Fallen Angels stabbed at them, but could only spark, unable to even pierce their skin.
And the massive shields in their hands were no longer defensive weapons at this moment.
Instead, they became the most terrifying offensive weapons.
A thirty-meter-tall Martial King believer swung his shield, sending a large swath of Fallen Angels flying.
These agile Angel Race warriors seemed to have truly turned into mere mosquitoes in front of these giants.
In the sky, a rain of blood began to fall continuously.
It was not ordinary rain, but the flesh and blood of countless Angel Race believers who had been blasted to pieces.
Meanwhile, behind Yang Fan’s army.
Those Cultivation Believers and the Elf Race responsible for long-range combat looked at the battle ahead, and they couldn’t help but frown.
“The people of the Wanxiang Martial Court are indeed as crude as ever.”
A Core Formation Realm Cultivator couldn’t help but transmit his voice.
“A bunch of reckless fools who only know how to rely on their Physical Bodies.”
“Their way of fighting has absolutely no aesthetic value.”
Another Cultivation Believer beside him nodded.
“Indeed.”
“The great deity is watching.”
“Yet they actually fight in such a crude manner.”
“Nothing but clumsy brutes.”
“Back in the day, when I was young, I snatched a Spirit Stone from a Martial Master.”
“Later, I had already returned to my Heavenly Court Immortal Cave to Cultivate in seclusion.”
“But that Martial Master had only just chased his way out of the city.”
A group of Core Formation Cultivators transmitted their voices to each other.
Their eyes, as they looked at the giants ahead, were filled with disdain.
However, disdain aside, they had to admit in their hearts.
These fellows with powerful Physical Bodies were indeed somewhat terrifying.
On the other side.
The Angel Race deity Lufa was completely stunned at this moment.
He stared blankly at the battlefield, his eyes full of disbelief.
“How is this possible...”
“How could these Human race believers on the Martial Route possess such terrifying combat talents?”
His gaze fell upon those massive stone steles.
“That is actually an S-grade war buff building?”
Lufa felt his head spinning in confusion.
“How do we fight this?”
Lufa swallowed his saliva, then forced himself to calm down and quickly analyze the battle situation.
“No.”
“These Martial Arts believers have too strong a defense.”
“If we continue to clash head-on, it will only result in massive casualties for my believers.”
“We must avoid them.”
With this in mind, Lufa looked at the other phalanxes in the distance that still maintained their formations, instantly changing his combat strategy.
“My believers!”
“Do not continue to crash into these mountains of flesh!”
“You possess the wings of freedom, utilize your advantage!”
“Bypass them!
Attack those foreign races in the rear!”
“First, destroy those Intelligent Lives!”
“As long as they lose the control of Intelligent Life, those Mechanical monsters will become scrap metal!”
“In this battle, the final victory will still belong to us!”
As the Divine Decree was handed down.
Countless Fallen Angels immediately changed direction.
They spread their pitch-black wings and flew directly into the high sky.
Bypassing the Martial Arts legion in front, they charged toward the Intelligent Life and other believers in the rear.
Seeing this scene, the Martial Masters and Martial Kings below suddenly grew anxious.
“Running?”
“These birdmen only know how to run?”
A Martial Master cursed angrily.
“Do they think we can’t do anything just because they’ve taken flight?”
Saying that, he directly pressed the button on the left side of the shield.
In the next moment, the massive shield instantly deformed.
The metal structure recombined, and in the blink of an eye, it transformed into a giant gun barrel.
He was just about to hoist it onto his shoulder.
However, in the next second, a hand pressed down on his shoulder.
It was none other than the Martial King leading this legion.
“My Lord?”
That Martial Master turned back in confusion.
The Martial King shook his head.
“General Eight has given orders.”
“This battle is a military parade.”
“What the great deity wants to see is the strength of our Wanxiang Martial Court itself.”
“Not reliance on the weapons of the Mechanical Civilization.”
“As for the rest, someone else will naturally handle it.”
The Martial Master was stunned for a moment, then put away his weapon.
“This subordinate understands.”
Watching the massive host of Fallen Angels change direction and fly toward their side.
Instead of being nervous, those Cultivation Believers showed expressions of excitement one after another.
Finally... it was their Heavenly Court’s turn to show its power!
In the sky above the battlefield, Yang Four, serving as the commander-in-chief of the entire war, swept his gaze over the incoming Fallen Angels and spoke calmly.
“These Angel Race believers have limited strength.”
“Group yourselves into tens of thousands and form the F-grade Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array to face the enemy.”
“Let Master see the fruits of the Heavenly Court’s development over these years.”
“Display all the advantages of the Spirit Body.”
“If you encounter danger, you can enter the God-Slaying Tower at any time to avoid battle.”
As Yang Four’s voice fell.
Boom!
Massive towers suddenly rose from the Void Realm.
Twelve God-Slaying Towers floated above the battlefield, exuding an incomparably sharp aura.
These war buildings were the ultimate guarantee for the Cultivation Believers, allowing them to fight without any worries.
Seeing this scene, the Battle Intent in the eyes of those Cultivation Believers grew even more intense.
They had waited for this moment for far too long.
For all these years, they had been immersed in Cultivation.
Constantly perfecting their Cultivation Techniques, raising their Realms, and researching spells.
Now, they finally had the opportunity to prove their strength before the deity.
“Heavenly Court Disciples, face the enemy!”
As the order was passed down.
The Cultivation Believers also grouped themselves into tens of thousands to form combat phalanxes.

chapters.title: Chapter 388: Angel Rain
paragraphs: However, unlike the uniform fighting style of the Wanxiang Martial Court,
the Cultivation system’s combat was more like a magnificent spectacle.
Boom!
The Spiritual Qi within a Cultivation Believer erupted.
In the next instant, his entire body transformed into a towering flame giant.
Terrifying heat swept across the surroundings, warping even the air itself.
Innumerable Fallen Angels felt a scorching heatwave before they could even draw near.
On another side, a Cultivator with a Wood Spirit Physique extended his right hand.
Dense wood-attribute Spiritual Qi gathered in his palm.
A second later, countless thick vines burst out from the ground.
As if imbued with life, they coiled wildly toward the Fallen Angels in the sky.
Just as those Fallen Angels tried to break free, they discovered that the vines contained a terrifying vitality.
Not only did it restrict their movements, but it was also frantically draining the energy from their bodies.
Other Cultivators formed hand seals directly.
In an instant, countless beams of pale golden light emerged in the sky.
These lights transformed into a sky full of sharp blades, pouring down like a torrential rain.
Pfft! Pfft! Pfft!
Masses of Fallen Angels were pierced through by golden sword lights before they could even react.
Compared to the simple and brutish combat style of the Wanxiang Martial Court,
the attack methods of the Heavenly Court’s Cultivators could truly be called a dazzling display of diversity.
Five Elements Spiritual Qi of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth.
Wind Spirit Physiques, Ice Spirit Physiques, Dark Spirit Physiques, Lightning Spirit Physiques...
All kinds of special Physiques unleashed their might at this moment.
Although Yang Four had issued an order for ten thousand of them to form the Myriad Spirits Origin-Returning Array,
these Cultivation Believers had not done so.
The reason was simple: they wanted to prove themselves before their god.
In addition to their own spells and techniques,
all kinds of Talisman Treasures, Talismans, poison pills, and Formation Plates,
and even various special Magical Artifacts were unleashed without holding back.
Across the entire sky, explosions echoed continuously.
Some angels were sliced in two by golden light.
Some angels had their life force swallowed by vines.
Some angels were charred to cinders by raging flames.
Some angels were stricken by lethal poison, their bodies rotting away rapidly.
At this moment, the army of Fallen Angels fell completely into despair.
What they were facing was no longer an ordinary army, but a swarm of Cultivators wielding endless methods and tricks.
It was entirely a one-sided slaughter.
Inside the Divine Kingdom’s grand hall, Yang Da had proactively taken on the role of a commentator.
“Master, this is the A-rank talent—Spirit Physique.”
“Among all A-rank talents, the Spirit Physique ranks among the very best.”
“The Divine Kingdom’s believers have a certain probability of Awakening various special Physiques.”
“Metal Spirit Physique, Wood Spirit Physique, Water Spirit Physique, Fire Spirit Physique, Ice Spirit Physique, Dark Spirit Physique...”
“As long as they Awaken a special Spirit Physique, the Heavenly Court focuses on nurturing them.”
“Not only do they gain permanent residency in the Heavenly Court,”

“but within the Heavenly Court’s Scripture Pavilion, I have purchased a large number of Cultivation Techniques from the Divine Shop suitable for their Cultivation, paired with an unlimited supply of Spirit Stones.”
“When making a breakthrough into key Realms, they can even use top-tier Resources like Earth Heart Milk.”
Yang Da’s tone carried a hint of pride.
“Therefore, in terms of believers’ individual offensive prowess alone, the Cultivation system ranks supreme.”
“Not bad.”
Yang Fan nodded with satisfaction.
As a god, he was naturally able to use these believers’ abilities as well.
It was just that in the Real World, he had always remained in the safe zone, never truly having the chance to fight.
Now, watching his believers unleash their various abilities on the battlefield,
Yang Fan could not help feeling a surge of burning excitement in his chest.
“If I were to use these abilities myself...”
“Would I also possess the strength to slay gods in the Real World?”
The moment this thought arose, Yang Fan shook his head.
Safety was always the number one priority.
Remaining in the safe zone at The Frontline and expanding continuously through proxy wars was already fast enough.
There was absolutely no need to take personal risks just to acquire more gods’ coordinates.
Deducing the coordinates of Alien Gods through proxy wars was the safest, most reliable method.
Meanwhile.
In the Angel Race’s Divine Kingdom.
Lufa’s eyes had turned completely bloodshot.
He could clearly sense that his power was rapidly waning.
Because... his believers were dying en masse.
“Switch targets!”
“Kill those Intelligent Lives for me!”
Lufa gritted his teeth and sent down another Divine Decree.
At this moment, he had fallen completely into despair.
Those Intelligent Mechas had been the greatest nightmare haunting his mind recently.
Countless charges, countless failures.
Those cold Mechanical lives had almost become an inescapable shadow over him.
But now... when those Intelligent Mechas took the initiative to halt and yield the battlefield,
Lufa truly realized that what was truly terrifying... was not those Mechanical monsters.
Rather, it was the Human race believers hidden behind the Mechanical army.
These Martial Artists and Cultivators were all so powerful that they did not seem like beings ordinary Divine Kingdoms could nurture.
A horrifying guess suddenly surfaced in Lufa’s mind.
“Could it be...”
“These three gods all hail from the Human race’s Five Great Families?”
The Human race’s Five Great Families were just like the top nobility in their Angel Race.
Possessing endless Resources, possessing the strongest Legacies.
Gods with high status and powerful backgrounds often preferred to collaborate with beings of the same tier.
And the scene before his eyes had already exceeded the scope of what ordinary gods could accomplish.
Mechanical Civilization, Cultivation system, Martial Arts system.
Three completely different paths, yet simultaneously possessing such terrifying foundations.
Aside from coming from the Human race’s Five Great Families, Lufa could think of no other possibility.
Only...
Thinking up to this point, Lufa’s heart was filled with intense indignation.
Why?
Just how unlucky was he?
To have his Divine Kingdom’s coordinates discovered by the young masters of the Human race’s top Families!
He refused to accept this!
He was truly unwilling to accept this!
Seeing hundreds of millions of Fallen Angels surge toward the center of the army like a black torrent,
those Intelligent Lives seemed to have received a synchronized command in advance.
The next moment, all Intelligent Lives raised their right hands in unison.
Perfectfully synchronized, without the slightest error.
“Plasma cannons activated!”
“Energy modules connected!”
“Initiating charge.”
“Countdown...”
Boom!
In an instant, blinding white light burst simultaneously from the right hands of countless Intelligent Lives.
Terrifying energy fluctuations instantly swept the battlefield.
The next second, the light flared violently.
Beams of brilliant plasma light shot out from the hands of the Intelligent Lives.
However, these beams did not blast straight ahead, but rapidly split in midair,
transforming into countless slender threads of energy.
Then... precisely locking onto every single Fallen Angel.
Buzz!
Countless rays of light streaked across the sky.
On the forehead of every single Fallen Angel, a thin white trace of light appeared.
There were no redundant attacks, no wasted energy, not even an area-of-effect bombardment.
This round of attacks was purely a precision strike calculated by the Intelligent Lives.
Every attack corresponded to one target.
Every bit of energy exerted maximum effect.
In the next instant, countless Fallen Angels stiffened abruptly.
Before they could even react, their brains had already been destroyed by the plasma energy.
Then, corpse after corpse began plummeting from the sky,
like flocks of birds that had lost their wings.
Across the sky of the entire Divine Kingdom,
at this moment, there fell an extraordinary “Angel Rain.”

chapters.title: Chapter 389: Giving Up Resistance
paragraphs: Countless black feathers drifted down as countless Fallen Angel corpses plummeted to the earth.
Watching this scene, the other believers under Yang Fan’s command couldn’t help but swallow hard.
This was too terrifying.
Compared to their systems that relied on their own strength to fight,
the Mechanical Civilization’s way of fighting was simply too efficient and too precise.
It was even precise to a degree that inspired dread.
On the other side,
the Elven Warriors looked at the vast area of the sky that had been instantly cleared, staring at each other in disbelief.
After a moment, an Elven Warrior couldn’t help but speak up.
“As the god’s vassals, we cannot just stand in the back and watch forever.”
“We must share the burdens of our great God.”
The Elven Warrior next to him immediately nodded.
“Indeed.”
“Our Elf Race should also display our own strength.”
In the next moment, the Elven Commander raised the longbow in his hand.
“All Elven Warriors!”
“Draw your bows and nock your arrows!”
“Fire at will!”
“Let the enemy witness the archery of the Elf Race!”
Swish!
In an instant, countless Elven Warriors drew their bowstrings simultaneously, and a rain of arrows filled the sky.
Although the first round of attacks from the Intelligent Life had already wiped out the vast majority of the Fallen Angels,
there were still some powerful existences who managed to dodge the attack with their own strength.
These Fallen Angels had just breathed a sigh of relief, thinking they had finally escaped disaster.
However, in the next second,
Whoosh!
an arrow pierced through the sky, precisely embedding itself between the brows of one of the Fallen Angels.
His expression instantly froze, and his body fell limply.
Right after, a second, a third, a fourth...
More and more arrows rained down from the sky.
The Fallen Angels who had luckily survived did not even have a chance to steady themselves before they were killed one by one by the Elven Warriors.
The vanguard army of billions sent by Lufa,
in less than fifteen minutes,
was completely wiped out!
From beginning to end, they had not even truly breached the defensive line of Yang Fan’s army, nor had they caused any effective casualties.
At this moment, the remaining believers of the Angel Race felt their hands holding their sacred spears begin to tremble uncontrollably.
Looking at the terrifying army ahead, only deep dread remained in their eyes.
“My God... this is not a war, this is a massacre...”
A Fallen Angel muttered.
“They are too strong; we have absolutely no hope of winning.”
The voice of another Angel Race believer trembled.
“Oh, my God... we are willing to offer our lives for our deity.”
“But... we do not want to die so meaninglessly.”
“We can’t even touch the enemy’s defensive line...”
Voices of despair rang out one after another.
At this moment, the morale of the Angel Race army completely collapsed, and the Battle Intent in the eyes of countless believers vanished.
In its place was an unconcealable despair.
Facing the terrifying combat power displayed by the army under Yang Fan’s command,
the last shred of hope in Lufa’s heart completely vanished.
He knew very well that with his current power, it was absolutely impossible to win this Divine Kingdom War.
If he continued to hold out, only the complete breaching of his Divine Kingdom awaited him.
“As long as I can survive...”
“nothing else matters.”
Lufa took a deep breath.
Finally, hesitating no longer, he directly disclosed his Divine Kingdom coordinates to the four Angel Race gods in his clan who were supporting him.
“I hope... you must come.”
Lufa closed his eyes; this was now his last hope.
For this Divine Kingdom War, Lufa had already paid everything he could.
The Divinity Points he had accumulated over hundreds of years were all invested into it.
In the Real World, the shares he owned in various major Angel Race corporations and the liquid funds his Family had accumulated—
almost everything that could be sold, he had sold.
All of this was to defend his Divine Kingdom’s core area.
Because as long as the core area was not breached, he still had a chance to turn the tables.
But now... Lufa had been pushed to the final step.
With his consciousness inside his Divine Kingdom, he sat upon his divine throne, waiting anxiously.
The support of the other four Angel Race gods was his final hope.
But even so, Lufa did not have absolute confidence in his heart.
Because he had made a mistake and shown the true situation of the war to the four of them.
The invaders were highly likely to be from the Human race’s Five Great Families.
Support among the Angel Race’s gods on The Frontline was not mandatory.
If the risks far outweighed the benefits, it was entirely possible for the other party to choose to give up.
After all, once they were defeated,
their own Divine Kingdom coordinates were highly likely to be exposed as a result.
On the battlefield,
Yang Fan’s army continued to press forward.
The Angel Race’s defensive lines retreated steadily.
More and more Formations were destroyed, gaps appeared in the defensive lines, and a large number of Angel Race believers died continuously.
And time was slipping away bit by bit.
But...
the support Lufa was waiting for never appeared.
He sat on his divine throne, silent for a long time.
“Hahaha...”
A desolate laugh rang out.
Lufa slowly leaned back against his divine throne.
His originally tense body finally relaxed completely.
“It is fate...”
“It is destiny.”
Actually, he had already prepared himself mentally for this outcome.
If he were in their shoes and discovered that the one requesting aid was likely facing a Genius god from the Human race’s Five Great Families,
he might not choose to deploy his forces either.
After all... once they failed, what they paid would be the future of their entire Divine Kingdom.
“A hundred years ago, I came to The Frontline to join the army.”
“I thought I could obtain a large amount of Resources to help myself breakthrough to a Second-tier God.”
“I didn’t expect...”
“that I would end up in such a state in the end.”
Lufa murmured in a low voice.
But soon, his gaze became firm once again.
“But before I die...”
“I must at least make my death a satisfying one.”
In the next moment, Lufa took a deep breath.
His Divine Thought instantly penetrated the fog of the Divine Kingdom and fell upon the Zombie Army led by Yang Eleven in the distance.
Without any hesitation, a Divine Decree descended instantly.
“All believers!”
“Abandon your current defensive lines!”
“Head to the southwest region immediately!”
“Prioritize the annihilation of those filthy Corpse Cultivator lifeforms!”
“Make them pay the price for desecrating sacred life!”
Although the Angel Race army was already utterly defeated at this moment,
they still did not dare to disobey their deity’s command.
In the next moment,
a large number of Angel Race believers directly abandoned the defense of the core area and turned around one after another.
They charged toward the location where Yang Eleven was.
Seeing this scene,
Yang Four, who was coordinating the overall situation, was completely stunned.
“What is the situation?”
“What is this Alien God doing?”
“Voluntarily giving up the core area?”
“Could it be... he has already given up resisting?”
Just as Yang Four was feeling puzzled, a furious voice suddenly rang out in his mind.
“Yang Four! What are you still waiting for?!”
“Hurry up and invade!”
“I’m holding off the pressure for you!”
“If you don’t know how to be a marshal, hand the position over to me!”
Hearing Yang Eleven’s roar,
Yang Four’s expression turned a bit awkward, and he coughed lightly.
“All legions, accelerate into the enemy’s core area!”
With the order given, the army under Yang Fan’s command advanced on all fronts.
