From beginning to end, they had not even truly breached the defensive line of Yang Fan’s army, nor had they caused any effective casualties.
At this moment, the remaining believers of the Angel Race felt their hands holding their sacred spears begin to tremble uncontrollably.
Looking at the terrifying army ahead, only deep dread remained in their eyes.
“My God... this is not a war, this is a massacre...”
A Fallen Angel muttered.
“They are too strong; we have absolutely no hope of winning.”
The voice of another Angel Race believer trembled.
“Oh, my God... we are willing to offer our lives for our deity.”
“But... we do not want to die so meaninglessly.”
“We can’t even touch the enemy’s defensive line...”
Voices of despair rang out one after another.
At this moment, the morale of the Angel Race army completely collapsed, and the Battle Intent in the eyes of countless believers vanished.
In its place was an unconcealable despair.
Facing the terrifying combat power displayed by the army under Yang Fan’s command,
the last shred of hope in Lufa’s heart completely vanished.
He knew very well that with his current power, it was absolutely impossible to win this Divine Kingdom War.
If he continued to hold out, only the complete breaching of his Divine Kingdom awaited him.
“As long as I can survive...”
“nothing else matters.”
Lufa took a deep breath.
Finally, hesitating no longer, he directly disclosed his Divine Kingdom coordinates to the four Angel Race gods in his clan who were supporting him.
“I hope... you must come.”
Lufa closed his eyes; this was now his last hope.
For this Divine Kingdom War, Lufa had already paid everything he could.
The Divinity Points he had accumulated over hundreds of years were all invested into it.
In the Real World, the shares he owned in various major Angel Race corporations and the liquid funds his Family had accumulated—
almost everything that could be sold, he had sold.
All of this was to defend his Divine Kingdom’s core area.
Because as long as the core area was not breached, he still had a chance to turn the tables.
But now...
Lufa had been pushed to the final step.
With his consciousness inside his Divine Kingdom, he sat upon his divine throne, waiting anxiously.
The support of the other four Angel Race gods was his final hope.
But even so, Lufa did not have absolute confidence in his heart.
Because he had made a mistake and shown the true situation of the war to the four of them.
The invaders were highly likely to be from the Human race’s Five Great Families.
Support among the Angel Race’s gods on The Frontline was not mandatory.
If the risks far outweighed the benefits, it was entirely possible for the other party to choose to give up.
After all, once they were defeated,
their own Divine Kingdom coordinates were highly likely to be exposed as a result.
On the battlefield,
Yang Fan’s army continued to press forward.
The Angel Race’s defensive lines retreated steadily.
More and more Formations were destroyed, gaps appeared in the defensive lines, and a large number of Angel Race believers died continuously.
And time was slipping away bit by bit.
But...
the support Lufa was waiting for never appeared.
He sat on his divine throne, silent for a long time.
“Hahaha...”
A desolate laugh rang out.
Lufa slowly leaned back against his divine throne.
His originally tense body finally relaxed completely.
“It is fate...”
“It is destiny.”
Actually, he had already prepared himself mentally for this outcome.
If he were in their shoes and discovered that the one requesting aid was likely facing a Genius god from the Human race’s Five Great Families,
he might not choose to deploy his forces either.
After all... once they failed, what they paid would be the future of their entire Divine Kingdom.
“A hundred years ago, I came to The Frontline to join the army.”
“I thought I could obtain a large amount of Resources to help myself breakthrough to a Second-tier God.”
“I didn’t expect...”
“that I would end up in such a state in the end.”
Lufa murmured in a low voice.
But soon, his gaze became firm once again.
“But before I die...”
“I must at least make my death a satisfying one.”
In the next moment, Lufa took a deep breath.
His Divine Thought instantly penetrated the fog of the Divine Kingdom and fell upon the Zombie Army led by Yang Eleven in the distance.
Without any hesitation, a Divine Decree descended instantly.
“All believers!”
“Abandon your current defensive lines!”
“Head to the southwest region immediately!”
“Prioritize the annihilation of those filthy Corpse Cultivator lifeforms!”
“Make them pay the price for desecrating sacred life!”
Although the Angel Race army was already utterly defeated at this moment,
they still did not dare to disobey their deity’s command.
In the next moment,
a large number of Angel Race believers directly abandoned the defense of the core area and turned around one after another.
They charged toward the location where Yang Eleven was.
Seeing this scene,
Yang Four, who was coordinating the overall situation, was completely stunned.
“What is the situation?”
“What is this Alien God doing?”
“Voluntarily giving up the core area?”
“Could it be... he has already given up resisting?”
Just as Yang Four was feeling puzzled, a furious voice suddenly rang out in his mind.
“Yang Four!
What are you still waiting for?!”
“Hurry up and invade!”
“I’m holding off the pressure for you!”
“If you don’t know how to be a marshal, hand the position over to me!”
Hearing Yang Eleven’s roar,
Yang Four’s expression turned a bit awkward, and he coughed lightly.
“All legions, accelerate into the enemy’s core area!”
With the order given, the army under Yang Fan’s command advanced on all fronts.

chapters.title: Chapter 390: Before Death
paragraphs: Without a large number of believers stationed there.
In the core area of the Angel Race, there was almost no effective resistance.
The mighty army marched straight in.
Inside the Divine Kingdom’s main hall,
Through the battlefield imagery, Yang Fan finally saw the appearance of the core area of the Angel Race’s divine kingdom.
That was a world completely different from the Human race’s divine kingdom.
In the sky, tens of thousands of A-Rank Buildings emitted pure white Holy Light.
Gigantic buildings floated above the earth.
There were things similar to angel altars, special buildings Yang Fan had never seen before, and even some bizarre facilities whose uses were completely incomprehensible from their appearances.
Between different races, the systems of divine kingdom buildings varied greatly.
Many buildings could hardly be directly used by other races.
However... This was The Frontline battlefield, after all.
These high-tier buildings inherently represented immense value.
Even if they couldn’t be used, they could be exchanged for military achievements.
Yet now, these Advanced buildings of astonishing value no longer had any believers stationed to guard them.
They were left for the army to plunder at will.
At this moment, Lufa was still sitting on the divine throne.
His Divine Power was waning, and his aura was withered.
The whole person felt like a twilight elderly person, waiting for death to arrive.
On the other side.
The zombie army led by Yang Eleven was steadily retreating at the moment.
Aside from the continuous deaths of a large number of Zombie General, believers at the Zombie King level also began to suffer large-scale casualties.
On the battlefield, a series of commands constantly came out from Yang Eleven’s mouth.
“Leave two hundred million Zombie General in charge of covering the rear!”
“The rest of the army, under the cover of the flesh disaster hive, retreat in an orderly fashion!”
“Remember, do not fight to the death with the enemy!”
“As long as the main force seizes the Divine Kingdom Core over there, these alien believers will instantly lose their ability to act!”
“Our task is to stall them!”
As one directive after another was issued.
The massive zombie legion began to quickly adjust its formation.
Yang Eleven was well aware that the outcome of this Divine Kingdom War had long been determined.
As the highest commander of the Zombie Kingdom, the most important thing for him right now was not to continue fighting for battle gains.
Instead, it was to minimize losses as much as possible.
At the front of the battlefield.
A large number of Zombie King held fourth-tier Smart Weapon tailored for them by the Mechanical Civilization.
At this moment, one Zombie King after another stood at the very front of the battlefield.
The Smart Weapon in their hands continuously transformed, eventually turning into mobile turrets one after another.
“Boom! Boom! Boom!”
Terrifying energy attacks continuously poured out.
In the sky, those Fallen Angels frantically diving down were constantly hit by beams of light, falling from the sky in large patches.
Even powerful Fallen Angels found it difficult to withstand the power of these Smart Weapon.
However... facing such terrifying casualties,
the Angel Race did not flinch in the slightest.
Under Lufa’s command,
almost all remaining Fallen Angels in the entire divine kingdom charged toward the direction where Yang Eleven was.
The number was simply too great.
It was as if they were endless.
Even with the blessing of Mechanical Civilization weapons, the casualties of the zombie army continued to increase.
“General,”
“would you allow us to host the Zombie Tide Dance Formation?”
a believer of the White Zombie rank said in a deep voice.
“These Angel Race believers possess a natural resistance to the zombie virus.”
“The effect of the flesh disaster hive is limited.”
“If this continues, the losses will probably grow larger and larger.”
Hearing this, Yang Eleven directly shook his head.
“Unnecessary.”
“In the Zombie Kingdom, every single one of you holds immense value.”
“Your most important task is to condense the corpse pill.”
“That is the resource truly needed by gods.”
“Continue to control the flesh disaster hive and fight while retreating.”
“Use the poisonous fog and the hive’s defensive abilities to delay their advance speed.”
“They won’t be able to hold on for much longer.”
Yang Eleven’s tone was firm.
Among ten thousand Zombie Kings, a White Zombie might not even necessarily be born.
As a war-type Intelligent Life, apart from considering victory or defeat on the battlefield, he also needed to consider the cost of war.
To consume precious White Zombie believers for short-term battle gains,
in his view, was not cost-effective.
“Is this Angel Race god’s brain problematic?”
“Seeing that I’m easy to bully, right?”
“If I were allowed to command the entire battlefield, I would have wiped you out long ago!”
Looking at the continuously charging Angel Race army, Yang Eleven frantically complained in his heart.
In this battle, because the Corpse Cultivation System was naturally countered by the Angel Race,
the battle results of the army he led were limited, but the losses were extremely heavy.
This sense of stifled grievance made Yang Eleven extremely uncomfortable.
“After going back...”
“I must apply to Yang Yi to purchase more cloning nutrient pods.”
“The Zombie Kingdom needs more fresh blood for replenishment.”
Yang Eleven secretly made up his mind.
As time passed,
the army led by Yang Four finally successfully occupied the core area of the Angel Race’s divine kingdom.
Without believers defending it, this area had almost no resistance.
The next moment,
an Intelligent Mecha walked up to the front of the Divine Kingdom Core, and its huge Mechanical arm reached directly deep into the earth.
Then, a huge crystal was slowly retrieved by it from underground.
That was... the Divine Kingdom Core of the Angel Race god.
A full hundred zhang high, it looked like a small building.
And at the exact moment the Divine Kingdom Core was controlled,
a figure slowly emerged.
It was none other than the Angel Race god—Lufa.
However, to Yang Fan’s surprise,
even though his Divine Kingdom Core was controlled by the enemy, there was not the slightest panic on Lufa’s face; instead, he carried a relief-like calmness.
As if he had been waiting for this moment for a long time.
“Human race god, I have lost.”
Lufa slowly spoke.
“Before death comes, I wonder if...”
“I might meet everyone?”
His voice was very calm.
Although Yang Fan was in his own divine kingdom,
relying on his believers, he clearly heard the other party’s words.
“Yang Da, if I meet him,”
“does he still have the ability to transmit information to the outside world right now?”
Yang Fan asked.
This Divine Kingdom War had lasted for so long.
Although he hadn’t used all his trump cards, his own divine kingdom troops had all been displayed on the battlefield.
He didn’t want his identity to be grasped by an Alien God.
“Reporting to Master, the other party’s Divine Kingdom Core has been completely controlled.”
“His consciousness cannot leave to transmit any information to the outside world.”
Yang Da responded respectfully.
Hearing this, Yang Fan finally set his mind at ease.
The next moment,
his consciousness followed the spatial channel established by his believers, instantly descending to the location of the Angel Race’s Divine Kingdom Core.
Lufa stood there quietly.
Seeing Yang Fan appear, he didn’t speak immediately.
He just silently gazed at Yang Fan, as if waiting for something.
“Angel Race god,”
Yang Fan looked at him.
“what is the purpose of seeing this deity?”
His voice was calm.
Lufa furrowed his brows slightly.
“The other few...”
“why haven’t they shown themselves?”

chapters.title: Chapter 391: I Curse You All
paragraphs: Hearing these words, Yang Fan’s heart suddenly tightened.
“The other gods?”
“What do you mean?”
A trace of tension and doubt appeared on Yang Fan’s face.
“There are other gods?”
“Impossible.”
If other gods were truly involved in this Divine Kingdom War,
as one of the parties in the war, Yang Fan couldn’t possibly be completely unaware.
Yet up until now, he hadn’t felt anything unusual at all.
Yang Fan looked at Lufa in front of him, his gaze gradually growing suspicious.
For a moment, he didn’t know what kind of tricks this defeated Angel Race god was trying to play.
“Good, good, good...”
Lufa looked at Yang Fan in front of him and suddenly burst out laughing.
Except there was not a trace of joy in this laughter.
All that was in it was unwilling resentment and irony.
“I heard long ago in my clan that you Human race have strict hierarchies.”
“Those gods from big Clan backgrounds have their eyes above their heads and completely look down on ordinary gods.”
“Seeing it today... it is indeed so.”
Lufa glared intently at Yang Fan.
At this moment, the anger and helplessness in his eyes ultimately turned into a thread of bitter unwillingness.
“If I had known it would turn out like this...”
“No matter what, I should have saved my Subordinate God back then.”
Thinking of this, Lufa’s heart was filled with regret.
If he hadn’t given up on that Subordinate God back then, perhaps things wouldn’t have reached this point today.
Yang Fan’s brows creased slightly; he always felt the other party had misunderstood something.
But thinking carefully, he hadn’t really said anything, had he?
Why did this Angel Race god look like Yang Fan owed him millions?
“Before I die, I have only one question.”
Lufa took a deep breath and spoke in a deep voice.
“Speak.”
Yang Fan nodded.
“What feud do I have with you?”
Lufa stared fixedly at Yang Fan.
“Why were you willing to pay such a huge price?”
“To use such a massive favor,”
“and insist on destroying my Divine Kingdom?”
Lufa’s voice was filled with bewilderment.
As a god,
Lufa’s brain had long been developed to the extreme, and tens of thousands of years of memories were crystal clear.
He was certain he had never met Yang Fan before and couldn’t possibly have any grievances with him.
But... everything before his eyes was completely unexplainable.
In order to breach his Divine Kingdom, the war buildings the Mechanical god behind him deployed were already worth enough to buy several of his lives.
Such vast war Resources,
just to destroy him?
What on earth was the point of this?
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s expression instantly turned peculiar.
“Is there something wrong with your head?”
“Of course it’s for your Divine Kingdom Core.”
“What else could it be for?”
Hearing this sentence, Lufa froze completely on the spot.
The next second, his eyes widened dramatically.
“Divine Kingdom Core?”
“What did you say?”
“You did all this for my Divine Kingdom Core?”
Lufa’s voice raised sharply.
“The Mechanical god behind you lost so many war buildings!”
“And you tell me...”
“All of this was just for my Divine Kingdom Core?”
“Do you think I’ll believe that?”
“Do you take me for a fool?”
By the end of his words, Lufa’s eyes were nearly tearing at the sockets.
Looking at his expression, it was as if he wanted to pounce right up and devour Yang Fan whole.
When a person is about to die, their words are usually kind.
He had thought that before dying, he could at least learn the true reason.
But he never expected... to get an answer like this.
Hearing this, Yang Fan finally realized what was going on.
So... this guy had been thinking all along that he brought a gang of gods to launch a group invasion?
No wonder he had been speaking so strangely since earlier.
Yang Fan was silent for a moment, then asked tentatively:
“Do you know the Divine Kingdom coordinates of other gods?”
As his words fell, the entire space instantly fell silent.
Lufa was stunned, and Yang Fan was stunned too.
The two looked at each other, and an inexplicable awkwardness suddenly filled the air.
A moment later, the corner of Lufa’s mouth twitched violently.
“Are you... making fun of me?”
Yang Fan hurriedly shook his head.
“No, I’m just asking casually.”
“After all, every month I deduce nearly a hundred Demigod Divine Kingdom coordinates.”
“But the success rate is too low.”
“If you know the coordinates of other gods, it would indeed be helpful to me.”
Lufa: “...”
Yang Fan continued earnestly:
“You might not believe it if I say it,”
“but you are actually the first god I’ve ever fought.”
“This battle made me realize that ordinary gods like you don’t seem that strong.”
“So I was thinking of speeding up my invasion pace.”
What Yang Fan said was completely from the heart.
But... falling into Lufa’s ears, these words took on a completely different meaning.
“Heh... hehe...”
Lufa suddenly laughed.
“You despicable human taking the Corpse Cultivator route.”
“If you want to kill or slice me, do as you please.”
“Are you still here trying to humiliate me?”
Yang Fan: “...”
What did he mean by taking the Corpse Cultivator route?
When did he ever become a Corpse Cultivator?
“Do you really not know the coordinates of other gods?”
Yang Fan still hadn’t given up.
“I can treat you to a meal.”
“You’re going to die soon anyway.”
“The coordinates of other gods won’t be of any use to you anymore, right?”
However, upon hearing this, Lufa’s face turned even uglier.
“Don’t you dare mock me!”
The next instant, he suddenly raised his right hand, pointing towards the sky.
“You Human race aristocrats!”
“I curse you all!”
“One day! You will end up just like me!”
“Your Divine Kingdoms destroyed! Your cores stolen!”
“Hahaha...”
After speaking, a final trace of madness flashed through Lufa’s eyes.
Then, his right hand slammed violently down on his own crown.
Boom!
His Divine Soul, which was already extremely weak, shattered in an instant.
His consciousness dissipated, falling completely.
On the spot, only Yang Fan remained alone.
He stood there with a look of complete bewilderment.
“This guy...”
“Who on earth is he cursing?”
Yang Fan looked up at the sky and muttered softly in a low voice.
“And... his mental resilience is way too poor.”
“He’s not even as good as Qi Tian, that monkey.”
After complaining, Yang Fan’s consciousness instantly returned to his own Divine Kingdom.
“Yang Da.”
Yang Fan spoke up.
“Arrange for Yang Er to lead the Otherworldly Collectors into the enemy’s Divine Kingdom.”
“Move back all valuable Resources.”
“Especially those high-tier Angel Race buildings.”
“Understood, Master.”
Yang Da replied respectfully.
For the current Yang Fan,
among the Resources in the Angel Race Divine Kingdom, what was truly valuable was not those ordinary Resources, but those high-tier Divine Kingdom buildings.
Although these buildings didn’t have much of a function for Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom,
this didn’t mean they were useless.
Because to earn military merit, these alien high-tier buildings were the true main bulk.
One should know that killing an Foreign Deity only yielded around ten million military merit.
But an S-Level alien building, after being turned in, could be exchanged for military merit far exceeding the value of killing the god itself.
And this military merit could then be exchanged for top-tier S-Rank Buildings that Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom needed.

Looking at his expression, it was as if he wanted to pounce right up and devour Yang Fan whole.
When a person is about to die, their words are usually kind.
He had thought that before dying, he could at least learn the true reason.
But he never expected... to get an answer like this.
Hearing this, Yang Fan finally realized what was going on.
So... this guy had been thinking all along that he brought a gang of gods to launch a group invasion?
No wonder he had been speaking so strangely since earlier.
Yang Fan was silent for a moment, then asked tentatively:
“Do you know the Divine Kingdom coordinates of other gods?”
As his words fell, the entire space instantly fell silent.
Lufa was stunned, and Yang Fan was stunned too.
The two looked at each other, and an inexplicable awkwardness suddenly filled the air.
A moment later, the corner of Lufa’s mouth twitched violently.
“Are you... making fun of me?”
Yang Fan hurriedly shook his head.
“No, I’m just asking casually.”
“After all, every month I deduce nearly a hundred Demigod Divine Kingdom coordinates.”
“But the success rate is too low.”
“If you know the coordinates of other gods, it would indeed be helpful to me.”
Lufa: “...”
Yang Fan continued earnestly:
“You might not believe it if I say it,”
“but you are actually the first god I’ve ever fought.”
“This battle made me realize that ordinary gods like you don’t seem that strong.”
“So I was thinking of speeding up my invasion pace.”
What Yang Fan said was completely from the heart.
But... falling into Lufa’s ears, these words took on a completely different meaning.
“Heh... hehe...”
Lufa suddenly laughed.
“You despicable human taking the Corpse Cultivator route.”
“If you want to kill or slice me, do as you please.”
“Are you still here trying to humiliate me?”
Yang Fan: “...”
What did he mean by taking the Corpse Cultivator route?
When did he ever become a Corpse Cultivator?
“Do you really not know the coordinates of other gods?”
Yang Fan still hadn’t given up.
“I can treat you to a meal.”
“You’re going to die soon anyway.”
“The coordinates of other gods won’t be of any use to you anymore, right?”
However, upon hearing this, Lufa’s face turned even uglier.
“Don’t you dare mock me!”
The next instant, he suddenly raised his right hand, pointing towards the sky.
“You Human race aristocrats!”
“I curse you all!”
“One day!
You will end up just like me!”
“Your Divine Kingdoms destroyed!
Your cores stolen!”
“Hahaha...”
After speaking, a final trace of madness flashed through Lufa’s eyes.
Then, his right hand slammed violently down on his own crown.
Boom!
His Divine Soul, which was already extremely weak, shattered in an instant.
His consciousness dissipated, falling completely.
On the spot, only Yang Fan remained alone.
He stood there with a look of complete bewilderment.
“This guy...”
“Who on earth is he cursing?”
Yang Fan looked up at the sky and muttered softly in a low voice.
“And... his mental resilience is way too poor.”
“He’s not even as good as Qi Tian, that monkey.”
After complaining, Yang Fan’s consciousness instantly returned to his own Divine Kingdom.
“Yang Da.”
Yang Fan spoke up.
“Arrange for Yang Er to lead the Otherworldly Collectors into the enemy’s Divine Kingdom.”
“Move back all valuable Resources.”
“Especially those high-tier Angel Race buildings.”
“Understood, Master.”
Yang Da replied respectfully.
For the current Yang Fan,
among the Resources in the Angel Race Divine Kingdom, what was truly valuable was not those ordinary Resources, but those high-tier Divine Kingdom buildings.
Although these buildings didn’t have much of a function for Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom,
this didn’t mean they were useless.
Because to earn military merit, these alien high-tier buildings were the true main bulk.
One should know that killing an Foreign Deity only yielded around ten million military merit.
But an S-Level alien building, after being turned in, could be exchanged for military merit far exceeding the value of killing the god itself.
And this military merit could then be exchanged for top-tier S-Rank Buildings that Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom needed.

chapters.title: Chapter 392: Finally Dead
paragraphs: After dealing with the matters of the Angel Race Divine Kingdom,
Yang Fan finally turned his attention back to the return gift Lu Yanran gave him.
With a thought, the 100,000 Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests instantly transformed into streaks of light, beginning to distribute everywhere across Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
Boom!
Accompanied by the simultaneous operation of the 100,000 Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests,
the Spiritual Qi of the entire Divine Kingdom began to churn violently at this moment.
The Spiritual Qi, concentrated to the extreme, even faintly showed a trend of liquefying.
One had to admit that Lu Yanran, this mother-in-law of his, was truly generous with her actions.
Looking across the entire Human Federation, absolute few people could casually pull out 100,000 Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests.
However, for the current Yang Fan, his heart did not feel too much surprise.
After all... possessing the channel of the Dark Web.
If he was truly willing to purchase without holding back, it would not take long to get 100,000 Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests either.
Furthermore, his Divine Kingdom was currently under a thousand-fold returns.
The growth rate of Divinity Points had already reached a terrifying degree.
The current Yang Fan was even starting to consider a problem.
That was... how on earth these Divinity Points should be spent.
Continue investing in Yang Corporation?
It was not that Yang Fan was unwilling.
But within a short period, he had already invested two hundred trillion Divinity Points.
If he continued large-scale capital injection, it would easily arouse the suspicion of interested parties.
After all, the source of the Divinity Points was a problem.
This did not align with Yang Fan’s consistent principle of low-profile development.
” Forget it. “
” Earth Core Spirit Milk itself is a scarce resource of the entire Human Federation. “
” The higher the yield, the better. “
” In the future, even without continuing to directly inject capital into Yang Corporation, supported by these Resources, the company’s development speed will not be slow. “
Yang Fan said in a low voice.
Afterwards, his gaze landed on another building within the card.
S-Rank Building — — Tianchi.
With a thought, a brilliant light flew out from the card.
The next moment,
a huge pool of water slowly descended into one of the Heavenly Courts.
Boom!
The moment the building landed, information about this building immediately surfaced in Yang Fan’s mind.
[ S-Rank Building: Tianchi ]

[ Introduction: A special Cultivation building nurtured by spiritual energy of heaven and earth, containing special marrow-cleansing divine liquid inside, which can help life improve its own Foundation. ]
[ Effect 1: Marrow Cleansing and Body Washing ]
Entering Tianchi to Cultivate can clear impurities from the body, strengthen the Physical Body Origin, and greatly enhance Cultivation Aptitude.
The effect is best for low-tier believers, helping ordinary life transform into Genius-level life.
[ Effect 2: Stabilize Dao Foundation ]
After cultivators break through Realms, they can enter Tianchi to stabilize their own Foundation, reducing the hidden dangers brought by unstable Realms.
[ Effect 3: Spiritual Body Awakening ]
Using Tianchi for long-term Cultivation has an extremely low probability of activating hidden bloodlines and Awakening special Physiques.
[ Remarks: Tianchi is an object of heaven and earth creation, incomparable to ordinary spiritual springs, and can be used as a building for cultivating core believers. ]
After reading the effects, Yang Fan did not feel too much excitement.
Even feeling... somewhat of a tasteless option.
” If this thing was obtained in the Early Stage of Divine Kingdom development, “
” the effect would indeed be terrifying. “
” but right now... “
Yang Fan shook his head.
His current Divine Kingdom had already evolved for an unknown number of years.
Believers reproduced generation after generation.
Through natural selection, the newly born believers already had talents reaching an extremely high level, completely having no need for so-called marrow cleansing and body washing.
As for stabilizing the Foundation...
Yang Fan was even more speechless.
Which of his high-tier believers did not enjoy Cultivation nurtured by top-tier Resources?
Cultivators in the Heavenly Court had Spirit Stones supplied without limit.
When breaking through Realms, they could even use top-tier Resources like Earth Core Spirit Milk.
Their Cultivation path had always relied on piling up massive top-tier Resources.
Their Foundation had long been stabilized to the extreme.
There was fundamentally no issue of pushing success by rushing it.
” Forget it. “
” It still has some use after all. “
” In the future, let us just treat it as a place for believers to relax, entertain, and take a bath. “
Yang Fan smiled.
” There is also no need to sell it. “
” Anyway, now and in the future, there is a high probability that I will not lack Divinity Points anymore. “
Thinking of this, Yang Fan could not help but sigh with emotion.
Along with the continuous Evolution of his SSS-rank Talent,
he felt that he... might truly never be able to return to those days of the past.
That meticulous budgeting for tens of thousands or hundreds of thousands of Faith Points.
Taking out loans for Resources.
That “good life” of striving desperately to improve a tiny bit of strength.
Thinking about it now, he actually felt somewhat nostalgic.
After all, the past self, although poor, had a clear goal every day.
And now the biggest annoyance had unexpectedly turned into — — having too many Divinity Points and not knowing how to spend them.
Yang Fan’s consciousness slowly returned to reality.
The next moment, he opened his eyes.
The familiar room came into view.
At this moment, Lu Wan was still quietly lying in his arms, sleeping very sweetly.
Looking at the beauty in his arms, the corners of Yang Fan’s mouth could not help but curve into a hint of a smile.
This Divine Kingdom War of the Angel Race had not passed very long for the Real World.
After all, several months in the Divine Kingdom,
in the Real World, was nothing more than taking a nap.
Slaying an Foreign Deity alone was enough to become a boastful battle record for any God at the frontline.
But Yang Fan did not produce any emotions of pride and self-complacency because of this.
Even in the Real World, he did not show any abnormalities.
No celebration, no showing off.
He still quietly stayed in Lu Wan’s villa.
The development of the Divine Kingdom was managed comprehensively by Yang Da.
The expansion of Yang Corporation was managed by Ma Yu.
The current Yang Fan, on the contrary, rare-foundly began to enjoy his own life.
During the day, he lay in the courtyard, enjoying massages from intelligent robots and basking in the warm sunlight.
Waiting for Lu Wan to finish work and return.
When evening came, the two ate dinner together.
Afterwards, Yang Fan would take Lu Wan back to the room to carry out ‘work’.
The days were plain, yet full of happiness.
During this period of time, Li Tianheng was not idle either.
New Subordinate God Contracts and Divine Kingdom Cores were continuously sent into Yang Fan’s hands.
Just like before, Yang Fan chose to sign all of these Subordinate God Contracts.
Ever since Gu Xuanting told him that possessing fifty or sixty Subordinate Gods at the same time would not attract too much attention,
Yang Fan relaxed some restrictions; he directly had Li Tianheng increase the original cost basis by another five percent.
The purpose was only one: to attract more demigods to actively sign Subordinate God Contracts.
After all, for the current Yang Fan, he lacked no Divinity Points at all.
What he wanted were Divine Kingdom Cores and the coordinates of gods.
As for those Divine Kingdom Cores sent by Li Tianheng, Yang Fan collected all of them into his own Divine Kingdom.
Yang Da first purchased divine kingdom deduction cards to conduct coordinate deduction.
Yang Fan prepared to wait until the land reclamation of the Angel Race Divine Kingdom ended before absorbing them together.
Time slowly passed, and another ten days went by.
On this day, Yang Fan received messages from both Ma Mian and Niu Tou at the same time.
The demigods in the Alien Divine Realm Zone they challenged had finally died!

chapters.title: Chapter 393: Harvest of War
paragraphs: The moment he saw the message, Yang Fan’s eyes lit up slightly.
Finally, it was a success.
The divine kingdoms of these demigods in the Alien Divine Realm Zone had areas infinitely close to one hundred million square kilometers.
To completely poison them to death, the number of corpse pills required grew almost exponentially.
Even so, the goal was ultimately achieved successfully.
Subsequently, Ma Mian and Niu Tou purchased a large number of Otherworldly Collectors from the Divine Shop as planned, and installed high-definition camera equipment on them.
Once the data from these Otherworldly Collectors was linked to Yang Yi, the pioneering work officially began.
Throughout the entire process, Yang Fan still did not need to pay personal attention.
Yang Yi was fully capable of coordinating everything.
He believed that very soon, a batch of high-quality Divine Kingdom Cores would appear in his divine kingdom.
At this thought, Yang Fan took a deep breath, an expectant look naturally appearing in his eyes.
The Human Divine Kingdom Cores possessed by these demigods in the academy’s Alien Divine Realm Zone all belonged to former human geniuses.
The last time he absorbed those Divine Kingdom Cores, he had directly obtained an S-rank Talent—Growth of All Things.
It was precisely because of this talent that the development speed of his divine kingdom had experienced a massive boost.
Otherwise, neither the currently massive Yang Corporation...
...nor the countless resource industries within his divine kingdom could have developed to their current scale.
“I wonder...”
“...after the next batch of Divine Kingdom Cores is absorbed,”
“what kind of improvements they will bring me.”
Leaning back in his massage chair, Yang Fan gazed at the sky outside the window, his mind filled with a myriad of thoughts.
Even he himself began to look forward to his next transformation.
Five more days passed in the Real World.
Over the past few days, Yang Fan, who was staying at the Lu Family Villa, had relaxed a bit too much.
With Lu Wan’s company, smart robots taking care of his daily life, and a plethora of the latest virtual entertainment activities...
...he even felt himself becoming a bit ‘decadent.’
He spent most of his time every day enjoying a leisurely life.
However, Yang Fan quickly realized something was wrong.
Although his strength was currently rising extremely fast, his understanding of Divine Kingdom Wars was still lacking.
Especially after becoming a true deity.
He had somewhat seriously overestimated his opponents’ strength.
Therefore, Yang Fan began to actively adjust his state of mind over these past few days.
Every day, he would set aside a few hours to enter the Virtual World.
He read a vast number of books on Divine Kingdom Wars, alien civilizations, and war command.
He continuously refined his own knowledge system.
After all, while improving one’s strength was indeed important...
...a truly powerful deity could not rely solely on brute force.
On this day, Yang Fan was studying in the Virtual World.
Suddenly, Yang Da’s voice echoed in his mind.
“Master, the pioneering work in the Angel Race’s divine kingdom has been completely finished.”
Upon hearing the voice, Yang Fan’s consciousness instantly exited the Virtual World.
The next moment.
His consciousness descended into his own divine kingdom.
Inside the Divine Kingdom Great Hall.
All the intelligent lifeform responsible for managing the divine kingdom had gathered.
From Yang Yi to Yang Eleven, they stood in neat rows on both sides.
And Ling Xuzi, who was Yang Fan’s Subordinate God, also stood respectfully to the side.
By now, the pioneering work in the Angel Race’s divine kingdom had completely concluded.
All transportable Resources had been fully gathered into Yang Fan’s divine kingdom.
“Reporting to Master,”
“Within the Angel Race’s Divine Kingdom War zone, all participating believers have fully returned, and the pioneering work is complete.”
“Aside from the Divine Kingdom Core of the Angel Race deity,”
“...we have seized a total of S-Rank Buildings: [Sacred Glow Angel Altar x5], [Fallen Sacred Wing Crucible x3], and [Angelic Holy Judgment Hall x5].”
“A-Rank Buildings: [Angel Prayer Sanctuary x1678], [Radiant Feather Life Pool x2768]...”
“In addition, there is a vast number of B-rank and C-rank buildings, which are still being tallied.”
Just as Yang Da finished speaking...
...Yang Yi stepped forward.
“Master, the cleanup of the Divine Kingdom Battlefield that you previously assigned me to supervise has also been fully completed.”
“The two Human Demigods, Ma Mian and Niu Tou, did not engage in any improper behavior.”
“Currently, we have obtained: one Dark Elf Race Divine Kingdom Core and one Sky-Sea Demon Race Divine Kingdom Core.”
“Additionally, from the storage vaults in their Divine Kingdom Core areas, we discovered and seized a total of fourteen Human Demigod Divine Kingdom Cores.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s eyes lit up slightly.
These Human Demigods themselves were top-tier geniuses, and their divine kingdom talents were of extremely high value to him.
Yang Yi continued,

“The S-Rank Building harvest is as follows: ten Great Void Warships, forty Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests, ten S-Rank Deep Sea Warships, one S-Rank Shadow Ancient Spirit Tree, one S-Rank Sea Demon Tide Palace, and one S-Rank Abyssal Dragon Palace.”
“According to Master’s instructions, the remaining A-rank, B-rank, and other building Resources have been gifted to Ma Mian and Niu Tou via the Otherworldly Collectors.”
After listening to the report, Yang Fan nodded with satisfaction.
As expected of the top academy’s Alien Divine Realm Zone; the Resources left behind by these demigods were indeed abundant.
He was especially impatient to absorb those Divine Kingdom Cores.
To see exactly what new talents he could obtain.
“Very well.”
Yang Fan looked at everyone.
“In this Angel Race Divine Kingdom War, everyone will be rewarded.”
“Especially Yang Yi, you were responsible for coordinating the allocation of all Resources in the divine kingdom, and your contribution to this war is indispensable.”
“I reward you with the discretionary use of 10 billion Divinity Points. You may purchase Mechanical Hearts on your own to enhance your strength.”
“The other intelligent lifeform will each be rewarded with 500 Mechanical Hearts.”
As Yang Fan’s voice fell, everyone from Yang Yi to Yang Eleven dropped to one knee.
“Thank you for the reward, Master!”
They responded in unison.
The other intelligent lifeform had no complaints whatsoever regarding Yang Fan’s rewards.
Because they all knew very well that in this Divine Kingdom War against the Angel Race...
...they were not the ones who actually bore the immense pressure.
The entire course of the war was basically a complete steamroll.
Their commanders on the frontline only needed to execute basic combat modules.
But how a massive number of Intelligent Mecha were transported to the frontline, the scheduling of production in the divine kingdom, and how to coordinate various Resources...
...all of these matters were coordinated behind the scenes by Yang Yi.
In comparison, it was entirely reasonable for Yang Yi to receive a larger reward.
Just then, Yang Da continued reporting,
“Master, besides the spoils of war,”
“the current inventory of Alien Demigod Divine Kingdom Cores in the divine kingdom has reached over two hundred.”
“I have already selected a portion of Divine Kingdom Cores suitable for Ling Xuzi.”
“Currently, Ling Xuzi’s divine kingdom area has reached seventy million square kilometers.”
“At the current rate, it is estimated that before long, she will be able to make a breakthrough to the deity Realm.”
Hearing this, Ling Xuzi, who was standing nearby, quickly stepped forward and bowed respectfully, saying, ‘Thank you for your cultivation, Master.’
Yang Fan nodded with satisfaction.
“Make your breakthrough as soon as possible. The next time I launch a Divine Kingdom War, I hope your believers can play a greater role.”

“Additionally, from the storage vaults in their Divine Kingdom Core areas, we discovered and seized a total of fourteen Human Demigod Divine Kingdom Cores.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s eyes lit up slightly.
These Human Demigods themselves were top-tier geniuses, and their divine kingdom talents were of extremely high value to him.
Yang Yi continued,

“The S-Rank Building harvest is as follows: ten Great Void Warships, forty Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests, ten S-Rank Deep Sea Warships, one S-Rank Shadow Ancient Spirit Tree, one S-Rank Sea Demon Tide Palace, and one S-Rank Abyssal Dragon Palace.”
“According to Master’s instructions, the remaining A-rank, B-rank, and other building Resources have been gifted to Ma Mian and Niu Tou via the Otherworldly Collectors.”
After listening to the report, Yang Fan nodded with satisfaction.
As expected of the top academy’s Alien Divine Realm Zone; the Resources left behind by these demigods were indeed abundant.
He was especially impatient to absorb those Divine Kingdom Cores.
To see exactly what new talents he could obtain.
“Very well.”
Yang Fan looked at everyone.
“In this Angel Race Divine Kingdom War, everyone will be rewarded.”
“Especially Yang Yi, you were responsible for coordinating the allocation of all Resources in the divine kingdom, and your contribution to this war is indispensable.”
“I reward you with the discretionary use of 10 billion Divinity Points.
You may purchase Mechanical Hearts on your own to enhance your strength.”
“The other intelligent lifeform will each be rewarded with 500 Mechanical Hearts.”
As Yang Fan’s voice fell, everyone from Yang Yi to Yang Eleven dropped to one knee.
“Thank you for the reward, Master!”
They responded in unison.
The other intelligent lifeform had no complaints whatsoever regarding Yang Fan’s rewards.
Because they all knew very well that in this Divine Kingdom War against the Angel Race...
...they were not the ones who actually bore the immense pressure.
The entire course of the war was basically a complete steamroll.
Their commanders on the frontline only needed to execute basic combat modules.
But how a massive number of Intelligent Mecha were transported to the frontline, the scheduling of production in the divine kingdom, and how to coordinate various Resources...
...all of these matters were coordinated behind the scenes by Yang Yi.
In comparison, it was entirely reasonable for Yang Yi to receive a larger reward.
Just then, Yang Da continued reporting,
“Master, besides the spoils of war,”
“the current inventory of Alien Demigod Divine Kingdom Cores in the divine kingdom has reached over two hundred.”
“I have already selected a portion of Divine Kingdom Cores suitable for Ling Xuzi.”
“Currently, Ling Xuzi’s divine kingdom area has reached seventy million square kilometers.”
“At the current rate, it is estimated that before long, she will be able to make a breakthrough to the deity Realm.”
Hearing this, Ling Xuzi, who was standing nearby, quickly stepped forward and bowed respectfully, saying, ‘Thank you for your cultivation, Master.’
Yang Fan nodded with satisfaction.
“Make your breakthrough as soon as possible.
The next time I launch a Divine Kingdom War, I hope your believers can play a greater role.”

chapters.title: Chapter 394: Preparing to Expand the Divine Kingdom's Area
paragraphs: Yang Fan looked at Yang Da and continued.
“Purchase more Resources suitable for the Void Spirit Race to Cultivate.”
“Nurturing Ling Xuzi to break through to godhood is to raise even more powerful Void Spirit Race believers.”
“This subordinate understands.”
Yang Da immediately responded.
“Rest assured, Master. After this period of resource investment,”
“within the Void Spirit Race, quite a few Foundation Establishment Realm believers have already been born.”
“In the future, as Resources continue to be invested, the growth rate of the Void Spirit Race will further increase.”
For the development of a Divine Kingdom, Resources are always the primary factor.
Under Yang Fan’s support, Ling Xuzi’s Divine Kingdom was no longer the weak Divine Kingdom of the past that couldn’t even guarantee its believers’ basic needs.
Now, everything had undergone earth-shattering changes.
Now, with the support of the Breeding Card, the number of Ling Xuzi’s believers had already broken through ten billion.
And these believers did not need to undertake any production work at all.
All Resources were supplied uniformly by Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
The only thing they needed to do every day was Cultivate.
Furthermore, they cultivated under an unlimited supply of Spirit Stones and spiritual liquid.
Looking across the entire Human Federation, probably not many gods could be so extravagant.
Even Ling Xuzi himself could clearly feel the massive changes in his Divine Kingdom every month.
All of this... was forcefully smashed out using a massive amount of Divinity Points.
Without having to personally participate in Divine Kingdom Wars, he could obtain precious Divine Kingdom Cores.
Cultivation Resources were even more inexhaustible.
Under such circumstances, even for a demigod with extremely ordinary talent,
Yang Fan had the confidence to forcefully pull them up to the Realm of a god.
“The rest of you may dismiss first.”
“Before discovering the coordinates of a new god’s Divine Kingdom, everyone should continue to cooperate with each other, focusing primarily on developing believers.”
Yang Fan ordered.
“Yes, Master.”
Everyone responded respectfully and then left the main hall one after another.
Soon, in the entire Divine Kingdom’s main hall, only Yang Fan and Yang Da were left.
Yang Fan waved his hand.
In the next moment, a large number of Divine Kingdom Cores appeared out of thin air.
The largest among them was, of course, the Divine Kingdom Core left behind by the Angel Race god, Lufa.
It was a full hundred Zhang high, like a small building, emitting powerful fluctuations of Origin.
As for the remaining demigod-level Divine Kingdom Cores, their sizes were obviously much smaller.
The largest of them were the Divine Kingdom Cores left behind by the demigods of the Dark Elf Race and the Sky-Sea Demon Race.
Following closely behind were the Divine Kingdom Cores of Human race Geniuses captured from their Divine Kingdoms.
As for the rest, they were the Divine Kingdom Cores that Yang Fan had collected through Li Tianheng and a large number of Subordinate Gods on the frontline.
These cores varied in size; the large ones were as high as a The Imp, while the small ones were even only the size of a fist.
Looking at the mountain of Divine Kingdom Cores before him, Yang Fan was in no hurry to absorb them.
Instead, he turned his gaze to Yang Da.
“First, upload the information of the Angel Race’s Divine Kingdom to the military merit system on the frontline.”
“Once the military merit is confirmed, we will proceed to the next step.”
“Yes, Master.”
Yang Da nodded.
In the next moment, his eyes lit up instantly.
A blue light shot out, beginning to rapidly scan the Divine Kingdom Cores in front of him.
In just a single breath, a large amount of information regarding the Angel Race’s Divine Kingdom had been compiled.
Subsequently, it was uploaded to the Human race’s military merit system on the frontline.
A moment later, Yang Da spoke.
“Master, the military merit system has completed the confirmation.”
“For killing the Angel Race god Lufa this time, we have obtained ten million military merits.”
Yang Fan was slightly taken aback. “So fast?”
Yang Da explained:
“To report to Master, the military merit system on the frontline itself is also audited and has merits distributed by intelligent lifeform.”
“Faced with such a massive volume of data processing, the intelligent lifeform responsible for maintaining the military merit system is likely of an extremely high Level.”
“It might at least reach the ninth-Level intelligent lifeform.”
“A ninth-Level intelligent lifeform...”
A trace of anticipation flashed in Yang Fan’s eyes.
“One day, my Divine Kingdom will also give birth to such an existence.”
Hearing this, Yang Da showed a look of confidence.
“Rest assured, Master. With the Resources of the Divine Kingdom being so abundant now,”
“the development speed of the Mechanical Civilization will surely far exceed other routes.”
“Coupled with the SSS-Rank Evolution Talent,”
“this subordinate believes that in the future, we won’t even need to wait for the Divine Kingdom’s area to expand to the level of a High-Order God.”
“Within the Divine Kingdom, it is possible for a ninth-Level intelligent lifeform to be born.”
According to the development route of ordinary gods,
“one needs to constantly make investments in the Divine Kingdom, using the Resources obtained from investments to improve the strength of the believers.”
“Then, through Divine Kingdom Wars, plunder the Divine Kingdom Cores of other gods.”
“Expanding step by step and growing step by step, the combat power of the believers will match the area of the Divine Kingdom.”
“As for gods of the Mechanical Route, they require an even longer time of accumulation.”
“Under normal circumstances, to allow the Divine Kingdom to give birth to a seventh-Level intelligent lifeform,”
“the area of the Divine Kingdom would highly likely need to break through seventy billion square kilometers.”
“Because only with a sufficiently vast Divine Kingdom area can it accommodate a sufficient number of believers.”
“Possessing a massive population base, and then continuously investing Resources over a long period of development, can finally allow the intelligent lifeform to break through its bottleneck.”
“But Yang Fan was different.”
“The SSS-Rank Evolution Talent allowed his Divine Kingdom to have a hundred-fold time flow rate.”
“Even though his current Divine Kingdom area could not yet compare with those of High-Order Gods,”
“on the dimension of time, it completely crushed them.”
“One must know that even for a ninth-order god, their Divine Kingdom area was merely nine times that of Yang Fan’s current Divine Kingdom area.”
“But the speed of Time Evolution differed by a full hundred-fold.”
“Of course.”
“This premise was... that the opponent’s Divine Kingdom Talent had nothing to do with time.”
“Precisely because of this, Yang Da was so confident.”
“After contemplating for a moment, Yang Fan looked at Yang Da.”
“Keep up the hard work.”
“While the Divine Kingdom’s own development is indeed important, next, we also need to change our strategy.”
Yang Fan said slowly.
“From now on, I will increase the intensity of signing Subordinate God Contracts.”
“At the same time, I will obtain the Divine Kingdom coordinates of Foreign Deitys through more deductions, all to accelerate the expansion of the Divine Kingdom’s area.”
Speaking up to this point, Yang Fan’s gaze landed in the distance.
“Although the Evolution Talent is powerful, as the Divine Kingdom continues to develop, the growth speed of the believers’ overall strength will ultimately slow down gradually.”
“By that time, relying solely on internal development will become less and more efficient.”
“Next, we need to accelerate the expansion of the Divine Kingdom’s area, obtain more Resources, more believers, and stronger combat power!”
Hearing Yang Fan’s words.

chapters.title: Chapter 395: Han Family Military Prefecture's Business
paragraphs: After all... the larger the Divine Kingdom’s area,
the greater the number of believers it could accommodate, and the richer the Resources that could be born.
And for a Divine Kingdom with Evolution Talent, the last thing it needed to worry about was its development speed.
As long as the Divine Kingdom was given a large enough stage,
the number of believers, weapons of war, intelligent lifeform, and all kinds of buildings would complete their accumulation in an extremely short period of time.
What limited Yang Fan’s development now was no longer the believers’ own strength, but the Divine Kingdom’s area.
“Yang Da.”
Yang Fan looked aside and said,
“If all these alien buildings that my Divine Kingdom cannot use are exchanged for military merit, what suggestions do you have?”
Yang Da was already prepared.
“Reporting to Master.”
“Before you entered the Divine Kingdom, this subordinate had already checked the exchange prices of various alien buildings in the military merit system.”
“Among them, S-Rank Building exchange values are the highest.”
“For example, the [Holy Radiance Angel Altar] of the Angel Race can be exchanged for one million military merit.”
“The [Angel Holy Verdict Sanctuary] can be exchanged for 1.5 million military merit.”
“And the [S-Rank Deep Sea Warship] obtained from the Sky-Sea Demon Race Divine Kingdom can be exchanged for even two million military merit.”
Yang Da casually gave a few examples.
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s eyes lit up slightly.
“Can buildings looted from the Alien Divine Realm Zone also be exchanged?”
“Of course.”
Yang Da nodded.
“The military merit system does not check the specific origin of these buildings.”
“To it, all alien buildings are just Resources commodities.”
“The entire military merit system is more like a centralized trading mall established by the Han Family Military Prefecture.”
“Everyone exchanges according to a unified price.”
“The Han Family Military Prefecture is responsible for purchasing, while the frontline deities are responsible for selling.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan showed a look of sudden realization.
He only remembered then that when he was still in Primordial City,
he had obtained the [Eternal Corpse Mine] from the Undead Race Divine Kingdom.
The Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence had also suggested that he exchange it for military merit.
“Then what about A-rank and B-rank buildings?”
Yang Fan continued to ask.
“They can also be exchanged.”
Yang Da replied.
“However, the value will be much lower.”
“For example, the [Light Feather Life Pool] of the Angel Race can only be exchanged for 500 military merit.”
“Judging by the cost-effectiveness, it is not worth it.”
“According to this subordinate’s understanding, it is not just the military merit system of the Han Family Military Prefecture.”
“There are also quite a few shops on the frontline that will purchase these alien buildings.”
“Although they will not provide military merit, they will directly pay Divinity Points.”
“However, the transaction cost-effectiveness is often much higher than that of the military merit system.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan instantly lost interest and directly waved his hand.
“There is no need to be so troublesome.”
“Just bundle all those unusable alien buildings in the Divine Kingdom and exchange them for military merit.”
“Now that the Divine Kingdom investment system has been formed, Divinity Points are just a number to me.”
“What truly restricts my development are those top-tier S-Rank Buildings that can change the overall environment of the Divine Kingdom.”
“Yes, Master.”
Yang Da respectfully replied, “This subordinate will upload them immediately.”
The next moment, Yang Da moved his mind.
A large number of alien buildings piled up in a corner of the Divine Kingdom instantly turned into streams of light, all sealed into storage cards.
Immediately after, this building information was uploaded to the military merit system.
In just a short moment, the exchange was completed.
“Master.”
Yang Da brought up Yang Fan’s current military merit information, and a light screen was projected in the center of the Divine Kingdom’s main hall.
[Name: Yang Fan]
[Identity: Belonging to the Ninth Legion]
[Current Military Merit: 305.6 million]
Looking at his military merit quantity, Yang Fan frowned slightly.
Too little!
Over 300 million military merit seemed like a lot.
But when actually used, it simply couldn’t withstand consumption.

He had obtained 50 million military merit given by Lu Yanran, plus the 10 million military merit provided by the Gu Family every month, as well as the military merit rewards obtained from killing Alien Demigods during this period.
Before turning in those S-Rank Buildings, his military merit actually already exceeded 100 million.
But looking at it now, the military merit was still far from enough.
If they were all exchanged for top-tier S-Rank Buildings like [Heavenly Court], he could probably only buy about six of them.
Yang Fan’s eyes lit up as if he had thought of something.
“Yang Da, what do you think is the significance of the Han Family Military Prefecture establishing the military merit system?”
“Why not trade directly using Divinity Points? Instead, they additionally created a military merit currency?”
“And they also purchase these alien buildings in large quantities.”
“What are these buildings eventually used for by them?”
Yang Da was silent for a moment, then replied:
“Reporting to Master, on the Virtual World official website, there is no public information about this matter.”
“However, according to this subordinate’s analysis, this is very likely a huge business.”
“Business?” Yang Fan’s brows raised slightly.
“That’s right.”
Yang Da explained.
“For different deities, the value of the same building is not fixed.”
“Some buildings have extremely low value in certain divine kingdoms, or even have side effects.”
“But when changed to another divine kingdom system, they might become core Resources that change the direction of development.”
“Resources themselves have no absolute value; what truly determines value is demand.”
“As long as there is demand, transactions will naturally be born.”
“And as long as there is a huge trading market, someone will definitely profit from it.”
Yang Da’s voice was calm.
“In fact, many deities already have guesses about the ultimate flow of these high-tier alien buildings.”
“However, as one of the Five Great Families of the Human race, the Han Family Military Prefecture possesses huge influence.”
“For many things, even if there are guesses, no one dares to discuss them publicly.”
Speaking of this, Yang Da’s voice lowered slightly.
“This subordinate suspects that these acquired alien buildings may have eventually flowed to the aliens.”
“And a large amount of Divinity Points obtained from the transaction entered the Han Family Military Prefecture.”
Yang Fan’s eyes condensed slightly, “Aliens?”
“Yes.”
Yang Da nodded.
“Take the Dark Web for example; this is a trading channel.”
“However, how huge is the number of alien buildings confiscated every year in the entire frontline area.”
“Solely relying on the Dark Web, it is simply impossible to digest such huge Resources.”
“Therefore, this subordinate speculates.”
“As one of the Five Great Families, the Han Family Military Prefecture likely possesses more secretive and larger trading channels.”
“Even... maintaining long-term cooperation with certain alien forces.”
After listening to Yang Da’s analysis, Yang Fan narrowed his eyes slightly.
But after a moment, he figured out the key point in it.
Yang Da’s guess was probably close to the truth.
The war front, the war between the Human race and the alien races.
For those ordinary Divine Beings living on living planets,
it needs to be packaged as a racial dispute, requiring justice and glory.
It requires everyone to believe that the deities on the frontline are fighting for the future of the race.
But for those existences truly standing at high places...
this war ultimately could not escape the word “profit”.
Creating the military merit system and using it as a new wartime currency,
then utilizing the scarcity of top-tier buildings to make countless deities actively exchange their captured alien buildings for military merit at a relatively low price.
Everyone desperately accumulated military merit, solely to exchange for those core buildings that could change the development of their divine kingdoms.
As for the Han Family Military Prefecture, it controlled the largest trading channels, sitting back and enjoying the profits from within.

“However, how huge is the number of alien buildings confiscated every year in the entire frontline area.”
“Solely relying on the Dark Web, it is simply impossible to digest such huge Resources.”
“Therefore, this subordinate speculates.”
“As one of the Five Great Families, the Han Family Military Prefecture likely possesses more secretive and larger trading channels.”
“Even... maintaining long-term cooperation with certain alien forces.”
After listening to Yang Da’s analysis, Yang Fan narrowed his eyes slightly.
But after a moment, he figured out the key point in it.
Yang Da’s guess was probably close to the truth.
The war front, the war between the Human race and the alien races.
For those ordinary Divine Beings living on living planets,
it needs to be packaged as a racial dispute, requiring justice and glory.
It requires everyone to believe that the deities on the frontline are fighting for the future of the race.
But for those existences truly standing at high places...
this war ultimately could not escape the word “profit”.
Creating the military merit system and using it as a new wartime currency,
then utilizing the scarcity of top-tier buildings to make countless deities actively exchange their captured alien buildings for military merit at a relatively low price.
Everyone desperately accumulated military merit, solely to exchange for those core buildings that could change the development of their divine kingdoms.
As for the Han Family Military Prefecture, it controlled the largest trading channels, sitting back and enjoying the profits from within.

chapters.title: Chapter 396: Six Heavenly Courts
paragraphs: As for whether the other four families knew?
Yang Fan didn’t even need to think about it.
They definitely knew.
In fact, Yang Fan suspected that the other four families were probably involved as well.
Otherwise, he had only just arrived at the frontline.
How could the Gu Family so easily award him ten million military merit points every month?
To the Gu Family, those military merit points were like mere numbers.
Thinking up to this point, Yang Fan didn’t feel angry at all; instead, he felt it was somewhat to be expected.
This was just how the world worked.
Resources were always in the hands of a few.
The strong set the rules, while powerful families monopolized channels and Resources.
Then, through rules, they redistributed the profits.
Big fish eat little fish, and little fish eat shrimp.
This was an eternally unchanging law.
The so-called military merit System.
At the end of the day, it was nothing more than a more hidden form of the Federation’s tax System.
The only difference was that instead of ordinary Resources, it collected special wealth from war.
The only thing Yang Fan found somewhat ironic was...
Those demigods and Low-rank Deitys risked their lives fighting the foreign races,
Only for the precious buildings they ultimately reclaimed
To pass through certain channels and flow right back to the foreign races in the end.
The people at the bottom were still slaughtering each other with all their might.
The people at the top were still greedily devouring meat.
That was reality.
However, Yang Fan did not develop any resistance or resentment because of this.
Because he knew very clearly.
Right now, he was also a beneficiary of these rules.
In fact, he was reaping far more dividends than the vast majority of people.
Without the military merit System, if he wanted to obtain those top-tier S-Rank Buildings, he would also have to spend a tremendous amount of time and effort searching for them.
Now that someone had built a trading platform for him,
He only needed to trade Resources for what he needed, so why wouldn’t he be happy to do so?
“Hahaha!”
Thinking of this, Yang Fan suddenly burst out laughing.
To the side, Yang Da was somewhat confused. “Master, what is it?”
Yang Fan waved his hand.
“It’s nothing, I just suddenly realized...”
“Those endless Divinity Points in my divine kingdom finally have a place to be spent.”
Saying this, a faint smile appeared on Yang Fan’s face.
“The Han Family Military Prefecture is indeed turning a profit out of this.”
“But... who asked them to hold so many top-tier S-Rank Buildings in their hands?”
“As long as these things are useful to me,”
“What does it matter if I let them make a profit?”
“Besides, Divinity Points are just numbers to me now.”
Yang Fan looked at Yang Da and said seriously,
“From now on, start purchasing foreign S-Rank Buildings in large quantities during the subsequent Dark Web auctions.”
“As for which ones specifically to buy, compare prices in the military merit System beforehand.”
“Give priority to buildings with high cost-performance ratios.”
“Understood?”
Yang Da said with a hint of concern: “Master, transactions on the Dark Web are all conducted through auctions.”
“Even the most ordinary S-Rank Buildings often have their prices bid up to around ten times their market value.”
“Purchasing on such a large scale, won’t the cost be too high?”
After all, acquiring military merit this way was essentially converting Divinity Points into military merit.
If it were just buying a few buildings occasionally, it would be fine.
But if he relied on the Dark Web to farm military merit in the long term, no matter how many Divinity Points Yang Fan had, he couldn’t withstand such consumption.
In the end, massive amounts of Divinity Points would flow to the Han Family Military Prefecture through these transactions.
In Yang Da’s view, this was not a wise choice. After all, as the divine kingdom developed and believers grew, there were many places where Divinity Points needed to be spent.
“Do it first.”
“So what if the cost is high?”
There was no hint of hesitation on Yang Fan’s face.
“Right now, investments in my divine kingdom yield a thousandfold return.”
“Divinity Points are no longer my biggest issue.”
Saying this, Yang Fan paused briefly.
“However, you do have a point.”
“These foreign buildings will ultimately circulate through the channels of the Han Family Military Prefecture.”
“If my transaction volume is too absurdly high, it will inevitably draw their attention. There’s no need to expose too much.”
Yang Fan pondered for a moment and said,
“For now, cap the monthly purchasing volume within 20 trillion Divinity Points.”
“Yes, Master,” Yang Da responded respectfully.
“In addition,”
Yang Fan continued,
“Through the military merit System, purchase all available S-Rank Buildings—Heavenly Court.”
“Yes.”
Blue light flashed in Yang Da’s eyes as he rapidly connected to the military merit System.
A moment later, Yang Da confirmed,
“Master, for the S-Rank Building Heavenly Court, the exchange price for each is 50 million military merit.”
“Purchase requests have been submitted.”
“Purchase successful, transferring buildings.”
The moment his words fell,
Yang Fan felt six special cards suddenly appear inside his divine kingdom.
Sealed inside each card was an immensely vast Heavenly Court building.
With just a thought, he could load them directly.
Yang Fan didn’t hesitate at all.
Given the current size of his divine kingdom, even if six Heavenly Courts descended simultaneously, it was far from reaching its capacity limit.
And with the addition of new Heavenly Courts, those believers practicing Cultivation would have a much wider living space.
The large number of Cultivation believers who currently still lived in the City of Technology on the ground could finally all migrate inside.
This way, more space on the ground could be freed up for intelligent lifeform and believers on the Martial Route to develop.
“Load,” Yang Fan thought with a move of his mind.
The next moment,
The six cards simultaneously transformed into dazzling streams of light and shot into the sky of the divine kingdom.
Boom!!!
In an instant, the entire heaven and earth of the divine kingdom began to shake violently.
It was as if six new expanses of heaven and earth were slowly descending.
In the sky, endless streams of light intertwined.
Between heaven and earth, Spiritual Qi gathered crazily.
A massive amount of dense Spiritual Qi produced by the Spirit Veins and the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest seemed to be drawn by something at this moment, surging wildly toward the sky.
All at once, across the sky of the entire divine kingdom, spiritual mist churned, and glorious rays of light radiated in ten thousand directions.
Heaven and earth seemed to lose their original colors, leaving behind only an expanse of dazzling immortal light.
Right after, beside the original two Heavenly Courts,
Six brand-new Heavenly Courts began to slowly emerge.
They did not simply descend; instead, like colossal jigsaw puzzle pieces, they gradually connected with the original Heavenly Courts.
Countless palaces, immortal mountains, spiritual pools, and dojos materialized continuously.
In the sky, seas of clouds churned, enveloped in immortal fog.
Streams of Spiritual Qi turned into visible white currents, flowing between the Heavenly Courts.
It was as if the entire divine kingdom was transforming into a true immortal realm.
“Rumble!”
As the final Heavenly Court fully took shape,
Yang Fan clearly felt the Cultivation environment of the entire divine kingdom instantly improve.
The concentration of Spiritual Qi, the stability of rules, and even the affinity toward cultivators between heaven and earth all showed significant enhancements.
The overall environment had improved by a full twofold.
“As expected of top-tier S-Rank Buildings.”
A look of satisfaction flashed in Yang Fan’s eyes.
A building of Heavenly Court’s caliber was no longer merely enhancing a single category of believers.
Rather, it was altering the Cultivation environment of the entire divine kingdom.
Meanwhile, inside the divine kingdom,
Countless Cultivation believers also felt the changes in heaven and earth.
“The Heavenly Courts have opened!”
“New Heavenly Courts have appeared!”
“Our God has bestowed upon us new Holy Lands for Cultivation!”

chapters.title: Chapter 397: Noticed
paragraphs: In the next moment, a large number of Cultivation believers began to actively migrate.
Those Cultivators who had reached the Qi Refining Realm or above even flew straight into the sky.
Figure after figure streaked across the sky.
Like countless streams of light, they flew toward the newly born Heavenly Court.
They could not wait to find their own Cave Dwellings and better Cultivation dojos.
Many powerful believers had even begun moving from the original two Heavenly Courts to occupy positions with richer Spiritual Qi in advance.
As for those Cultivation believers who had just entered the ranks and had not yet mastered the ability to fly, they registered in an orderly manner under Yang Yi’s arrangement.
Then, they boarded F3500 fighter jets to travel to the new Heavenly Court areas.
A grand population migration unfolded within Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
However, this migration did not require Yang Fan to issue any orders at all.
Because to all Cultivation believers,
the Heavenly Court was the Holy Land they had always dreamed of.
The capacity of the only two original Heavenly Courts had long reached its limit.
Cave Dwellings, dojos, and even the open spaces within the Heavenly Courts had already been filled with various buildings.
Many Cultivation believers born later had no choice but to live in the technological cities on the ground.
Now, the descent of six brand-new Heavenly Courts was enough to accommodate the entire population of existing Cultivation believers.
It would even leave ample space for reproduction and development over the next thousands of years.
At this moment, after arriving at the Heavenly Courts, countless Cultivation believers immediately knelt on the ground.
They bowed devoutly toward the sky.
“Thank you, our God, for your blessings!”
“Gratitude to our God!”
“We will surely train diligently and not fail our God’s grace!”
“May our God be eternal!”
Meanwhile, in the innermost region of the Human race’s Frontline.
This place was far from the most intense areas of war, and it was also the region where many gods went into seclusion to develop and handle affairs.
Inside a simple yet highly technological room,
a young man sat upright at a desk.
On either side of him stood a sophisticatedly designed intelligent robot.
One of the intelligent robots was constantly flipping through books, projecting the important contents.
Meanwhile, the other robot was responsible for processing various data and documents.
The young man read while handling the affairs at hand.
His eyes moved constantly, and his brain barely paused.
The book projected on the left was titled “Essays on the Development of Cultivation Divine Kingdoms”.

It recorded various development experiences of believers under the Cultivation System, including Divine Kingdom Spiritual Qi planning, Cultivation Sect construction, Resource allocation, and training programs for high-level Cultivation believers.
On the right was a work log.
[Yesterday’s Frontline resource allocation completed.]
[The Ninth Legion applied for war building replenishment. A total of 37 A-Rank Buildings and 426 B-Rank Buildings have been approved.]
[Military Merit System audit record for yesterday: Completed 136,721 applications for alien building redemption.]
[Three abnormal military merit transactions detected, submitted for review.]
Dense data kept appearing.
Yet the young man just sat there quietly,
learning while working.
It was as if handling hundreds of things simultaneously was an easy task for him.
This person was none other than Han Jue, the Peerless Prodigy of the Han Family who had recently graduated from the Primordial Academy.
Just then, the notification sound of the intelligent lifeform suddenly rang in the room.
“Young Master Han Jue.”
“The development status of graduates from the Primordial Academy and Star Dome Academy in the past ten years, which you asked me to closely monitor, has currently triggered an orange alert.”
Hearing this, Han Jue stopped what he was doing.
“An orange alert?”
His brow furrowed slightly.
For the Han Family’s intelligent System to actively issue an orange alert meant that this person’s situation had already exceeded the scope of an ordinary Genius.
“Which family is it?” Han Jue asked.
“The Gu Family.”
Han Jue’s eyes flickered slightly. “Bring up the detailed information.”
“Yes.”
In the next moment,
the intelligent robot on his right instantly tensed up.
A pale blue light shot out from its body, projecting onto the wall of the room.
A large amount of information quickly emerged.
Han Jue’s originally calm face
finally showed a change as the information unfolded.
He could not even help but rub his eyes,
wearing a look of utter disbelief.
On the wall,
the detailed profile of a person was displayed.
[Name: Yang Fan]
[Identity: Primordial Academy Graduate]
[Affiliation: Gu Family]
[Recent Transaction Records...]
A vast amount of information kept lining up.
This included a batch of alien buildings that Yang Fan had just sold to the Han Family.
S-Rank Buildings, A-Rank Buildings, and a large number of ordinary buildings.
In addition, there were also the six S-Rank Buildings—the Heavenly Courts—that Yang Fan had redeemed through the Military Merit System.
But none of these were enough to shock Han Jue to this extent.
What truly made him lose his composure was the final piece of information.
[Personally submitted the Divine Kingdom Core information of an Foreign Deity.]
Seeing this line of words, Han Jue’s pupils suddenly contracted.
“It’s him!”
In the next moment, Han Jue abruptly stood up from his seat.
In his mind, a memory instantly surfaced.
In Primordial City, during his senior year.
In order to pull off something big, he had once entered the Level 3 area of the Alien Divine Realm Zone.
Preparing to challenge those most powerful Alien Demigods.
And it was there that he had met Yang Fan for the first time.
To obtain enough information to challenge the Alien Demigods in the Level 3 area,
Han Jue had spent a full one or two years investigating.
Analyzing the other party’s racial characteristics, researching the structure of their Divine Kingdom, and searching for the best conquest strategy.
But even so, he still had not made a move.
Because the risk was too great.
But what about Yang Fan?
Upon entering the Level 3 area for the first time, he had merely looked over some racial information before directly choosing the Vajra King Monkey.
What was most exaggerated was that,
not long after, Han Jue received news of Yang Fan’s successful conquest of the Vajra King Monkey’s Divine Kingdom.
At that time, Han Jue had developed an interest in Yang Fan and wanted to make friends with him.
However, Han Jue was engaged in battle with an Alien Demigod in the Level 2 area at the time and simply could not spare any time.
In the end, he still had his intelligent lifeform deliver a generous gift when the Gu Family held a banquet for Gu Chengye.
It could be considered as establishing good karma in advance.
Uploading the Divine Kingdom information of an Foreign Deity under a personal name—
what did this mean?
It meant that... Yang Fan, who had only recently broken through to become a god,
had successfully conquered an Alien First-Order God solely by relying on his own strength!
And it was without any external assistance whatsoever.
“How is that possible?”
“How on earth did he do it?”
“How did he dare to do this? Is he crazy?”
Countless questions flashed through Han Jue’s mind.
Han Jue himself was also a god who had only recently broken through.
Currently, his Divine Kingdom was in a phase of rapid development.
During this period, while enjoying the Han Family’s subsidies, he was also investing in his Divine Kingdom and had taken on an internal auditing job for the Han Family.
His purpose was very simple: to earn more Divinity Points so that his Divine Kingdom could grow rapidly.
As for actively launching a Divine Kingdom War?
Han Jue had not considered it at all for the time being.
At the very least, he would have to wait for seven or eight years to pass in the Real World, until the development of his Divine Kingdom reached a bottleneck.
Only then would he consider looking for a suitable target.
After all, the risk of a Divine Kingdom War was too high.
Even the Geniuses of the Five Great Families would not be confident enough to easily risk their futures.
