Is he crazy?”
Countless questions flashed through Han Jue’s mind.
Han Jue himself was also a god who had only recently broken through.
Currently, his Divine Kingdom was in a phase of rapid development.
During this period, while enjoying the Han Family’s subsidies, he was also investing in his Divine Kingdom and had taken on an internal auditing job for the Han Family.
His purpose was very simple: to earn more Divinity Points so that his Divine Kingdom could grow rapidly.
As for actively launching a Divine Kingdom War?
Han Jue had not considered it at all for the time being.
At the very least, he would have to wait for seven or eight years to pass in the Real World, until the development of his Divine Kingdom reached a bottleneck.
Only then would he consider looking for a suitable target.
After all, the risk of a Divine Kingdom War was too high.
Even the Geniuses of the Five Great Families would not be confident enough to easily risk their futures.

chapters.title: Chapter 398: Devouring the Divine Kingdom Core
paragraphs: Thinking of this, Han Jue could not help but smile bitterly.
“Freak...”
“We are both Peerless Prodigies, so how is this guy so fierce?”
“And how is he so bold?”
He could not even help but swallow hard.
However, Han Jue’s gaze soon became firm.
“No, I must find an opportunity to establish contact with him.”
“With such potential...”
“He will definitely become a truly prominent figure in the federation in the future.”
“He is worth befriending deeply.”
As an heir nurtured by the Five Great Families, Han Jue knew very well.
A truly top-tier god never grows up alone, but has their own circle.
Thinking of this, Han Jue immediately gave an order.
“intelligent lifeform, immediately investigate Yang Fan’s basic information on the frontline.”
“Including his residence in the Real World, as well as everything that has happened since he arrived at the frontline.”
“Yes.”
The intelligent lifeform immediately responded.
As one of the Five Great Families, the Han Family possessed extremely strong influence on the frontline.
Although under the supervision of the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence, core secrets involving Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom talent and Divine Kingdom area could not be queried.
But his residence in the Real World, his recent activity trajectory, and publicly known events...
...were not difficult for the Han Family to investigate.
Han Jue’s purpose was also very simple.
As a descendant of a great Clan, the development of the Divine Kingdom was indeed important.
But connections were equally important.
Right now, he and Yang Fan...
One was the Peerless Prodigy of the Han Family.
The other was the Peerless Prodigy supported by the Gu Family.
Both were top newcomers within the system of the Five Great Families.
They could completely cooperate in the future, whether it was jointly investing in Divine Kingdoms, teaming up to conquer Alien Divine Kingdoms, or even exploring unknown Secret Realms.
All of these held immense value.
On the other side.
Yang Fan did not know that Han Jue, whom he had only met once at the Primordial Academy, had already noticed him.
At this moment, all his attention was focused on the mountain of Divine Kingdom Cores piled up before him.
Looking at these Resources that represented future growth potential, Yang Fan could not help but lick his lips.
Then, he slowly closed his eyes.
In the next moment.
The Divine Kingdom Core belonging to the Angel Race god began to vibrate violently.
The originally hundred-zhang-sized Divine Kingdom Core seemed to be drawn by some kind of force and began to shrink continuously.
Ultimately, it turned into a beam of brilliant light and fused into Yang Fan’s body.
Boom!!!
In an instant.
Yang Fan only felt as if his consciousness was enveloped by endless energy, and an indescribable sensation of comfort instantly swept through his entire body.
His spirit, Physical Body, soul, and even the very essence of his life began to undergo a frantic transformation at this moment.
That feeling was like a living being that had been starving for countless years suddenly devouring an incredibly sumptuous feast.
Every cell and every spiritual thought greedily absorbed the power contained within.
Yang Fan could even clearly feel that his life level was continuously rising.
His perception of the laws of heaven and earth was also strengthening at an astonishing speed.
This feeling...
It was too comfortable, too intoxicating.
It was as if his entire life was being sublimated.
It was as if with every breath, he was closer to the essence of a god than in the past.
This was the improvement brought about by absorbing a Divine Kingdom Core.
When he first absorbed a demigod’s Divine Kingdom Core, Yang Fan had experienced this indescribable pleasure.
Experiencing it again now still left him utterly intoxicated.
At the same time.
The Angel Race Divine Kingdom, which had already lost the control of its god, also began to undergo changes.
With the Divine Kingdom Core devoured, the entire Divine Kingdom was like a world that had lost the pillars supporting heaven and earth.
Large amounts of land began to collapse, and space began to shatter.
But in the next moment.
Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom power instantly descended.
Streams of invisible law power pulled the land of the Angel Race Divine Kingdom.
Spanning across space, it fused toward the direction of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
Rumble!
A vast amount of land appeared at the outermost periphery of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
Then, like pieces of a puzzle, it was embedded and fused bit by bit.
Becoming a part of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
[Divine Kingdom area increased by 10 million square kilometers!]
[Divine Kingdom area increased by 20 million square kilometers!]
[Divine Kingdom area increased by 50 million square kilometers!]
The Divine Kingdom area continuously grew.
And with the addition of a vast amount of new land, the incredibly dense Spiritual Qi originally within Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom also began to be continuously diluted.
After all, the newly fused regions essentially still belonged to the former Alien Divine Kingdom.
There was a huge gap between its environment and Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
However, under the effect of the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, these regions were rapidly changing.
Spiritual Qi began to recover, plants began to grow, and the land began to nurture life.
The entire barren region was transforming toward the ecology of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
This process lasted for a full half-hour.
Ultimately, all the changes gradually subsided.
Yang Fan slowly opened his eyes.
Exhaling a long breath, a trace of hard-to-conceal pleasure appeared on his face.
“Comfortable.”
Feeling the even more abundant power within his body, Yang Fan could not help but sigh.
Then, he subconsciously looked at his Divine Kingdom information.
[Divine Kingdom Area: 10.8 billion square kilometers]
[Divine Kingdom Talent: [A-rank Spiritual Body, C-rank Attribute Affinity]...
“10.8 billion square kilometers. It increased by nearly 800 million.”
Yang Fan said softly.
“Not bad.”
Yang Fan was not too disappointed with this result.
Because he knew very well that as his own Divine Kingdom area grew larger and larger,
...the improvement brought about by devouring other Divine Kingdom Cores would also become lower and lower.
This was an inevitable law.
He had seen a similar theory in the Primordial Academy’s library in the past.
The growth of a Divine Kingdom is fastest in the early stages.
Because the Divine Kingdom area is small, a large amount of amplification can be obtained when fusing other Divine Kingdoms.
But as the Divine Kingdom area continuously expands, the improvement brought by each devouring will decrease exponentially.
Just like this time, that Angel Race god’s Divine Kingdom area exceeded 15 billion square kilometers.
But the region Yang Fan ultimately fused was only about 5% of the other party’s total Divine Kingdom area.
This was still because Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom area was only at the ten-billion level.
If his Divine Kingdom reached 300 billion square kilometers in the future, devouring a Divine Kingdom Core of the same scale...
...being able to increase it by 1% would probably be considered not bad.
To continue growing rapidly, he would definitely need to challenge even more powerful Foreign Deitys in the future.
As for the newly added C-rank talent, Yang Fan was likewise not disappointed, finding it quite normal instead.
This indicated that the Angel Race god had a high probability of possessing some kind of A-rank Talent that increased the growth speed of believers.
One must know that whether it was the Human race or alien races,
looking across the entire Universe, gods possessing A-rank Divine Kingdom talents were extremely scarce in number.
Previously, Yang Fan was able to come into contact with a large number of S-rank and SS-rank Talent possessors...
...not because there were many top geniuses in this world,
but because the place he was in was different.
The Primordial Academy was a top-tier academy that recruited students from the entire Human Federation.
Those who could enter it were already the elite among billions of lives.
There, A-rank Talents could only be considered excellent, S-rank Talents were the true geniuses, and SS-rank Talents were as rare as phoenix feathers and unicorn horns.

chapters.title: Chapter 399: Talent Fusion
paragraphs: But now that he had come to the war Frontline and faced that massive population base,
Yang Fan truly realized that ordinary gods were the main body of this world.
The vast majority of gods only possessed A-rank or B-rank talents.
Even most of those Divine Beings in the federation production bases probably only had D-rank or F-rank talents.
True top geniuses would always be a tiny minority.
“Next up are the Divine Kingdom Cores of these demigods.”
Yang Fan looked at the piled-up Divine Kingdom Cores before him, a flash of anticipation in his eyes.
“Although the area of these demigods’ divine kingdoms offers very limited improvement for me now, the divine kingdom talents contained within are the truly precious things!”
Especially this time, many of them came from demigods of the Alien Divine Realm Zone of the Two Major Academies.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan slowly extended his right hand.
In the next moment, the Divine Kingdom Cores seemed to be drawn by an invisible force, instantly floating up before turning into streams of light and rapidly merging into Yang Fan’s body.
Meanwhile.
Within the divine kingdom world.
One by one, the demigods’ Small Worlds began to collapse.

Under the guidance of Yang Fan’s Origin Evolution talent, those divine kingdom lands that originally belonged to different races traversed space, continuously merging toward the outer edges of his divine kingdom.
Rumble!
Large swathes of land, like pieces of a jigsaw puzzle, slotted into the edges of Yang Fan’s divine kingdom.
Some divine kingdoms were larger, bringing tens of thousands of square kilometers of expansion.
Others belonged to weaker demigods, with divine kingdoms of only a few thousand square kilometers.
But regardless of size, under Yang Fan’s currently vast divine kingdom area, they were merely icing on the cake.
Meanwhile, as the Divine Kingdom Cores were absorbed one by one, the talent Origins contained within them also began to be analyzed by Yang Fan’s Origin Evolution talent.
Lines of information constantly surfaced.

[S-rank Talent Growth of All Things, A-rank Talent Spiritual Vein Nourishment, A-rank Talent Abundant Resources, B-rank Talent Spirit Plant Catalysis, C-rank Talent Spiritual Qi Gathering, F-rank Talent Resources...]
[A-rank Talent Spiritual Body, A-rank Talent Spiritual Qi Perception, B-rank Talent Lightning, C-rank Talent Attribute Affinity... F-rank Talent Low-level Element Adaptation...]
[A-rank Talent Divine Craftsman, B-rank Talent Mechanical Modification, C-rank Talent Materials Analysis... F-rank Talent Basic Craftsmanship]
[B-rank Talent Procreation, A-rank Talent Life Reproduction, C-rank Talent Fertility Enhancement, F-rank Talent Ordinary Reproduction...]
[A-rank Talent Battle Body, A-rank Talent Undying Battle Physique, A-rank Talent Berserk Battle Soul, B-rank Talent Combat Instinct, C-rank Talent Endurance Boost, F-rank Talent Basic Physique...]
[B-rank Talent Alchemical Spirit Heart, C-rank Talent Alchemical Heart]
[B-rank Talent Array Deciphering, C-rank Talent Array Dao]
Lines of talent information constantly flashed past.
After a long time, all the Divine Kingdom Cores were finally completely absorbed.
Yang Fan opened his eyes and looked at his talent list, but a faint trace of disappointment flashed across his face.
“Sure enough... still no S-rank Talent.”
Although he had harvested quite a few A-rank talents this time, it was still a bit short of the result he had anticipated.

“Although these Alien Demigods have been in the Two Major Academies for so many years and experienced countless wars, Peerless Prodigies who truly possess SS-rank Talents are indeed not that easy to fall.”
Yang Fan sighed softly.
He knew very well that although Origin Evolution was powerful, it was not an unconditional duplication.
There was a massive loss in the process, though even if they were both of the Human race, the loss would be significantly lower.
But if he wanted to obtain an S-rank Talent, the Divine Kingdom Cores he devoured had to at least come from gods or demigods who possessed SS-rank Talents.
And geniuses of this level were themselves the very top existences of the entire federation.
Even in places like the Primordial Academy and Star Dome Academy, they were the key investment targets of the Five Great Families.
Once they entered the Alien Divine Realm Zone, they usually had powerful resource support behind them.
Even if they encountered an unbeatable enemy, they could rely on various trump cards to buy time until the academy rescued them or they graduated and left.
Obtaining the [S-rank Talent Growth of All Things] last time was a complete coincidence in itself.
He just happened to encounter an unlucky fellow with an SS-rank resource-type talent who had been defeated by that monkey, Qi Tian.
This kind of Fortune could not last forever.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan frowned slightly.
“Should I let Niu Tou and Ma Mian challenge the demigods in the Level 3 Area?”
“There are more valuable Divine Kingdom Cores there.”
But soon, Yang Fan fell into hesitation again.
“But doing this, wouldn’t it cause too much of a stir?”
After all, Niu Tou and Ma Mian only had A-rank talents.
If they really succeeded in conquering the Alien Demigods in the Level 3 Area, it would inevitably attract the attention of the Two Major Academies and even the entire federation.
After all, the Alien Demigods of the Level 3 Area were no longer existences that ordinary geniuses could touch.
That was a battlefield belonging to Peerless Prodigies.
“No.”
Yang Fan pondered for a moment and ultimately shook his head.
“The Divine Kingdom Cores possessed by those demigods in the academy’s Alien Divine Realm Zone are too important to me. At least in the short term, I can’t do this; there’s a risk of exposure.”
“If only I could recruit some Human race Prodigies, or even geniuses of the Peerless Prodigy level, to work for me.”
Yang Fan leaned back on his divine throne, murmuring softly.
But soon, he shook his head again.
“The current Yang Corporation still can’t achieve this.”
Existences at the level of a Human Race Prodigy would almost always become the targets of contention for various factions.
The Five Great Families naturally went without saying; they themselves possessed massive resource systems and cultivation channels.
Beyond that, those large corporations capable of listing on the main board of the Human Federation would also throw out olive branches.
Although the current Yang Corporation was developing rapidly and was already of considerable size,
there was still a significant gap compared to those true behemoths.
Relying purely on throwing money to get those prodigies destined to become powerful gods in the future to join was unrealistic.
After all, for these people, money was only one factor.
Future development platforms, social networks, and resource channels were equally extremely important.
“Let’s take it slow.”
Yang Fan withdrew his thoughts.
“The current development speed of the Yang Corporation is already fast enough. Once it truly grows in the future, there will naturally be more opportunities.”
Yang Fan stopped overthinking and turned his gaze to the divine kingdom talent column.
“Begin merging divine kingdom talents.”
As Yang Fan’s thought fell, the Origin Evolution talent instantly activated.
In the next moment.
Only Yang Fan and Yang Da could sense it.
The very essence of the entire divine kingdom began to undergo subtle changes.
Invisibly, lines of talent Origins began to merge.
Some talent Origins merged into original talents, making them even more powerful.
Some talent Origins combined with each other to form brand-new talents.
Boom!
The entire divine kingdom seemed to vibrate slightly at this moment.
Although the vast number of believers could not sense the specific changes, they felt in the dark that the laws of heaven and earth seemed to have become more complete.
The circulation of Spiritual Qi became smoother, and cultivation efficiency also showed a subtle increase.

chapters.title: Chapter 400: Too Many Resources
paragraphs: This process did not last very long.
Just a few breaths later, the Fusion of all Talents was already complete.
Yang Fan slowly opened his eyes and cast his gaze toward the Divine Kingdom information panel.
“Divine Master: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: 10.8 billion square kilometers
SSS-Rank Talent: Evolution [First Divine Authority: Time Evolution (one hundred times); Second Divine Authority: Origin Evolution]
[S-rank Talent Growth of All Things] [A-rank Talent All Things Spirit Body] [A-rank Talent Ingenuity] [A-rank Talent Life Reproduction]
[A-rank Talent Undying Body] [B-rank Talent Alchemical Spirit Heart] [B-rank Talent Formation Resolution]

Believers: Nascent Soul (4.78 million), Core Formation (5.8 billion)... Martial King (6.8 billion)... Fourth-class intelligent lifeform (290 million), Third-class intelligent lifeform (18.9 billion)... White Zombie (8.9 billion)...
Occupations: Alchemist (56.6 billion)...
Dependents: Elven Warriors (86.5 billion)
Techniques: Four Symbols Heaven Evolution Array (B-rank, Mastery)...
Divinity Points: 983 trillion (Reality provides 1,789 Divinity Points daily)

Buildings: Fountain of Life X6 million, War God Codex (S-rank), Heavenly Court X8 (S-rank), Goddess of Wisdom (S-rank), Eternal Corpse Mine (S-rank), World Tree (S-rank), Alchemy Spirit World (S-rank), Great Void Warship X154 (S-rank), Mechanical War Puppet X178 (S-rank), God-Slaying Tower X198 (S-rank), Immortal Army Soul Stele X209 (S-rank), Flesh Scourge Mother Nest X258 (S-rank), Sanctuary of Myriad Paths of Evolution X13 (S-rank), Nine Nether River X17 (S-rank), Life Essence Conversion Pool X2 (S-rank), Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest X271,000 (S-rank), Ancient Tree of Enlightenment X188,000 (S-rank)... Alchemy Tower X10 million (B-rank)...
Wonders: Omitted
Assets: Spirit-Plant Planet X600, Mineral Vein Star X70, Fourth-class Smart Weapon X18.4 billion... Cloning Nutrient Pod X300 billion...”
After fusing so many Talents, the resource-type Talent [Growth of All Things] was still S-rank.
However, Yang Fan could feel that the current Growth of All Things Talent had clearly grown quite a bit.
If it could previously bring a ten-fold resource amplification, then it should now have reached eleven-fold or even twelve-fold.
However, he long ago stopped calculating these things in detail.
Because the Divinity Points earned by the Divine Kingdom every day were simply too much, the so-called multiplier increase was nothing more than a numerical change to him.
The changes to the other Talents were likewise not significant.
The Cultivate-type Talent [Spirit Body] evolved into [All Things Spirit Body], while the combat-type Talent [Battle Body] transformed into [Undying Body].
The strength of both had improved, but they still belonged to the category of A-rank Talents.
As for what the specific effects were like, they would have to wait for the new batch of believers in the Divine Kingdom to be born and gradually manifest during the long Evolution process.
Only during the next Divine Kingdom War could their true power be tested.
As for the Divine Kingdom’s buildings, S-rank war building like the Great Void Warship were continuously purchased by Yang Fan through the Dark Web, and their numbers had also been growing steadily.
The one with the greatest change was still the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest.
Because of Lu Yanran, the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest now covered almost one-tenth of the area of the entire Divine Kingdom Core region.
For Yang Fan now, this type of resource-based building was long no longer just a tool for making money.

Compared to the profits brought by the Divine Kingdom’s investments, what he valued more was the enhancement to the entire Divine Kingdom’s environment after the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest replaced the Spirit Vein.
After all, as an S-rank resource-based building, the spiritual energy of heaven and earth it nurtured was far from comparable to ordinary Spirit Veins.
Now, under the joint blessing of the hundred-fold Time Evolution and the S-rank [Growth of All Things] Talent, the Divine Kingdom’s resource output was at a thousand-fold level.
Every month, Earth Core Spirit Milk alone could produce a value of up to 271 trillion Divinity Points, and enlightenment tea similarly exceeded 100 trillion.
Besides this, the Divine Kingdom also continuously produced a large amount of Spirit Stones, Medicinal Pills, and weapons and equipment every month.
However, Yang Fan did not convert these Resources into Divinity Points.
All produced materials were classified and stored under the arrangement of Yang Yi, serving as strategic reserves for the Divine Kingdom’s future wars.
After all, nowadays, even for Earth Core Spirit Milk and enlightenment tea, Yang Fan only dared to control the monthly sales volume at around 100 trillion.
On the one hand, he was worried that the volume was too large and would impact market prices;
On the other hand, it was also to avoid attracting the attention of interested parties.
As for other Resources, in his eyes, they were naturally just trivial gains.
Nowadays, the sales scale of the Yang Corporation was also gradually touching a bottleneck.
Several months ago, Ma Yu had reported to Yang Fan that the sales channels currently controlled by the group were approaching their limit.
If they wanted to continue expanding the sales volume of Earth Core Spirit Milk and enlightenment tea, they either had to actively lower prices or find new buyers.
However, Ma Yu analyzed in the report that the two Resources were high-grade strategic Resources in short supply.
The Yang Corporation was not lacking in funds in the short term, so he suggested maintaining the original price and only appropriately reducing the sales quantity.
In response to this, Yang Fan simply replied with a sentence: “Follow your own ideas.”
Whether selling these Resources for cash or keeping them in the warehouse as fixed assets, it did not make much difference to Yang Fan now.
Now, with the Divine Shop channels and the Yang Corporation’s sales channels operating simultaneously, the Divine Kingdom’s monthly output could still only consume a small portion of it.
As of now, the Divinity Points grasped in Yang Fan’s hands were already close to one quadrillion.
Moreover, the total value of various high-grade Resources such as Earth Core Spirit Milk and enlightenment tea stored within the Divine Kingdom exceeded two quadrillion Divinity Points.
Furthermore, at the Divine Kingdom’s current production speed, this inventory would only become more and more massive.
Compared to selling Resources, what consumed the most of these high-grade Resources nowadays was actually the believers within the Divine Kingdom.
Since high-grade Resources like Earth Core Spirit Milk were not lacking at all, ordinary intelligent lifeform like Yang Yi still kept the habit of careful calculation.
But Yang Da, who deeply understood the Divine Kingdom’s production capacity, directly used these Resources as rewards to motivate all believers.
Feeling that you are about to breakthrough?
You can apply to receive Earth Core Spirit Milk and enlightenment tea.
Successfully breakthrough the Realm?
You can similarly receive rewards.
Creating a new Pill Formula, or achieving a breakthrough in aspects like Alchemy, forging, or Formation, can also be reported to receive rewards.
In order to allow the Divine Kingdom’s believers to combine work and rest while further enhancing their enthusiasm for Cultivate and work.
Yang Da even specially purchased a complete calendar system from the Divine Shop and promoted it throughout the entire Divine Kingdom.
As time passed, Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had long formed its own unique civilization system.
Here, there were holidays, study days, and it even derived a Divine Thanksgiving Day.
These festivals were not artificially stipulated, but were cultural customs spontaneously formed by the believers as civilization continuously evolved.
And whenever these festivals occurred, Yang Da would always distribute high-grade Resources such as Earth Core Spirit Milk as rewards in the name of divine blessings.
Of course, the number of believers in the Divine Kingdom was simply too huge; it was impossible for everyone to receive blessings.
Only those high-grade believers with outstanding contributions and powerful strength were qualified to obtain precious Resources like Earth Core Spirit Milk.

Precisely because of this, the Cultivate enthusiasm of those believers who had not yet reached the standard rose even higher, and the entire Divine Kingdom always maintained a positive and upward competitive atmosphere.
